title: Siivooja, Siivouspalvelut Mikkelin alue
description:
Primary location:

MIKKELI

Haemme siivoojaa Osuuskauppa Suur-Savon Siivouspalveluihin Mikkelin alueelle toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen, jossa työtunnit ovat keskimäärin 60 h/ 3 viikossa. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

Me Suur-Savossa sanomme olevamme Ihan tavallisissa töissä. Työtä kuvaillaan usein erilaisin korulausein, jotka toivottavasti ovat myös totta, mutta meidän mielestämme ihan tavallinen työ on mahtavaa. Meillä on myös poikkeuksellisen kivoja työkavereita, erinomaisia henkilöstöetuja ja harvinaisen paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia.

Siivouspalveluissa työ on nopeatempoista, joten toivomme ripeää työskentelyotetta ja halua ottaa vastuuta oman työpäivän tehokkaaseen organisointiin vaihtuvissa kohteissamme. Siivousalan kokemuksesta on etua. Toivomme sinulta myös joustavuutta ja halua tehdä vaihtelevaa vuorotyötä, työvuorot alkavat useimmiten aikaisin aamulla. Työssä siivotaan hotellihuoneita ja hotellin yhteisiä tiloja, toimialueeseemme kuuluu myös muita ravintoloita ja myymälöitä Mikkelin alueella. Liikkuaksesi toimipisteiden välillä, tarvitset ajokortin ja auton. Työssä tarvitaan suomen tai englannin kielen taitoa.

Palkkaus tässä työssä on MaraTES:in mukainen. Meillä panostetaan työntekijöidemme työhyvinvointiin ja tarjoamme esimerkiksi laajan työterveyshuollon sekä vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksen. Työsuhteesi aikana pääset myös tulospalkkauksen piiriin ja saat käyttöösi Suomen monipuolisimmat henkilöstöedut. Osuuskauppa Suur-Savon työntekijänä olet oikeutettu saamaan alennusta S-ryhmän ravintoloista ja ABC:ltä -25% ravintolalaskun loppusummasta, S-ryhmän myymälöistä jopa -15%, autopesuista -50%, Sokoksen käyttötavaroista -20%.

Haku on avoinna 20.8.2026 saakka. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja etenemme tarvittaessa hakuprosessissa ennen hakuajan umpeutumista. Jos haluat liittyä Mikkelin Siivouspalveluiden huipputiimiin, lähetä sähköinen hakemuksesi nyt!

Lisätietoja työtehtävästä antaa siivouspäällikkö Katja Kiiliäinen puh: 010 7640136

Osuuskauppa Suur-Savon Siivouspalveluiden tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on auttaa hotelleitamme, ravintoloitamme ja myymälöitämme tarjoamaan täydellinen asiakaskokemus vieraillemme. Haluamme tehdä sen näkyvästi ja ylpeinä osaamisestamme. Toimialueemme Mikkelissä kuuluu Original Sokos Hotel Vaakuna sekä Osuuskauppa Suur-Savon toimipaikat Mikkelissä.

title: Project Control Analyst- CORP
description:
Project Control Analyst

Full Time Alexandria, VA

Job Description:

A Project Control Analyst is part of the Project Management Team and assists the Program Manager to ensure the project stays within budget and is completed on time. As a Project Control Analyst, accurate records of expenditures and timelines must be kept, regulatory compliance of each phase must be tracked, and any market changes that may affect the project must be monitored. The Junior Project Control Analyst assists in compiling this data and processes reports for management to determine whether changes should be made to the project.

  • Generate regular reports on project performance, trends, and forecasts, utilizing data to provide insights and recommendations.
  • Supports and consults with project managers and deployment managers on project issues, status and tracking requirements
  • Helps identify ways to reduce costs while improving control measures
  • Analyze and interpret complex financial data, understand project financial fundamentals, and perform scenario analysis.
  • Implement reporting procedures to review project status and valuation of work in progress, tracking procedures for contract deliverables
  • Gather all necessary documentation, such as timesheets, expense reports, and progress reports, to prepare accurate invoices for the client; Generate and submit client invoices according to the project's billing schedule.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelors Degree in Business, Computer Science, Marketing or other related field. An additional two years of relevant experience can be substituted for the degree.
  • 5+ years cradle to grave project controls and analysis including project billing/charging setup, baseline vs actual analysis, and variance analysis
  • Implements project plans under the direction of others in the project
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite
  • Proficiency in project accounting software such as Unanet a plus.
  • Strong financial knowledge and experience managing government contracts, cost controls, and project budgets
  • Proficient with MS Excel including pivot tables, vlookups, formulas, index match, conditional formatting, filter, etc
  • Proven ability to supervise and mentor staff, with a thorough understanding of industry-standard project controls practices

title: Transportation Supervisor
location: USVI Transportation - St. Thomas, US Virgin Islands 00802
description:
The Transportation Supervisor plays a crucial role in ensuring the smooth and efficient operations of RED Car USVI. This position is responsible for a variety of administrative and logistical tasks, supporting the Transportation Manager and collaborating with other departments to maintain high standards of service and operational efficiency. He/she will assist with scheduling, reconciliation, and various ground-based logistics, while fostering a positive and inclusive team culture.

Administrative Support

  • Assist in all transportation administrative needs, including private VIP transfers and requests from other departments or locations.

  • Ensure all charges are properly recorded and reconciled.

  • Support the cruise ship operation by ensuring updates are accurate in FareHarbor.

  • Report any employee or vendor issues to the Transportation Manager for follow-up.

Scheduling & Operations

  • Create the weekly schedule for dispatchers, drivers, and vehicles by EOD on Thursday the week prior.

  • Load the schedule into Paycom.

  • Assign drivers and vehicles to trips in TripWorks based on the schedule.

  • Review all next day's bookings and assignments for accuracy the night before.

  • Confirm assignments in the Red Transportation Chat.

  • Collaborate with the DMC team on group guest movements, including airport meet and greets, hotel arrivals and departures, and activities as assigned by the Transportation Manager.

  • Drive vehicles and dispatch as assigned by the Transportation Manager.

  • Assist as assigned with any ground-based logistics in support of RED's USVI operations, which may include the movement of goods and/or associates.

Reconciliation & Accounting

  • Review the underpaid report daily and follow up on collecting payment.

  • Cancel transient bookings with no payment if no payment is received within 24 hours.

  • Monitor the AMEX Buoy Haus program’s bookings for accuracy.

  • Ensure that all TripWorks driver assignments are accurate and that a driver and vehicle has been correctly assigned to each individual per booking.

  • Ensure that all DMC bookings are assigned appropriately.

  • Monitor upcoming transfers related to group travel and flag any issues to the Transportation Manager.

  • Track the status of DMC groups to ensure accuracy against the A&D.

  • Work with DMC coordinators to ensure that allocation is completed accurately.

  • Receive invoices from third-party vendors.

  • Reconcile trips in invoices to TripWorks for accuracy.

  • Send reconciliation to the Department Manager for final approval.

  • Compile a monthly report on Amex Usage for the Buoy Haus Amex program.

  • Send the monthly report to the Manager for final approval.

  • Bill the Buoy Haus Amex TripWorks Account once approved.

  • Send payment email to Buoy Haus for payment and follow up with the Buoy Haus team on payment.

Communication & Culture

  • Create a positive culture of inclusion and support between the transportation team.

  • Communicate effectively and respectfully with the Call Center, team members, vendors, and guests.

title: Lähihoitaja / hoiva-avustaja / sairaanhoitaja (keikkatyö), Mainiokoti Jussoila, Rauma
description:
Lähihoitaja / hoiva-avustaja / sairaanhoitaja (keikkatyö), Mainiokoti Jussoila, Rauma

Tule mukaan rakentamaan kodin tuntua Mainiokoti Jussoilaan Raumalle!

Haemme tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttavia lähihoitajia, hoiva-avustajia ja sairaanhoitajia mukaan sijaisrinkiimme.

Mihin tulet töihin?
Mainiokoti Jussoila tarjoaa ympärivuorokautista hoivaa ja huolenpitoa ikääntyneille. Mainiokotimme sijaitsee kauniissa ympäristössä, aivan Rauman keskustan sekä Vanhan Rauman tuntumassa, vanhaa Rautatieasemaa vastapäätä. Meillä työskentelee iloinen joukko monipuolisia ammattilaisia.

Mitä pääset tekemään?
Hoitajana pääset tekemään jokapäiväistä hoitotyötä ja kehittämään yksikkömme toimintaa yhteistyössä muiden tiimiläisten kanssa. Arkemme on toiminnallista ja järjestämme jatkuvasti aktiviteetteja asukkaillemme.

Kuka sinä olet?
Olet koulutukseltasi lähihoitaja / hoiva-avustaja / sairaanhoitaja tai opintojesi loppusuoralle ennättänyt opiskelija. Joukossamme viihtyy parhaiten positiivisesti asioihin suhtautuva ja oma-aloitteinen henkilö, joka on aidosti kiinnostunut mielenterveystyöstä. Vanhustyön osaaminen katsotaan eduksesi. Hoitotyön tehtävien hoitaminen edellyttää vähintään B1 jaavustavien tehtävien hoitaminen edellyttää vähintään A2 tai vastaavaa suomen kielen kielitaitotasoa,sekä sitoutumista kielitaidon ylläpitämiseen.

Miksi tulisit meille töihin?
Mainiokoti Jussoilassa pääset osaksi yhteen hiileen puhaltavaa työyhteisöä, jossa töitä tehdään hymy huulilla. Olemme joustava työnantaja ja otamme huomioon henkilökunnan yksilölliset toiveet työvuorosuunnittelussa.

Tulevien työkavereiden mietteitä:
"Työyhteisömme on tiivis ja huumorintajuinen. Jokainen saa olla meillä oma itsensä. Työkavereilta saa aina apua, ketään ei jätetä yksin."

Työ on 2- 3-vuorotyötä ja tehtävän palkkaus on yksityisen sosiaalialan TES:n mukainen. Tehtävä on keikkatyösuhde.

Sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti tehtävään valittavien ikääntyvien tai vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työskentelevien on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitetturikosrekisteriote. Työ edellyttää tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotesuojaa, tuberkuloosiselvitystä ja salmonellatodistusta sekä voimassa olevaa Suosikki/Terhikkirekisteröintiä, ammattikorttia ja hygieniapassia.

Hae tehtävää rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta mahdollisimman pian. Toimithan nopeasti, sillä täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löytyessä. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

Kerron mielelläni lisää:
Yksikönjohtaja Marika Uusitalo
puh. 050 386 9199 (arkisin klo 8–16)
marika.uusitalo1@mainiokodit.fi

Sen tuntee, kun tulee kotiin.

Mainiokotien missiona on luoda parempaa hoitoa Suomeen mahdollistamalla jokaiselle asukkaalle yksilöllinen ja hyvä elämä. Panostamme Mainiokodeissa laadukkaaseen hoivaan, hoitoon ja ohjaukseen, maukkaaseen ruokaan, turvallisuuteen, yhteisöllisyyteen sekä siihen, että jokaisella asiakkaalla on oma viihtyisä koti. Mainiokotien brändin symboli, räsymatto, kuvaa koko elämän kirjoa iloineen ja suruineen.

Mainiokodit on osa Mehiläistä. Mehiläisen sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluiden ammattilaiset työskentelevät joka päivä tinkimättömästi yksityis-, yritys- ja hyvinvointialueasiakkaidemme hyväksi. Tervetuloa mukaan vahvistamaan ammattilaistemme joukkoa!

title: Crisis Care Center RN - PRN
company: JEFFERSON BLOUNT ST CLAIR MENTAL HEALTH AUTHORITY
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Crisis Care Center Registered Nurse

Crisis Care Center

RN

The Crisis Care Center is designed to provide crisis stabilization to individuals experiencing a behavioral health and/or substance use crisis and reduce pressure on law enforcement and local emergency departments. Once the crisis has been resolved and the individual has been stabilized, they will be linked with a community mental health provider for on-going services. This position is a direct service provider for the Crisis Care Center. The individual hired for this position is responsible for the coordination of medical, nursing and program services for individuals with mental health, substance use, and co-occurring disorders. The individual hired will be responsible for the initial nursing assessment of clients when they present to the Crisis Care Center to assure stabilization. This individual will also interpret medical information and assist or administer medications.

Supervised by: Nurse Manager

Employees Supervised: None

Division: Crisis Care Center

Shift: 7:00 pm-7:30 am (3-12 hour shifts weekly which includes every other

weekend)

PRIMARY JOB FUNCTIONS:

Complete all admission and discharge paperwork including nursing assessments, physical assessments on individuals with mental health/substance abuse symptoms exhibiting a state of crisis and needs with development of nursing care plans

Obtain medical histories and provide medical screening

Monitor, record and report symptoms and changes in individuals' conditions by observation using proper nursing care to the Provider and Nurse Manager and document individual progress or lack thereof

Responsible for updating the initial treatment plan with any medical issues, in conjunction with other staff

Complete required daily shift note for all individuals on Extended Observation

Ensure all chart checks, CIWA, COWS, vitals are completed on the shift and all required logs (refrigerator, temperature logs) are updated on the sift

Transcribe orders if needed

Coordinate and implement discharge plans to outside community agencies and providers

Follow-up on medical concerns by providing direct nursing services to clients

Monitors with or without observation, withdrawal complications, possible medication side effects and emerging symptoms of mental illness

Demonstrate competency for Blood Glucose Monitoring, Alcohol Breathalyzer, Urine Drug Screen, Pregnancy Test, and PPD skin tests

Monitor and document all ordered labs, screenings, and results such as PPD, Blood Glucose, UA, RPR, Blood Chem, and CBC

Perform safe phlebotomy practices when drawing blood labs

Provides health education to groups and/or individuals

Maintains up to date, well documented medical records in compliance with state and program requirements

Participates in case reviews as a member of the multidisciplinary team

Administers medications and conducts audits on medication record documents to ensure accountability and compliance with medical direction

Intervene, stabilize and manage acute crisis situations as needed

Assist with seclusions and restraints when necessary and complete all required paperwork (i.e. seclusion/restraint packets and incident reports by the end of the shift)

Other duties and tasks as assigned

JOB DESCRIPTION, Crisis Care Center RN

Perform all administrative duties as required

Other duties as assigned

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

Registered nurse with a current Alabama Nursing license

Two years’ experience working with serious mental illness and/or substance use populations preferred

Familiarity with psychotropic and neuroleptic drugs, their uses as well as potential side effects

Valid American Red Cross CPR/First Aid certification

Valid Alabama driver’s license

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, & ABILITIES:

Knowledge of the seriously mentally ill and substance use population

Knowledge of special needs and behavioral characteristics of the seriously mentally ill and/or substance use adult population

Assessment skills in the areas of physical and mental status

Familiarity with psychotropic and neuroleptic drugs, their uses, and potential side effects

Knowledge and ability to properly administer psychotropic/neuroleptic drugs as ordered by the prescriber

Knowledge of legal and ethical issues relative to confidentiality of client records and the ability to interpret and apply them within the scope of the nursing responsibilities

Working knowledge of clinical interviewing techniques and principles

Effective communication skills, written and expressive

Ability and willingness to document activities and maintain records in the electronic health record

Trained in or willing to be trained in crisis intervention, specifically Therapeutic Options

title: Hyllyttäjä, Hanko
description:
Millaisesta työstä on kyse?

Joblinkilla hyllytystiimissä teet työtä joko vaihtelevissa kaupan alan kohteissa tai tietyn tiimin kohteessa. Työvuorot varaat kätevästi Joblinkin sovelluksella. Vuorot jaetaan pääsääntöisesti pidemmälle ajalle eteenpäin, mutta lisävuoroja on mahdollisesti tarjolla myös lyhyellä varoitusajalla.

On hyvä tietää, että hyllytystyötä tehdään kauppaan saapuvien kuormien mukaisesti – työntekijätarve vaihtelee kuormien suuruuden mukaisesti. Sesonkiaikoina kuormat ovat isompia, joten silloin hyllyttäjien tarve on suurempi. Riippuen kohteesta, vuoroja on tarjolla 0-5 vuoroa viikossa. Oma joustavuus, asenne ja aktiivisuus vaikuttaa tarjolla olevien vuorojen määrään.

Hyllyttäjien tehtävänä on hyllyttää päivän saapunut kuorma ohjeistusten mukaisesti. Päivän työlle on tavoiteaika ja työskentelyä mitataan tehokkuudella.

Hyllyttäjän työtehtävässä edellytetään oma-aloitteisuutta, tarkkuutta, järjestelmällisyyttä sekä loogista ajattelukykyä. Työ on fyysistä ja työskentelytahti on todella reipas. Odotamme sinulta tehokasta ja aikaansaavaa otetta työskentelyyn. Hyllytys tapahtuu pääsääntöisesti aamupäivisin alkaen klo 6, joten työ sopii etenkin reippaille aamuvirkuille. Työpäivät sijoittuvat maanantain ja lauantain välille.

Kaikissa kaupan töissä on pohjimmiltaan kyse siitä, että olemme kaupassa asiakasta varten. Toivottavasti siis innostut työstä, jossa on tekemisen meininki, kauniisti järjestetyt hyllyt miellyttävät silmääsi sekä työskentelet itsenäisellä työotteella yhdessä tiimin kanssa.

Ennen ensimmäisiä työvuorojasi saat meiltä tarvittavat eväät työssä onnistumiseen. Sinun ei siis tarvitse pelätä, että joudut altaan syvään päätyyn ilman tarvittavaa osaamista.



Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Sinulla ei tarvitse vielä olla aikaisempaa työkokemusta, vaan reipas asenne ja halu oppia on meille tärkeintä. Aikaisempi päivittäistavarakaupan kokemus on toki hyödyksi, mutta ei missään nimessä edellytys.

Keikkatyöntekijänä viihdyt, jos tykkäät vaihtelusta ja sinulla riittää rohkeutta ottaa haltuun useita eri työkohteita. Toivomme, että sinulla on hyvät sosiaaliset taidot ja innostut uusien ihmisten kohtaamisesta.

Työssä tarvitset sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa, jonka lisäksi odotamme sinulta vähintään 18 vuoden ikää.



Mahdollisuuksia myös pidemmälle

Moni työntekijämme on aloittanut meillä keikkatyön kautta ja löytänyt myöhemmin vakituisen työpaikan. Joblink voi siis olla askel uuteen alkuun tai ponnahduslauta koko kaupan alan uralle.


Tarjoamme

Kaupan alan TES:in mukaisen palkan.

Aikataulujesi mukaan joustavan työn, joka sopii moneen elämäntilanteeseen.

Mahdollisuuden pitää lomaa aina kun haluat.

Arvokasta työ- ja asiakaspalvelukokemusta, josta on hyötyä työssä kuin työssä.

Etenemismahdollisuudet kaupan alan eri tehtäviin ja vakituisiin työsuhteisiin. Meiltä on ponnistettu niin kassakouluttajaksi, tiiminvetäjäksi, myymäläpäälliköksi kuin kauppiaaksikin.

Joblinkin toimistotiimin tuen. Päivystämme 24/7, eli saat meidät kiinni kaikissa tilanteissa, joissa kaipaat tukea ja apua.

location: Grand Rapids - Surefil - Grand Rapids, MI 49512
description:
POSITION SUMMARY: Prioritize daily sample testing and perform a variety of microbiological tests on raw materials and finished batches. Identifies, isolates and studies micro-organisms, bacteria, and their byproducts. Investigate OOS/OOT results and implement any corrective action as determined by QC Management. Aid in training new Associates.

FUNCTIONS OF THE JOB:

1. Behavior: Exhibit team player qualities of cooperation and coordination; professional interaction in all business contacts.

2. Attendance/Punctuality: Presence at work on time when scheduled is a mandatory function

3. Safety: Compliance with all company safety rules, procedures, and guidelines is mandatory.

4. Perform and document testing in accordance with cGMP. Testing includes, but is not limited to, finished product analysis and preparatory testing of newly developed products, raw material analysis, and organism identification.

5. Maintains inventory levels of reagents, media, and stock cultures.

6. Troubleshooting, maintenance, and calibration of laboratory equipment are expected.

7. Organize workload of laboratory and provide management with feedback of overall laboratory performance.

8. Work on special projects as assigned or requested.

9. Modify SOPs as necessary and ensure that procedures are in place for all tasks within the laboratory.

10. Perform general housekeeping duties.

11. Coordinate information flow within the laboratory and to internal customers.

12. Access, input, and retrieve information from the QC computer systems.

13. Disposition of raw materials, process samples and finished products for use or sale.

14. Be thoroughly versed in GMP regulations and ensure that all laboratory documentation meets standards for completeness and accuracy.

15. Demonstrate a complete understanding of safe procedures for processing, analyzing, and storage of hazardous and/or flammable products and raw materials in accordance with local, state, and federal guidelines.

16. Document deviations in performance not anticipated or indicated in test procedures.

17. Be or become thoroughly familiar with QC and manufacturing process and workflow, QC retain program and documentation procedures.

18. Work with minimal supervision, re-prioritizing work schedules quickly.

19. Be proficient in performing traditional plating techniques and routine Celsius analysis.

20. Become familiar and assist with OOS/OOT and Customer complaint investigations.

21. Become familiar and assist with Method Development Protocols and conduct requisite testing.

22. Become familiar and assist with SOP creation, review, and revision activities.

23. Become familiar and assist with supplies/services ordering process.

24. Become familiar and assist with instrument maintenance and troubleshooting.

25. Must be able to perform any routine task in the laboratory in an efficient manner.

26. Participate in meetings as required.

27. Complete training assignments as required.

28. All other duties as assigned.

Physical Activities: Walking, talking, hearing, climbing, balancing, reaching, grasping, standing, and stooping.

Physical Demands: Occasionally lift boxes of product 5-40 lb. Frequently lift samples 1-5 lb.

Visual Acuity: Clarity of vision at 20 inches or less, with the ability to distinguish colors and adjust eye to bring objects into sharper focus.

Environmental/Atmospheric Conditions: Worker exposed to extreme heat and cold with temperatures sufficiently high or low to cause marked bodily discomfort. Exposed to sufficient noise to cause worker to shout to be heard above the ambient noise level. Worker exposed to hazards such as proximity to moving mechanical parts. Works in laboratory, production line and warehouse environments.

title: Transport Supervisor
description:
About Breedon Group:
Breedon Group plc is a leading vertically integrated construction materials group in Great Britain, Ireland, and the USA. We're dedicated to providing high-quality materials and services for the construction industry, with a commitment to safety, sustainability, and innovation. Joining Breedon means becoming part of a team that values excellence and is committed to making a positive impact.
Position Overview:
We are currently seeking a Transport Supervisor, ideally located to oversee the transport operations across Yorkshire.

You will support the Transport Manager in developing and establishing key projects or plans, alongside achieving optimal fleet utilisation whilst maintaining a strong focus on compliance.

Key responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Embed and promote a culture of health, safety and wellbeing across transport operations within the area through effective leadership, engagement and consistency of communication to both company and owner drivers.
  • Ensure strict compliance with DVSA regulations and all relevant industry standards, ensuring the Operations license is always current and up-to-date.
  • Maintain seamless coordination between transportation and distribution functions to assess resource requirements.
  • Maintain accurate records of transport activities, including vehicle inspections and maintenance schedules, to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements
  • Assist in managing the transport budget for the area, seeking cost-effective solutions while maintaining service levels and operational efficiency
  • Conduct weekly driver briefings to ensure smooth communication and address any immediate operational issues
  • Assist in managing local contracts with service providers, including hauliers and maintenance vendors, focusing on effective negotiation, contract compliance, and performance monitoring.
  • Address any customer complaints or issues related to transport operations promptly and work towards effective solutions.
  • Supervise daily transport operations and serve as the primary point of contact for drivers.
  • Monitor driver performance and compliance, providing regular feedback, and organising training sessions to enhance skills and knowledge.
  • Understand Transport KPI’s to aid decision making and drive continuous improvement.

  • Previous Transport experience (essential)
  • Knowledge of the Construction industry
  • A hard-working approach with a can do attitude
  • Demonstrated abilities in analysis & problem solving
  • Effective communication & exceptional customer service skills
  • Excellent attention to detail & good computer skills
  • A valid UK Driving License
  • Transport Manager CPC (desirable)

  • Company Pension Scheme
  • 25 days annual leave, plus bank holidays on top
  • Share Saver Scheme participation
  • Company Life Assurance Scheme
  • Access to our Employee Assistance Programme for health and wellbeing support
  • Discounts on a wide range of products through our employee benefits platform
  • Broad learning opportunities and career progression pathways.

Diversity Statement:
At Breedon Group, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diversity is valued. We believe in equality of opportunity for all and encourage applications from a diverse range of candidates.

Join Us:
If you're looking for a role that challenges you, offers progression, and contributes to building better futures, we'd love to hear from you. This position is an opportunity to grow your career within a supportive and dynamic environment at Breedon Group.
Application Process:
Ready to make a meaningful difference? Apply now by submitting your CV and cover letter. We look forward to considering your application and potentially welcoming you to our team.

title: Senior Workday PSA Consultant
description:
Be in IT specjalizuje się w kompleksowej rekrutacji specjalistów IT dla polskich i międzynarodowych firm. Wspieramy klientów w pozyskiwaniu ekspertów z obszarów software development, AI, data, cloud, cybersecurity, ERP, CRM oraz zarządzania IT.

Stawiamy na znajomość technologii, przejrzystą komunikację i partnerskie podejście, dzięki którym skutecznie dopasowujemy kandydatów do potrzeb organizacji i realizowanych projektów.

Obecnie dla naszego klienta poszukujemy osoby na stanowisko Senior Workday PSA Consultant.

Zakres obowiązków:

  • Długofalowa współpraca z międzynarodową, topową firmą consultingową, świadczącą usługi IT dla dużych i średnich firm z różnorodnych sektorów.

Oczekujemy:

  • Praktycznego doświadczenia w pracy z modułem Workday Professional Services Automation (PSA) lub Workday Projects.

  • Udokumentowanego doświadczenia w obszarach wdrażania, konfiguracji oraz wsparcia rozwiązań Workday Projects.

  • Umiejętności komunikacyjnych oraz doświadczenia w stakeholder management, szczególnie w dynamicznych środowiskach o bezpośrednim kontakcie z klientem (customer-facing).

  • Mile widziana jest dostępność ASAP, akceptowalny jest maksymalnie miesięczny okres wypowiedzenia, ze skutkiem na koniec miesiąca.

Oferujemy:

  • Długofalowa współpraca z wynagrodzeniem w przedziale 180-210 PLN netto/godz. + VAT.

  • Wsparcie przy zakładaniu i prowadzeniu działalności gospodarczej, dla osób bez takiego doświadczenia.

  • Sprawny proces rekrutacyjny - dwie rozmowy techniczne z managerami, online (każda maksymalnie po godzinie).

  • Współpraca w pełni zdalna.

  • Benefity - prywatna opieka medyczna, karta Multisport.

  • Nowoczesny sprzęt zapewniany przez firmę, wraz z softem i konfiguracją.

title: Product Manager
description:
Department Information


This posting is only open to residents of the State of Colorado

ABOUT US:

At The Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment (CDPHE) we are dedicated to the Colorado for All philosophy - working toward a Colorado where everyone has the opportunity to succeed.


We support the basic human rights of our neighbors regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, religion, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, citizenship status, education level, disability, socio-economic status, or any other visible or invisible identity. We are committed to increasing the diversity of our staff and providing culturally responsive programs and services. Therefore, we strongly encourage individuals from diverse backgrounds to apply.


IMPORTANT INFORMATION:


  • The referral list generated by this position announcement may be used to fill multiple position vacancies and may be extended.
  • This position will have hybrid workplace options available, at the discretion of the supervisor and based on business needs. The employee will still be required to report to the agency address listed on this announcement.

Be BOLD.....Make a REAL difference . . . join us in serving our communities advancing Colorado's health and protecting the places we live, work, learn, and play, to create a healthy and sustainable Colorado where current and future generations thrive.

CDPHE offers:

  • Free parking and access to RTD bus lines.

  • Flexible working arrangements

  • Retirement ( PERA options), Medical and dental health plans

  • Defined Benefit Plan or the PERA Defined Contribution Plan, plus optional 401K and 457 plans

  • Paid life insurance

  • Short- and long-term disability coverage

  • 11 paid holidays per year and generous personal time off

  • Tuition assistance

  • Wellness programs

  • Professional development opportunities on a wide variety of subjects

  • Career advancement opportunities throughout the State system


Some positions may qualify for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) Program. For more information, go to: https://studentloans.gov/myDirectLoan/pslfFlow.action#!/pslf/launch


Description of Job

The Work Unit:

The Colorado State Public Health Laboratory (CSPHL) provides accurate, timely, and reliable scientific laboratory testing to support public health surveillance, diagnostic services, and epidemiologic investigations. The laboratory plays a critical role in responding to communicable disease outbreaks, bioterrorism and chemical terrorism threats, and in safeguarding food, water, dairy products, and the environment. CSPHL also conducts newborn screening in strict accordance with statutory and regulatory requirements, ensuring quality, safety, cost-effectiveness, and timeliness across all services.

The Laboratory Data and Informatics Unit delivers end-to-end support for laboratory data systems, providing expertise in data integration, system configuration, custom development, and seamless laboratory instrument connectivity. The unit manages the full system lifecycle, including customer onboarding, data visualization, and ongoing optimization, while serving as the primary bridge between the laboratory and the Office of Information Technology (OIT) through its Business Technology Liaison and Product Owner roles. It leads IT project initiation and oversight, manages software and hardware procurement, and serves as the final authority for reviewing and approving IT deliverables. To sustain reliable and modern operations, the unit proactively reduces technical debt, governs data systems and ensures all systems meet OIT and departmental standards for security, accessibility, and modernization.

What You Will Do:

This position provides strategic, operational, and project leadership for the State Public Health Laboratory’s laboratory data systems, ensuring they are reliable, compliant, and aligned with public health priorities. It serves as the central authority for product direction, system performance, and stakeholder alignment—translating complex laboratory and program needs into effective technology solutions while overseeing project delivery, vendor coordination, and ongoing system operations. Through a combination of governance, execution, and continuous improvement, the role ensures laboratory applications consistently support critical public health functions, user needs, and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities:


Product Strategy, Governance & Stakeholder Alignment

Driving the strategic direction and reliability of CDPHE’s laboratory data systems, this position translates complex operational needs into user-centered solutions that support the state's public health mission. The position centers heavily on robust data governance, establishing frameworks that enforce compliance with data standards, security expectations, and regulatory obligations to safeguard system integrity. Central to this mission is proactive stakeholder engagement: the role bridges laboratory leadership, program partners, external vendors, and end-users through transparent communication channels and structured feedback mechanisms. By acting as a dedicated advocate for user workflows, this position continuously integrates diverse feedback into actionable, prioritized backlogs and long-term product roadmaps. Ultimately, this role balances immediate operational demands with long-term strategic vision, delivering scalable, defensible data products through strong cross-functional alignment and shared accountability.

Project Management

Leading the end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of laboratory data system initiatives, this position applies project management methodologies to ensure projects are completed on time, within scope, and aligned with operational priorities. Responsibilities include developing comprehensive project plans, tracking milestones, and coordinating cross-functional internal teams and external vendors to mitigate risks and sequence dependencies. The position maintains transparency through key project documentation—such as charters, decision records, and executive status updates—while actively overseeing the operational stability, testing, and regulatory compliance of active applications. Crucially, the role carries authority for release go/no-go decisions, balancing system enhancements against the need to preserve uninterrupted laboratory operations. By proactively resolving vendor disputes, managing system incidents, and enforcing strict quality standards, this position ensures seamless service continuity, data integrity, and reliable support for core public health functions.

Minimum Qualifications, Substitutions, Conditions of Employment & Appeal Rights

Residency Requirement:

This posting is only open to residents of the State of Colorado at the time of submitting your application.

Class Code & Classification Description:

H1C4XX Analyst IV

Minimum Qualifications:


NOTE: An applicant may meet the minimum qualifications for this job in one of two ways: They may qualify through their work experience alone or through a combination of education and work experience.


Experience Only:

Seven (7) years of relevant experience in business or management, administration, health services/health sciences, product/technology management, evaluating new technology solutions, designing and monitoring implementation of new technologies, or other closely related experience in an occupation related to the work assigned to this position.


Or


Education and Experience:

A combination of related education from an accredited institution in Business or Management, Administration, Health Services/Health Sciences, Technology Management, Information Technology, Computer Science, Database Management, or a field of study closely related to the work assignment. And/or relevant experience in business or management, administration, health services/health sciences, product/technology management, evaluating new technology solutions, designing and monitoring implementation of new technologies, or other closely related experience in an occupation related to the work assigned to this position equal to seven (7) years.


**This experience must be substantiated within the Work Experience section of your application. "See Resume" will not be accepted. In addition, part-time work will be prorated.**


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

In addition to the minimum requirements, the successful candidate in this position will have the following highly desirable experience and competencies:

  • Experience in Public Health Technology.
  • Demonstrated experience on how to securely and efficiently review, analyze, and prioritize digital needs and requirements.
  • Knowledge, skills and experience with Project Management Principles, Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL), Agile, and Health Information Management Systems Society principles and industry best practices.
  • Knowledge and familiarity with data sharing practices


CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT:

  • A pre-employment background check will be conducted as part of the selection process.

  • Critical Status: Must be available in the event of an emergency, (e.g., bio-terrorist attack, chemical attack, disease outbreak or all hazards) and be required to report to work immediately at the regular or alternate location. During this time, travel restrictions may be in place.

  • Critical Status: Must be available in the event of the activation of the Continuity of Operations Plan (COOP) and be required to report to work immediately at the regular or alternate location. During this time, travel restrictions may be in place.


Appeal Rights:

As an applicant who has been removed from consideration during the selection or comparative analysis process, you may file an appeal with the State Personnel Board and/or request a review by the State Personnel Director. A standard appeal form is available on the State Personnel Board website, . If you appeal, your appeal must be submitted in writing on the official appeal form, signed by you or your representative, and received at the following address within ten (10) days of your receipt of this notice: Colorado State Personnel Board/State Personnel Director, Attn: Appeals Processing, 1525 Sherman Street, 4th Floor, Denver, CO 80203. Fax: 303-866-5038. Phone: 303-866-3300. Email address: dpa_state.personnelboard@state.co.us. The ten-day deadline and these appeal procedures also apply to all charges of discrimination. Refer to Chapters 4 and 8 of the State Personnel Board Rules and Personnel Director's Administrative Procedures, 4 CCR 801, for information about the appeals process. The State Personnel Board Rules and Personnel Director's Administrative Procedures are available at .

Supplemental Information

A complete application packet must include:

  • Completed State of Colorado application.

  • If using education to qualify for this position a copy of your transcripts (unofficial acceptable) or diploma must be provided with application. Transcripts must be attached to your colorado.gov/jobs application.

  • If you are a veteran, a copy of your DD214 must be attached to your colorado.gov/jobs application.


The Selection Process:

  • All applications that are received by the closing of this announcement will be reviewed against the Minimum Qualifications in this announcement. Candidates who meet the minimum qualifications proceed to the next step.

  • Colorado Revised Statutes require that state employees are hired and promoted based on merit and fitness through a comparative analysis process.

  • Part of, or all of, the comparative analysis for this position may be a structured application review, which involves a review of the information you submit in your application materials by Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) against the preferred qualifications.

  • A top group, up to six candidates, will be invited to schedule an interview with the hiring manager.


E-Verify:

CDPHE uses e-Verify, an Internet-based system, to confirm the eligibility of all newly hired employees to work in the United States. Learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities.


ADAAA Accommodations:

The State of Colorado believes that equity, diversity, and inclusion drive our success, and we encourage candidates from all identities, backgrounds, and abilities to apply. The State of Colorado is an equal opportunity employer committed to building inclusive, innovative work environments with employees who reflect our communities and enthusiastically serve them. Therefore, in all aspects of the employment process, we provide employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, medical condition related to pregnancy, creed, ancestry, national origin, marital status, genetic information, or military status (with preference given to military veterans), or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law. The Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, our agency will assist individuals who have a disability with any reasonable accommodation requests related to employment, including completing the application process, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, participating in the employee selection process, and/or to perform essential job functions where the requested accommodation does not impose an undue hardship. If you have a disability and require reasonable accommodation to ensure you have a positive experience applying or interviewing for this position, please direct your inquiries to our ADAAA Coordinator at cdphe_benefits@state.co.us or call 303-692-2060, option 5.

title: Quality Assurance Lead
description:
Team Summary

Our AI QA team provides end-to-end testing solutions of complex AI-driven features, hardware sensors supporting AI functionality, and large-scale cloud and embedded systems. We bring proven experience in both hardware and software product development, with a strong focus on motion detection technologies.

We specialize in testing across integration, E2E, and acceptance levels, ensuring comprehensive test coverage, continuous product state monitoring, and stable product releases.

The team contributes to the development of AI features and embedded systems.

Job Summary

We are looking for a QA Team Lead who will own and drive QA strategy and processes across multiple programs, aligning testing approaches with business needs and evolving them as requirements change.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Ensure the team adheres to testing best practices, meets division-level quality standards, and delivers outcomes aligned with stakeholder expectations.

  • Track and analyze testing metrics and results to provide clear quality status reports at each SDLC milestone.

  • Plan QA activities, support engineers with task estimation, and define test scopes.

  • Allocate QA resources across features, review performance, and mentor direct reports and team members.

  • Help the team with difficult or urgent tasks or tests

  • Support ongoing automation

Qualifications and Skills

  • 5+ years of experience as a QA engineer

  • 2+ years of experience in a leading role

  • Basic knowledge in computer vision and machine learning

  • Understanding and hands-on experience with embedded systems testing

  • Automation skills with Python (ability to read a script, maintain tests and reuse existing code)

  • Hands-on experience in UNIX/Linux, including CLI navigation and use of regular expressions

  • Experience with databases and SQL

  • Practical experience with API testing (CRUD operations, debugging with Postman or similar tools)

  • Experience with CI tools (Jenkins)

  • Experience in mobile testing

  • Ability to work from our lab location in Gdansk

Nice to have

  • Basic experience with Raspberry Pi

  • Hands-on experience in Bash scripting

  • Familiarity with AWS services

  • ISTQB Certification Advanced Test Manager

We offer multiple benefits that include

  • The environment of equal opportunities, transparent and value-based corporate culture, and an individual approach to each team member

  • Competitive salary packages with performance-based annual reviews.

  • Opportunity to receive a Performance Bonus for your individual achievements and a Loyalty Bonus recognizing your dedication to the company.

  • Employment via Contract of Employment (UoP) in complete alignment with Polish Labour Law.

  • Guaranteed paid vacation, public holidays, and medical leaves as per statutory regulations.

  • Continuous growth and development opportunities through internal knowledge hubs, corporate courses, and free English classes

  • Comprehensive private medical insurance to supplement your standard NFZ coverage.

title: Bread Baker
description:
Rosemont Market & Bakery

Bread Baker

Rosemont's Bread Bakers are the hands behind our daily bread - mixing, shaping, and baking the seasonal loaves and baked goods our neighbors count on. Working out of our central kitchen, you'll help set the standard for Rosemont's bread program while pitching in on everything else that keeps a bakery running: handling ready-to-eat foods safely, filling orders for our markets, and keeping the workspace clean and organized.

What You'll Do

  • Bake efficiently and consistently for high-volume, daily production.
  • Portion, package, and label every item to Rosemont's standards.
  • Keep your station, equipment, and workspace clean and well-maintained.
  • Follow Maine Department of Health and Department of Agriculture rules for hygiene, sanitation, and safe food handling.
  • Help track and organize bakery ingredients, product, and supplies - and flag any shortages to your manager right away.
  • Pick and pack orders for our markets and stage them for delivery.
  • Contribute ideas to seasonal recipe testing and development, rooted in local, sustainable ingredients.
  • Keep your manager and team in the loop on production needs, changes, and wins - and flag urgent maintenance issues to your manager, the Facilities Maintenance Engineer, or the Director of Operations.
  • Follow the policies in the Employee Handbook, and pitch in on other tasks as needed.

What You Bring

  • A love of bread, local food systems, and baking - and curiosity about where it's all headed.
  • Strong baking technique and hands-on culinary skill.
  • A team-first attitude and a commitment to a safe, respectful, inclusive workplace.
  • Reliable transportation.
  • Strong time-management skills and the ability to juggle a few things at once.
  • English language proficiency.

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; college degree a plus.
  • Bakery or culinary experience preferred; professional bread-baking experience a strong plus.

Good to Know

  • This is an in-person role based at Rosemont's headquarters, which is not open to the public.
  • Hours and shift schedule are set together with your department manager.
  • The production and warehouse areas can be loud - expect moderate to loud noise levels throughout a shift.
  • You may be asked to attend trainings or earn certifications.

Physical Requirements

  • Able to lift 50 lb. cartons or bags.
  • Able to bend, twist, squat, and reach throughout a shift.
  • Able to stand for the full duration of a shift.

Rosemont is committed to making this role accessible. If you need a reasonable accommodation to perform the essential functions of this job, let us know.

title: Redovisningskonsult med kundansvar
description:
Vill du göra skillnad i ett entreprenöriellt företag där laganda, prestigelöshet och framåtanda genomsyrar vardagen? Är du en serviceinriktad och affärsmässig redovisningskonsult som trivs med eget kundansvar och nära kundrelationer? Har du ett konsultativt förhållningssätt och drivs av att hjälpa kunder att utveckla sina verksamheter genom hög kvalitet, proaktivitet och kvalificerad rådgivning? Då kan det här vara rollen för dig!


Om tjänsten

ECIT levererar produkter och tjänster inom ekonomi, lön, HR, IT och affärslösningar med verksamhet över hela Sverige. Vi söker nu en nyfiken och serviceinriktad redovisningskonsult till vårt kontor i Västerås. Här får du en central roll i att stötta våra kunder i deras ekonomiska vardag, med fokus på rådgivning, uppföljning och kvalitet i redovisningen.

Du arbetar nära våra kunder som har outsourcat sin ekonomihantering till oss. Ofta är de entreprenörer och mindre till medelstora bolag, där du blir en viktig partner och ett bollplank i både små och stora frågor. Genom att bygga långsiktiga relationer, ge rådgivning och bidra med ekonomiska insikter hjälper du kunderna att utveckla sina verksamheter.

Du kommer att ha eget kundansvar för ett antal kunder och fungera som deras primära kontaktperson i ekonomiska frågor. Arbetet omfattar löpande bokföring för aktiebolag samt hantering av momsdeklarationer, inkomstdeklarationer och årsbokslut. Du kommer även att ta fram rapporter, analysera ekonomiska resultat och ge kunderna underlag som bidrar till välgrundade affärsbeslut.

Hos oss får du möjlighet att successivt utvecklas genom att ta ett större ansvar och fördjupa din kompetens inom redovisning och rådgivning. På sikt ges du möjlighet att arbeta mer konsultativt och ta dig an mer komplexa kunduppdrag.

Du utgår från vårt kontor i Västerås, med möjlighet att även besöka kunder för att skapa en djupare förståelse för deras verksamhet.


Kvalifikationer

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:

  • Eftergymnasial utbildning inom ekonomi (YH eller högskola)
  • Minst 5 års erfarenhet av redovisning för aktiebolag
  • Erfarenhet av kundansvar och löpande kunddialog
  • God kunskap inom löpande bokföring, momsredovisning, årsbokslut samt inkomstdeklarationer
  • God Kunskap inom K2-regelverk
  • God systemvana och erfarenhet av Fortnox, Capego och Oxceed
  • Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift

Meriterande om du har erfarenhet från redovisningsbyrå eller annan konsultverksamhet.

Vem är du?

Du har ett konsultmässigt förhållningssätt och drivs av att skapa värde för dina kunder. Du är kommunikativ, serviceinriktad och trivs med att bygga förtroendefulla relationer. Vidare är du analytisk och kan på ett pedagogiskt sätt förklara ekonomiska rapporter och resultat för kunder med varierande ekonomisk kunskap.

Du är van att arbeta i affärs- och redovisningssystem, hanterar flera uppdrag parallellt och känner dig trygg i att prioritera ditt arbete.

Som person är du ansvarstagande, lösningsorienterad och självgående samtidigt som du är prestigelös och samarbetar väl med kollegor. Du tar ansvar för dina kunduppdrag och har förmågan att kombinera hög kvalitet i redovisningen med ett starkt kundfokus.

Du har ett starkt driv att utvecklas, trivs med kundansvar och vill successivt ta större ansvar i en rådgivande och affärsnära roll.

Vad kan ECIT erbjuda dig?

  • Kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling
  • Hybrid arbetsplats
  • Ett engagerat team med god laganda
  • Möjlighet att arbeta med välkända varumärken
  • Entreprenöriell företagskultur i en växande internationell koncern

ECIT är ett företag med nordiska rötter som grundades 2013. Idag har vi mer än 3 000 anställda i 11 länder varav ca 650 i Sverige.

Våra värdegrundsord är: Öppen kommunikation, mod, integritet och entreprenörskap.

Tjänsten är på heltid och tillsvidareanställning tillämpas efter provanställning.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Nattvärd Scandic CH, deltid  61,25%
description:
Nu söker vi en Nattvärd till Scandic CH.

Oavsett varför gästen kommer till oss är det få saker som är så uppskattade som ett vänligt ansikte som hälsar välkommen. Du agerar värd tillsammans med övriga teamet på hotellet och skapar en gästupplevelse i världsklass.

Hos oss får du ta ett stort eget ansvar för att ta de beslut som krävs för att göra gästen nöjd och teamen utvecklar och förbättrar arbetssätt och service i takt med att omvärlden förändras. Vi är nämligen övertygade om att det är när du får utvecklas och bidra med all din kompetens och erfarenhet som vi överträffar gästens förväntningar. På köpet får vi kul på jobbet!

Så ta med dig dina erfarenheter, ditt engagemang och ditt sätt att tänka till oss – och bidra till en kultur där vi bryr oss på riktigt: om varandra, våra gäster och vår planet. Välkommen till Scandic!

Information om tjänsten

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på deltid.

Du som arbetar som Nattvärd delansvarar för att hotellet håller en hög standard avseende för Mötes- och Loungeytorna. Du är den som ser till att våra mötesgäster få en ”wow-känsla” när de på morgonen kliver in på hotellet och sin mötes-lokal. Du tar även ansvar för gästbemötandet då du är ett av ansiktena utåt. Du kommer även att bistå baren/receptionen och göra grundläggande uppgifter så som att checka ut/in gäster och bemästra night audit. En del rengöring av de offentliga ytorna kommer också att förekomma i dina arbetsuppgifter.

Tjänsten är förlagd nattetid så det är viktigt att du gillar att arbeta natt. Meriterande är om du arbetat natt tidigare.

Arbetstiden är 7 nätter i följd, och sedan 7 lediga nätter. Vi tillämpar provanställning.

Vem är du?

Det är viktigt att du är praktiskt lagd, gillar varierande arbetsuppgifter och har en bra fysik då tyngre lyft förekommer. Du behöver ha kunskap om fastighetsskötsel och ha goda kunskaper i svenska. Vi lägger stor vikt vid din personlighet och samarbetsförmåga då alla medarbetare tillsammans ansvarar för gästens upplevelse.

För den här rollen krävs du är trygg i att arbeta självständigt och är noggrann. För att passa i rollen tror vi också att du har en väl utvecklad social förmåga och är kapabel att hantera att det händer många olika saker samtidigt. Det är mycket viktigt att du kan förmedla ett gott värdskap till hotellets gäster. Du är en lyhörd och prestigelös lagspelare som tar ett stort ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och helhetsresultatet.

Du har också vana och kunskap i att arbeta med dator som arbetsredskap.

Eftersom arbetet till stor del består av att kommunicera med gäster är goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska en förutsättning.

Vi tar enbart emot ansökningar via vår hemsida. Alla ansökningar kommer att behandlas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, varför vi ber dig att ansöka så snart som möjligt. I denna rekrytering använder vi oss av ett enklare test om service vid urvalet.

Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till oss på Scandic!

Ps. på vår hemsida kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, vad tjänsten innebär och om våra förmåner!

Allt börjar med dig. Att arbeta på ett av våra hotell innebär att vara en del av ett team där omtanke, samarbete och små vardagsögonblick gör skillnad. Du hjälper till att skapa den varma, hemlika känslan som kännetecknar Scandic – genom att vara närvarande, här och nu, och låta detaljerna räknas.

Vissa dagar går snabbt, andra är mer förutsägbara – ingen dag är den andra lik. Men det som alltid består är lagandan. Ni ställer upp för varandra, löser saker när de händer och är stolta över att leverera kvalitet – även när tempot är högt. Och när ni gör det vill gästerna inte bara njuta av sin vistelse – de vill komma tillbaka.

Så arbetar vi på Scandic

Vi är som bäst när vi arbetar tillsammans – över roller, hotell och team – och fokuserar på det som gör verklig skillnad i vardagen. Våra värderingar vägleder hur vi agerar och levererar: Be Pro, Be Bold, Be Caring och Be You.

Om du tror att fantastisk gästfrihet skapas genom samarbete, konsekvent kvalitet och små välgjorda ögonblick, kommer du att känna dig som hemma hos oss.

title: Sr Prin IT Technologist - Network Security Engineer
description:
At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world.

About the Role

A Day in the Life

Our Global Diabetes Capability Center in Pune is expanding to serve more people living with diabetes globally. Our state-of-the-art facility is dedicated to transforming diabetes management through innovative solutions and Technologies that reduce the burden of living with diabetes.

This position is an exciting opportunity to work with Minimed’s Diabetes business. Medtronic has announced its intention to separate the Diabetes division to promote future growth and innovation within the business and reallocate investments and resources across Medtronic, subject to applicable information and consultation requirements. This separation provides our team with a bold opportunity to unleash our potential, enabling us to operate with greater speed and agility. As a separate entity, we anticipate leveraging increased investments to drive meaningful innovation and enhance our impact on patient care.

#BetterDayStartNow

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.

Security Engineering & Architecture

Network Controls and Management

Detection, Response & Vulnerability Management

Cloud & Application Security

Governance, Risk & Collaboration

  • Contribute to security policies, standards, and technical procedures

  • Communicate risks and recommendations clearly to technical and non technical stakeholders
  • Security Engineering & Architecture
  • Design, implement, and maintain security solutions across on prem, cloud, and hybrid environments
  • Evaluate and integrate security technologies such as endpoint protection, IAM, network security, and cloud security controls

  • Perform threat modeling and security design reviews for new systems and applications

12+ years of experience with a bachelor’s degree or 8+ years of experience with an advanced degree or 12+ years of experience with a high school diploma or equivalent.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or equivalent experience
  • 10-12 years of hands on experience in security engineering, cybersecurity, or related technical roles
  • Strong understanding of: Network security (firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs, segmentation)
  • Operating system security (Windows, Linux)
  • Cloud security fundamentals and shared responsibility models
  • Experience implementing and operating enterprise security tools
  • Solid scripting or automation skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash)
  • Proven ability to analyze security risks and design practical mitigation strategies
  • Experience in regulated industries (healthcare, medical devices, finance, or similar)
  • Hands on experience with one or more cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Knowledge of DevSecOps tooling and practices
  • Security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, GIAC, or equivalent
  • Experience with infrastructure as code and configuration management tools
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and lead technical initiatives
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to influence without authority
  • Attention to detail with a risk based approach to security

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

Benefits & Compensation

MiniMed offers a competitive salary and flexible benefits package

At MiniMed, we put people first. A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values: We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every stage of your career and life.


About MiniMed

We want to make every day a better day for people living with diabetes. Our team of creative innovators around the globe share a passion for finding the simplest solutions to the problems that people with diabetes face on a daily basis. For more than 40 years, we've been redefining what's possible, from intelligent dosing systems designed for real life to predictive insights that stay a step ahead, and we're dedicated to continuing to support our customers through every step of their journey — meeting them where and how they need it.

title: Salesforce Senior Developer
description:
Job Description

As a Salesforce Senior Developer within the Agilent IT Team, you will be part of a high-performing global team responsible for delivering enterprise Salesforce solutions. In this role, you will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Services, and IT teams to design, develop, configure, integrate, and support scalable Salesforce capabilities across Sales Cloud, Data Cloud, CRM Analytics, and related platforms, including integrations with Marketing Cloud and enterprise systems.

Job Description

The Salesforce Senior Developer will be responsible for designing, developing, configuring, and supporting Salesforce solutions that meet business requirements and enable scalable, secure, and reliable business processes. Specific responsibilities include:

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and solution teams to understand requirements and translate them into effective Salesforce technical solutions.
  • Design, develop, configure, test, and deploy Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce, Flows, validation rules, security models, and other Salesforce platform capabilities.
  • Support Sales Cloud functionality, including account, contact, opportunity, lead, forecast, territory, and related sales process capabilities.
  • Develop and support Salesforce Data Cloud and CRM Analytics capabilities to enable data-driven insights, segmentation, reporting, and business decision-making.
  • Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce and Marketing Cloud, as well as other enterprise applications using APIs, middleware, event-based integrations, and standard Salesforce integration patterns.
  • Create technical design documents, unit test plans, deployment plans, and other development artifacts required to support high-quality delivery.
  • Follow Salesforce development best practices, including code quality, governor limit awareness, security, data model design, environment management, version control, and release management.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable fixes that improve platform stability and user experience.
  • Stay current with Salesforce platform capabilities and recommend practical improvements that support Agilent’s Salesforce roadmap and business priorities.

Qualifications

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 6+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience, including configuration, customization, integration, and production support.
  • Strong development experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce, SOQL/SOSL, Flows, triggers, batch jobs, asynchronous processing, and Salesforce platform services.
  • Strong Salesforce configuration knowledge, including objects, fields, page layouts, record types, permissions, profiles, roles, sharing rules, validation rules, approval processes, and automation.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud functionality and core CRM business processes.
  • Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud and CRM Analytics, including data modeling, insights, dashboards, reporting, and analytics use cases.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with Marketing Cloud and other enterprise systems using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, events, connectors, or other integration patterns.
  • Experience designing and supporting MuleSoft-based integrations, including API-led connectivity, error handling, end-to-end monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability setup for reliable enterprise integration operations.
  • Understanding Salesforce security, data access, sharing model, platform limits, and performance considerations.
  • Experience with Agile delivery methods, Jira, version control, CI/CD, and Salesforce deployment tools.
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I or Platform Developer II certification preferred; equivalent hands-on experience will also be considered.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with business and technical teams.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a global team environment, manage multiple priorities, and make sound decisions with appropriate risk awareness.

Additional Details

This job has a full time weekly schedule.

Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. During the hiring process, a recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for a preferred location. title: Membership Representative - Marion
description:
ABOUT US

The nonprofit YMCA of Western North Carolina strengthens local communities through youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility. Founded in 1889, we engage more than 100,000 people – regardless of age, income, or background – to nurture the potential of children and teens, improve the region’s health and well-being, and provide opportunities to give back and support the community. We do this through seven YMCAs, dozens of program sites, and YMCA Camp Watia. As the state’s largest provider of licensed school-age childcare, we give more than 1,000 children a day the opportunity to learn, grow, and thrive. We are made up of people of all ages, from all backgrounds, working side by side to ensure that everyone can reach their full potential with dignity. Thus, we are “For All”. Our core values are caring, honesty, respect, and responsibility, and they guide everything we do. We are committed to being an organization that exposes and addresses social constraints that limit and/or negatively affect all humans from all walks of life. We recruit staff who are passionate about giving back to the community, helping people, and upholding our core values. For more information, please visit .

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for dedicated and friendly faces to create a welcoming environment for members of all backgrounds and abilities. The Membership Representative is a very important, highly visible position providing exceptional customer service to our community. Membership Representatives are the first face greeting members arriving in our facilities and are the engagement specialists at the Y. In this role, you will create a welcoming atmosphere, drive sales, and connect members to YMCA programs like swim lessons, sports, childcare, and more.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Welcomes and greets all members and prospective members as they enter our facilities.
  • Communicates the value and benefit of the YMCA as a non-profit in the community and the benefits of a YMCA Membership
  • Regularly works within our Daxko Operations software to sell and update memberships and to register participants for programs (youth sports, swim lessons, etc.).
  • Understands all program offerings, pricing, business policies, and procedures and is proficient in Daxko Operations.
  • Provides excellent service to members, guests, and program participants in the branch and on the phone, contributing to member retention.
  • Guides prospective members on highly engaged cause-driven tours, highlighting the community work of the Y and the value of a Y membership.
  • Attends all staff meetings and trainings, as required.
  • Performs all other duties as assigned.

ABOUT YOU

Qualifications

  • Must be at least 16 years old
  • GED or High School Diploma Preferred
  • Bilingual English-Spanish Preferred
  • A working knowledge of computers or ability to learn within 90 days (MS Word, MS Excel, Daxko helpful)
  • BLS Requirement Physically perform all CPR and First Aid skills and/or assist as needed in emergency situations
  • Prefer a minimum of one year or more experience in work relating to customer service, either paid or volunteer.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • A high degree of human relations skills: Ability to effectively communicate and manage information to peers, staff, and volunteers

PHYSICAL ASPECTS OF THE JOB

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Must be able to clearly see, hear, and speak.
  • Must be able to bend, stand, stoop, and walk.
  • Ability to constantly and quickly move to various locations in and around the entire facility
  • Must be able to comprehend and communicate written and verbal instructions

PART-TIME BENEFITS

  • Free individual membership to all YMCA of WNC locations
  • Discounted membership for household members
  • Discounted program fees (swim lessons, youth sports, summer camp and more)
  • Start a 403(b) smart savings account on day one of employment (optional) and begin eligibility for YMCA retirement plan
  • Professional development opportunities through local and Y-USA trainings

The YMCA of Western North Carolina is committed to equal opportunity in terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, faith, gender, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, gender expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law, except where a bona fide occupational qualification applies.

title: Senior Product Manager - (Core Data, Tech Foundations)
description:
We are on the lookout for a Senior Product Manager - Core Data to join the central Data Platform tribe on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences for our internal users.

As a member of the central Data Platform tribe, you’ll drive the product vision, strategy, and execution of DH's global core infrastructure and data products, supporting thousands of internal users on leveraging data to provide an amazing experience for millions of customers across 70+ countries.

As the Senior Product Manager for Core Data, you won't just manage global data models and products: You will own the global blueprint for how Delivery Hero understands and measures its business. You will bridge the gap between local brand nuances (like foodpanda, Glovo, or Talabat) and a unified global data product portfolio that empowers teams and users across the globe to operate with consistent definitions and reliable insights.

This role requires a strong understanding of DH’s business operations and data landscape, exceptional stakeholder alignment skills, and hands-on analytical expertise to understand the status and quality of our core data. You will work closely with local data teams and global services to align on scalable data models that address critical business challenges, while partnering internally with your Core Data team to deliver high-impact data products built on those foundations.

You will play a key role in shaping a data ecosystem that processes millions of events every day. Your success will be measured by the reliability and impact of your global data products.

In this role you will,

  • Own the Vision: Define and execute the roadmap for Core Data products, moving us from fragmented local silos and inconsistent data definitions to a high-performance global standard.

  • Scale Global Models: Partner with local data teams and central global services to align on data models that solve high-stakes business issues across DH’s key processes (Search and Recommendation, Order Processing, Finance, Marketing…).

  • Lead a Power Squad: Drive a cross-functional team of Data Engineers and Analysts. You aren't just a "backlog manager"; you are the bridge that translates business intent into technical architecture and drives execution.

  • Guardian of Quality: Implement federated data governance processes. When data quality dips, you don't just fix it: You build the systems that prevent it from happening again.

  • PM Experience: Proven track record in managing internal data products in complex organisations.

  • Analytical Depth: You are hands-on. You can dive into BigQuery to troubleshoot a data issue yourself and find root causes.

  • Strategic & Persuasive: You can take a complex data related issue, understand root causes and nuances, and drive global initiatives to rally people across the organisation behind a common solution.

  • Bias for Action: You move autonomously and fast, unblock business impact now, and then iterate based on what the data tells you.

  • Business Understanding: You understand the "Golden Path" of an order, from the first click in an app to the final financial reconciliation.

  • Technical Literacy: You bridge the gap between business requirements and technical execution. You speak the language of data engineering. You understand how data implementation shapes the speed and quality of data delivery at scale.

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

  • Make the most of our hybrid working model and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week

  • We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service

  • We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.

  • Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation, Yoga, Gym & Bicycle Subsidy

  • Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan

  • The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers, Food Vouchers, Corporate Discounts. Courses.

Ready to join our team? If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you.

We encourage you to let us know if you need any accommodations or specific accessibility support to ensure a smooth interview experience—just let us know with an email to our Inclusion Officer at inclusion@deliveryhero.com.

Severely disabled applicants with equal qualifications will be given preferential consideration.

You're welcome to share your pronouns (he/she/they) right from the start so we can address you respectfully from our first contact.
