title: Part Time Dispatcher (Weekend PM Shift)
description:
Union Power Cooperative has an immediate opening for a qualified Part Time Dispatcher who will provide night, weekend and/or holiday relief in the Operations Center to manage outage crew assignments, assist in regular and after-hours customer service activities, and the monitoring of both the distribution system and the security system while continuously remaining focused on the Cooperative's Mission and Vision Statements, and the promotion of the Cooperative's Guiding Values.

Essential Duties of the Position:

  1. Utilizes UPC's Outage Management System (OMS) and other related systems to evaluate and prioritize outage management, hazard conditions, and unusual system activity.
  2. Assigns personnel and equipment to outages and hazard conditions.
  3. Documents and communicates outages, abnormal conditions and hazard conditions to Operations personnel, contractors and other stakeholders in the System Operations Center.
  4. Provides outage and hazard data to various individuals at the Cooperative, including executive leadership.
  5. Serves as main point of contact for employee Mayday or hazard situations.
  6. Performs after hours customer service functions, including telephone contact with end consumers.
  7. Assigns service orders to Operations personnel.
  8. Documents and reports system irregularities to the appropriate personnel.
  9. Responsible for monitoring security system and reporting abnormal or suspicious activity.
  10. Perform all other duties assigned by supervision.

Work Qualifications:

  1. High school diploma or equivalent is required.
  2. Five years' work experience required.
  3. Associates degree in a related field with a preference in electrical technology preferred.
  4. This job requires availability for up to 12-hour shifts periodically during the week, weekends, or holidays. Hours will be irregular based on the need of the System Operations Center to ensure 24x7 coverage.
  5. Ability to read and interpret documents of a technical nature such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals; write routine service orders and log reports; speak effectively and present information orally to customers and/or employees of organization.
  6. Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rates and percentages.
  7. Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists.
  8. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram or schedule form.
  9. High level of computer competency.
  10. Maintains regular and predictable attendance.
  11. Ability to work without direct supervision required.
  12. Ability to read and interpret both digital and paper maps.
  13. Knowledge of system geography required.
  14. Must be able to effectively multi-task and communicate using a variety of mediums including telephone, two-way radio, and email.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability status, veteran status, or other legally protected status.

title: Delivery Driver, Security - Administrative Assistant II
description:
Department Information



This position is only open to Colorado state residents.
NOTE: This posting may fill more than one vacancy.

Thank you for your interest in working for the State of Colorado. Join us and find meaningful work in public service to our state and its residents, helping to make Colorado a great place to live and work in. Please watch the short video below for tips on applying.

Apply for a job with the State of Colorado


To learn more about what happens after you apply for a position with the State of Colorado, please watch the short, informative video

What Happens After You Apply


Colorado for All Philosophy: Colorado for All means working toward a Colorado where everyone has the opportunity to succeed. It means we support the basic human rights of our neighbors regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, religion, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, citizenship status, education level, disability, socio-economic status, or any other visible or invisible identity.


The Department of Personnel & Administration (DPA) is the foundation for dependable state government, leading with responsiveness, integrity, and teamwork. We provide services to other government agencies and all Coloradans by taking bold initiative toward a government with engaged employees, innovative solutions, and constructive partnerships.


DPA provides a wide range of programs and services, from custodial & maintenance to financial and human resources support, which assist other state agencies in fulfilling their missions. At DPA, there are countless opportunities to contribute to meaningful work that supports and serves the people of Colorado. The wide variety of positions in DPA allow individuals to learn about state operations and provide for long-term career growth.


If your goal is to build a career that makes a difference and build greater public confidence in good government, consider joining the dedicated people of the State of Colorado; it's a chance to combine your expertise with public service. Our professionals strive to support state government and the residents of Colorado. Customer service is a key component for every position in state government as is the focus on ideas and ways to redesign the delivery of services in making state government more.

Good Government Starts Here!

Why We Want You:

We want your expertise, positive energy, drive to succeed, and love of this great state as we work to elevate the expectations Coloradans have of their government.


What You'll Get From Us:

In return for the skilled work you do, DPA provides a competitive compensation and benefits package to accompany employment opportunities. Please see the Benefits Overview video for details on the benefits offered to employees.





Description of Job

Integrated Document Solutions (IDS) is a full-service, end-to-end document management operation. IDS advises, assists, and supports each agency’s needs, providing a wide variety of cost-efficient document solutions at a professional level.

This position will drive deliveries, provide support for mail operations, as well as security of the North Campus for DPA. It provides support for critical infrastructure jobs and performs duties of a sensitive and vital nature for mail services, facility security and secure storage.

We are building a Colorado for All through a commitment to equal opportunity and hiring based on merit and fitness. The State is committed to non-discriminatory practices in hiring, employment, and advancement opportunities.

title: Network API Developer
description:
Strength. Care. Growth


Did you know that A1 Bulgaria is working on international projects as well?
Our wide portfolio has long past the telecom services, and we are now offering digital solutions to millions of corporate, public, and private customers.
State-of-the-art technology, the latest innovations, and extremely talented professionals in various areas help us deliver the best-in-class products, services, and customer experience.

You’ll know A1 Bulgaria is the right place for you if you are driven by:

  • Opportunities to learn and build your career.
  • Meaningful work in a stable and fast-paced company.
  • Diversity of people, projects, and platforms.
  • A supportive, fun, and inspiring place to work.

Would you like to join us?

Borislav Kosatev is looking for a new team member.

We are looking for a skilled Network API Developer to design, develop, and maintain scalable APIs that power network services and integrations. You will work closely with network engineers, backend developers, and product teams to build robust interfaces that enable seamless communication across systems.

Your daily routine would include:

  • Design and develop RESTful and/or gRPC APIs for network services.
  • Integrate APIs with telecom/network infrastructure (5G, LTE, MPLS, SDN, etc.).
  • Build scalable, secure, and high-performance backend services.
  • Collaborate with network engineers to translate network capabilities into APIs.
  • Implement API versioning, documentation, and lifecycle management.
  • Ensure high availability, reliability, and monitoring of APIs.
  • Troubleshoot performance issues and optimize system performance.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.

We’ll know you can make it if you have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in backend/API development.
  • Strong experience with Python, Java, Go, or Node.js.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, microservices architecture.
  • Experience with API gateways and management tools (e.g., Kong, Apigee).
  • Knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS).
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience working with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in telecom environments (5G Core, IMS, OSS/BSS).
  • Knowledge of OpenAPI/Swagger specifications.
  • Familiarity with event-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ).

title: Portfolio Director
description:
As a Portfolio Director or Portfolio Management Office Director, you will have experience leading global/national/regional portfolios with a focus on converting strategy into delivery, optimising portfolio performance, driving strategic capital planning and leading sustained success against annual portfolio objectives.

You provide strategic leadership and governance across a portfolio of real estate investments, programmes, and projects, making sure investments are aligned to organisational strategy and deliver measurable business value.

You know how to oversee the successful implementation of best-in-class Portfolio, Portfolio Management Office, governance and portfolio controls frameworks and functions that realise delivery excellence across growing and major portfolios.

You provide effective oversight throughout the investment lifecycle – from strategy development and portfolio planning through to benefits realisation and portfolio optimisation. Capabilities include: Strategic Leadership, Stakeholder Engagement, Partnership Building, Capability Development, Portfolio Management, Portfolio Optimisation, Capital Investment Planning, Scenario Planning, Strategic Analysis, Benefits Realisation Management.

You act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders and business leaders, providing strategic insight, constructive challenge and assurance on portfolio performance, delivery risks and organisational strategy. You work closely with executive leadership, business stakeholders and delivery teams and directly enable the delivery of a strategically aligned, competitive portfolio.

Through your leadership you ensure portfolios are delivered effectively, stakeholders are engaged, benefits are realised, and investment objectives are achieved, fostering collaboration, innovation and performance excellence across client and internal teams.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Portfolio Leadership & Direction: Take end-to-end ownership of shaping, embedding, and communicating portfolio vision and direction. Effectively empower, motivate, and guide high-performing teams to drive success and cohesion across delivery activities, translating strategy into measurable outcomes. Lead on Strategic Portfolio Management and Capital Investment Planning providing a forward-looking view of capital allocation strategies. Drive robust investment decision-making that delivers sustained strategic performance and business value across the portfolio
  • Portfolio Controls & Optimisation: Lead the evaluation of portfolios through gap analysis, using internal and external benchmarking data and market analysis. Create a roadmap and effectively lead teams to deliver the optimised future state. Establish and embed portfolio management and control frameworks to ensure rigor, compliance, transparency, and continuous improvement.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Influence: Establish and maintain trusted relationships with senior leaders, clients and key stakeholders, building a reputation as a collaborative partner & advisor. Drive connectivity across business functions, delivery teams and leadership groups, fostering strong partnerships and aligning diverse stakeholders behind a common vision and shared outcomes. Proactively collaborate across stakeholder groups to establish and deliver innovative and integrated solutions.
  • Risk & Health/Safety Management: Define and embed safeguards that manage portfolio risks, including health and safety considerations. Oversee the proactive identification, escalation, and mitigation of risks and issues across the portfolio.
  • Financial Oversight: Oversee and drive the implementation and control of financial management processes, including CapEx performance, budget tracking, cost reporting, and financial risk visibility. Ensure portfolio financials are controlled, accurate, and aligned with governance requirements.
  • Commission Management and Business Development: Ensure the commission is well-managed from a contractual and commercial perspective, ensuring performance expectations are met, build trusting client partnerships and identify and pursue future business growth / Business Development opportunities.
  • People & Culture: Act as a first-class colleague and leader, taking a lead and positively contributing to the culture of internal and commission teams and demonstrating leadership in internal team growth. Build capability, mentor teams, drive inclusion across the team and successfully carry out people management responsibilities to drive internal team performance and growth and our One Business culture.

This is a Director level role. To excel in this role, you will have:

  • Accreditation or strong working knowledge of portfolio and/or programme management methodologies and governance frameworks, particularly within real estate and complex delivery environments, with demonstrated experience establishing or working within portfolio and/or programme governance frameworks in fast‑paced environments.
  • Strong capability in managing a portfolio of programmes and/or projects, with experience in performance optimisation initiatives, and experience in managing capital investment plans.
  • Strong experience overseeing the delivery of expected outcomes with best practice and high standards, driving performance and discipline in a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Exceptional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to lead strategic partnerships and foster trust, and to inspire and empower teams.
  • Experience operating at Executive / C-suite level – demonstrating exceptional communication skills including presentation of data to influence outcomes.
  • Experience in effective portfolio / programme financial performance oversight including reporting, budget tracking and portfolio and/or programme cost management processes. Good understanding of procurement methodologies, contract forms, and commercial frameworks.
  • Experience in business development and successfully securing portfolio / programme management commissions and roles through your industry networks, competitive tender and interview processes, and negotiated opportunities.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and portfolio / programme management tools, reporting systems and digital platforms, with a proactive approach to data, innovation and digital tools and strategy, including the use of AI.
  • Degree or postgraduate qualification, professional membership in a relevant field.

title: Therapist I (54866)
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Therapist I provides quality psychosocial assessment and psychotherapy services to individuals who are experiencing mental illness, behavior problems, and/or substance misuse issues. Services could be provided in a variety of settings including the clinic, community, and home. Position will include collaboration with other positions within the agency (i.e. case manager, peer support, psychiatry, etc.) and outside of the agency (i.e. DCBS, courts, schools, etc.).

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Clinical Support & Service Delivery

  • Assist in completing clinical evaluations, psychosocial assessments, and diagnostic screenings under supervision.
  • Deliver individual, family, collateral, psychoeducation and/or group therapy using evidenced-based/informed interventions.
  • Participate in intake, referral, orientation, and engagement activities for new clients.
  • Provide services to general outpatient, co-occurring, and assigned specialty populations (i.e. first episode psychosis, youth, adults, dual-diagnosis, residential) as applicable.
  • Assist in crisis response under supervision, including gathering information, coordinating with staff, and supporting safety planning. May include on call work through Adult Crisis Services, if applicable to this position.
  • Help develop and update person centered recovery treatment plans.
  • Maintain accurate, timely documentation in the electronic health record.

Team & Collaboration

  • Participate in treatment team meetings, clinical staffing, consultations, and interdisciplinary coordination.
  • Communicate professionally with referral sources, families, community partners, and internal staff, always within the boundaries of supervision.
  • Maintain professional relationships with clients, families, referral sources, community partners, and coworkers.
  • Collaborate with school systems, law enforcement, community agencies, and other partners as applicable.
  • Participate in committees or workgroups when assigned, if applicable.
  • Support continuity of care between programs (e.g., outpatient therapy, case management, psychiatry, peer support, residential, crisis).

Professional Practice

  • Adhere to ethical standards, agency policies, state regulations, and clinical best practices.
  • Participate in clinical supervision as required by state licensure.
  • Maintain current knowledge of evidence-based practices and emerging research relevant to assigned populations.
  • Maintain expectations regarding quality of care and agency deliverables.
  • Maintain professional conduct that reflects agency core values.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned or required.

title: Senior Frontend and Conversational Developer
description:
• Architecteren en bouwen van conversational oplossingen in platformen zoals Cognigy - inclusief intent-modellen, dialoogontwerp, NLU-tuning en complexe integraties met backend-systemen en API's
  • Ontwerpen van de technische architectuur voor schaalbare, onderhoudbare conversational platformen en het maken van weloverwogen keuzes rond platform, tooling en integratie
  • Ontwikkelen van bijbehorende frontend-componenten en chat/voice-interfaces (React / ReactNative, Vue.js of Svelte)
  • Technisch leiderschap: het begeleiden van medior/junior developers, code reviews, en het bewaken van best practices op het gebied van software design, security, testautomatisering en release management
  • Optreden als technisch aanspreekpunt richting senior stakeholders en klanten — vertalen van business-vraagstukken naar concrete technische oplossingen
  • Automatiseren en orkestreren van workflows en agentic flows met tools zoals n8n of Flowise
  • Bijdragen aan het verder professionaliseren van onze conversational AI-praktijk (patterns, reusable components, delivery-aanpak)
  • Signaleren van nieuwe ontwikkelingen op het gebied van conversational AI en frontend development en nieuwe kennis delen met klanten en collega’s.

Je hebt een enorme passie voor digitale ervaringen en je zet de gebruiker, ondanks technische uitdagingen, altijd op #1. Natuurlijk ontdek je graag nieuwe manieren om complexe problemen op te lossen en ga je door tot de oplossing er is. Bovenal durf je jezelf te zijn. De ware jij. Met je eigen sterke punten, blik op de wereld en persoonlijkheid. Verder heb jij als Senior Frontend and Conversational Developer:

  • Een sterke frontend-basis: aantoonbare ervaring met het bouwen van Single Page / Native Applications (React/ ReactNative, Vue.js of Svelte), responsive interfaces (HTML/CSS), Node.js en versiebeheer (Git)
  • Ruime, aantoonbare ervaring met Conversational AI - je hebt zelf production-grade oplossingen gebouwd en uitgerold, bij voorkeur met Cognigy (of vergelijkbaar), en je bent vertrouwd met agentic frameworks zoals n8n of Flowise
  • Diepgaande ervaring met conversational design en engineering: intent-herkenning, dialoogflows, NLU, context-handling en integratie met externe systemen
  • Ervaring met AI-assisted coding en met GenAI-API's (zoals Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI)
  • Solide kennis van Cloud hosting (Azure, AWS of Google Cloud) en van architectuur- en integratievraagstukken op schaal
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het begeleiden of aansturen van andere developers en/of het leiden van technische workstreams
  • Aantoonbare ervaring in het meenemen van stakeholders en het vertalen van de techniek naar business waarde
  • Ervaring met rapid prototyping workshops, Design Systems en het bouwen van Component Libraries is een sterke pré
  • Een afgeronde (universitaire) opleiding in een relevante richting zoals Computer Science, Informatica, Software Engineering of Creative Technology
  • Een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal en sterke communicatieve vaardigheden om de brug te slaan tussen strategie, design, engineering én de klant

Als Senior Frontend & Conversational Developer ben je een drijvende kracht achter onze Conversational AI-oplossingen. Je ontwerpt en bouwt niet alleen zelf, maar je bepaalt mede de technische richting: je realiseert schaalbare architectuur van conversational platformen met Cognigy, agentic frameworks zoals n8n of Flowise, en de frontend-ervaringen (web / mobile) daaromheen.

Je bent T-shaped met diepgang in Conversational AI: een stevige gedegen frontend-basis (web / mobile), gecombineerd met aantoonbare, praktijkervaring in het bouwen en uitrollen van production-grade chat- en voice-oplossingen. Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor complexe integratievraagstukken, je bewaakt kwaliteit en je tilt het team mee omhoog.

Samen met een multidisciplinair team van UX-researchers, visual designers, strategen en engineers lever je conversational oplossingen voor (grote) organisaties - van eerste prototype tot robuuste, production-ready implementatie. Je gaat deel uitmaken van het Marketing, Commerce & Product team bij Deloitte Digital.

Tip: vertel in je brief kort over je ervaring met conversationele AI, e.g. chatbots of LLM-projecten

title: Automotive Alignment Technicians
description:
Mavis Tires & Brakes at Discount Prices - Automotive Alignment Technicians


Put your career into high gear with Mavis Tires & Brakes at Discount Prices! We're looking for a full-time Automotive Alignment Technicians to join Team Mavis at one of our state-of-the-art automotive service, repair and tire sales centers in the Poughkeepsie, NY area. With over 2,000 retail locations, Mavis is one of the largest tire sales and automotive repair chains in the United States.

About the Position of Automotive Alignment Technician

Automotive Alignment technicians use the latest equipment to align newly-mounted tires and wheels on customer's vehicles. By measuring and adjusting caster, camber, toe and thrust angles, our Automotive Alignment Technicians reduce customer's tire wear and ensure serviced vehicles travel straight and true. Mavis's Alignment Technicians also complete state-mandated inspections, oil and filter changes and flat repairs, and perform any other required automotive service or vehicle repairs to customer vehicles.

Employee Benefits

At Mavis, we understand that our people drive our success. We provide our team members with competitive weekly pay, including weekly incentive compensation, a good working environment and an excellent combination of additional benefits like health, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer match, paid vacations, paid time off, paid holidays, life insurance, on-the-job training, and opportunities for career growth and advancement.

Qualifications

We recruit team members who share our commitment to providing complete customer satisfaction and delivering the highest quality service. To be eligible for the position of Automotive Alignment Technicians you must (1) be at least 18 years of age; (2) be legally authorized to work in the United States; and (3) possess 1 year of experience and/or training in dismounting, mounting, rotating and balancing tires or any combination of education, training and experience which demonstrates the ability to perform the duties and responsibilities of the position. In addition, it is preferred that Alignment Technicians possess a state inspection license.

As an active position, Automotive Alignment Technicians are required to stand, walk, bend, kneel, stoop, crouch, crawl, climb, pull, reach and perform repeated and repetitive movements consistent with vehicle and tire maintenance and repair. Alignment Technicians must regularly lift and/or move items weighing over 50 pounds.

title: Account Resolution Specialist
description:
It's fun to work at a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Recruiting agencies must have a valid, written and fully executed Master Service Agreement and Statement of Work for consideration.

Job Summary:

The Account Resolution Specialist is responsible for contacting customers regarding delinquent accounts and overdraft demand deposit accounts (DDA) through approved communication channels, including telephone, email, and written correspondence. This role focuses on resolving account delinquencies by providing payment options, sending required notices, maintaining accurate documentation, and ensuring all collection activities comply with applicable laws and regulations, including the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA).

Essential Job Functions include, but are not limited to:

  • Contact customers regarding delinquent and overdraft accounts via phone, email, and mail to resolve account balances and to respond to account-related guidelines.
  • Negotiate repayment arrangements and establish payment plans in accordance with customers’ financial situations and bank guidelines.
  • Send required collection and overdraft correspondence to customers in compliance with established procedures and regulatory requirements.
  • Ensure all collection activities are performed in accordance with FDCPA guidelines, bank policies, and applicable federal and state regulations.
  • Research, monitor, and evaluate delinquent accounts using internal systems to determine appropriate resolution acts.
  • Accurately document all customer interactions, payment arrangements, and account activity; upload and maintain supporting documentation in collections systems and Web Director.
  • Prepare, process, and retain account related documentation, correspondence, and reports in accordance with record retention records.
  • Perform clerical and administrative duties related to collections, including filing, record maintenance, and document management.
  • Perform all duties in relation to the Bank Secrecy Act under the guidance of the BSA Officer.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, Reasonable Accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Skills and Abilities Required to Perform Essential Job Functions:

Must have and be able to consistently apply the following skills at the levels indicated to produce assigned results.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate records and documentation.
  • Ability to apply FDCPA guidelines and exercise sound judgement during customer interactions.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to handle sensitive information with professionalism and confidentiality.
  • Proficiency with computer systems, including collections software and document management platforms.

Education, Experience and Qualifications:

  • High School Graduate or General Education Degree (GED).
  • Minimum one to two years equivalent experience preferred.
  • Knowledge of FDCPA and regulatory compliance standards is preferred.

Physical Requirements of Essential Job Functions:

The associate is frequently required to sit and/or stand, communicate, reach, and manipulate objects, tools or controls that are typical of an office/bank environment. Lifting items weighting up to 10 pounds on a consistent basis. Manual dexterity and coordination are required over 80% of the work period while operating equipment such as computers, phones, calculators, etc. Weekend and evening work will be required.

Working Conditions:

  • Typical office environment.
  • Extended viewing of computer screens.
  • Regular office hours are Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Occasional weekend and evening work may be required.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by associates assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of the associate classified as such. Duties and responsibilities may be added or changed as deemed appropriate by management at any time therefore, they could differ from those outlined above.

title: Lamination Operator, Nights

Our data-integrated media solutions drive sales and loyalty, engaging shoppers where it matters most – the point of decision. Our patented innovation has been trusted by top retailers for more than 30 years to drive productivity and profitable growth. title: Key Holder
description:
Job Location

Mill Creek

Job Summary:

The Key Holder supports the delivery of a consistently positive shopper and donor experience by helping maintain a clean, organized, well merchandised, and welcoming store environment during assigned shifts. This role provides hands on, on shift leadership of customer and donor facing activities, including point of sale support, sales floor standards, merchandising execution, donor flow support, and basic store readiness, while carrying out established processes in alignment with Goodwill’s mission of Changing Lives through Education, Training, and Employment.

Through active, on floor presence, the Key Holder reinforces expectations for cleanliness, shop ready merchandising, friendly service, safe operations, and respectful donor interactions while supporting daily routines such as opening, closing, and shift execution. Under the direction of store management, this role focuses on consistent task completion, associate guidance, and customer and donor support, ensuring the store and donor areas remain easy to navigate and ready to serve the community throughout the day, grounded in Goodwill’s values of Teamwork, Respect, Uprightness, and Empowerment.

Job Description

Essential Functions

On Shift Leadership & Key Holder Coverage

  • Serve as the on‑duty key holder during assigned shifts, supporting store opening and closing routines and ensuring store readiness.
  • Provide visible, on‑floor leadership to guide associates and support smooth shift execution.
  • Support shift handoffs by communicating priorities, coverage needs, and operational issues to store leadership.
  • Escalate complex customer, donor, safety, or operational concerns to store leadership as appropriate.
  • Maintain a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, and perform other duties as assigned to support store operations.

Shopper & Donor Experience

  • Support the delivery of a consistently positive shopper and donor experience during assigned shifts by helping maintain a clean, organized, and welcoming store and donor environment.
  • Reinforce shop‑ready merchandising standards through timely recovery, basic replenishment, and adherence to established presentation guidelines.
  • Support point‑of‑sale and front‑end activities by reinforcing accurate transactions, friendly service behaviors, and efficient customer flow.
  • Reinforce expectations for cleanliness, organization, and safety across all shopper‑ and donor‑facing areas, including registers, aisles, fitting rooms, restrooms, checkout zones, and donor drop‑off areas.
  • Support donor flow by reinforcing respectful, friendly, and efficient donor interactions and ensuring donor areas remain safe, organized, and easy to navigate.
  • Assist with maintaining signage placement, price accuracy checks, fixture organization, and product presentation by following established processes and reporting issues to store leadership.
  • Reinforce expectations for proactive associate greetings and excellent service by modeling positive interactions and coaching team members to engage shoppers and donors in a friendly, helpful, and respectful manner.
  • Model positive shopper and donor service behaviors and provide on‑the‑spot guidance to associates to reinforce service standards and expectations.

Performance Execution & Store Readiness Support

  • Support opening and closing routines while leading assigned shifts to restore and maintain the store in grand‑opening condition through strong execution of recovery, cleanliness, merchandising standards, production support, backroom organization, and operational routines.
  • Train and coach new and existing associates during shifts by reinforcing standard work, service expectations, basic production and backroom workflows, and daily task execution, escalating needs or concerns to store leadership as appropriate.

Compliance and Risk Oversight

  • Reinforce adherence to company policies, safety guidelines, and operational standards across shopper‑ and donor‑facing areas during assigned shifts.
  • Monitor on shift activities to support accurate POS transactions, pricing integrity, and safe cash handling, escalating concerns as needed.
  • Support loss‑prevention efforts through situational awareness and by coaching associates on safe and compliant practices.

Minimum Qualifications

Required Skills

Education

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.
  • Associate’s degree in business, Logistics, Supply Chain, Management, Retail Operations, or a related field preferred.

Experience

  • One to two years of supervisory or lead experience in production, warehouse, retail, or logistics environments required.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Strong oral and written communication skills with the ability to provide clear, respectful direction and feedback.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities accurately in a fast‑paced retail environment.
  • Ability to learn and consistently apply established processes, systems, equipment, and standard operating procedures.
  • Ability to provide on‑shift leadership by guiding, training, and motivating associates while promoting a positive, inclusive work culture grounded in our Mission and TRUE Core Values.
  • Ability to deliver strong shopper and donor service, ensuring safe, friendly, and efficient interactions, including at the Donor Door.
  • Ability to recognize execution issues related to service, cleanliness, merchandising, and safety and escalate concerns appropriately.
  • Basic computer proficiency, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and online product research.
  • Ability to operate a forklift (must obtain forklift certification; training and certification are provided by the organization), if required by the assigned location
  • Bilingual skills are preferred.

Preferred Education / Experience / Knowledge & Skills / Certifications & License

  • Associate’s degree in business, Logistics, Supply Chain, Retail Management, or a related field; or equivalent experience, including four (3) years of supervisory or lead experience in retail, warehouse, logistics, or production environments.
  • Experience working in fast‑paced, high‑volume operations preferred.
  • Prior retail, nonprofit, or mission‑based organization experience preferred.
  • Experience supporting or working alongside eCommerce operations is a plus.
  • Previous experience training, coaching, or developing staff strongly preferred.
  • Bilingual language skills are preferred.

title: Warehouse Operative
description:
​​​​​​We have a fantastic opportunity for Warehouse Operatives to join our Spalding team, supporting our chilled warehouse operations in a fast-paced, modern environment. This is a hands-on role where you will play an important part in keeping stock moving accurately, safely and efficiently while being part of a reliable and supportive team.

The role is based in a chilled warehouse environment, so you will need to be comfortable working in temperatures of around 3 degrees.

Shift Patterns: Flexible 4 on, 3 off and 5 on, 2 off rotas available, with start times from 12:00 and finish times of 22:00 or 00:00. We'll discuss your preferred shifts and working days at interview.

Salary:

  • Between £12.94 - £17.83 per hour depending on shift
  • Opportunity to boost earning potential with Premium overtime rates

What you'll be doing:

  • To ensure you load/unload product strictly in line with the Company's policies and procedures.
  • To ensure the correct documentation is completed for all inbound and dispatch loads.
  • Reporting any trailer or MHE faults in line with Company procedures and ensuring VOR vehicles are placed in the designated areas.
  • To remain vigilant in ensuring goods are picked and assembled accurately as per instructions.
  • To ensure dispatched loads are properly secured prior to leaving the loading bay.
  • To reach and maintain the standards required to meet the Company's productivity targets.
  • Ensure all practices and procedures are safely carried out in line with the Company’s Health & Safety policy, SSOWs and HACCP regulations, where appropriate, and to challenge colleagues who fail to adhere to any such rules or regulations.
  • Ensure customer returns are received, recorded and notified to the appropriate Stock Controller

What we're looking for:

  • Recent warehouse experience in a fast-paced environment is an advantage
  • Confident working to clear targets and KPI’s and delivering strong performance
  • Comfortable working in a chilled warehouse environment
  • Strong verbal communication and numerical accuracy
  • Reliable, hardworking and committed to doing the job we

In return for your hard work and dedication we offer the added bonus of an excellent benefits package, which include – but are not limited to – the following:

  • Free Fowler Welch Healthcare Cash Plan
  • Free life insurance as a Fowler Welch employee equal to three times your basic salary.
  • Competitive pension scheme
  • ‘Cycle 2 Work’ Scheme – save up to 42% on the cost of a new bike and necessary equipment.
  • Recognition schemes for our exceptional employees – monthly winners receive £100 of shopping vouchers

When our staff have passion for what they do they work with more care and attention which is reflected to our clients, Click APPLY NOW to #JoinOurWinningTeam and begin your career today!

description:
Shape Your World

At Alcoa, you will become an essential part of our purpose: to turn raw potential into real progress. The way we see it, every Alcoan is a work-shaper, team-shaper, idea-shaper & world-shaper.

Founded in 2006, with operations starting in 2009, the Juruti mine has a potential bauxite reserve of 700 million metric tons. Its current operating capacity is 7.5 million tons per year (6.5 million dry metric tons) of high-quality bauxite.

title: Associate Director – Portfolio Management
description:
As an Associate Director – Portfolio Management, you will have experience playing a pivotal role in driving excellence in global/national/regional portfolios with a focus on converting strategy into delivery, optimising portfolio performance, driving strategic capital planning and driving sustained success against annual portfolio objectives.

You lead multidisciplinary Portfolio and Portfolio Management Office teams, working closely with the portfolio leadership and senior client stakeholders. You set up, embed and manage robust governance, assurance and performance management frameworks that provide confidence in portfolio delivery. You ensure compliance with contractual, commercial, financial and risk management requirements, lead delivery teams to operate with transparency, accountability and consistency across portfolios, and drive continuous improvement and performance impact and maturity.

You know how to provide effective oversight throughout the investment lifecycle – including: Strategy Development, Stakeholder Engagement, Partnership Building, Capability Development, Portfolio Management, Portfolio Optimisation, Capital Investment Planning, Scenario Planning, Strategic Analysis, Benefits Realisation Management.

You lead and develop high-performing Portfolio and Portfolio Management Office teams, establishing the governance, controls and disciplines required to enable efficient and effective delivery across complex portfolios, programmes and projects.

Acting as a trusted advisor and critical interface between portfolio delivery teams, senior client stakeholders and the wider business, you provide assurance, constructive challenge and insight into portfolio performance. Your leadership ensures informed decision-making, effective portfolio controls and the successful delivery of strategic objectives, fostering a culture of operational excellence, high-quality client service, a strategically aligned, competitive portfolio and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Portfolio Leadership & Direction: Take end-to-end ownership of shaping, embedding, and communicating portfolio vision and direction. Effectively empower, motivate, and guide high-performing teams to drive success and cohesion across delivery activities, turning strategy into measurable outcomes. Lead on or deliver Strategic Portfolio Management and Capital Investment Planning providing a forward-looking view of capital allocation strategies. Work effectively with internal and client leads as required to deliver sustained strategic performance and business value across the portfolio.
  • Portfolio Controls & Optimisation: Evaluate the current state of portfolios through gap analysis, creating a roadmap and effectively leading a team to deliver the optimised future state. Establish and embed portfolio management and control frameworks to ensure rigor, compliance, transparency, and continuous improvement.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Influence: Establish and maintain trusted relationships with senior leaders, clients and key stakeholders, building a reputation as a collaborative partner & advisor. Drive connectivity across business functions, delivery teams and leadership groups, fostering strong partnerships and aligning diverse stakeholders behind a common vision and shared outcomes. Proactively collaborate across stakeholder groups to establish and deliver innovative and integrated solutions.
  • Risk & Health/Safety Management: Define and embed safeguards that manage portfolio risks including health and safety considerations. Lead on the proactive identification, escalation, and mitigation of risks and issues across the portfolio.
  • Financial Oversight: Drive the implementation and control of financial management processes, including CapEx performance, budget tracking, cost reporting, and financial risk visibility. Ensure portfolio financials are controlled, accurate, and aligned with governance requirements.
  • Commission Management and Business Development: Ensure the commission is well-managed from a contractual and commercial standpoint, build trusting client partnerships and identify and pursue future business growth / Business Development opportunities.
  • People & Culture: Act as a first-class colleague, taking a lead and positively contributing to the culture of internal and commission teams and demonstrating leadership in internal team growth. Build capability, mentor teams and colleagues, drive inclusion across the team and successfully carry out people management responsibilities to drive internal team performance and growth and our One Business culture.

This is an Associate Director level role. To excel in this role, you will have:

  • Accreditation or strong working knowledge of portfolio and/or programme management methodologies and governance frameworks, particularly within real estate and complex/fast-paced delivery environments.
  • Proven experience in portfolio and/or programme management, including in large-scale and/or high-profile real estate transformation projects.
  • Experience in performance optimisation initiatives and managing capital investment plans.
  • Strong experience overseeing the delivery of expected outcomes with best practice and high standards, driving performance and discipline in a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Excellent leadership skills, with the ability to lead and empower teams.
  • Proven ability to build successful delivery partnerships and trust, leading to strong stakeholder relationships.
  • Ability to balance multiple tasks and preserve portfolio delivery performance, team performance and the right behaviours.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills across various seniority levels.
  • Experience in effective portfolio / programme financial performance management including financial reporting, budget tracking, and cost / financial management processes. Awareness of procurement methodologies, contract forms, and commercial frameworks.
  • Experience in business development and successfully contributing to the securing of portfolio / programme management commissions and roles through your industry networks, competitive tender and interview processes, and/or negotiated opportunities.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and programme management tools, reporting systems and digital platforms, with a proactive approach to data, innovation and technology adoption.
  • Professional membership in a relevant field.
  • Degree or postgraduate qualification in a relevant field desirable.

title: Ekonom med inriktning inköp och avtal
description:
Länsstyrelsen är en viktig samordnande länk i gränssnittet mellan stat, region, kommun, näringsliv och enskilda. Länsstyrelsen verkar för att nationella mål får genomslag i länet, samtidigt som hänsyn tas till regionala förhållanden och förutsättningar. I det ingår att balansera angelägna samhällsintressen och reda ut målkonflikter. Länsstyrelsen har ett brett och mångfacetterat uppdrag både när det gäller uppgifter och sakområden. Myndighetens huvudsakliga uppgifter inkluderar tillståndsprövning, tillsyn, kunskapsförmedling samt samordning inom många samhällsområden. Hos oss arbetar cirka 230 personer och vår chef är landshövdingen.

Om du är intresserad av samhällsfrågor och vill medverka till utvecklingen av Värmlands län kan du vara rätt person för oss.

Beskrivning

Tjänsten som ekonom är placerad vid Ekonomienheten som ingår i avdelningen Verksamhetsstöd vid Länsstyrelsen Värmland.

Verksamhetsstöd innefattar även Informationshantering och HR, Kommunikation och Intern Service. Ekonomienheten arbetar med ekonomiska processer så som redovisning, årsredovisning och upphandling.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som ekonom kommer du kommer att få möjlighet att jobba med ekonomistöd till verksamheten och hjälpa till med andra vid en ekonomienhet vanliga arbetsuppgifter.

I arbetsuppgifterna ingår;

  • att bistå budgetansvariga med stöd vid inköp/avrop
  • avtalsförvaltning och uppföljning
  • jobba med strategiska, hållbara inköp och effektivt resursutnyttjande
  • administration och organisation av avtal
  • e-handel
  • att jobba med avrop från statliga avtal, service- och underhållsavtal och övriga gemensamma inköp
  • utveckla beställarkompetens internt, informera om avtal och beställningsrutiner
  • delta i direktupphandlingar

Du förväntas delta i olika typer utvecklingsprojekt inom verksamhetsområdet, ibland inom myndigheten och ibland i nationella sammanhang.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har eftergymnasial utbildning inom ekonomi eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig. Du har kunskap om och erfarenhet av inköp, förhandlingsteknik, avtalsuppföljning, avtal och digitala inköp. Du har vana av att arbeta självständigt och tar ansvar för resultatet av ditt arbete och att uppsatta mål uppnås.

Du är noggrann och kvalitetsmedveten och van att arbeta mot deadlines. Du har en god analytisk förmåga samtidigt som du samarbetar väl med andra och har en god kommunikativ förmåga såväl muntligt som skriftligt. Tjänsten innebär ett nära samarbete med chefer och medarbetare inom myndigheten. Därför är det viktigt med ett konsultativt förhållningssätt, god samarbetsförmåga, att du har lätt för att skapa goda relationer samt har en känsla för service och tillgänglighet.

Villkor

Vi använder oss av sex månaders provanställning.

Svenskt medborgarskap är ett krav då anställning innebär placering i säkerhetsklass. Ett krav för att få anställning är godkänd säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll. Säkerhetsprövningen kommer att genomföras i enlighet med bestämmelser i säkerhetsskyddslagen.

Tjänsten innebär placering i myndighetens kris-och krigsorganisation.

För att arbeta hos oss ska du dela statens gemensamma värdegrund. Dess sex principer anger inriktningen för hur myndigheter och statsanställda ska ta sig an sina uppdrag.

title: Kitchen Assistant Supervisor
description:
As a Kitchen Assistant Supervisor, you will oversee food prep and assembly operations while ensuring high standards of safety, quality, and efficiency. Acting as a link between management and staff, you will direct daily production workflows while fostering a fair, inclusive environment where tasks are shared equally and every team member receives opportunities to learn.

Fair Team Leadership & People Management (Togetherness & Nurture)

  • Fair Task Distribution: Rotate tasks fairly, ensuring balance across the team whilst ensuring all staff can complete all tasks.
  • Equal Opportunity Champion an inclusive team culture where every Kitchen Assistant receives equal access to on-the-job training and cross-skilling across different prep sections.
  • Supportive & Objective Management: Lead by example with consistency, fairness, and transparency (Togetherness) Resolve day-to-day shift issues objectively and supportively
  • Team Morale & Inclusion: Encourage open communication, foster strong teamwork across shifts, and ensure every team member feels valued, heard, and respected regardless of background or experience level.

Production & Operational Supervision

  • Oversee daily prep, assembly, and packaging workflows for high-volume ready-to-eat products and salads,
  • Ensure all products strictly follow approved spec sheets, portion controls, and wastage controls
  • Monitor efficiency to ensure production schedule is met on time.
  • Assist in organising daily shift allocations, rotation of duties, and break management fairly across the team.

Quality, Food Safety & Hygiene Standards

  • Working with kitchen assistants, supporting food safety, ensuring strict adherence to HACCP guidelines, CCP controls, and allergen segregation procedures.
  • Monitor traceability documentation and blast chilling records,
  • Implement clean as you go attitude ensuring workstations, and production areas meet high cleaning standards on every shift.
  • Report operational hazards, equipment faults, or product non-conformances immediately to senior supervisors/management.

The role is based primarily within temperature-controlled cold rooms (chilled environments, <8°C) to maintain product freshness and safety.

Thermal protective wear and specialised PPE are fully provided.

Requires physical stamina, including standing for extended period and lifting

Skills/Knowledge/Experience Required:

Essential

  • Leadership & Fairness: Demonstrated ability to lead people fairly and impartially, fostering an inclusive team dynamic with equal support for all members.
  • Experience: Proven track record in a high-volume food production, central assembly kitchen, or commercial catering environment
  • Qualifications: Level 2 Award in Food Safety in Catering/Manufacturing (or willingness to achieve Level 3 upon appointment).
  • Communication: Clear, open, and empathetic communication skills to mentor and direct a diverse team during busy production.
  • Attention to Detail: Precise approach to specs and allergen safety.
  • Flexibility: Adaptable mindset regarding shift patterns, rota schedules, and support throughout the Central Production Kitchen.

Desirable

  • Experience in inclusive leadership, shift delegation, or mentoring staff.
  • Level 3 Award in Food Safety / HACCP certification.
  • Health & Safety qualification or First Aid at Work certificate
  • Experience operating in chilled high-care or high-risk manufacturing environments.

Interpersonal Skills

Fairness & Impartiality

Treats every team member consistently and without bias, ensuring work assignments, break rotations, and development opportunities are distributed equitably.

Empathetic & Active Listening

Demonstrates a genuine willingness to listen to staff concerns, feedback, or shift challenges, ensuring team members feel heard, valued, and respected.

Clear & Approachable Communication

Adapts communication style to suit a diverse team, delivering daily briefs clearly, giving constructive feedback supportively, and maintaining an open-door presence

Conflict Resolution

Handles floor-level disagreements, friction, or misunderstandings calmly and objectively, de-escalating tensions before they impact shift morale.

Team Motivation & Engagement

Drives a positive, collaborative environment ("Be a tractor, not a trailer"), encouraging teamwork, recognizing good work, and keeping morale high during busy production runs.

Mentorship & Coaching Mindset

Takes pride in supporting staff (Nurture), offering patient guidance and encouragement to help others succeed.

Employee Benefits Menu

At Somerset Larder, we believe our people are the secret ingredient to our success. Here’s a flavourful look at the benefits we’ve cooked up for our amazing team:

Generous Time Off

Savour a well-balanced blend of work and personal time with our generous annual leave allowance (31 days including bank holidays)

Pension Contributions with Extra Spice

Prepare for your future with a pension plan that goes beyond the basics – 5% from you, matched with a hearty 5% from us

Life Assurance

Our life assurance plan is here to provide peace of mind, so you can focus on serving up excellence

Cycle Scheme

Get a healthy and eco-friendly start to each day with our cycle scheme – perfect for working up an appetite!

Comprehensive Family Leave Benefits

When life serves up big changes, we’re here to support you with a menu of family leave benefits designed so you can make memories as you care for your family.

Free Food and Drink on Shift

Enjoy a daily free meal/drink so you can fuel up and stay energised.

Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)/Mental Health First Aiders

Tap into our 24/7, all-year round helpline and portal Wisdom, loaded with resources on health, finances, legal advice and lifestyle tips – a full menu of support options

Christmas Shutdown

Relax during the festive period whilst the operation is closed between Christmas and New Year – a rarity for the Hospitality industry (option to volunteer for skeleton staffing)

Learning, Development and Apprenticeship Opportunities

Stir up new skills with a range of development and apprenticeship opportunities to help you grow your career and cook up success in the culinary world.

Access to Occupational Health

As a perk of being part of the HPC project, you will have access to Health Partners, the UK’s leading provider of workplace health services

Refer a Friend Scheme

Use our employee referral programme and benefit financially by adding people from your professional network to our workforce.

Monthly Recognition: A Toast to you

Each month, we raise a glass to our star team members who go above and beyond, as nominated by their colleagues

Long Service Awards

Celebrate the milestones! Receive our heartfelt gratitude and special recognition at your 5- and 10-year anniversaries

Annual Team Awards

Join us for our annual awards event as we honour the outstanding contributions and achievements of our team. It’s our way of saying cheers to you!

This benefits menu is our recipe for a rewarding and fulfilling career, where you can develop your talents and delight in the journey ahead.

Pre-Employment Screening

Successful applicants will be required to provide a three-year employment history and five-year address history to work on Hinkley Point C.

They must be able to provide in date photographic ID and their right to work in the UK so that security clearance can be obtained as these roles are based on a nuclear regulated site.

title: Tiimivastaava, Mainiokoti Saimaa, Savonlinna
description:
Tiimivastaava, Mainiokoti Saimaa, Savonlinna

Tule mukaan luomaan kodin tuntua Mainiokoti Saimaaseen Savonlinnaan.

Haemme tiimivastaavaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen osaksi huipputiimiä kauniiseen ja kodinomaiseen yksikköömme.

Mihin tulet töihin?
Mainiokoti Saimaa on ainutlaatuinen yksikkö Savonlinnassa, Saimaan rannalla. Tarjoamme ympärivuorokautista hoivaa sekä ikääntyneille asukkaillemme että kehitysvammaisille asukkaillemme omissa yksiköissään. Kodissamme on yhteensä 37 asukaspaikkaa, ja tarjoamme asukkaillemme turvallisen ja viihtyisän kodin, jossa jokainen saa elää omannäköistään elämää. Panostamme yhteisöllisyyteen ja aktiiviseen arkeen, jossa asukkaiden toiveet ja mielenkiinnon kohteet ovat keskiössä. Työryhmämme on avoin ja ammattitaitoinen. Arjen käytäntöjen organisointi on tiimivastaavan tehtävä kodissamme.

Mitä pääset tekemään?
Tiimivastaavana pääset tekemään arvokasta työtä asukkaidemme hyvinvoinnin eteen osana huipputiimiä. Tehtäväsi painottuu kehitysvammaisten yksikköön ja sisältää vastuuta molemmista yksiköistä, riippuen osaamisestasi ja yksikön tarpeista. Työnkuvaan kuuluu myös laadunvalvontaa, arjen sujuvuudesta vastaaminen/työn organisointi, työvuorolistojen teko, yksikönjohtajan sijaistaminen, tilaajayhteistyö sekä muita yhdessä sovittuja vastuita yksikön tarpeen ja oman kiinnostuksesi mukaan.

Arkemme on aktiivista ja toteutamme asukkaiden toiveita parhaamme mukaan. Järjestämme monipuolista toimintaa ja sinulla on mahdollisuus vaikuttaa ja kehittää tätä toimintaa.

Kuka sinä olet?
Olet koulutukseltasi sosionomi tai sairaanhoitaja AMK, olet innovatiivinen ja haluat olla osana kehittämässä toimintaa yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa. Pystyt ottamaan vastuuta, olet oma-aloitteinen ja uskallat tehdä myös itsenäisiä päätöksiä tarpeen vaatiessa. Aiempi kokemus vastaavasta tehtävästä sekä koulutus ja kokemus ikääntyneiden hoivatyöstä ja kehitysvammatyöstä on eduksi. Tiimissämme menestyy parhaiten ulospäin suuntautunut, huumorintajuinen ja toimeen tarttuva persoona. Hoitotyön tehtävien hoitaminen edellyttää vähintään B1 ja avustavien tehtävien hoitaminen edellyttää vähintään A2 tai vastaavaa suomen kielen kielitaitotasoa, sekä sitoutumista kielitaidon ylläpitämiseen.

Miksi tulisit meille töihin?
Mainiokoti Saimaassa pääset aidosti välittävään ja iloiseen ilmapiiriin. Kotimme on ainutlaatuinen rakenteeltaan ja tiimimme on työskennellyt täällä pitkään yhdessä. Tarjoamme sinulle merkityksellisen työn, jossa pääset kehittämään omaa osaamistasi ja vaikuttamaan asukkaidemme arkeen. Mainiokoti Saimaassa olemme luoneet yhdessä työyhteisön hyveet, joita ovat avoimuus, arvostus ja huumori. Mainiokotien työntekijänä sinulla on monipuoliset koulutus- ja kehitysmahdollisuudet.

Työ on pääsääntöisesti päivätyötä arkisin. Työsuhde on kokoaikainen ja toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Palkkauksemme on yksityisen sosiaalialan TES G24D mukainen, jonka lisäksi maksetaan tiimivastaavalle tehtäväkohtaista lisää.

Mehiläisenä saat käyttöösi hyvät henkilöstöedut, kuten E-passiedun ja työterveyshuollon. Meillä on myös laajat koulutusmahdollisuudet ja pääset kehittämään itseäsi.

Sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti tehtävään valittavien ikääntyvien tai vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työskentelevien on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitetturikosrekisteriote.

Hae tehtävää rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta mahdollisimman pian.

Kiinnostutko tehtävästä, kerron mielelläni lisää:
Yksikönjohtaja Taina Malkki
puh. 044 531 9616
taina.malkki@mainiokodit.fi
Tavoitettavissa 6-7.7.2026 klo 14-16 välisenä aikana.

https://mainiokodit.fi/hoivakodit/mainiokoti-saimaa

Sen tuntee, kun tulee kotiin.

Mainiokotien missiona on luoda parempaa hoitoa Suomeen mahdollistamalla jokaiselle asukkaalle yksilöllinen ja hyvä elämä. Panostamme Mainiokodeissa laadukkaaseen hoivaan, hoitoon ja ohjaukseen, maukkaaseen ruokaan, turvallisuuteen, yhteisöllisyyteen sekä siihen, että jokaisella asiakkaalla on oma viihtyisä koti. Mainiokotien brändin symboli, räsymatto, kuvaa koko elämän kirjoa iloineen ja suruineen.

Mainiokodit on osa Mehiläistä. Mehiläisen sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluiden ammattilaiset työskentelevät joka päivä tinkimättömästi yksityis-, yritys- ja kunta-asiakkaidemme hyväksi. Tervetuloa mukaan vahvistamaan ammattilaistemme joukkoa!

title: AI/HPC Data Center Rack Design Engr
description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.

AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.




THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly skilled systems engineer to design data center rack layouts for AI/HPC clusters. This role involves

evaluating and selecting rack-level compute, storage, networking, power delivery, and cooling solutions to optimize performance and reliability across global deployments. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver cutting-edge infrastructure for AI and high-performance computing workloads.

THE PERSON

An experienced systems engineer with a strong background in HPC, AI infrastructure, and data center engineering. You bring deep technical knowledge of data center rack layout, compute and networking components, a strategic mindset for system-level design, and the ability to collaborate across diverse technical domains. You thrive in fast-paced environments and are passionate about building efficient, scalable, and reliable compute platforms.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Rack & Cluster Design
    • Design scalable AI/HPC data center rack layouts including compute, storage, networking, power delivery and cooling
    • Translate high level requirements and architecture input into detailed rack designs
    • Design leading-edge thermal and power delivery for high-density deployments

  • Network
    • Design intra-rack and rack-to-rack network connections to maximize overall cluster performance
    • Translate network architecture requirements and input into rack-level designs
    • Understand the network performance needs of different types of workloads
    • Understand advantages and performance trade-offs of network topologies for AI/HPC clusters

  • Power
    • Design rack-level and data center power delivery infrastructure
    • Define power budgets, redundancy schemes, and fault tolerance mechanisms
    • Understand differences in power delivery and regulatory requirements in global locations, e.g. U.S., EMEA, Asia and other countries

  • Storage
    • Translate storage architecture requirements and input into rack-level designs
    • Design and optimize storage solutions to maximize AI/HPC cluster performance
    • Understand advantages and performance trade-offs of cluster storage solutions, e.g. Lustre, Ceph, etc.

  • Collaboration
    • Work across multiple organizations with subject matter experts from hardware, software, network, data center, and operations teams to deliver scalable, efficient, and reliable compute infrastructure.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

  • Extensive experience in HPC, AI infrastructure, or data center systems engineering
  • Experience with liquid cooling or advanced thermal management
  • Experience with rack level power distribution
  • Contributions to open-source HPC or AI infrastructure projects

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Eng

title: menedżer(-ka) klienta agro
description:
To masz na bank:

  • umowa o pracę (pierwsza na 12 miesięcy, po zakończeniu okresu wdrożenia możliwość zawarcia umowy na czas nieokreślony),

  • mobilną pracę z klientami z sektora rolnego,

  • zespół/lider: Jarosław Pałasz,

  • udział w atrakcyjnym systemie premiowym (z gwarantowaną premia w okresie wdrożeniowym) i w szerokiej ofercie benefitowej.

Na bank cenimy sobie relacje z ludźmi. Do oddziałów szukamy osób, które tak jak my chcą zapewnić naszym klientom z sektora rolnego najlepsze doświadczenie w obszarze finansowym - jesteśmy bankiem z zapleczem technologicznym i doświadczeniem w finansowaniu gospodarstw rolnych.

Zarządzamy wieloma produktami bankowymi dla osób prywatnych oraz przedsiębiorstw. Mamy ponad 10-letnie doświadczenie w finansowaniu sektora rolnego.

Cenimy różnorodność wśród naszych pracowników. Wierzymy, że każdy, bez względu na indywidualne predyspozycje, może wnieść niepowtarzalną wartość do naszej firmy.

Aplikuj, jeśli:

  • masz minimum 5-letnie doświadczenie w obsłudze klienta MŚP w sektorze rolnym (obszar finansów)

  • masz bardzo dobrą wiedzę na temat rynku rolnego

  • cenisz sobie kontakt z ludźmi i długotrwałe relacje oparte na zaufaniu,

  • lubisz działać zespołowo i osiągać wspólnie ustalone cele,

  • posiadasz wiedzę z zakresu analizy finansowej gospodarstw rolnych,

  • masz minimum 5 lata doświadczenia w kredytowaniu klientów z sektora rolnego

  • posiadasz szeroką wiedzę na temat standardów, procesów i procedur oraz produktów i usług bankowych, w szczególności tych skierowanych do sektora rolnego,

  • masz doświadczenie w strukturyzowaniu finansowania inwestycji dla sektora rolnego,

  • masz doświadczenie w finansowaniu gospodarstw rolnych ze wsparciem środków publicznych (kredyty preferencyjne, inwestycje w ramach PROW i KPS),

  • masz doświadczenie we współpracy z organizacjami rolniczymi (Ośrodki Doradztwa Rolniczego i inne organizacje branżowe)

  • masz minimum średnie wykształcenie,

  • masz umiejętności analityczne,

  • umiesz budować długoterminowe relacje z klientami,

  • masz prawo jazdy kat. B.

Twoje zadania w tej roli:

  • pozyskiwanie do współpracy klientów z sektora rolnego,

  • pełna diagnoza potrzeb klienta (w tym w bliższej i dalszej perspektywie), dopasowanie oferty banku z uwzględnieniem właściwej struktury finansowania,

  • strukturyzowanie transakcji oraz przygotowywanie rekomendacji kredytowych dla klientów z sektora rolnego,

  • umawianie spotkań w siedzibie klienta, aby poznać specyfikę działania gospodarstwa rolnego,

  • prezentowanie klientowi rozwiązań na podstawie informacji z systemów bankowych i z wykorzystaniem dostępnych narzędzi,

  • udzielanie informacji na temat obowiązującej oferty produktów i usług bankowych oraz leasingowych skierowanych do sektora rolnego,

  • organizowanie spotkań akwizycyjnych,

  • inicjowanie zmian powodujących poprawę/dostosowanie produktów/usług/procesów do potrzeb klientów oraz w celu zwiększania konkurencyjności banku,

  • realizacja celów i zadań wspierając jednocześnie wyniki całego zespołu i regionu,

  • dbanie o aktualność, jakość i kompletność danych klienta w systemach informatycznych banku,

  • bieżąca i systematyczna rejestracja kontaktów z klientem w systemie,

  • oferowanie i promowanie produktów bankowych i leasingowych dla klientów z sektora rolnego.

Na bank zadbamy dla Ciebie o:

  • umowę o pracę (pierwszą na 12 miesięcy, po zakończeniu okresu wdrożenia możliwość zawarcia umowy na czas nieokreślony),

  • ubezpieczenie na życie,

  • prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover (z możliwością wykupienia pakietu stomatologicznego),

  • ofertę produktową banku oraz pożyczki na warunkach pracowniczych,

  • system kafeteryjny z punktami do wymiany na aktywności, np. wypoczynkowe, kulturalne, gastronomiczne lub dofinansowanie do przedszkola/żłobka/klubu dziecięcego,

  • kartę Multisport oraz aktywności wellbeingowe, np. Kluby Zainteresowań, webinary,

  • możliwość udziału w wolontariacie,

  • dodatkowe świadczenia socjalne (np. wyprawka dla dzieci),

  • benefity dla osób z niepełnosprawnościami: dodatek finansowy na cele prozdrowotne, dodatkowe 2 dni urlopu dla pracowników z lekkim stopniem niepełnosprawności,

  • program poleceń pracowniczych – nagrodę pieniężną za polecenie osoby do pracy w naszym banku.

Jak wygląda wdrożenie i rozwój?

  • Na bank nie wrzucimy Cię na głęboką wodę. Zaplanowaliśmy wdrożenie, które obejmować będzie wprowadzenie do organizacji, Twojej jednostki biznesowej i zadań.

  • Pierwsze szkolenie będzie trwało 6 miesięcy w ramach Akademii Rozwoju Mocy.

  • Po 2 miesiącach zaczniesz realizować część planu sprzedażowego i otrzymywać pierwsze premie.

  • Przez pierwsze miesiące pokażemy Ci naszą kulturę organizacyjną i odpowiemy na wszystkie pytania.

  • Po okresie wdrożenia zaczniesz w pełni realizować plany sprzedażowe.

  • Zapewnimy Ci wsparcie ekspertów w finansowaniu sektora rolnego,

Dołącz do nas w 3 krokach:

  • Wyślij CV do naszej analizy, a my podejmiemy decyzję czy zaprosimy Cię do kolejnego etapu,
  • Spotkaj się z rekruterem i menadżerem,
  • Pracuj z nami w naszym Zespole!

Po każdym z etapów rekrutacji otrzymasz od nas informację zwrotną, dostosowaną do jego poziomu zaawansowania. Po spotkaniach zaś wrócimy do Ciebie z kompleksowym podsumowaniem mailowym lub telefonicznym.

Stosujemy najwyższe standardy zarządzania ryzykiem, dbamy o bezpieczeństwo naszych klientów i świadczonych usług.

title: Head of Brand & Campaigns, Deliveroo for Work
description:
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it’s a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

We’re looking for a Head of Brand & Campaigns to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us shape and scale the B2B brand strategy and multi-channel campaign execution for Deliveroo and Wolt for Work across 25 global markets.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the For Work B2B Marketing team. Deliveroo and Wolt for Work operate as a fast-growing, entrepreneurial vertical within the business, helping corporate clients across 25 global markets deliver great food solutions for their teams.

Brand & Campaign Strategy

  • Lead the planning, orchestration, and message mix for integrated campaigns across 25 global markets, balancing brand positioning with performance objectives.

  • Act as a steward for the For Work brands, setting the strategic direction, preserving brand voice, and maintaining high quality across all customer-facing touchpoints.

Digital Execution & Scaling

  • Apply hands-on digital media expertise to help scale campaigns across LinkedIn, Meta, Search, podcasts, and publications, while embedding AI-led processes for media buying and creative translation.

  • Oversee end-to-end integration across paid and owned channels (CRM, organic social), managing campaign budgets, agency contracts, and quarter-by-quarter forecasting.

Measurement & Leadership

  • Define measurement frameworks, campaign KPIs, and reporting processes to surface insights and continuously improve efficiency.

  • Partner closely with four functional Marketing Managers (Creative, Campaign Leadership, Product Marketing, CRM), providing strategic direction, coaching, and execution support.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Proven ability to combine strategic brand thinking with hands-on digital media execution and buying expertise (including LinkedIn, Meta, and Search).

  • Demonstrated experience orchestrating multi-market, integrated campaigns across cross-functional teams, including CRM, organic social, and commercial functions.

  • Experience in line management, leading direct reports, and coaching teams to support their ongoing development.

  • Strong analytical capabilities with a track record of setting KPIs, defining measurement frameworks, and using data to guide decisions.

  • An entrepreneurial owner’s mindset with comfortable operating at pace in high-growth, ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience scaling marketing execution across multi-market B2B or corporate verticals.

  • Familiarity with leveraging AI tools for global creative translation, automation, and media buying efficiency.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

  • 🔧 Make a visible impact every day

    Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

  • 🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

    Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

  • 🧠 Build a career, not just a role

    Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

  • 🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

    Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!
