title: Product Owner Lead (gn)
description:
Job Type:

Permanent

Build a brilliant future with Hiscox

Lead Product Owner (gn)

Reporting to: Head of Change
Location: Lisbon
Band: III

The Role

This role is part of the European Change Team, working closely with Value Streams, business sponsors, technology teams, and delivery roles in order to deliver strategic, operational, and regulatory change and achieve tangible business outcomes across Hiscox Europe.

The Lead Product Owner is accountable for the leadership, capability development, and performance of the Product Owner function across Hiscox Europe.

The role has a dual mandate:

  • to act as the functional owner of Product Ownership, defining standards, career paths, and quality expectations; and
  • to act as a Change Business Partner to one or more Countries or Functions, supporting senior stakeholders in shaping, prioritising, and delivering change outcomes through Value Streams.

The role is responsible for managing and balancing priorities across multiple Value Streams, ensuring that European, local, and functional initiatives are effectively incorporated into backlogs and delivery plans.

Working closely with the Agile Coach, the role ensures strong and consistent application of agile principles and practices across Value Streams.

The Lead Product Owner operates with a high degree of autonomy and judgment, influencing outcomes across multiple Value Streams, initiatives, and geographies, and acting as a key integrator between strategy, prioritisation, and delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Main activities for this role should be:

  • Lead and be accountable for the Product Owner function across Hiscox Europe, ensuring consistent quality, value delivery, and outcomes
  • Define, own, and embed Product Ownership standards, ways of working, and quality benchmarks in collaboration with the Agile Coach
  • Establish and maintain a clear Product Owner career framework, including role definitions, progression criteria, and capability expectations
  • Line manage, coach, and develop Product Owners, setting clear objectives and holding accountability for performance and delivery outcomes
  • Manage and balance priorities across multiple Value Streams, ensuring alignment with European strategy and business objectives
  • Ensure European, local, and functional initiative requirements are effectively translated into Value Stream backlogs
  • Work with Value Stream sponsors and senior stakeholders to shape objectives, priorities, and expected outcomes
  • Act as the senior escalation point for prioritisation conflicts, scope decisions, and value trade offs
  • Oversee and challenge Value Stream roadmaps, backlogs, and delivery plans to maximise value and manage dependencies
  • Ensure effective coordination and dependency management across Value Streams and initiatives
  • Act as Change Business Partner to one or more Countries or Functions, supporting senior leaders in shaping, prioritising, and sequencing change agendas
  • Work with the remaining Change team leaders to ensure a cohesive change pipeline across Europe and representing the interests of the Country or Function they represent
  • Build trusted relationships with Country and Functional leadership, providing insight, challenge, and decision support
  • Represent Product Ownership in governance, prioritisation, and senior decision forums
  • Promote a value-driven, customer-centric, and outcome-oriented mindset across Value Streams
  • Drive continuous improvement in agile maturity, delivery effectiveness, and ways of working
  • Ensure Product Ownership practices align with Hiscox Europe change frameworks, agile principles, and operating model

Technical must-haves

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, ideally in Management / Economics / Engineering (or similar)
  • Proven experience in a Product Owner or similar role within agile delivery environments
  • Strong understanding of agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid models)
  • Experience working in Value Stream based or product-centric operating models
  • Ability to translate business needs into clear, actionable backlog items
  • Experience working closely with business stakeholders and Tech delivery teams
  • Strong prioritisation and decision-making capability
  • Fluent in English, verbally and written

Personality trades

  • Strong sense of accountability and ownership for outcomes
  • Ability to make informed prioritisation decisions in complex environments
  • Clear and confident communicator with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Pragmatic, delivery-oriented, and value-focused mindset
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills
  • Curiosity and drive for continuous improvement

Nice to haves

  • Experience in insurance or financial services
  • Exposure to multi-country or European operating models
  • Agile certification (e.g. CSPO, SAFe PO/PM, or similar)
  • Experience working with regulatory or compliance-driven change
  • Fluency in other European languages (e.g. French, German, Spanish)

DEPARTMENT: Donated Goods SUPERVISED BY: Store Manager. Asst. Mgr. STATUS: Non-exempt, Temporary

Mission Contribution: Supports the mission of Goodwill Gulf Coast by assisting across retail operations, contributing to effective donation intake, merchandise preparation, and customer service.

Function: This temporary position is designed to train and support individuals in all core areas of retail store operations including donation intake, sales floor maintenance, and merchandise processing.

Essential Functions:

  1. Ensures World Class donor and customer service, greeting customers within 10 seconds and providing friendly service and information.
  2. Assists with unloading donations from the donors’ vehicle and takes in donations left outside of store.
  3. Keep an accurate count of donations.
  4. Sorting donations into designated equipment.
  5. Loading large purchases for customers.
  6. Sort and price merchandise, separating sellable from unsellable items, and preparing items for display.
  7. Clean, hang, and rotate merchandise on the sales floor, ensuring a neat and organized presentation.
  8. Monitor and maintain cleanliness and organization of the dressing rooms and sales floor throughout the day.
  9. Support customers with questions, including assisting with free medical equipment forms and stocking as needed.
  10. Ensures a clean and empty work station at the end of each shift.
  11. Ensures the image of the exterior and interior of the donation area are maintained to Goodwill’s standards.
  12. Keeps aisles free from debris in the production area.
  13. Maintains adherence to all company policies and procedures.
  14. Other duties as assigned.

Skills, knowledge and abilities: (these are required to enable job holder to perform the essential functions of the job).

  1. Must be able to interact cordially and productively with a variety of people.
  2. Must be able to market Goodwill and explain the mission to the general public.
  3. Must be able to take initiative and work well with little supervision.
  4. Must be able to work a flexible schedule including nights and weekends.
  5. Must be able to distinguish between better name brand merchandise.

Experience and Education Requirements:

    • High School diploma or GED preferred, but not required.
    • Prior work experience in the service industry preferred.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to engage in frequent bending, stretching and stooping.
  • Ability to engage in prolonged standing, walking and twisting.
  • Ability to push equipment on wheels weighing 50 lbs. to 150 lbs.
  • Ability to lift and carry objects weighing up to 25 lbs. frequently and 75 lbs. with assistance occasionally.
  • Ability to use fingers, hands and wrists, repetitively.

Working Conditions:

Frequent physical exertion; exposure to unfit donated goods.

Critical Performance Factors:

  1. Customer Service
  2. Safety/Accident Prevention
  3. Speed and quality of processing
  4. Cleanliness & Organization

title: Family Practice Physician
company: HEART OF OHIO FAMILY HEALTH CENTERS
description:
Summary: This position supports the Organization in the following manner:

  • Provider is compliance of laws and regulations pertaining to the Organization’s administration of health care
  • Physician provides medical services to the patients of Community Health Services in acute care and the clinical office setting
  • Establishes and maintains a patient practice establishing health plans with diagnosis and performing non-surgical treatment of diseases and injuries of internal organ systems. Provide care mainly for adults who have a wide range of problems associated with the internal organs.

Reports to: Chief Medical Officer

Supervises: N/A

Dress Requirement: Business casual with white provider coat or scrubs in accordance to Heart of Ohio Family Health’s dress code policy

Work Schedule: Full Time

Monday through Friday during standard business hours Times are subject to change due to business necessity

Exempt

Job Duties, these are considered essential to the successful performance of this position:

  • Maintains strict patient confidentiality at all times
  • Completes patient history and physical
  • Documents all patient care provided according to policy
  • Formulates and directs plan of care for the patient
  • Refers to other Providers as needed
  • Prescribes medications in accordance with Ohio revised code and Ohio Administrative Code

  • Participates in Performance Improvement Program

OSHA, OIG, guidelines, other State and Federal laws). This also includes reporting to the Board of Directors, Compliance Officer, Privacy Officer, supervisor, suggestion box, any suspected unethical, fraudulent, or unlawful acts or practices.

Telephone

Computer

Printer

Fax machine

Copier

Other office equipment as assigned

description:
Coach is a global fashion house founded in New York in 1941. Inspired by the vision of Creative Director Stuart Vevers and the inclusive and courageous spirit of our hometown, we make beautiful things, crafted to last—for you to be yourself in.

Coach is part of the Tapestry portfolio – a global house of brands committed to stretching what’s possible.

A member of the Tapestry family, we are part of a global house of brands that has unwavering optimism and is committed to being innovative and wholly inclusive. Visit Our People page to learn more about Tapestry's commitment to equity, inclusion, and diversity.

The successful individual will leverage their proficiency in eCommerce to...

  • Monthly upload of new products on UK, FR and EU / ROW sites, ensuring proper presentation of the online assortment, including product information, category information and website merchandising to maintain the sites to a high standard.
  • Prepare for site refreshes by building navigation, search dictionary updates, merchandising and trend shops, and managing the item set-up process, including catalogue and product attribution.
  • Support the planned migration of smaller EU sites to Global-e, helping enable greater localisation and ensuring site set-up is accurate and customer-ready.
  • Work with our translations agency to ensure localised site content, with particular focus on France, is translated accurately and to a high standard.
  • Work with Buying and Planning partners to support the promotional calendar, new product launches and category launches across Retail category.
  • Work with Digital Design and Web Production on creative for homepages, promotions and campaigns, ensuring the site reflects business priorities, stock availability and local market needs.
  • Regular research of competitor online activity, edit creation and digital innovation.
  • Weekly site review of UK, FR, EU and ROW sites to monitor site standards, reporting any operational or testing issues that arise.
  • Additional ad hoc website tasks as required, including testing new functionality and analysis of competitor tools or functionalities we should be looking to develop.
  • Optimise on-site search, as well as cross-sell and up-sell products on the site.
  • Work closely across all functions of the eCommerce team.
  • Deliver weekly reporting on site performance for cross-functional and team meetings, leveraging available analytics platforms to provide relevant and actionable insights.

The accomplished individual will possess...

  • Bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 1-2 years’ experience in an eCommerce or digital focused role.
  • Experience working independently and as a team member in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience of working in a global company/brand and/or online startup.
  • Excellent organizational skills and detail orientation.
  • Excellent communication, presentation and analytical skills.
  • Ability to multi-task under tight deadlines and have a strong sense of urgency.
  • Strong problem-solving skills; proactive and take initiative.
  • Ability to act quickly to last-minute requests and changes.
  • Able to work autonomously.
  • Computer literate, particularly in Excel.
  • Prior experience with SFCC, a PIM system, Global-e or CMS tools would be advantageous.

An outstanding professional will have...

  • Experience of working with U.S based head office
  • Additional European language skills, particularly French
  • Interest in AEO, inspirational site content and online customer experience

What Tapestry can offer you:

  • Hybrid working (3 days working from the office, 2 days remote)

  • Option to finish early on a Friday (Flex Fridays)

  • 1 Paid Volunteering Day per year and opportunities to volunteer with global projects

  • Learning & Development opportunities

  • Internal mobility & career progression

  • Regular Social Events - Seasonal & Cultural

  • Equity Inclusion & Diversity initiatives which include employee resource groups & regional inclusion council

Other benefits include:

At Tapestry, we are committed to building a diverse & inclusive workforce. We know that having a wide range of perspectives and experiences makes us more innovative and brings us closer to our consumers. If you are interested in this role but do not believe you meet all the set criteria, that’s ok. We are happy to work with individuals who have the drive, passion, agility and willingness to learn. So, take a chance and apply; you may just be who we are looking for. We would be delighted to hear from you.

Our Competencies for All Employees
Courage: Doesn’t hold back anything that needs to be said; provides current, direct, complete, and “actionable” positive and corrective feedback to others; lets people know where they stand; faces up to people problems on any person or situation (not including direct reports) quickly and directly; is not afraid to take negative action when necessary.

title: Shipping Specialist
description:
The Shipping Specialist will perform safe and efficient picking, preparation, packaging, and transportation of products for customer shipments. Reference packing list/bill of lading to verify the accuracy of incoming and outgoing shipments and orders, and document damages and discrepancies for future reimbursement and reconciliation.

Shift: Monday - Friday, 8a - 4:30p

Essential Functions/Responsibilities

  • Safely, expeditiously, and accurately transport products:
    • To/from work site or shipping areas using material handling equipment such as a forklift or pallet jack.
    • Load and unload materials onto or from trucks, pallets, trays, racks, and shelves; assist outside truckers to properly load cargo.
  • Accurately examine job packet, order information, and shipping documents to ensure:
    • Items are prepped properly for cargo through inspection, weighing, measuring, and counting.
    • Parts for shipment are securely stored, including efficiently operating RanPak, InstaPak and other packaging machines.
    • Package contents are verified, complete and meet company quality standards.
    • Count and part numbers of items are verified prior to packaging.
    • Incoming and outgoing freight is verified and documented against packing list/bills of lading.
    • Incoming and outgoing warehouse parts are subject to a visual quality check.
  • Efficiently build pallets and crates using hand and power tools as needed for specific orders ensuring wrap and labels for packages are correct as indicated on the work order.
  • Accurately maintain inventory levels by transferring and transacting products in real time using the bar code scanning system.
  • Ensure timely communication with the Warehouse Supervisor to advise of status changes that affect order commitments.
  • Safely operate fork trucks, overhead crane, electric pallet jack and other industrial vehicles for which training has been completed and qualification achieved and maintained through the daily checklist. Operate tools and equipment as instructed and only as intended by the manufacturer. Ensure tools and other items are safely and properly stored.
  • Under instruction from Warehouse Supervisor, assist with storage/shipping projects as needed; to include:
    • Performs bench and floor work as assigned to assemble, construct, build and repair parts for, degassing equipment, metal pumps and similar units.
    • Set up or adjust fixture equipment as appropriate to assemble parts.
    • Complete workorder kits for production and point of use deliveries.
    • Perform cycle counts and monitor inventory levels.

Education/Experience

  • High School Diploma or General Education Development (GED) / Test Assessing Secondary Completion (TASC), plus one (1) year in a manufacturing warehouse, or shipping environment, preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experiences.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

  • Technical Skills. Ability to use hoists, and various hand and power tools such as band and circular saws, weigh scales, foam generating equipment and banding equipment. Ability to read and interpret simple blueprints. Ability to obtain and maintain forklift certification and other industrial equipment certification(s), as needed.
  • Computer/Applications Skills. Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Products, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Ability to operate electronic weight, printing and computing equipment including bar code scanners.
  • Core Business Skills. Ability to exercise sound judgement and discretion in handling of proprietary and confidential information. Ability to work independently and to use resources effectively to “figure it out”. Ability to add, subtract, multiply and divide numbers. Ability to perform mathematical skills in the form of measurement and other work material calculations utilizing a calculator.

Physical/Sensory Requirements
The following physical activities described here are representative of those required by a Team Member to perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodation, if feasible, will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions of position.

While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is regularly required to talk, hear, and see and effectively use a personal computer, office equipment and telephone. This position is very active and requires standing, walking, using stairs, bending, reaching and repetitive hand movements to build and move shipping containers. The Team Member must frequently lift and/or move items up to 75 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. Team Members performing this job must be able to wear protective or safety equipment such as safety shoes, glasses, gloves, hearing protection, and a respirator as needed.

Working Environment
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts such as overhead cranes, vibration and moving vehicles. The noise level in the work environment and job sites can be loud.

The minimum and maximum hourly range for this full-time position is $20.00 - $27.00 + benefits.

Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including but not limited to job-related skills, experience, and relevant education and/or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in this posted role reflect the base salary only and do not include bonus or benefits.

title: Project Manager
description:
Title: Construction Project Manager

Scope: Multifamily or Hospitality Renovations

Location: Atlanta GA area Raleigh NC area

Type: Hybrid or Possibly Remote

Rate: $85k - $100k (Negotiable DOE)

General Purpose


The Construction Project Manager holds responsibility for planning, directing, and coordinating all activities of construction projects, while being responsible for the financial well-being of the project. Ensure that the goals and objectives are accomplished within the prescribed time frame, funding parameters and contract terms. An additional focus of this position is to strengthen existing, as well as build new and lasting relationships with clientele and subcontractors in existing and new markets.

Why should you join THS National?

Certified as a Great Place to Work, with 100% satisfaction rating in not one but five categories, THS National LLC, is a full-service general contractor specializing in multi-family renovation and revitalization. THS is about finding the best people and empowering them to grow professionally and personally through continued support and up-skilling to become the leaders of tomorrow. We don’t want you to “fit” our culture we want you to “add” to it!

ESSENTIAL JOB DETAILS:

  • Develop and execute project specific expectations, schedules, budgets with strategies and methods to accomplish goals and objectives.
  • Build and maintain rapport with clients and project stakeholders ensuring that scopes of project and outside business forces affecting the project is fully understood and that specific deliverables are fully understood with performance standards and other relevant criteria.
  • Lead the client and project team through the construction process from the planning phase through execution all the way to completion and project close out. This includes setting and managing expectations and perceptions.
  • Own the success of your projects. Working with Customers, Architects, Engineers, local governing jurisdictions, THS project team, etc... You must lead and coordinate the success of your projects.
  • Receive and review projects estimated by others and ready the project for execution.
  • Prepare Subcontractor Scopes of Work, Subcontract Agreements, Schedule of Values and Purchase Orders needed for vendor and subcontractor services. You are responsible to manage the sub-contractor & vendor selection process while keeping the project within the expected budget & schedule.
  • Facilitate all critical project meetings with internal and external personal including weekly OAC’s, Production, Subcontractor & Safety meetings and monthly KPI meetings.
  • Act as the primary contact & problem solver with the client and other project stakeholders throughout the duration of the project.
  • Develop and maintain master project schedules and meet all time-frames. Manage project performance against baseline, contract dates, contract schedule, scheduled milestones and critical path items to ensure success.
  • Manage subcontractors, vendors and project team performance to ensure compliance with contractual requirements, all regulating entities and client expectations.
  • Responsible for the success of project Superintendents and oversight of all their responsibilities.
  • Maintaining submittal and commitment schedules.
  • Execution of projects with an understanding of Prime Contract language and all required compliance.
  • Monthly reporting of all project KPI’s including earned revenue projections, margin, % committed, submittals, change orders, over/underbilling's, schedule slip or compression, projections vs actuals, contingency management, buyout savings, customer satisfaction, performance of field team, contract compliance, vendor relationships, etc...
  • Follow all existing SOP’s, processes, procedures and project management best practices.
  • Responsible for the architecture and organization of construction management software at a project level.
  • Building, managing & improving subcontractor resources in NEW and existing markets.
  • Review RFP’s and all associated bid documents. Create preliminary cost estimates, create fully qualified estimates ready for review and contract execution. Establishing relationships with subtrades and vendors as needed to accomplish the estimating activity in compliance with THS standards. Other activities & responsibilities associated with the pre-construction phase of a project.
  • Travel to assigned projects for monthly draw walks and to facilitate meetings with THS team, customer, architect, subcontractors, and other stake holders.
  • Additional travel to projects may be required to avoid upcoming potential setbacks or when a project encounters setbacks that the PM as the primary responsible party needs to solve for.
  • Other duties as assigned.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • 4+ years of Construction PM Experience.
  • 4+ years of multifamily experience.
  • Preferred: Experience in Hospitality Renovations
  • Experience managing multifamily projects of $3+ million.
  • Experience and understanding of all construction documents, specifications and the management of them.
  • Experience managing submittals & commitments is required along with the associated schedules.
  • Strong Project Management software experience (MS Project, Procore, Etc).
  • Availability for some travel on a monthly basis.
  • Bachelor’s degree in construction management, construction science, engineering, architecture, or related field from an accredited university, preferred but not required

BENEFITS:

  • Medical Plans with BCBS
  • 401(k) & 401(k) matching
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • Employee assistance program
  • Life insurance
  • Accrued Paid time off

title: Vastaava sairaanhoitaja Järvenpään Validia-talo
description:
Tule mukaan luomaan yhdessä elämäsi tarinaa. Haemme vastaavaa sairaanhoitajaa Järvenpään Validia-taloon.

Etsimme nyt sairaanhoitajaa vahvistamaan moniammatillista tiimiämme. Vammaistyö on monipuolista ja tuo vaihtelevuudellaan sopivasti haastetta työhön. Meillä korostuvat aito kohtaaminen, kuntouttava työote sekä yhdessä tekeminen. Työ on kokopäivätyötä ja pääosin arkiaamuvuoroja.

Vastaavana sairaanhoitajana vastaat asiakkaiden kokonaisvaltaisesta hoitotyöstä ja terveyden edistämisestä. Työhösi kuuluu asiakkaiden terveydentilan arviointi, seuranta ja dokumentointi sekä hoitosuunnitelmien laatiminen ja henkilöstön ohjaaminen niiden toteutuksessa.

Vastaat lääkehoidon suunnittelusta ja kehittämisestä sekä huolehdit sen turvallisesta toteutumisesta. Tuet ja perehdytät hoitohenkilökuntaa sekä vahvistat heidän osaamistaan, mutta osallistut myös itse aktiivisesti päivittäiseen hoitotyöhön asiakkaiden parissa. Lisäksi olet mukana tiimipalavereissa ja yksikön kehittämisessä, tuoden oman asiantuntijuutesi osaksi moniammatillista yhteistyötä.

Järvenpään Validia-talo on ympärivuorokautisen palveluasumisen yksikkö, jossa asuu 32 asiakasta. Asiakkaamme ovat vammaisia, vammautuneita tai neurologisia sairauksia sairastavia henkilöitä.

Tutustu linkistä yksikköömme Järvenpään Validia-talo. Voit myös kurkata Instagramista, miltä meno meillä Validialla näyttää!

Validialla työtä ohjaavat arvot Kunnioitus, Osaaminen, Sujuvuus ja _Vastuullisuus._Jokaisella on oikeus arvokkaaseen elämään, ja meillä sekä asiakkaat että työntekijät tulevat kuulluksi. Opimme toisiltamme, johdamme kuunnellen ja pidämme lupauksemme.

title: Membership Representative Lead - Marion
description:
ABOUT US

The nonprofit YMCA of Western North Carolina strengthens local communities through youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility. Founded in 1889, we engage more than 100,000 people – regardless of age, income, or background – to nurture the potential of children and teens, improve the region’s health and well-being, and provide opportunities to give back and support the community. We do this through seven YMCAs, dozens of program sites, and YMCA Camp Watia. As the state’s largest provider of licensed school-age childcare, we give more than 1,000 children a day the opportunity to learn, grow, and thrive. We are made up of people of all ages, from all backgrounds, working side by side to ensure that everyone can reach their full potential with dignity. Thus, we are “For All”. Our core values are caring, honesty, respect, and responsibility, and they guide everything we do. We are committed to being an organization that exposes and addresses social constraints that limit and/or negatively affect all humans from all walks of life. We recruit staff who are passionate about giving back to the community, helping people, and upholding our core values. For more information, please visit .

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Membership Representative Lead is a critical and highly visible position providing exceptional customer service to our community. In this role, you will develop strong and supportive relationships focusing on the needs of the member and center.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Welcomes and greets all community members as they enter our facilities.
  • Creates excellent member experiences through engaging conversations and connecting them to membership benefits and programs.
  • Processes membership and program registrations, keeping a focus on correct standards.
  • Provides highly engaged facility tours that highlight the benefits of a Y membership and our non-profit work in the community.
  • Offers excellent communication in person, over the phone, and through email, answering community member questions.
  • Helps train new Membership Representatives and implements our new Membership Standard Operating Procedures and training.
  • Supports Association initiatives around membership prospecting and sales.
  • Supports the Membership Department on higher-level initiatives, including creating department schedules, flyers, prospect management, tour tracking, and more.
  • Serves as Leader/Manager on Duty for the center as needed.
  • Supports open shifts and weekend shifts in times of need.
  • Creates and collects social media content to drive member success stories.
  • Supports the Membership Director by assisting or leading the following tasks:
    • Monthly Staff Schedule
    • Community Outreach Events
    • Member Appreciation Days and Visit Drivers
    • Web Lead Follow Up
    • Financial Assistance / Scholarship Tracking
    • Facility Rental Program
    • Staff Appreciation
    • Membership Supply / Stocking

ABOUT YOU

Qualifications

  1. Must be 18 years or older.
  2. A minimum of one year or more experience relating to customer service preferred.
  3. Must be able to work a flexible schedule to meet the needs of the position, including nights and weekends.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  1. Ability to answer phones and use multiple computer software systems
  2. A high degree of human relations skills: Ability to effectively communicate and manage information to peers, staff, and volunteers
  3. Team player that works well with others

PHYSICAL ASPECTS OF THE JOB

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Must be able to clearly see, hear, and speak.
  • Must be able to bend, stand, stoop, and walk.
  • Ability to constantly and quickly move to various locations in and around the entire facility
  • Must be able to comprehend and communicate written and verbal instructions

PART-TIME BENEFITS

  • Free individual membership to all YMCA of WNC locations
  • Discounted membership for household members
  • Discounted program fees (swim lessons, youth sports, summer camp and more)
  • Start a 403(b) smart savings account on day one of employment (optional) and begin eligibility for YMCA retirement plan
  • Professional development opportunities through local and Y-USA trainings

The YMCA of Western North Carolina is committed to equal opportunity in terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, faith, gender, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, gender expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law, except where a bona fide occupational qualification applies.

title: Bi-Lingual Prevention Specialist-Program Facilitator - Full-time 12 months
description:
The mission of the Center for Humanistic Change (CHC) located in Bethlehem PA is to give people, especially youth, the knowledge and tools they need to make better-informed and more positive life choices through the interactive delivery of prevention education and evidence-based programming. Drug and alcohol prevention programs and student mentoring are core services.

NOTE: The Center for Humanistic Change, Inc. in Bethlehem IS NOT affiliated in any way with the organization of the same name in New Jersey.

The Center for Humanistic Change is seeking a full-time bi-linqual Prevention Program Specialist. This is an ongoing 12-month exempt position. The Prevention Specialist will be responsible for facilitating prevention programs/trainings in schools for students of all ages, as well as providing community awareness and information dissemination at events and health fairs in the Lehigh Valley. Daytime availability is required. Flexibility is required to work some weekends and evenings to facilitate programs, school nights, and community events.

Applicants must be bi-lingual. Experience with MS Teams is a plus. Familiarity with prevention curriculum materials is a plus, but training will be provided. Ideal candidates must demonstrate the ability to work independently and with a team, manage deadlines for paperwork and electronic data entry, and relate well to youth and adults. Excellent judgment, attention to detail, outstanding written and verbal communication skills, strong presentation and facilitation skills, and proficiency in MS Office are required. Juggling deadlines, thinking outside the box, adapting to new situations, remaining current with new trends in prevention and technology, and the ability and willingness to learn new skills are essential to success. Select candidates will be invited to provide a brief mock presentation to a group as part of the interview process.

A Bachelor's Degree is required - preferably in education, psychology, counseling, public health, social work, or a closely related human services field with relevant work experience or equivalent training. A Master's Degree is a plus. All applicants must have reliable transportation and the ability to do light lifting to transport supplies and other materials as necessary to/from the office, schools and community programs. Applicants should have access to mobile and home internet.

CHC staff are expected to obtain and maintain all state and local training requirements and clearances, including PA Child Abuse history clearance, PA State Police background clearance, FBI background fingerprinting check, mandated child abuse reporter training, and abuse prevention training. Clearances and criminal record checks must be in compliance and in accordance with the laws reflecting the ability to work in schools and with children.

Applicants who do not provide a resume and cover letter will not be considered. An official college transcript will be required.

CHC is an equal employment opportunity employer. Employment decisions for all qualified applicants are based on merit and business needs, and not on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, citizenship status, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, sex, religious creed, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, veteran status, political affiliation or any other factor protected by law. CHC complies with the law regarding reasonable accommodation for handicapped and disabled employees.

Job Description

JOB TITLE: Associate Director - Asset Finance
LOCATION: London

SALARY: Competitive package
HOURS: Full Time
WORKING PATTERN: Our work style is hybrid, which involves spending at least two days per week, or 40% of your time, in the office.

About this opportunity

We're seeking an Associate Director to join the Asset Finance sales team within our Corporate Trade and Working Capital (T&WC) team. This is a great opportunity to play a crucial role in the origination and development of Asset Finance and ABL transactions to our “CIB” (Corporate and Institutional Banking) clients.

CIB serves all UK corporates turning over more than £500m per annum, and all Lloyds’ Institutional Banking clients (e.g. specialist SME lenders through to international banking groups).

This role sits within the Asset & Invoice Finance Sales team, a subject matter expert specialist sales team; focusing on business development and delivery of the asset finance and invoice finance/ABL products to the whole of CIB’s client base; principally within the UK, but with a developing focus on US and Europe as well.

The Asset Finance product set covers finance lease, operating lease, hire purchase, term loans, ABL and contract receivables; and there is a particular focus on building on these base products to develop bespoke and structured solutions for our clients.

The wider T&WC team is a cross-sector product team providing our CIB clients with working capital and lending solutions across not only Invoice Finance, but also Traditional Trade, Open Account (including Receivables, Payables, and Asset Backed lending), Structured Trade and Commodity Finance and Asset Finance.

Your accountabilities will include:

  • Work and build active relationships with CIB relationship and T&WC sales teams across the bank to build innovative Asset Finance solutions for new business opportunities to existing and new to bank clients; using Asset Finance and structured lending solutions to help deepen the bank’s client relationship.
  • Working with your immediate team and the Head of CIB Asset & Invoice Finance to define the sales strategy, delivery and business plans for the Asset Finance team and wider T&WC product set.
  • Finding and developing relationships outside the immediate team to help build sales opportunities and pipeline, both internally (e.g. relationship teams and T&WC colleagues) and externally (e.g. debt advisors and other financial institutions).
  • Present Asset Finance and structured lending solutions directly to clients (at C suite level), external advisors, and our internal relationship and sales teams.
  • Work with the T&WC Product teams to enhance, create and develop our suite of products.
  • Actively maintain product relationships within the portfolio of existing and agreed target clients.
  • Meeting Group risk and profitability requirements to deliver targeted growth in the T&WC business in terms of Income and Assets.
  • Manage your performance within a sales and target led environment.
  • Maintaining a full understanding of our product sets including but not limited to Traditional Trade, Open Account (including Receivables, Payables, Invoice Finance and Asset backed lending), Structured Trade and Commodity Finance and Asset Finance.
  • Prepare and submit product specific credit applications in conjunction with Coverage, aligned with defined strategy and engage with colleagues in Product, Delivery, Lending Execution and Risk as appropriate.

About Us

If you think all Banks are the same, you’d be wrong. We're an innovative, fast-changing business that’s shaping finance as a force for good. A bank that’s empowering its people to innovate, explore possibilities and grow with purpose.

What you’ll need

  • 3+ years of experience and strong understanding of the Asset Finance and ABL product as well as a good understanding of corporate finance and lending structures.
  • Experience in originating, structuring, and completing solutions for large corporate / investment grade clients with a proven track record in partnering and delivering direct business development.
  • Experience of working in a corporate client facing role, interacting directly with large corporate clients and their advisors at a senior level.
  • Experience and understanding of general lending requirements for large corporate clients.
  • Confidence to present ideas clearly to credit partners, collaborating effectively to close successful transactions.
  • Ability to balance business development with a strong risk management ethos.
  • Willingness and ability to be flexible to suite business and client requirements, including frequent travel both to the main London office, but also to client premises around the UK.

We know that great talent comes from many backgrounds. Whilst this job advert may reference specific years of experience, we recognise that skills are developed in many ways, so if you have relevant, transferable experience, we encourage you to apply.

This is a place for you:

Our ambition is to be the leading UK business for diversity, equity and inclusion supporting our customers, colleagues and communities, and we’re committed to creating an environment in which everyone can thrive, learn and develop.

We were one of the first major organisations to set goals on diversity in senior roles, create a menopause health package, and a dedicated Working with Cancer Initiative.

We offer reasonable workplace adjustments for colleagues with disabilities, including flexibility in office attendance, location and working patterns. And, as a Disability Confident Leader, we guarantee interviews for a fair and proportionate number of applicants who meet the minimum criteria for the role with a disability, long-term health or neurodivergent condition through the Disability Confident Scheme.

We provide reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process to reduce or remove barriers. Just let us know what you need.

We also offer a wide-ranging benefits package, which includes:

  • A generous pension contribution of up to 15%
  • An annual bonus award, subject to Group performance
  • Share schemes including free shares
  • Benefits you can adapt to your lifestyle, such as discounted shopping
  • 30 days’ holiday, with bank holidays on top
  • A range of wellbeing initiatives and generous parental leave policies

This is a once in a career opportunity to help shape your future as well as ours. Join us and grow with purpose!

At Lloyds Banking Group, we're driven by a clear purpose; to help Britain prosper. Across the Group, our colleagues are focused on making a difference to customers, businesses and communities. With us you'll have a key role to play in shaping the financial services of the future, whilst the scale and reach of our Group means you'll have many opportunities to learn, grow and develop.

We keep your data safe. So, we'll only ever ask you to provide confidential or sensitive information once you have formally been invited along to an interview or accepted a verbal offer to join us which is when we run our background checks. We'll always explain what we need and why, with any request coming from a trusted Lloyds Banking Group person.

We're focused on creating a values-led culture and are committed to building a workforce which reflects the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Together we’re building a truly inclusive workplace where all of our colleagues have the opportunity to make a real difference.

title: Director of Development
description:
Position Summary

The Director of Development is Project Hospitality's senior fundraising leader responsible for implementing and managing a comprehensive fundraising program that expands philanthropic revenue, strengthens donor relationships, and supports the organization's long-term financial sustainability. Reporting directly to the Chief Advancement Officer (CAO), the Director of Development serves as a key member of the Advancement leadership team and is responsible for executing fundraising strategies aligned with Project Hospitality's mission, strategic priorities, and organizational goals.

The Director of Development provides leadership for day-to-day fundraising operations, including major gifts, annual giving, foundation and corporate partnerships, donor stewardship, fundraising campaigns, signature events, and community engagement. Working closely with the Chief Advancement Officer, the Director of Development cultivates and stewards donor relationships, identifies new funding opportunities, and ensures the successful execution of the organization's advancement initiatives.

The Director of Development collaborates with the Senior Development Associate and other assigned development staff such as advancement consultants, grant writers, and external fundraising partners as directed by the Chief Advancement Officer. The Director ensures that departmental activities, systems, and resources are aligned to achieve fundraising goals and support organizational growth.

In partnership with the Chief Advancement Officer, the Director of Development supports the work of the Board of Directors' Development Committee by preparing reports, coordinating meetings, and assisting with Board engagement in fundraising and donor cultivation activities.

As a visible ambassador for Project Hospitality, the Director of Development helps strengthen the organization's philanthropic presence throughout Staten Island and the greater New York Community while fostering a culture of philanthropy across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Fundraising & Revenue Growth

  • Implement fundraising strategies established in partnership with the Chief Advancement Officer.
  • Lead annual giving, major gifts, foundation relations, corporate partnerships, donor stewardship, fundraising campaigns, and special events.
  • Cultivate, solicit, and steward individual donors, foundations, corporations, and community partners.
  • Research, craft, and submit compelling proposals for private grant opportunities & competitive government RFPs
  • Compile post-award deliverables and prepare comprehensive grant reports for funders.
  • Expand unrestricted philanthropic revenue and strengthen donor engagement.
  • Establish measurable fundraising goals, utilize data to evaluate performance, and identify growth opportunities.


Advancement Operations

  • Oversee the daily operations of the Development Department.
  • Supervise and develop the Senior Development Associate and assigned development staff.
  • Coordinate the work of fundraising consultants, grant writers, and strategic partners.
  • Ensure accurate CRM management, prospect tracking, fundraising analytics, and performance measurement.
  • Strengthen departmental systems, processes, and infrastructure to support fundraising excellence.

Board & Executive Support

  • Support the Chief Advancement Officer in advancing the Board Development Committee's work.
  • Prepare fundraising reports, dashboards, presentations, and donor briefings.
  • Assist with Board engagement, donor cultivation strategies, and special fundraising initiatives.
  • Collaborate closely with the Chief Advancement Officer and executive leadership on strategic fundraising priorities.

External Relations

  • Represent Project Hospitality to donors, foundations, corporations, community organizations, elected officials, and strategic partners.
  • Strengthen Project Hospitality's visibility within Staten Island and the greater New York philanthropic community.
  • Support donor communications, stewardship activities, and advancement marketing initiatives.

description:
Als Junior Communicatie Medewerker draag je bij aan duidelijke, toegankelijke en aantrekkelijke communicatie voor onze huurders en collega's. Je ontwikkelt, beheert en verbetert uiteenlopende communicatiemiddelen en speelt een belangrijke rol bij de ontwikkeling van ons nieuwe huurdersportaal en de bijbehorende kennisbank. Daarmee help je huurders sneller de juiste informatie te vinden en ondersteun je collega's bij een consistente dienstverlening.

Dit ga je doen

Schrijven, redigeren en actualiseren van uiteenlopende communicatie-uitingen, zoals bewonersbrieven, flyers, informatiedocumenten, nieuwsbrieven en webteksten. · Beheren en actualiseren van de website en andere digitale communicatiekanalen, waaronder het intranet (Workvivo). · Continu verbeteren van de online informatievoorziening op basis van vragen, signalen en gebruikersinzichten. · Een actieve bijdrage leveren aan de ontwikkeling en het beheer van het nieuwe huurdersportaal en de bijbehorende interne en externe kennisbank. Hierbij zorgdragen voor actuele, begrijpelijke en gebruiksvriendelijke informatie. · Vertalen van complexe informatie naar heldere en toegankelijke communicatie die aansluit bij de informatiebehoefte van huurders en collega's. · Ondersteunen bij communicatieprojecten, waaronder communicatie rondom nieuwbouwprojecten, bewonerscommunicatie en incidentele campagnes. · Ondersteunen bij het opstellen en versturen van e-mailcommunicatie en nieuwsbrieven. · Bijdragen aan de consistente toepassing van de huisstijl, tone of voice en corporate branding van Heimstaden. · Signaleren van kansen om communicatieprocessen, content en digitale communicatiemiddelen verder te verbeteren. · Waar passend gebruikmaken van AI en andere digitale hulpmiddelen om content te ontwikkelen en communicatieprocessen efficiënter in te richten.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent creatief, leergierig en krijgt energie van het schrijven en creëren van content. Je hebt hbo werk- en denkniveau en hebt onlangs een opleiding in communicatie, marketing of een vergelijkbare richting afgerond, of rondt deze binnenkort af.

Je hebt een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal. Je weet informatie helder, toegankelijk en aantrekkelijk over te brengen en hebt affiniteit met digitale communicatie. Je vindt het leuk om content te ontwikkelen voor verschillende kanalen. Ervaring met een CMS, Adobe Express of e-mailmarketingsoftware, zoals Apsis, is een pré, maar geen vereiste.

Natuurlijk zijn we naast jouw kennis en vaardigheden ook benieuwd naar jou als persoon. Je werkt nauwkeurig, toont initiatief en werkt graag samen om onze communicatie iedere dag een beetje beter te maken.

Wat bieden wij?

Werken bij Heimstaden betekent werken in een dynamische internationale organisatie. Hier is volop ruimte voor ontwikkeling en persoonlijke groei, sterker nog, je past goed bij Heimstaden als je verder wilt komen en een stapje extra wilt zetten. We vragen redelijk wat van onze nieuwe collega, maar…daar staat natuurlijk ook wat tegenover:

  • Salaris tussen EUR 2.900 en 3.800 bruto per maand (afhankelijk van ervaring);
  • Goede pensioenregeling en diverse personeelsverzekeringen;
  • Reiskostenvergoeding van 0,25 cent per km of volledige OV-vergoeding;
  • 28 vakantiedagen + 3 roostervrije dagen en mogelijkheid tot bijkoop van 5 vakantiedagen;
  • Laptop en telefoon
  • Een maandelijkse internetvergoeding;
  • Eenmalige vergoeding van maximaal 400,- euro netto voor inrichting van de thuiswerkplek.

We hechten veel waarde aan een goede samenwerking en van elkaar leren. Het is mogelijk om af en toe thuis te werken, maar jouw aanwezigheid op kantoor wordt zeer gewaardeerd. Ons kantoor is goed gefaciliteerd en beschikt over een dakterras waar collega’s samen lunchen en borrelen.

Een assessment maakt onderdeel uit van het sollicitatieproces, net zoals het nagaan van referenties en het aanvragen van een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag. Bij vragen hierover horen we het graag van je!

Bij Heimstaden geloven we dat diversiteit ons sterker maakt. Onze collega’s zijn net zo divers als de buurten waarin we actief zijn. Met toewijding, vernieuwende ideeën en een gedeelde passie creëren we een veilige en fijne plek om te wonen met aandacht voor vandaag en de wereld van morgen.

title: Tax Director - Global Tax Controversy, Governance and Controls
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking an exceptional Director to join our team in Amsterdam. This is a leadership position, reporting to Booking.com Head of Tax.

This role leads Booking.com’s global tax controversy and litigation strategy, with primary responsibility for audits, disputes, tax authority engagement, and defense of the company’s direct and indirect tax positions across multiple jurisdictions.

The Director will also manage the team responsible for tax governance and controls, quarter and year-end close for Tax, and strategic oversight of tax compliance activities by the Tax Accounting team.

Key Responsibilities

Global Tax Controversy Leadership:

  • Lead and direct tax authority information requests, audits, disputes and litigation relating to direct and indirect taxes, including digital services tax, and partner with the Transfer Pricing (TP) team on TP controversy matters.
  • Serve as Booking.com’s primary technical and strategic interface with tax authorities, and lead negotiations on material controversy matters.
  • Direct high-quality technical submissions, legal-tax position papers, presentations and formal responses that clearly articulate and defend Booking.com’s tax positions.
  • Own the technical assessment and defense strategy for material controversy matters, including the evaluation of legal merits, technical strengths and weaknesses, evidentiary requirements, settlement options and litigation posture.
  • Provide clear recommendations to senior leadership on disputed positions and resolution strategies for high-risk or precedent-setting matters.

Tax governance and controls:

  • Drive the tax control framework, ensuring tax controls are designed, documented, executed and continuously improved to support compliant, defensible and audit-ready tax positions.
  • Drive standardization, automation and simplification across tax processes, with a focus on improving the quality, consistency and evidentiary strength of tax data and documentation.
  • Incorporate AI-enabled ways of working in a practical and responsible manner, including improving velocity, consistency and scalability without compromising technical quality, audit readiness or risk management.
  • Ensure governance and controls materially enhance controversy readiness, audit support, documentation quality and the defensibility of Booking.com’s filed and reported tax positions.

Tax compliance and reporting oversight:

  • Provide senior technical oversight on tax positions arising through compliance and reporting processes where those positions may affect audit readiness, dispute defense, litigation risk or broader group tax posture.
  • Partner with the broader Tax team on material matters affecting provisions, uncertain tax positions and supporting documentation, ensuring alignment between filed positions, reporting outcomes and controversy defense strategy.

External advisor management:

  • Lead relationships with external counsel and advisors, setting strategic direction, defining expected technical standards and ensuring cost-effective, high-quality delivery.
  • Select, instruct and lead external advisors on major audits, disputes and litigation, with clear direction on tax technical positions, procedural strategy, evidentiary requirements and target outcomes.

Team leadership and development:

  • Attract, mentor, and develop a high-performing team, fostering a collaborative environment.
  • Evolve the team structure and operating model to support scale, velocity and stronger ownership.
  • Partner effectively with the broader Tax team, Transfer Pricing, Legal, Finance, Public Affairs and business stakeholders to align tax technical positions, controversy strategy and internal and external communications.

Knowledge and skills

Level of Education: Degree in Law required; Master’s Degree, specialised tax qualification, or equivalent legal/tax training strongly preferred.

Years of experience: 12+ years

Language: Native or fluent English speaking and writing skills.

Requirements of special knowledge/skills:

  • Significant experience leading tax audits, disputes, settlements and litigation in a multinational group, major law firm, Big 4 controversy practice or similarly complex environment.
  • Deep technical experience across direct and indirect tax controversy matters; familiarity with DST and transfer pricing disputes is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success managing high-value, high-sensitivity matters with tax authorities, external counsel and senior internal stakeholders.
  • Strong judgment on technical risk assessment, escalation strategy, negotiation posture, written advocacy and executive communication.
  • Proven ability to translate complex tax technical issues into clear recommendations for senior leadership and non-tax stakeholders.
  • Ability to work under pressure and strict deadlines, thriving in a fast-turnaround environment and managing multiple priorities.
  • Strong people leadership experience, including leading teams through demanding stakeholder environments, tight deadlines, and high-impact projects.
  • Excellent corporate agility to collaborate and build relationships at all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to drive change and adapt quickly in an agile environment.
  • Strong sense of ethics.

Pre-Employment Screening

If your application is successful, your personal data may be used for a pre-employment screening check by a third party as permitted by applicable law. Depending on the vacancy and applicable law, a pre-employment screening may include employment history, education and other information (such as media information) that may be necessary for determining your qualifications and suitability for the position.

title: Cobalt TN Warehouse Clerk
description:
Job Title: Materials Clerk

Department: Warehouse

Reports To: Department Supervisor

FLSA Status: Hourly

Summary: Responsible for all warehouse, materials, and inventory control functions for a specific area of operations. Receives, stocks, picks, and distributes parts and materials used in manufacturing operations. Verifies inventory accuracy through the execution of counting activities including daily cycle counting. Maintains a clean, safe workplace. Must be a customer driven individual who is self-motivated and detail oriented. Works most often alone supporting the specific area of operations with little to no assistance.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Responsible for all aspects of materials and inventory control for the specific area of operations assigned, including:
    1. Receipts;
    2. Put-aways;
    3. Custody, Control and Care of Inventory;
    4. Physical Issue of parts and materials (picking, kitting and bundling when required);
    5. Inventory Management and record keeping (including cycle counting, variance reporting, adjustment reporting);
    6. Transactional Issue of parts and materials; and,
    7. Completion and closing of manufacturing orders.
  • Adequately labels and maintains an organized inventory with accurate records.
  • Puts-away parts, components and materials in the correct inventory locations safeguarding such from damage.
  • Actively participates in stock counting activities such as cycle counting, location audit counts and fiscal year-end inventory counts.
  • Actively participates in ensuring the workplace is safe and clean.
  • Operates equipment including but not limited to forklift, pallet picker, utility truck, banding tools, corrugated compactor, pick-up truck and other various warehouse tools and equipment as required to complete assigned tasks.
  • Picks and stores parts/material at ground level and at heights up to 16 feet using mobile stairs, forklift and/or pallet picker as required.
  • Delivers parts to internal customer departments in the form of parts kits, Kanban stocking or bulk delivery, as instructed.
  • Transacts materials and parts issue and associated processes within MS Dynamics.
  • Load and unload parts/materials from freight trucks using forklift and/or pallet jack.
  • Load and unload small package shipments from courier trucks by hand.
  • Use computer and other office technology tools to prepare and/or transact pick lists, packing lists, inventory transactions, shipping documents and other daily requirements.
  • Other duties may be assigned.

title: Software Engineer (SY-BI-SW-2026-175-LD)
description:
Introduction:

You will take responsibility for the maintenance and further development of several key existing beam instrumentation systems. As automation, AI and ML continue to transform scientific computing and software engineering, you will play a major role in the coordination of our group’s efforts as we embark on an ambitious programme to apply these technologies to accelerator instrumentation, data analysis, software development, and system operations.

Functions:

  • Collaborate with experts, operators, and multidisciplinary teams to understand needs, gather requirements, and develop effective software solutions.
  • Contribute to the adoption of modern AI-assisted software development tools and practices in collaboration with colleagues across CERN.
  • Maintain, support, and continuously improve existing beam instrumentation software systems.
  • Design, develop, test, commission, and maintain new and upgraded real-time software systems.
  • Contribute to knowledge sharing within the team and, where appropriate, supervise and mentor students or early-career talent.

During Long Shutdown 3, you will contribute to major modernisation activities, including:

  • Enhancing the performance, maintainability, and reliability of beam instrumentation systems through thoughtful redesign, refactoring, comprehensive testing, and safe recommissioning.
  • Designing, developing, deploying, and optimising machine learning solutions for a range of beam instrumentation applications, such as anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, signal classification, and automated diagnostics.
  • Master's Degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of computer science, applied physics or a related field.

Experience:

  • Demonstrated experience in the field of software engineering with an emphasis on developing deterministic software in a real-time environment.
  • Experience applying AI and machine learning techniques to engineering, scientific, or software development challenges.
  • Familiarity with large language models and AI-assisted software engineering, or agent-based systems is considered an advantage
  • Basic knowledge of electronics-based digital acquisition hardware.

Technical competencies:

  • Development of software for embedded and real-time systems with/without OS: using Python and C++?.
  • Conceptualising, designing and developing new methods of exploiting measurement and diagnostic data with a view to improving accelerator and instrument efficiency.
  • Development and deployment of machine learning and AI-based solutions for data analysis, diagnostics, and system optimisation.
  • Re-engineering, refactoring, integration and porting of existing software.
  • Testing, diagnosing and optimisation of software.

Behavioural competencies:

  • Achieving Results: delivering high quality work on time and fulfilling expectations.
  • Working in Teams: working well in groups and readily fitting into a team; participating fully and taking an active role in team activities.
  • Demonstrating Flexibility: readily absorbing new techniques and working practices; proposing new or improved ways of working.
  • Learning and Sharing Knowledge: sharing knowledge and expertise freely and willingly with others; coaching others to ensure knowledge transfer.

Language skills:

  • Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Eligibility and closing date:

Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States.

This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 06.09.2026 at 23:59 CEST.

Employment Conditions:

Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.

Working Hours: 40 hours per week

Job Flexibility: Hybrid

Job grade: 6-7

Job reference: SY-BI-SW-2026-175-LD

Field of work: Software Engineering and IT

Benchmark Job Title: Computing Engineer

Global Benefits

  • A competitive salary (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.
  • 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
  • Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
  • Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
  • A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
  • Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.

Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.

Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.

If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! TAKE PART!

title: Programme Manager
description:
As a Programme Manager in Real Estate Programme Services you drive successful delivery of transformational capital programmes across real estate and construction environments within sectors such as Central Government, Health, Education, Life Sciences, Data Centres and Defence. Through leadership of small to medium programmes, or supporting large scale transformation initiatives within a multidisciplinary team, you ensure client outcomes are achieved and benefits realised.

  • Leadership & Vision: Positively contribute to the set up and delivery of the direction of the programme by the programme team, empowering and inspiring teams to achieve success .
  • Programme Governance and Controls: Apply industry best practice programme management methodologies, governance and controls within a real estate environment consistently and in the right way. This includes maintaining programme logs/registers, performance reporting (e.g. presentations and status reports for leadership and governance forums) data quality and secretariat duties (preparing meeting materials, action tracking)
  • Stakeholder Engagement and Communication Support robust processes for engaging and managing programme stakeholders such as stakeholder registers, communication plans
  • Financial Oversight: Support the management and oversight of programme-level financial management processes, ensuring transparent and effective reporting.
  • Risk, Health & Safety: Understand and ensure compliance with governance and risk management requirements, instilling confidence in senior managers. Understand and control measures to proactively manage programme-wide health and safety risks, ensuring successful safeguards are in place.
  • People & Team: positively contribute to the culture of internal and commission teams and contributing to internal team growth and our One Business culture. Promote a collaborative culture focused on high performance, innovation and continuous learning

This is a Professional level role. To excel in this role, you will have:

  • Ability to operate in a fast‑paced, high‑performing real estate programme environment, demonstrating attention to detail, leadership qualities and strong organisational capability.
  • Experience in programme management, with demonstrable achievement of benefits and outcomes for clients/employers.
  • Project delivery background with progression into programme management within a real estate/construction environment
  • Accreditation or working knowledge of programme management methodologies, ideally within the Real Estate sector.
  • Awareness of construction project delivery models, procurement routes and contracts (NEC, JCT)
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to successfully perform governance duties.
  • Analytical capability, commercial acumen and comfort with programme data, dashboards, and reporting systems.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and programme management tools, reporting systems and digital platforms, with a proactive approach to data, innovation and digital tools and strategy, including the use of AI.
  • Degree or postgraduate qualification in a relevant field, desirable
  • Professional membership (e.g. MSP) desirable.

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to effect change. We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive, and flexible working environment.

At Turner & Townsend, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. title: Ravintolapäällikkö, Original Sokos Hotel Vaakuna, Helsinki
description:
Primary location:

HELSINKI


Ravintolapäällikkö, Original Sokos Hotel Vaakuna, Helsinki

Tervetuloa ravintola 10. Kerrokseen, jossa työt sujuvat rennossa ja inspiroivassa ilmapiirissä ja maisemat kaupungin kattojen yli kruunaavat päivän! Meillä pääset tekemään hommia moderneissa tiloissa, yhdessä mahtavan porukan kanssa. Olemme kasvaneet ja kehittyneet yhdessä vuosien varrella, ja täällä tehdään hommia rennolla otteella, mutta kunnianhimoisella asenteella. Jos haluat olla osa tätä tarinaa ja työskennellä mukavassa porukassa inspiroivissa tiloissa, ravintola 10. Kerros on sinua varten!

Haemme Sokos Hotel Vaakunaan ravintolatiimiin kokenutta, energistä ja asiakaspalveluhenkistä ravintolapäällikköä johtamaan legendaarisen ravintola 10. Kerroksen toimintaa.

Tässä roolissa pääset vastuuseen ravintolan päivittäisestä toiminnasta ja tiimin johtamisesta. Tehtävässäsi korostuvat positiivinen ja jämäkkä johtaminen, ensiluokkaisen asiakastyytyväisyyden varmistaminen sekä myynnin kasvattaminen yhdessä motivoituneen ravintolatiimin kanssa. Työskentelet myös iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin, jolloin pääset varmistamaan, että ravintolan toiminta sujuu saumattomasti myös kiireisinä aikoina ja tiimisi suoriutuu parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla.

KESKEISIÄ VASTUUALUEITA:

  • Vastaat arjen sujuvuudesta ja varmistat, että palvelu ja keittiö toimivat saumattomasti yhdessä. Pidät huolen siitä, että asiakaskokemus on tasalaatuista kaikkina aikoina ja ravintola toimii sovittujen standardien mukaisesti.
  • Huolehdit siitä, että aamiaisbuffet on houkutteleva, kokouksiin liittyvät tarjoilut sujuvat ajallaan ja à la carte -palvelu ylittää asiakkaiden odotukset. Sinulla on kykyä hallita erilaisia palvelukonsepteja yhtäaikaisesti.
  • Vastaat siitä, että tiimissä on oikea määrä osaajia oikeaan aikaan. Rekrytoit uusia työntekijöitä, perehdytät heidät ja rakennat motivoivan ilmapiirin. Työvuorosuunnittelulla varmistat tehokkaan ja tasapainoisen työskentelyn.
  • Huolehdit siitä, että asiakastyytyväisyys pysyy korkealla ja ylittää odotukset. Kuuntelet palautetta, seuraat asiakaskokemusta ja viet muutoksia käytäntöön.
  • Seuraat myyntiä ja kustannuksia, asetat tavoitteita ja teet kehitystoimenpiteitä kannattavuuden varmistamiseksi. Osaat tehdä datasta käytännön johtopäätöksiä ja kehittää toimintaa strategisesti.
  • Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä keittiöpäällikön ja muiden esihenkilöiden kanssa. Yhdessä kehitätte tuotteita, prosesseja ja tapahtumia, jotka tukevat ravintolan kokonaismenestystä.

ODOTAMME SINULTA:

  • Kokemusta esihenkilötehtävistä ravintola- tai palvelualalla, erityisesti aamiaisen, kokoustoiminnan ja à la carte ravintolan johtamisesta
  • Strategista ajattelutapaa ja kykyä viedä suunnitelmat käytäntöön niin, että prosessit toimivat tehokkaasti ja sujuvasti
  • Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja organisointitaitoja sekä rohkeutta tehdä päätöksiä
  • Positiivista ja ratkaisukeskeistä asennetta, jolla innostat ja motivoit tiimiäsi
  • Kykyä toimia paineen alla ja säilyttää kokonaiskuva kiireisissäkin tilanteissa
  • Osaat luoda erinomaista työilmapiiriä, jossa jokainen työntekijä tuntee itsensä tärkeäksi. Etsimme johtajaa, joka uskaltaa luottaa tiimiinsä, antaa vastuuta ja toimii itse esimerkkinä.
  • Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa, ruotsin osaaminen katsotaan eduksi

MITÄ TARJOAMME SINULLE:

  • Monipuoliset työtehtävät
  • Mahdollisuuden kehittyä ja laajentaa omaa osaamistasi
  • Sokotelin ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön tuen
  • Suomen parhaiksi kehutut S-ryhmän henkilöstöedut
    • ostoalennukset S-ryhmän kaupoista, ravintoloista, hotelleista ja liikennemyymälöistä
    • kattavat työterveyspalvelut
    • normaalia laajemman vakuutusturvan
  • Sokotelin ja S-ryhmän laajat uramahdollisuudet

Lisätietoja ja hakuohjeet

Työtehtävä on vakituinen ja työaika on kokoaikainen 112,5 h/3 vko jakso. Aloitus sopimuksen mukaan.

Mikäli kiinnostuit lähetä hakemus mahdollisimman pian, viimeistään 23.8.2026 mennessä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa hotellijohtaja Marko Kurtto: torstaina 13.8. klo 10.00-11.00 tai maanantaina 17.8. klo 10.00-11.00 puh. 040-4551 865.

Käsittelemme hakemuksia ja kutsumme henkilöitä haastatteluun jo hakuaikana, joten ethän aikaile. Lähetäthän hakemuksesi meille ainoastaan sähköisen hakulomakkeen kautta, emme huomioi sähköpostitse lähetettyjä hakemuksia

Eezy Oyj toimii Sokotelin virallisena rekrytointikumppanina hoitaen rekrytoinnin ensimmäiset vaiheet. Työllistyt Sokotelille vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Sokotel Oy on osa S-ryhmää. Me operoimme Suomessa neljäätoista Sokos Hotel- ketjun hotellia ja kahdeksaa Radisson- ketjun hotellia. Sokotel Oy toimii pääkaupunkiseudulla, Tampereella ja Oulussa.

Sokotelille on myönnetty Suomen innostavimmat työpaikat tunnustus sekä Hyvän mielen työpaikka sertifikaatti. Ihminen, kasvu ja kehittyminen ovat toimintamme keskiössä, ja meiltä saat takuun hyvästä johtamisesta. Sokotel on savuton työpaikka.

description:
Whitehall Borough Post Acute is a 166-bed post-acute care facility located at 505 Weyman Rd., Pittsburgh. Our positive reputation in the community is a testament to our incredible staff members. We work hard and play hard. We believe if you're not having fun at work, you're not playing on the right team. Join us and experience the difference for yourself.

10p-6a

title: Member Services FT Oak Lawn

description:
Job Summary

The Member Services Representative (MSR) is responsible for creating a positive member experience by delivering exceptional customer service to Planet Fitness members, prospective members, and guests. This role involves greeting and engaging with members as they enter and exit the club, addressing inquiries, conducting facility tours, resolving issues, and ensuring a clean, safe, and inviting environment during AM, PM, or Overnight shifts. The representative will often work independently, including times when they may be alone, requiring self-reliance and proactive problem-solving.

Additional Job Summary

The Overnight Member Services Representative will work independently, often by themselves or alone for parts or all of their shift, to ensure the safety, security, and cleanliness of the facility while fostering a welcoming atmosphere. This role requires maintaining constant situational awareness, addressing issues promptly (contacting the management for emergencies and documenting non-emergencies in the Communication Log on Microsoft Teams), and upholding Planet Fitness standards without on-site managerial support.

Schedule

  • 8-hour shift
  • Sunday 11:30PM- 6:00AMM
