title: Associate Director – Programme Management
description:
As an Associate Director in Programme Management and Programme Management Office delivery, you will have experience in playing pivotal roles in £250m-£500m+ major capital programmes, across complex construction environments within sectors such as Central Government, Industrial, Life Sciences, Data Centres and Defence.

You play a critical role in driving excellence in programme management performance, client delivery, business performance and team leadership. Supporting the Programme Director/Leader, you provide leadership across major programmes, ensuring clarity of direction, performance of programme functions, robust governance, compliance, outcomes delivery, and trusted client partnership.

You shape and deliver programme strategy and establish and maintain successful stakeholder relations with client leaders and your teams across complex construction environments.

You are a credible and accomplished programme delivery professional with a proven track record of delivering complex programmes. You bring significant construction programme expertise, with the ability to operate efficiently and effectively between strategic programme leadership and project-level detail, influencing key stakeholders and driving progress and detailed investment decisions.

You drive programmes from early-stage definition and mobilisation through execution, transition and benefits realisation. Working across multi-disciplinary teams and complex stakeholder environments, you provide the leadership, governance and commercial acumen required to deliver successful outcomes with clarity, control and confidence for our clients.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Programme Leadership & Direction: Take end-to-end ownership of shaping, embedding, and communicating programme vision and direction. Effectively empower, motivate, and guide high-performing teams to drive success and cohesion across delivery activities.
  • Assurance Framework: Maintain and deliver frameworks for robust management and control of the programme. Manage critical programme functions/services within the wider controls framework, and a focus on outcomes and the realisation of benefits back to the business case and organisational strategy.
  • Commission Management and Business Development: Lead the successful commercial and contractual management of commissions, ensuring delivery excellence, client satisfaction and achievement of performance objectives. Develop trusted client partnerships, identify strategic growth opportunities and actively contribute to business development and market expansion activities.
  • Stakeholder Strategy & Engagement: Create structured stakeholder engagement and decision-making frameworks, ensuring all programme stakeholders across seniority are effectively engaged and managed.
  • Financial Leadership: Develop and implement robust processes to manage and report on all financial aspects of the programme, ensuring strong oversight and commercial governance. Oversee financial governance, ensuring robust financial reporting and management across the programme.
  • Risk Strategy, Health & Safety Leadership: Identify and mitigate health and safety risks, enforcing safeguards to protect all involved in programme delivery. Lead the development and implementation of programme-wide risk management and assurance strategies. Champion a culture of safety, wellbeing and compliance, ensuring effective controls are in place to protect people, assets and programme objectives.
  • People & Culture: Act as a first-class colleague and leader, establishing and positively contributing to the culture of internal and client-facing teams, and in internal talent development. Build capability, mentor teams, drive inclusion across the team and successfully carry out people management responsibilities to drive internal team performance and growth and our One Business culture.

This is an Associate Director level role. To excel in this role, you will have:

  • Proven experience delivering complex transformation/real estate programmes (£100-£300m+) with demonstrable achievement of tangible benefits and outcomes for clients/employers.
  • Ability to prioritise and optimise complex programmes, responding to internal and external influences over the programme lifecycle.
  • Strong project delivery background with progression into programme delivery management within a construction environment
  • Experience leading and working on large multidisciplinary teams including project management, project controls, technical and commercial teams
  • Strong understanding and practical application of construction project delivery models, procurement routes and contracts (NEC, JCT)
  • Good understanding of project controls methodologies and application including schedule management, cost control and risk and opportunity management at a project and programme level
  • Experience operating at senior client levels – demonstrating very strong communication skills including presentation of data to influence outcomes
  • Supply chain management experience
  • Very good stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with demonstrable experience in dealing with third parties and customers
  • A practitioner of industry best practice programme management methodologies, preferably within a real estate environment.
  • Practical experience of required health and safety activities and good understanding of legislative requirements including CDM and Building Safety Act.
  • An experienced and high quality people manager, committed to nurturing talent within the organisation and supporting professional growth among clients’ teams.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and programme management tools, reporting systems and digital platforms, with a proactive approach to data, innovation and digital tools and strategy, including the use of AI.
  • Education to a degree/postgraduate/equivalent level in a relevant technical discipline (eg Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying)
  • Professional accreditation (eg. RICS, CIOB, APM)

title: Erityisluokanopettaja, Sipoonjoen yhtenäiskoulu
description:
Oletko aktiivinen ja motivoitunut erityisopetuksen ammattilainen? Koetko tärkeäksi ohjata ja tukea oppilasta kokonaisvaltaisesti?

Sipoonjoen yhtenäiskoulu on noin 460 oppilaan koulu vuosiluokille 1-9. Sipoon Nikkilässä, hyvien liikenneyhteyksien päässä. Koulu sijaitsee modernissa, valoisassa Nikkilän Sydän -koulukeskuksessa yhdessä ruotsinkielisen Kungvägen skolan kanssa. Koulut toimivat itsenäisinä kouluina, tiiviissä yhteistyössä ja vuorovaikutuksessa. Sipoonjoen yhtenäiskoulussa on kielikylpyopetusta, joustavan perusopetuksen JOPO-luokka ja luokkamuotoisen erityisopetuksen luokat sekä perusopetukseen valmistavaa opetusta.

Haemme nyt

ERITYISLUOKANOPETTAJAA ajalle 18.9.2026- 4.6.2027. ajalle Sipoonjoen yhtenäiskouluun yläluokkien erityisopetukseen.

Haemme joukkoomme aktiivista ja yhteistyökykyistä opettajaa, joka osaa toteuttaa yksilöllisiä oppimisjärjestelyjä erilaisille oppijoille ja toimia moniammatillisessa työyhteisössä sovittujen toimintamallien mukaisesti.
Koulussamme on neljä erityisluokkaa, joita ryhmitellään joustavasti ja oppilaslähtöisesti. Oppilaita integroidaan yleisopetuksen ryhmiin. Edellytämme suunnitelmallista yhteistyötä muiden opettajien ja ohjaajien kanssa sekä valmiutta yhteisopettajuuteen.

Arvostamme aikaisempaa alan työkokemusta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja, joustavuutta ja toimimista yhteisöllisesti sekä kehittämishalukkuutta.

Tarjoamme sinulle hyvin toimivan työyhteisön lisäksi uudet opetustilat sekä mahdollisuuden osallistua koulun toimintakulttuurin ja opetusjärjestelyiden kehittämiseen. Koulumme sijaitsee Nikkilässä hyvien liikenneyhteyksien päässä HSL-alueella.

Kelpoisuusvaatimukset määräytyvät opetustoimen henkilöstön kelpoisuusvaatimuksista annetun asetuksen (986/98) mukaan.

Palkkaus määräytyy OVTESin mukaisesti ja virassa noudatetaan koeaikaa. Valitun on esitettävä hyväksyttävä lausunto terveydentilastaan sekä esitettävä nähtäväksi lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen rikosrekisteriote.

Hakemukset pyydetään jättämään ohessa olevan linkin kautta 21.8.2026 klo 16.00 mennessä. Alkuperäiset opinto- ja työtodistukset esitetään mahdollisen haastattelun yhteydessä.

title: Research Accounting Program Manager
description:
Our team in Research and Sponsored Programs Accounting directly impacts Notre Dame’s mission to be a force for good in the world by supporting our campus partners achieve their goals and properly stewarding their resources. As with all things at the University of Notre Dame, we are looking for the exceptional. Here, exceptional is seen in our teamwork, accountability, integrity, leadership in excellence and leadership in mission.

What’s in it for you?

We recognize there are a lot of great organizations in the world where you can share your talents. What makes Notre Dame special? The people that work here often cite the great work culture, our distinctive mission, the opportunity to build a career, and our endless list of best-in-class benefits. You’ll work for a department that encourages independent work, giving you the empowerment to make decisions that are driven by the mission of the University. So what’s it really like to work here? You’ll have the opportunity to work on a dynamic team that aims to get better each day. You’ll be encouraged to try new things, think about creative solutions, ask really good questions, and make mistakes and learn from them. The Research Accounting Manager will play an integral role in ensuring financial compliance and processing efficiencies with respect to externally and internally sponsored activities and related funds.

The Research Accounting Manager ensures comprehensive financial compliance, risk mitigation, and lifecycle management for the University’s externally and internally funded research programs.

The Research Accounting Manager will manage a portfolio of research awards and participate to varying degrees in (i) grant analysis and auditing; (ii) billing, cash collection and financial reporting; (iii) internal control documentation and testing; (iv) enterprise wide compliance programs, including costing analysis; and (v) policy development and dissemination.

What’s next?

If what you’ve read so far sounds like a position you would thrive in; if the prospect of doing what you love for a University with a distinctive mission sounds like a place you want to call home – simply hit apply and tell us more!

Job duties:

  • Perform regular grant analysis, regulatory research, and targeted account audits based upon risk assessments of sponsored awards and cost-share commitments.
  • Conduct in-depth research into complex compliance requirements, agency guidelines, and federal mandates.
  • Partner closely with Notre Dame Research, faculty, and academic departments to evaluate unique transaction allowability, in reference to OMB Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200) and award terms, and determine appropriate resolution.
  • Perform required lifecycle management of grant funds, including complex sponsor billings, cash collection, financial-related postings, financial reporting, and closeout reconciliations in compliance with specific agency terms.
  • Test internal controls specifically designed for compliance over externally funded research programs, protecting the University against noncompliance risks.
  • Assist with enterprise-wide research compliance programs, including effort reporting /certification, sub-recipient monitoring, and costing analysis.

title: Restaurangbiträde till Restaurang MR Tre Renar i Boden Extra/Vid behov
description:
ExtraarbeteTillträde enligt överenskommelse

Vem söker vi?Nu söker vi en restaurangmedarbetare som med glädje och positivitet vill arbeta i ett team där serviceanda och lagarbete står i centrum. Med entusiasm levererar du enastående service till restaurangens alla gäster.I tjänsten ingår bland annat förberedelse och servering av mat och dryck, kassahantering samt hålla arbetsplatsen och restaurangen ren och fin.

Om Restaurang MR Tre Renar

Tre Renar är belägen i Boden inne på Försvarsmaktens område. Enheten består av en stor militärrestaurang som dagligen serverar ca 300-1200 frukost, lunch, middag och kvällsmål, både i matsal samt utskick vid övningar. På området finns ytterligare tre mässar där vi bedriver verksamhet såsom kiosk, café och representationsmiddagar. I vårt uppdrag ingår även att serva kaffemaskiner på hela området för försvarsmakten. Vi har ett nära samarbete med mässföreningen där det förekommer flera stora evenemang och middagar. Verksamheten förväntas växa under kommande år. På Tre Renar är vi ca 25 glada och engagerade medarbetare som jobbar.

Vi söker nu extraanställda som framförallt kan arbeta kvällar och helger.

Eftersom vi verkar inom ett skyddsobjekt så krävs registerutdrag och sekretessintyg. Registerutdraget måste vara utan anmärkningar och du måste vara svensk medborgare eftersom verksamheten bedrivs inom militärt område.

Vem är du?

  • Du är över 18 år
  • Du tycker om att planera och strukturera ditt arbete så att det blir effektivt
  • Med din positivitet tar du ansvar för att hålla en hög servicenivå genom hela dagen
  • God service är viktigt för dig där ett leende och ögonkontakt är en självklarhet
  • Du ser din betydelse i nöjda gäster, är positiv, stresstålig och har lätt för att samarbeta och kommunicera
  • Du kan ta egna initiativ och är flexibel i din yrkesroll
  • Du talar och skriver svenska
  • Tidigare erfarenhet av restaurangarbete är ett plus

Om Compass Group

Vi är en del av Compass Group som är en världsledande leverantör inom mat, dryck och supportservice. Över hela världen har vi över 500 000 kollegor. I Sverige har vi cirka 450 verksamheter runt om i landet, vilket gör att det finns fantastiska utvecklingsmöjligheter hos oss. Vi har förmåner genom kollektivavtal som årlig löneökning, försäkringar och tjänstepension.

Compass Group i Sverige omsätter cirka 3 miljarder kronor och drivs under varumärken som Food & Co, Marketplace, Medirest, Amica, Chartwells, Levy Restaurants, UNISON, Eurest och fler. Compass Group Sverige är en del i koncernen Compass Group PLC. Koncernens omsättning uppgår globalt till 250 miljarder SEK (2022). Våra kunder är företag, arenor, universitet, skolor, vård och omsorg med flera. Vi tillhandahåller service såsom mat och dryck, konferens, reception, lokalvård, vaktmästeri med mera. Vill du läsa mer om Compass Group, besök gärna vår hemsida.

Varför ska du välja oss?

  • Vi rekryterar schysst! Vi tror att mångfald, olika erfarenheter och kompetenser gör den bästa stjärnhimlen.
  • Vi älskar service och vi vill leverera service i världsklass genom att alltid ge det lilla extra.
  • Vi tror på hållbarhet! Både när det gäller vår planet och våra kollegor.
  • Vi levererar kvalitet i allt vi gör!

Rekrytering på Compass Group

Rekryteringen sker löpande så varmt välkommen in med din ansökan idag! Vi tar enbart emot ansökningar via webben, ansökningar som kommer in på annat sätt behandlas inte. För mer information om hur Compass Group AB behandlar dina personuppgifter, klicka här.

title: Psykiatrisjuksköterska till barn- och ungdomspsykiatrin

description:
Är du specialistsjuksköterska inom psykiatri och vill göra skillnad för barn och unga? BUP i Hudiksvall söker nu en engagerad psykiatrisjuksköterska som vill bli en del av vårt team.

Barn- och ungdomspsykiatrin (BUP) har i uppdrag att bedöma, utreda och behandla barn och unga i åldern 017 år med medelsvår till svår psykisk ohälsa. BUP-mottagningen i Hudiksvall har norra Hälsingland som sitt upptagningsområde. Personalgruppen består i dag av läkare, psykologer, kuratorer, sjuksköterskor, skötare och medicinska sekreterare. Vi har en väl fungerande samverkan med aktörer inom både kommunen och Region Gävleborg.

Hos oss erbjuds du en stimulerande arbetsmiljö med goda möjligheter att utvecklas och växa i din yrkesroll.

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Vi söker dig som är legitimerad specialistsjuksköterska inom psykiatri. Hos oss får du arbeta i en stimulerande och utvecklande miljö där du gör skillnad för barn och unga med psykisk ohälsa. Du blir en del av ett professionellt team som arbetar för att ge våra patienter den bästa möjliga vården.

Som psykiatri sjuksköterska hos oss kommer du bland annat att arbeta med
• bedöma och planera vård insatser för barn och unga med psykisk ohälsa
• delta i och leda behandling samtal, både individuellt och i grupp
•  medicin uppföljning, information och stöd vid läkemedelsbehandling
• telefonrådgivning
• dokumentera vård insatser och följa upp behandlingar.

Hos oss får du
• ett meningsfullt arbete där du har möjlighet att påverka
• möjlighet till kompetensutveckling och handledning
• ett engagerat och stöttande team
• trygga anställningsvillkor och kollektivavtal.

Läs mer om våra förmåner: https://www.regiongavleborg.se/jobb-och-utbildning/jobba-i-region-gavleborg/dina-formaner/


KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som är lyhörd i mötet med andra människor och har förmåga att skapa förtroendefulla relationer med barn och ungdomar. Du är empatisk och har förmåga att sätta dig in i någon annans situation. Vidare ser vi att du är kommunikativ, har en god samarbetsförmåga och kan arbeta både självständigt och i team. Du planerar och strukturerar ditt arbete och du tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter. 

I rollen som psykiatrisjuksköterska ska du
• vara legitimerad sjuksköterska med specialistutbildning inriktning psykiatri.

För den här tjänsten är det meriterande om du har erfarenhet av barn - och ungdomspsykiatri.

Före erbjudande om anställning har arbetsgivaren rätt att begära ett utdrag från belastningsregistret.


Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare, tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse.

Med 7 500 medarbetare är vi länets största arbetsgivare. Det ger oss styrka att driva utvecklingen framåt för ett livskraftigt Gävleborg. Vårt uppdrag är spännande och komplext. Oavsett vilken roll du har hos oss hjälper du invånarna i länet och gör nytta i samhället. Vi ligger i framkant i samhällsutvecklingen och satsar på att du som medarbetare ska få växa och utvecklas. Hos oss får du använda hela din kraft för att tillsammans med dina kollegor skapa framtidens Gävleborg. 

Hälso- och sjukvårdsnämndförvaltningens cirka 6500 medarbetare arbetar tillsammans för att ge länets invånare de bästa förutsättningarna för ett aktivt liv med ökad livskvalitet. Genom att tillhandahålla god och nära vård i hela länet lägger vi grunden för ett starkt och friskt Gävleborg.

Vi har redan beslutat var vi vill synas med våra platsannonser samt vilket stöd vi vill ha i rekryteringen. Vi kommer inte att köpa annonsplats eller tjänster för pågående rekrytering och ber er därför att inte kontakta oss med sådana erbjudanden.

description:
As a Recruitment Coordinator, you will support client recruitment teams and contingent workforce programmes by providing exceptional candidate care, workforce administration, and recruitment coordination services. You will be responsible for managing a variety of administrative activities throughout the recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing and interview coordination through to onboarding, contingent worker extensions, and offboarding.

As a Recruitment Coordinator, you will possess strong attention to detail and accuracy, with the ability to identify and mitigate potential risks associated with recruitment, onboarding, and workforce administration processes. Reporting to the Recruitment Administration Manager, you will help drive a best-in-class experience for candidates, hiring managers, and contingent workers while acting as an ambassador for the Allegis Global Solutions brand.

  • Source, screen, and shortlist candidates for open positions.

  • Create offer letters and employment contracts using client HR systems and obtain the necessary approvals.
  • Initiate and monitor pre-employment screening and background check activities.

title: Student Internship in bioengineering (starting September 2026, for 12 months)
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche, we believe it’s urgent to deliver medical solutions right now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are fearless in both making decisions and taking action. And we believe that good business means a better world.

That is why we come to work each day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.

The Opportunity

Joining Roche’s Institute of Human Biology (IHB, https://institutehumanbiology.com), part of Roche Pharma R&D (pRED), focused on human model systems for drug discovery and personalized medicine.

In this position, you will

  • Contribute to the derivation of new methodologies for long-term tissue culture

  • Work closely with colleagues in the areas of bioengineering

  • Design and execute experimental work and perform data analysis

  • Actively participate in scientific discussions and present your work

Who you are

You are an ambitious student who is currently enrolled in life sciences (biology, bioengineering, biotechnology, or a related scientific field). You have a strong interest in scientific problem-solving and learning new techniques. You thrive in a dynamic, inclusive environment that gives you full accountability for your own contributions and development.

Desired skills

  • Prior experience in mammalian cell culture

  • Experience in basic molecular and cell biology techniques, including immunostaining, histology, and confocal imaging

  • Motivation to learn and apply innovative research tools and new techniques

  • Clear communicator and fluent in English

To be considered, please send us your complete application merged into one PDF including

  • CV

  • Motivation Letter

  • A certificate of enrollment (if you are currently studying)

  • For non-EU/EFTA citizens: Certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory (required due to regulations)

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.


Let’s build a healthier future, together.

title: Automotive Alignment Technicians
description:
Mavis Tires & Brakes at Discount Prices - Automotive Alignment Technicians


Put your career into high gear with Mavis Tires & Brakes at Discount Prices! We're looking for a full-time Automotive Alignment Technicians to join Team Mavis at one of our state-of-the-art automotive service, repair and tire sales centers in the Vails Gate, NY area. With over 2,000 retail locations, Mavis is one of the largest tire sales and automotive repair chains in the United States.

About the Position of Automotive Alignment Technician

Automotive Alignment technicians use the latest equipment to align newly-mounted tires and wheels on customer's vehicles. By measuring and adjusting caster, camber, toe and thrust angles, our Automotive Alignment Technicians reduce customer's tire wear and ensure serviced vehicles travel straight and true. Mavis's Alignment Technicians also complete state-mandated inspections, oil and filter changes and flat repairs, and perform any other required automotive service or vehicle repairs to customer vehicles.

Employee Benefits

At Mavis, we understand that our people drive our success. We provide our team members with competitive weekly pay, including weekly incentive compensation, a good working environment and an excellent combination of additional benefits like health, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer match, paid vacations, paid time off, paid holidays, life insurance, on-the-job training, and opportunities for career growth and advancement.

Qualifications

We recruit team members who share our commitment to providing complete customer satisfaction and delivering the highest quality service. To be eligible for the position of Automotive Alignment Technicians you must (1) be at least 18 years of age; (2) be legally authorized to work in the United States; and (3) possess 1 year of experience and/or training in dismounting, mounting, rotating and balancing tires or any combination of education, training and experience which demonstrates the ability to perform the duties and responsibilities of the position. In addition, it is preferred that Alignment Technicians possess a state inspection license.

As an active position, Automotive Alignment Technicians are required to stand, walk, bend, kneel, stoop, crouch, crawl, climb, pull, reach and perform repeated and repetitive movements consistent with vehicle and tire maintenance and repair. Alignment Technicians must regularly lift and/or move items weighing over 50 pounds.

title: Apprenticeship as a Mechatronics Technician (f/m/x)
description:
During your 3.5-year apprenticeship, you will gradually gain experience in all areas relevant to the profession of a Mechatronics Technician. You will be supported by experienced trainers and colleagues throughout your apprenticeship.

  • Mechanics and assembly: You will learn how to machine components manually and mechanically and assemble them into modules and complete measuring instruments.
  • Electronics and pneumatics: You will install and connect electrical, electronic and pneumatic components.
  • Technical drawings and circuit diagrams: You will learn how to read technical drawings, design documents and circuit diagrams and put them into practice.
  • Sensors and control systems: You will wire sensors, drives and control systems and put them into operation.
  • Testing and troubleshooting: You will test electrical equipment, systematically analyse faults and develop suitable solutions.
  • Commissioning: You will test our measuring instruments and prepare them for their future use.
  • Insights into our production: You will work in different areas of our production department and gain a comprehensive understanding of how our products are made.

For example, our instruments test how flour develops into dough or how plastics behave during processing. This means you can see directly what the instruments you assemble and test will later be used for.

Theory and practical experience
You will complete the theoretical part of your apprenticeship in block-release lessons at Berufskolleg West in Essen. You will then apply the knowledge you have gained directly in practice at our company.

  • You have completed your school education, whether with a lower secondary school certificate, intermediate school certificate, vocational diploma or Abitur.
  • You are interested in technology and would like to understand how machines and equipment work.
  • You enjoy practical work and have good manual skills.
  • You are reliable and enjoy working as part of a team.
  • You are eager to learn new things and continue developing your skills.

Good grades in mathematics, physics or technology will help you get started. However, your motivation and interest in technology are even more important to us.

Fair apprenticeship pay

  • 1st year: €1,250.00 gross per month
  • 2nd year: €1,300.00 gross per month
  • 3rd year: €1,380.00 gross per month
  • 4th year: €1,490.00 gross per month

Personal support and development
You will start together with one other Mechatronics Technician apprentice. Our small apprenticeship intake allows us to support you personally and help you develop your individual strengths.

  • personal support from experienced trainers and the specialist departments involved
  • dedicated contacts throughout your apprenticeship
  • external exam preparation courses, both online and in person
  • good prospects of being offered a permanent position after successfully completing your apprenticeship

Good working conditions

  • 30 days of annual leave
  • 40-hour working week
  • flexible working hours within the framework of your apprenticeship
  • laptop and all required learning materials
  • free public transport job ticket
  • capital-forming benefits

Additional benefits

  • Corporate Benefits with numerous shopping and leisure discounts
  • free drinks
  • company events
  • company sports groups, such as running, badminton or football
  • free parking
  • good public transport connections


How to apply
Simply upload your application via our careers website. Please include:

  • your CV
  • your two most recent school reports
  • any relevant internship certificates or other supporting documents

You do not need to submit a traditional cover letter. Instead, please briefly answer the following questions in the application form:

  • Why are you interested in an apprenticeship as a Mechatronics Technician?
  • What have you enjoyed building, repairing or experimenting with from a technical perspective?


What happens next
Once we have reviewed your application, we will get back to you. If your application is a good match, we will invite you to meet us in person.

Apply now
We look forward to getting to know you.

description:

  • Champion a test-and-learn culture across all digital channels.

Team Leadership

  • Build capability within the team through succession planning, coaching and development opportunities.
  • Foster a collaborative, commercially focused culture built around accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Champion cross-functional ways of working to ensure teams remain aligned against shared business objectives.

Essential

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate data and insights into actionable growth strategies.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing senior stakeholder relationships.
  • Excellent analytical, forecasting and financial planning capabilities.
  • Strong leadership skills with a demonstrated ability to develop high-performing teams.

Desirable

  • Experience operating across multiple European markets and territories.
  • Experience working with international brands within fashion, luxury, lifestyle or consumer goods sectors.
  • Experience leading digital transformation, platform migrations or marketplace expansion programmes.
  • Familiarity with personalisation, testing and optimisation platforms such as Optimizely, Dynamic Yield or similar solutions

title: OD Advisor
description:
At Ayvens, progress starts with you.

Our ambitions to shape the future of sustainable mobility are powered by our talent. Join us, and get better with every move.

Your responsibilities

As Order & Delivery Advisor you and your colleagues will be responsible for the complete management of vehicles ordered from us. Between 15 and 20,000 vehicles, bikes and energy cards are ordered, registered and delivered every year. You guarantee qualitative and timely handling of these orders, registrations and deliveries of their vehicles.

Your main tasks?

  • You ensure that all administrative steps of the files assigned to you are completed correctly. To this end, you are in frequent telephone contact with our customers (drivers, garages, fleet manager, etc.) and, of course, your colleagues from other Ayvens departments.

  • You gather the necessary information for drawing up contracts, orders and invoicing.

  • You also know how to improve the quality of processes and further optimise systems. With us, you get the space to put your ideas into practice yourself.

  • You are a sparring partner for the ODE Manager and together with her, you know how to take the department to the next level.

Who are we looking for?

  • You have at least 2 years of demonstrable experience in a similar position.

  • You have strong thinking and reasoning skills and are able to map and optimise existing processes.

  • You like administration, organisation and structure are important to you.

  • You can handle deadlines and like a brisk pace of work.

  • You are customer-oriented, have good communication skills.

  • You have a problem-solving, entrepreneurial and innovative approach.

  • You work equally well independently and in a team.

  • You are perfectly bilingual NL/FR and fluent in English

What do we offer?

Join Ayvens – Drive the Future of Mobility
At Ayvens, we’re turning mobility into more than just a destination — we’re making it a great experience. And to make that happen, we need people who make a difference.

We’re committed to helping our colleagues grow, thrive, and reach their full potential. That means:

  • providing extensive training opportunities

  • clear talent development plans

  • fair and competitive compensation

  • You can count on a well-rounded benefits package, including a free medical care plan, pension scheme, meal and eco vouchers, and a flexible income plan.

  • Healthy work-life balance

  • Flexible working hours

  • Possibility of homeworking several days a week

  • Thorough onboarding process and performance feedback

  • Opportunities for internal mobility

At Ayvens, we welcome fresh ideas, innovation, and open feedback. We’re building a culture where everyone has the space to be themselves and contribute to something bigger — the future of sustainable mobility.

We are Ayvens. We’re ready for what’s next.
Are you? Apply now and be part of the journey.


Why Ayvens?


With over 3.1 million vehicles managed across more than 40 countries, we provide full-service leasing, flexible subscription services, fleet management services and multi-mobility solutions to customers of all sizes, including large corporates, SMEs, professionals, and private individuals. By leveraging our unique position to lead the way to net zero and further shape the digital transformation of the industry, we are well-positioned to meet the evolving mobility needs of our clients and provide them with the solutions they need to thrive.


At Ayvens, we believe that our success is driven by our commitment to customer satisfaction. Our team is dedicated to delivering innovative solutions and technology-enabled services that help our customers focus on their everyday business. We’re committed to sustainable mobility and have made it a core part of our strategy. In everything we do, we’re guided by the principles of authenticity, curiosity, commitment and collaboration. We aim to foster an organisation that's diverse in people and ideas, where everyone can thrive and be themselves, no matter who they are.


Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to enable the transformation towards large scale adoption of sustainable mobility and provide our customers with the solutions they need to succeed. Follow our page for the latest updates, news, and insights.

title: Dataanalytiker inom Power BI
description:
Om företaget

Vi tillsätter specialister inom allt från teknik, IT och industri till projektledning och affärsstöd – och oavsett uppdrag har du en konsultchef som finns där för dig och din utveckling.

Om rollen

Du kliver in i en verksamhet inom vård och omsorg där data används för att stärka planering, uppföljning och beslut i en komplex och samhällsviktig miljö. Här får du arbeta nära verksamheten med att sammanställa, analysera och visualisera statistik så att mönster och samband blir tydliga och användbara.

Rollen kombinerar analys, datamodellering och verksamhetsförståelse. Du bidrar både till löpande beslutsunderlag och till vidareutveckling av verksamhetsstatistik, rapporter och planeringsunderlag. Det här är en roll för dig som vill använda Power BI och statistik i ett sammanhang där dina insikter får konkret betydelse för hur vård- och omsorgsverksamhet följs upp och utvecklas.

Arbetsuppgifter
  • Du sammanställer och analyserar data och statistik för att skapa tydliga rapporter och beslutsunderlag.
  • Du utvecklar och vidareförvaltar verksamhetsstatistik inom vård och omsorg.
  • Du bygger datamodeller som gör det möjligt att analysera komplexa samband.
  • Du tar fram visuellt tydliga och pedagogiska rapporter i Power BI.
  • Du integrerar och bearbetar data från flera olika datakällor, inklusive SQL Server, Excel och tredjepartskällor.
  • Du bidrar i projekt med analysstöd för att utveckla och förbättra planeringsunderlag.
  • Du tar fram underlag till olika typer av styrande och uppföljande dokument.
  • Du presenterar insikter och resultat på ett sätt som är anpassat efter målgruppen, även i forum som ledningsgrupper och samverkansråd.
  • Du dokumenterar ditt arbete strukturerat och samarbetar nära andra funktioner i verksamheten.
Krav
  • Du har relevant utbildning, exempelvis högskoleexamen inom data-/systemvetenskap, ekonomi eller likvärdigt, alternativt högre eftergymnasial utbildning inom statistik, datavetenskap, business intelligence eller liknande.
  • Du är en erfaren dataanalytiker med mycket goda kunskaper i statistik.
  • Du har kunskaper i Microsoft 365 och Power BI.
  • Du har erfarenhet av att arbeta inom offentlig förvaltning och av att ta fram och analysera statistik som beslutsunderlag.
  • Du kan utföra komplex datamodellering i Power BI.
  • Du har avancerade kunskaper i Power Query och kan skriva och optimera DAX-funktioner.
  • Du har goda modelleringskunskaper och erfarenhet av att integrera och bearbeta data från flera datakällor, inklusive SQL Server, Excel och tredjepartskällor.
  • Du har goda kunskaper inom systemintegration med verksamhetssystem.
  • Du har goda kunskaper inom prestandaoptimering i Power BI-rapporter.
  • Du har mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, både muntligt och skriftligt.
  • Du har erfarenhet av minst två liknande uppdrag.
  • Du kan förmedla statistik och insikter på ett pedagogiskt och visuellt tydligt sätt anpassat efter målgruppen.
  • Du kan dokumentera ditt arbete på ett strukturerat och begripligt sätt.

title: Sairaanhoitaja, Onnikoti Aalto, Pori
description:
Sairaanhoitaja, Onnikoti Aalto, Pori

Tule tekemään kehitysvammaisten ohjaustyötä ainutlaatuiseen joukkoommeuuteen Onnikoti Aaltoon, Poriin!

Haemme nyt sairaanhoitajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen uuteen, kauniiseen ja moderniin kotiimme. Tule meille hyvän arjen mahdollistajaksi!

Mihin tulet töihin?
Onnikoti Aalto on toukokuussa 2026 auennut uusi kehitysvammaisten asumisyksikkö. Onnikoti Aalto tarjoaa ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista 14 henkilölle sekä yhteisöllistä asumista 7 henkilölle. Palvelut tuotetaan uusissa tarkoitukseen suunnitelluissa tiloissa. Tilojen suunnittelussa on huomioitu esteettömyys ja viihtyvyys.

Mitä pääset tekemään?
Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan Onnikotien arvojen ja laatulupausten pohjalta kotimme toimintaan. Tavoitteenamme on jokaisen asukkaan yksilöllinen, turvallinen ja hyvä arki. Pääset tekemään jokapäiväistä hoitotyötä ja kehittämään yksikkömmetoimintaa yhteistyössä muiden tiimiläisten kanssa. Arkemme on toiminnallista jajärjestämme jatkuvasti aktiviteetteja asukkaillemme.

Sairaanhoitajana vastaat lääkehoidon suunnittelusta ja kehittämisestä sekä huolehdit sen turvallisesta toteutumisesta. Tuet ja perehdytät henkilökuntaa sekä vahvistat heidän osaamistaan, mutta osallistut myös itse aktiivisesti päivittäiseen hoitotyöhön asukkaiden parissa.

Kuka sinä olet?
Olet koulutukseltasi sairaanhoitaja. Joukossamme viihtyy parhaiten positiivisesti asioihin suhtautuva ja oma-aloitteinenhenkilö, joka on aidosti kiinnostunut kehitysvammaisten parissa työskentelystä.Osaaminen kehitysvammaisten kanssa työskentelystäkatsotaan eduksesi.Hoitotyön tehtävien hoitaminen edellyttää vähintään B1 ja avustavien tehtävien hoitaminen edellyttää vähintään A2 tai vastaavaa suomen kielen kielitaitotasoa, sekä sitoutumista kielitaidon ylläpitämiseen.

Miksi tulisit meille töihin?
Uudessa yksikössä pääset alusta asti mukaan rakentamaan ja kehittämään toimintaamme. Onnikoti Aallossa tulet osaksi yhteen hiileen puhaltavaa työyhteisöä, jossa töitätehdään positiivisella asenteella kaikkia kunnioittaen.

Olemme joustava työnantaja ja meillä kaikki saavat osallistua työvuorosuunnitteluun.Mehiläisen työntekijänä saat käyttöösi hyvät henkilöstöedut, kuten liikuntasaldon, työterveyshuollonja digiklinikan palvelut 24/7.

Työ on kokoaikainen 2-vuorotyö ja tehtävän palkkaus on yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:n G24 mukainen, jonka lisäksi maksetaan tehtäväkohtainen lisä. Työ edellyttää tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotesuojaa seka voimassa olevaa sote-ammattikorttia.

Sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti tehtävään valittavien ikääntyvien tai vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työskentelevien on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitetturikosrekisteriote.

puh. 040 684 5004 (arkisin klo 8–16)
veera.vanhatalo@onnikodit.fi

title: AI Integration Lead
description:
Please click "Apply Now" to respond to the initial questions in the application form and submit your CV / Resume and cover letter. We ask that you spend no more than 2 hours preparing your responses to the prompts.

Application Deadline: Sunday, August 30, 2026, at the end of the day (23:59) Anywhere on Earth (UTC-12:00).

About the Role

Our staff's time is one of RP's tightest bottlenecks. Over the last year, AI tools have crossed a threshold where they can meaningfully accelerate serious knowledge and administrative work. But they're also uneven, and it's easy to feel faster while producing plausible-sounding work that doesn't hold up. As an organisation that cares about getting things right, we don't want to adopt AI on vibes. We want to know, rigorously, where it genuinely improves our work and where it doesn't.

That's what this role is for. You'll lead RP's effort to figure out — empirically — which of our research and operational tasks AI can reliably and usefully augment, build and deploy the tools and workflows that prove out, and steer us away from the ones that don't. This is as much a measurement and research problem as an adoption one, which is why we want someone who understands both research rigor and the real capabilities and limits of modern AI tooling.

You'll be the lead for this area at RP and will report to the Principal Research Director, David Moss.

The role may be offered at a more junior or more senior level (and titled accordingly) depending on the successful candidate's experience

Hours and term: Our default is full-time on an initial 12-month contract with the possibility of extension. We're open to part-time for the right person, and open to a shorter initial term with the option to re-engage afterwards. Tell us what arrangement works for you.

Contact: Please email careers@rethinkpriorities.org if you have any questions.
  • Own RP's strategy for using AI in our work. Propose and prioritise where to invest, set the direction, and be the directly responsible individual for how AI is used across the organisation.
  • Design and run rigorous, decision-relevant evaluations. Test AI tools and workflows against the work we actually do, measuring real effects on quality, speed, and reliability, not just adoption or self-reported time savings. Distinguish clearly what AI can be trusted to do from what it can't.
  • Build and prototype. Get hands-on with agentic tooling (e.g. Claude Code), plugins, MCP integrations, and lightweight internal tools — first to test approaches, then to scale the ones that work.
  • Partner with teams across RP. Sit with researchers and operational staff to understand their workflows in detail, surface high-value use cases, and embed what works into day-to-day practice.
  • Turn findings into guidance. Translate evaluation results into clear, current advice, policy, and training, and raise the organisation's overall AI fluency.
  • Assess safety and security of AI tools. Identify risks from AI tool use, including cybersecurity, data protection and legal compliance, and document clear recommendations for handling them.
  • Stay ahead of a fast-moving field and keep RP's approach evidence-led rather than hype-led.

This role sits at the intersection of research and engineering, so we're looking for genuine strength in both of the following — though, as noted below, the balance can tilt in either direction.

Research judgment. You understand what rigorous research looks like, how that differs across domains, and why a slick-looking AI output can still be wrong in ways that matter. You can design fair, decision-relevant tests and change your mind based on the results.

Technical fluency. You're genuinely hands-on with modern AI tooling, comfortable working with agentic coding tools like Claude Code, building plugins and MCP integrations, and writing the scripts needed to wring real capability out of these systems and to evaluate them properly.

We'd also expect:
  • A self-directed, experimental disposition, happy owning an ambiguous, fast-evolving mandate without a playbook.
  • Familiarity with effective-altruism-style research and RP's priorities to judge where AI genuinely helps.
  • Comfort working in a fully remote, globally distributed senior role.

Two ways to be a strong fit

We expect most candidates to lean one of two ways, and we're open to both:
  • A researcher who's fluent in AI — someone with a solid research background in cause prioritization research who has gone deep on AI tooling.
  • A technically strong builder with EA literacy — someone with strong engineering and AI-tooling skills who is engaged with the cause prioritization research space.
If you're strong on one axis and credible on the other, we want to hear from you.

Nice to have

  • Prior experience in AI enablement, evaluation, or applied AI/ML.
  • A software engineering background or a track record of building internal tools.
  • Direct experience with one or more of RP's research domains (animal welfare, AI safety and strategy, global health and wellbeing, and general cause prioritization).

Compensation
  • We offer an annual salary between $132,986-$146,447 USD pre-tax for a full-time position, prorated for part-time work.
  • The exact salary will be based on the candidate’s prior relevant experience and corresponding title level, and calculated using RP’s salary algorithm.
  • Compensation is not restricted to the currencies listed above.
  • To ensure fairness across the entire organization, RP does not negotiate salaries.
Other Benefits
  • Opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, high-impact organization — our research is used by key decision-makers who influence the distribution of hundreds of millions of charitable dollars.
  • Remote-first environment, including flexible work hours and schedule.
  • Comprehensive global benefits program, including statutory benefits specific to a local country, as mandated by local law, and supplemental benefits, as available
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) and unpaid leave, including:
    • Statutory paid and unpaid leave (as applicable)
    • Unlimited (within reason) personal and sick paid and unpaid leave
    • “Mandated” mid- and end-year, organization-wide breaks (if the temporary employment contract falls within the break timeline)
    • Other paid and unpaid leave (e.g., bereavement)
  • Annual technology stipend of the equivalent of $500 USD that can be used to cover costs of purchasing work and office equipment
  • Learning opportunities, including workshops / training sessions
  • Virtual co-working spaces, including a private Rethink Priorities Focusmate group
  • RP Peer Support Program for New Employees.
  • Other benefits at the discretion of RP Leadership.
  • A caring team that values respectful work relations and a healthy work-life balance.
  • Opportunities to grow/advance your career and engage in professional development.
  • Low administrative bureaucracy.
  • We don’t provide snacks, but we could mail you a box of Oreos if you want!

Our Hiring Process

Stage 1 — Initial Screening.
To be considered for this role, we ask for the following, which you can complete on the application page:
  1. A C.V.
    1. We recommend you update your CV to include all prior relevant roles and work as CV’s will be evaluated for this role.
  2. A cover letter briefly describing your suitability for the role
    1. In particular, we'd like to hear about your strengths on the two axes described above: your hands-on experience with AI tooling (whether deploying it across an organisation, in research or operations workflows, or in your own work), and your research background, especially where it relates to RP's domains. As noted, we expect most candidates to lean one way — tell us which, and what makes you credible on the other. Bullet points are welcome.
  3. Relevant prior work you think would showcase your suitability
    1. You can upload documents/ share links on the application page
  4. No more than 1000 words addressing the following question:
    1. Rethink Priorities works across a variety of domains (AI, animal welfare, global health, cross-cause prioritisation), and methodologies (drawing on empirical literature, quantitative modeling, and philosophical theorising). With reference to some concrete research task conducted by Rethink Priorities, outline how you would evaluate the extent to which AI can be used to complete this task.
    2. Please see the application page for detailed instructions and the evaluation criteria.
Stage 2 — Paid Skills Assessment.
  • You will complete a standardized, time-boxed task that mimics the actual job (3–5 hours)
  • You’ll be paid $45 per hour for the test task
Stage 3 — Interview
  • We will ask you questions across the skills and experience the role requires
  • You will have a chance to ask questions about the role, and RP broadly
Stage 4 — Reference Checks. We ask two references about your work

We hope to hire for this role by end of September.

Additional Information

Role-Specific

  • Work Environment and Visa Sponsorship: This role is fully remote and we are able to legally hire in many countries. We are not able to sponsor visas for this role.
  • Time Zones and Working Hours: While we welcome applicants from all time zones, you may be expected to attend meetings with at least a two-hour overlap with UTC+2 working hours.
  • Language: Professional level of English language is required for all roles at Rethink Priorities.

Hiring Process Specific

  • Extension requests: We will try to accommodate extension requests that are made before the deadline and are up to three (3) days. We generally cannot accommodate extension requests made after the application deadline, or are longer than 3 days, and cannot accept late submissions to ensure fairness to other applicants.
  • Application materials: All application materials must be submitted in English language; otherwise, we will not be able to evaluate your candidacy.
  • Inclusivity and fairness: RP is committed to building an inclusive, equitable, and supportive community for you to thrive and do your best work. Please don’t hesitate to apply for a role regardless of your age, gender identity/expression, political identity, personal preferences, physical abilities, veteran status, neurodiversity or any other background. We provide reasonable accommodations and benefits, including, for example, flexible work schedules and locations.
  • Accessibility: We’re committed to running an inclusive and accessible hiring process. We warmly invite you to reach out to careers@rethinkpriorities.org with any questions or accessibility requests such as chat box use during interviews.
  • Hiring Software: We use Pinpoint for our recruitment and hiring processes and all of the email correspondence is done via Pinpoint. We encourage you to add Pinpoint domain (@pinpoint.email) to your trusted contacts and/or check your 'spam', 'promotions' and ‘updates’ folders, if you don’t hear from us within the expected timeframe.
  • Other: Visit our Career webpage if you’d like to know more about our hiring process, culture, and what working at RP is like.

We will advance candidates to the next stages based on their quality of responses during our hiring process. Please do not include a photograph, or headshot of yourself, or any personal information that is not relevant to the role for which you’re applying (including marital status, age, identity traits, etc.).

About Rethink Priorities

Founded in 2018, Rethink Priorities (RP) is a think-and-do tank. Through research and action, the organization improves the lives of humans and animals—both now and in the future.

We work to identify solutions, mobilize resources, and empower our team and others to address some of the world’s most pressing problems. Our team conducts rigorous research across animal welfare, climate change, global health, international development, and other important and neglected areas. Our operations experts help high-impact organizations to improve efficiency and achieve meaningful results.

RP works as all of the following:
  1. A consultancy doing commissioned work in response to demands from organizations doing high-impact work.
  2. A research institute driven by research agendas we set according to our own priorities.
  3. A think tank aiming to inform public policy to improve the world.
  4. An accelerator, incubator, and base for priority projects.
Accomplishments include:
  • Bringing attention to neglected issues, such as lead exposure, fungal diseases, and shrimp welfare.
  • Increasing the collective impact of advocates across each field in which we work through strategic coordination.
  • Investigating potential interventions and identifying the most cost-effective options. In 2025, our research influenced tens of millions of dollars in foundation grants.
  • Creating practical tools for philanthropists to compare resource allocations across different species and cause areas and to build giving portfolios despite uncertainties.
  • Providing organizations with data to inform their decisions. For example, we have conducted surveys on perceptions of existential risks, AI, effective giving, and other topics.
  • Providing fiscal sponsorship and operational support to ensure that high-impact initiatives in areas like AI safety and animal welfare can launch and grow effectively.
  • Donor Compass - Cross Cause Fund Tool to guide philanthropic giving.
We welcome you to review our research database and our latest annual report.

title: Autonomous Driving Systems Simulation and Data Analysis Engineer
description:
Support the validation and continuous refinement of performance requirements, safety thresholds, and key performance indicators (KPIs) for autonomous driving systems through large-scale simulation and real-world data analysis.

The engineer will leverage simulation, data analytics, and software development to quantify and refine performance, behavioral, and technical requirements necessary to achieve system safety. The role focuses on safety requirements quantification, including latency budgets, safety mechanism thresholds, and checker maturation parameters, while developing and maintaining simulation and analysis tools, and supporting scalable safety validation activities.

Key Responsibilities

Simulation Development & Scenario Execution

  • Develop and maintain simulation tooling in C/C++ and Python to support large-scale autonomous driving validation activities.
  • Design interfaces and integrations between internal validation tools, simulation environments, and data processing frameworks.
  • Extend existing simulation scenarios to inject perception noise, latency, and failure conditions to characterize system robustness.
  • Support containerized development and deployment environments using Docker and Linux-based infrastructure.
  • Use simulation results to support the definition and refinement of subsystem performance requirements and safety thresholds.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of safety mechanisms under degraded system performance conditions.

Data Analytics & Performance Evaluation

  • Develop and maintain Python- and C/C++-based analysis and simulation pipelines to process, visualize, and evaluate large-scale driving and simulation datasets.

  • Investigate scenarios where unsafe behavior occurs despite performance targets being met and provide data-driven recommendations for improving metrics, thresholds, or requirements.

  • Determine characterization data and quantify system performance against KPIs, SPIs, safety targets, and behavior requirements.

Education

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

Experience

  • Experience with validating and quantifying performance criteria for autonomous driving functions such as:
    • Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC)
    • Lane Centering
    • Automated Lane Change
    • Highway Driving Assist
    • Automated Driving / ADS functions
  • Experience analyzing autonomous driving datasets and vehicle performance data.
  • Experience developing production-quality software in C/C++ and/or Python, including tool development, automation, and system integration activities.
  • Experience with Linux-based development environments.
  • Experience integrating software applications into CI/CD pipelines and automated validation workflows.
  • Experience working with autonomous driving software stacks, particularly:
    • Perception
    • Object tracking/fusion
    • Vehicle Intent
    • Prediction
    • Planning
    • Vehicle control interfaces
  • Experience evaluating software and system performance using simulation and real-world validation data.

Desired Skills

Simulation & Scenario-Based Validation

  • Experience with Applied Intuition Simian simulation environments.
  • Experience with Foretellix scenario generation and validation tools.
  • Experience with AV simulation stacks and simulation workflows.
  • Experience developing, generating, and managing simulation scenarios for autonomous driving validation.
  • Experience evaluating ODD coverage and edge-case traffic situations.

Software & Infrastructure

  • Experience integrating simulation, validation, or analytics tools into enterprise software ecosystems.
  • Experience setting up, configuring, and running Docker containers.
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and large-scale data processing frameworks.
  • Experience developing internal engineering tools and automation frameworks in C/C++ or Python.
  • Experience with build systems such as CMake and software development best practices.

Autonomous Driving & Safety

  • Knowledge of Autonomous Driving Safety Performance Indicators and KPIs.
  • Familiarity with ISO 21448 (SOTIF).
  • Experience supporting safety case development, safety performance evaluation, or safety requirement specification activities.

Please note that only selected candidates and Permanent Residents/Canadian Citizens will be contacted.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

title: Battery Materials Lead
description:
RefinyX AB is building the world’s most efficient critical materials recovery platform for sovereign Western supply chains. We are now looking to hire a Battery Materials Lead at the Refinyx R&D facility in Västerås, Sweden.

Scope. The role owns the technical direction of three work streams: recycled iron phosphate qualified to battery grade, LFP cathode active material (CAM) by spray pyrolysis, and NMC pCAM by conventional co-precipitation.

Mandate. The Battery Materials Lead runs a team of scientists and carries technical accountability for what the group delivers. The role is also the technical counterpart to customers on specifications and acceptance criteria.

Location. The role is based at the Refinyx R&D facility, Nätverksgränd 1, 721 36 Västerås. The pilot line, the laboratories, and the team sit on that site. Travel is to customer sites and partner laboratories, driven by business need.

Position. The role sits between three groups: customers on specification, the QC team on characterization and validation, and the industrialization team on scale-up.

Key responsibilities

Team, customers, and qualification

• Build and lead the battery materials team, and carry technical accountability for what it delivers.

• Agree technical specifications and acceptance criteria for recycled iron phosphate, pCAM, and CAM products directly with customers.

• Own the technical direction of characterization, validation, and qualification protocols, together with the QC team.

• Build in-house characterization and validation capability with the QC team. Establish external laboratory partnerships to cover immediate needs while that capability is built.

Iron phosphate and LFP, spray pyrolysis stream

• Lead the work to bring recycled iron phosphate to battery grade, against targets for crystallinity, particle size distribution, purity, and composition.

• Lead development of CAM and bare CAM production by spray pyrolysis.

• Set impurity limits with customers and hold the process to them, on the elements that govern LFP cell performance.

NMC pCAM, co-precipitation stream

• Set composition and morphology targets across NMC grades, including nickel-rich chemistries, against customer requirements.

• Lead the development of NMC pCAM by conventional co-precipitation, and take it into production: reactor conditions, particle growth, morphology, tap density, and composition

Direction, IP, and modelling

• Set the technical direction of the battery materials work streams and act as technical lead within the group.

• Run targeted R&D with the industrialization team on routes that scale at commercially viable cost.

• Develop IP around the iron phosphate and spray pyrolysis CAM processes, including patent applications and supporting documentation.

• Develop predictive machine learning models for spray pyrolysis process parameters with the AI partners of Refinyx, to speed optimization and cut experimental cycles.

• Apply AI platforms to particle characterization from QC data, to cut development and validation time and to raise throughput and consistency.

Qualifications

• More than 10 years on battery materials, cathode active materials, or battery recycling, in industry or in an industrially facing research group.

• Experience leading a team of scientists: setting direction, carrying technical accountability for the output, and holding the work to schedule.

• PhD in Materials Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Metallurgy, or a related field. An MSc with equivalent industrial depth is accepted.

• Hands-on record in iron phosphate or LFP synthesis, precipitation, or purification.

• Expertise in NMC pCAM production by conventional co-precipitation: reactor design and control, nucleation and particle growth, morphology, tap density, and composition control across NMC grades.

• Working knowledge of layered oxide cathodes, including lithiation and the effect of process conditions on electrochemical performance.

• Nickel-rich pCAM, NMC811 or above, taken through to a qualified cathode material.

• Surface coatings or dopants for layered oxide cathodes.

• Command of SEM, XRD, ICP-OES/MS, BET, and particle size distribution analysis, including method development, calibration, and uncertainty assessment.

• Experience building a laboratory from empty room to running operation, covering characterization and validation as well as QC.

• Experience taking a materials specification through customer qualification, with cell manufacturers or CAM producers.

• Written and spoken English.

• Willingness to travel to customer sites and partner laboratories

title: Infection Preventionist
description:
SUMMARY:

Under the supervision of the Director, Epidemiology and Infection Prevention for Brown University Health, and the Medical Director, Epidemiology and Infection Control, is responsible for investigating nosocomial infections using advanced surveillance techniques. Develops and implements policies and procedures related to epidemiology, infection control and infectious diseases. Responsible for investigating nosocomial infections using standard epidemiologic methods and able to function independently.
Brown University Health employees are expected to successfully role model the organization's values of Compassion, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence as these values guide our everyday actions with patients, customers and one another.

In addition to our values, all employees are expected to demonstrate the core Success Factors which tell us how we work together and how we get things done. The core Success Factors include:

Instill Trust and Value Differences
Patient and Community Focus and Collaborate

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Investigates outbreaks of infection in conjunction with department. Establishes etiology, develops interventions and evaluate outcomes.

Obtains specimens from patients, hospital personnel and environmental reservoirs to determine source of infection during outbreaks. Uses molecular biological techniques to type bacteria and determine similarities of isolates. Monitors endemic hospital-acquired infections or potential sources of infection following procedural changes by use of surveillance cultures. Carries out investigations to determine risk of infection from medical devices.

Coordinates and performs safety and surveillance rounds throughout the hospital in collaboration with safety and facilities management personnel. Integrates monitoring of infection control practices and standard precautions into rounds.

Serves as consultant and educator to healthcare team members. Develops and presents in-service education programs regarding infection control for all areas of the hospital. Compiles and analyzes infection control data and creates related reports for end users. Compiles and analyzes data from research studies in order to identify risk factors and etiologies associated with specific infections.

Utilizes local area computer network for the Epidemiology and Infection Control Department. Participates in the development or updating of computer programs to enhance the productivity of the Epidemiology and Infection Control Department.

Performs surveillance activities as designated on an assigned basis. Carries out delegated responsibilities in the absence of the Director and/or Medical Director of Epidemiology and Infection Control Department.

Reviews, revises and updates policies and procedures related to infection control practice.

Represents Epidemiology and Infection Control Department on assigned committees and/or Task Forces.

Perform other duties as assigned.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION:
Bachelor 's Degree in medical technology, nursing or related field. Evidence of graduate level courses in microbiology or epidemiology preferred.

Certification in Epidemiology and Infection Control is preferred and required within 3 years of hire.

Demonstrated knowledge of the care provided in the tertiary, acute-care hospital to patients throughout the continuum of life with consideration of aging processes, human development stages and cultural patterns in each step of the care process.

Demonstrated skills with personal computers and software to include database management, spreadsheets, word processing and graphics applications.

Demonstrated skill with both verbal and written communication.

EXPERIENCE:
Three years experience in hospital epidemiology infection control.

INDEPENDENT ACTION:
Performs independently within department policies and practices. Refers specific, complex problems to Director where clarification of departmental policies and procedures may be required.

title: Automotive Product Experience Specialist - Flow Honda of Winston Salem

title: Team Ledare - Förpackning och Lager, Cheese Operations Götene
description:
Vill du leda en verksamhet där kvalitet, säkerhet och ständiga förbättringar står i centrum? Vi söker en engagerad ledare som drivs av att utveckla människor, skapa resultat och bygga en kultur präglad av samarbete, ansvarstagande och ständiga förbättringar.


Som Team Ledare ansvarar du för den dagliga driften inom Förpackning och Lager och leder ett team på cirka 20 medarbetare. Du har ett helhetsansvar för att verksamheten levererar enligt uppsatta mål inom säkerhet, kvalitet, leverans och produktivitet.

Du skapar förutsättningar för ett engagerat team genom ett nära och coachande ledarskap där feedback, tydliga förväntningar och delaktighet är en naturlig del av vardagen. Tillsammans med dina medarbetare driver du utvecklingen av verksamheten genom Lean, standardiserade arbetssätt och ett kontinuerligt förbättringsarbete.

Hur du kommer påverka

Ledarskap och medarbetarutveckling – Du leder, coachar och utvecklar cirka 20 medarbetare och skapar en arbetsmiljö där engagemang, ansvar och samarbete står i fokus.

Operativt resultatansvar – Du ansvarar för att verksamheten når uppsatta mål inom säkerhet, kvalitet, leverans, produktivitet och kostnad.

Säkerhet och arbetsmiljö – Du har delegerat arbetsmiljöansvar och arbetar proaktivt för att skapa en säker arbetsplats där alla kommer hem oskadda varje dag.

Lean och ständiga förbättringar – Du driver förbättringsarbetet genom Lean-principer, standardiserade arbetssätt och ett datadrivet arbetssätt med fokus på att eliminera slöseri och skapa värde.

Kvalitet och livsmedelssäkerhet – Du säkerställer att produktionen uppfyller Arlas höga krav inom kvalitet, hygien och livsmedelssäkerhet samt följer gällande standarder och regelverk.

Samarbete över funktioner – Du arbetar nära kollegor inom Produktion, Logistik, QEHS, M&E, Planering och andra stödfunktioner för att säkerställa effektiva flöden genom hela värdekedjan.

Vad kommer att göra dig framgångsrik

Vi söker dig som är en trygg och närvarande ledare med erfarenhet av att leda människor i en producerande verksamhet. Du har ett coachande förhållningssätt och motiveras av att utveckla både människor och verksamhet.

Vi tror att du har:

Erfarenhet av operativt ledarskap inom industri eller livsmedelsproduktion.

Ett coachande ledarskap där feedback används för att utveckla människor och skapa engagemang.

Erfarenhet av Lean, ständiga förbättringar och standardiserade arbetssätt.

God förståelse för arbetsmiljö, säkerhet och livsmedelssäkerhet.

Förmåga att analysera resultat, prioritera och fatta beslut i en verksamhet med högt tempo.

God samarbetsförmåga och ett strukturerat arbetssätt.

Vad erbjuder vi?

En nyckelroll i en av Sveriges viktigaste livsmedelsproduktioner. Du får stora befogenheter att forma arbetssätt och kultur och arbetar med produkter som finns på frukostbord över hela landet. Bli en del av Arlas resa mot världsklass inom mejeriproduktion. Arla Foods har kollektivavtal och säkerhet samt arbetsmiljö har högsta prioritet hos oss, varför vi bland annat tillämpar slumpmässiga drog- och alkoholtester.

Vill du bli en del av oss på Arla?

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Pär-Johan Ekman, ARPAEK1@arlafoods.com

Vänligen observera att ansökningar eller CV som skickas via e-post eller direktmeddelanden inte kommer att accepteras eller beaktas.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with natural, sustainable nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

title: Server
description:
About Douro

Douro is a culinary destination in the heart of Portland, Maine, inspired by the rich flavors, traditions, and hospitality of the Douro Valley region of Portugal. Our restaurant celebrates fresh, local ingredients paired with authentic Portuguese influence, offering guests a warm and memorable dining experience. At Douro, we are passionate about creating a welcoming environment for both our team and our guests—where quality, creativity, and community come together. As we build our team, we’re looking for individuals who share our dedication to exceptional service, genuine hospitality, and a love for food and culture.

Douro is part of the Prentice Hospitality Group, known for its portfolio of exceptional Maine dining destinations and dedication to culinary excellence.

Position Summary

We’re looking for a Server who brings more than just plates to the table — we want someone who brings energy, personality, and genuine hospitality to every shift. As the heartbeat of the guest experience, you’ll set the tone with warm welcomes, friendly conversation, and an eye for detail that makes every visit feel special. Whether it’s recommending a favorite dish, creating a memorable celebration, or keeping the vibe lively on a busy night, you’ll be part of the team that turns great meals into lasting memories. If you love people, thrive under pressure, and enjoy being in the center of the action, this is the role for you.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Greet guests promptly with professionalism and hospitality.
  • Present menus, answer questions, and provide knowledgeable recommendations on food and beverages.
  • Accurately take food and drink orders and enter them into the POS system.
  • Deliver meals and beverages to tables efficiently and ensure orders meet quality standards.
  • Monitor guest satisfaction throughout service and anticipate needs proactively.
  • Maintain clean, organized, and presentable dining and service areas.
  • Collaborate with team members and kitchen staff to ensure smooth service.
  • Handle guest concerns with professionalism and escalate issues to management as needed.
  • Process payments accurately and efficiently.
  • Follow all safety, sanitation, and responsible alcohol service procedures.

Qualifications:

  • Previous serving experience in a restaurant or hospitality environment preferred.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced setting while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Team-oriented with a positive, professional attitude.
  • Must meet the legal age to serve alcohol (if applicable).
  • Flexible availability, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

Benefits:

  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Health insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • Supplemental benefits
  • Employee discount
  • Free meals
  • Paid training

Why Join Us

At PHG, our work is guided by three core pillars: A Culinary Lens, Modern Service with Classic Values, and A Sense of Place. Food is our anchor — rooted in the terroir of Maine and executed with intention, discipline, and respect for craft. We deliver hospitality that is best in class, relationship-driven, and grounded in professionalism and care.

Our values — Expert, Nimble, Ambitious, Inclusive, and Timeless — shape how we operate every day. We bring deep expertise to our craft, move with agility, strive for excellence, foster welcoming environments for all, and build concepts designed to endure. Each of our restaurants is connected to its neighborhood and community, contributing meaningfully to Maine’s evolving hospitality landscape while creating lasting value for our guests and our teams.

We’re excited to meet passionate, dedicated individuals who want to grow with us. Apply today and become part of our amazing team!

description:

You’ll join an environment where learning and discovery go hand in hand. As a Technical Student, you’ll gain hands-on experience while supporting projects in mechanical engineering. You’ll be part of a community where your curiosity and willingness to learn matter most.

Your responsibilities

  • Learn from and assist experienced engineers, technicians and scientists in your field of study.
  • Contribute to ongoing projects in areas such as design, manufacturing, assembly or testing of mechanical components and systems.
  • Take part in day-to-day technical activities under close supervision.
  • Collaborate and exchange ideas within an international and multidisciplinary team.

Your profile

  • You are currently studying in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

  • You are eager to develop your skills through on-the-job learning.
  • You enjoy teamwork and learning from others in a collaborative setting.

Your skills

  • A good understanding of mechanical engineering fundamentals relevant to your studies.
  • Curiosity, precision and a proactive attitude towards learning.
  • Good communication skills and ability to work effectively in a multicultural team.

Application Deadline: 16/10/2026 at 23:59 (Geneva time)

Employment Conditions:

  • Ideal Start Date: 01/04/2027
  • Weekly Working Hours: 40
  • Contract duration (in months): 4 to 12
  • Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite

Global Benefits

  • A monthly allowance of 3486 Swiss Francs (tax free).
  • 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
  • Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive Health Insurance scheme (the contribution will be automatically deducted from your allowance).
  • Family supplement to subsistence allowance, depending on your individual circumstances.
  • Travel expenses to Geneva upon joining CERN, depending on your individual circumstances.

You will need these documents to complete your application

  • An academic transcript (optional)

Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.

Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe.
