title: Lifeguard
description:
Now Hiring Lifeguards - Be the Reason Someone Gets Home Safe

Are you alert, responsible, and ready to make a real impact?

At the YMCA, lifeguards do more than watch the water — they create a safe, welcoming environment where individuals and families can build confidence, learn new skills, and belong.

We’re hiring dependable, mission-driven Lifeguards to join our aquatics team.

Why This Role Matters

Drowning prevention is serious work. As a YMCA Lifeguard, you serve as a safety leader, role model, and calm presence in our aquatic spaces.

Every shift, you demonstrate our core values of caring, honesty, respect, and responsibility — and ensure every participant can enjoy the water safely.

What You’ll Do

  • Maintain constant surveillance of the pool area
  • Enforce safety rules in a professional and respectful manner
  • Respond quickly and confidently in emergency situations
  • Provide first aid and emergency care when needed
  • Build positive relationships with members and participants
  • Support swim lessons and aquatic programs as assigned

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong sense of responsibility and focus
  • Ability to remain alert for extended periods
  • Quick decision-making skills
  • Professional communication
  • Team-oriented mindset

Required Certifications

  • Lifeguard Certification
  • CPR/AED for Professional Rescuers
  • First Aid

(If certification is needed, candidates may contact the Aquatics Manager, Robert Baker at rbaker@denverymca.org training opportunities.)

Why You’ll Love Working at the Y

  • Flexible scheduling
  • Free YMCA membership
  • Paid training opportunities
  • Growth pathways (Head Guard, Swim Instructor, Aquatics Coordinator)
  • A workplace where your role truly matters

POSITION SUMMARY

The Lifeguard, working as part of the Aquatics team, will deliver world-class customer service and relationship building skills to create a welcoming environment at the YMCA. The Lifeguard will be responsible for guarding the pool and assuring a safe and clean aquatic environment for members and guests. The incumbent will also exhibit the core values of caring, honesty, respect and responsibility in all aspects of their work with the YMCA.

OUR PATH

For 150 years, the YMCA of Metro Denver has been more than a place - it is a movement that lifts spirit, mind and body for all. Our direction is clear: Elevate Lives and Rise Together. Grounded by our mission and strengthened by the global YMCA movement we will elevate our people, purpose, partnerships and promise.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Always maintain pool safety; guard using YMCA approved techniques and procedures including dismissing participants for disruptive behaviors
  • Perform chemical checks as indicated
  • Wear protective gear when handling biohazard materials
  • Proactively clean up and/or repair areas used by the program
  • Report all accidents and incidents to supervisor immediately using proper forms
  • Remain current on Lifeguard Certification, CPR Pro, First Aid and other safety certification training
  • Educate participants on pool rules and enforce rules as required
  • Be knowledgeable and supportive of the YMCA annual support campaign, and general procedures and policies, including personnel guidelines, facility access procedures, membership policies, and emergency plans

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Frequently required to stand, walk, sit, use hands to finger to handle or feel objects, tools, controls, reach with hands and arms, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, talk, hear
  • Exposed to wet and humid conditions, outdoor weather conditions including direct UV sun rays, fumes or airborne particles, toxic or caustic chemicals, and potentially explosive materials
  • Regularly lift and/or move up to 50-100 pounds
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, and focus

DISCLAIMER

  • The YMCA of Metropolitan Denver reserves the right to modify, add, or remove job duties and responsibilities as business needs evolve.
  • This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications required for the position.
  • Employment with the YMCA of Metropolitan Denver is at-will and may be terminated by either the employee or the organization at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER STATEMENT

The YMCA of Metropolitan Denver is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

YMCA CHILD ABUSE PREVENTION & RISK MANAGEMENT STATEMENT

The YMCA is committed to the safety and well-being of all children and vulnerable individuals. As part of our commitment to child abuse prevention and Praesidium accreditation standards, all employees are required to comply with YMCA abuse prevention policies, including screening, training, supervision, and reporting requirements.

title: Project Buyer
description:
Are you ready to play a key role in driving innovation at one of the most forward-thinking companies in the agricultural sector? As our Project Buyer, you’ll take ownership of procurement activities within New Product Introduction (NPI) and Continuous Development (CD) projects & other special projects (e.g. benchmarking, process improvement projects)—transforming concepts and designs into real solutions that improve the lives of farmers worldwide.

You will be working in a multidisciplinary team with colleagues from amongst others PD and integrated supply chain. You are the linking pin to our suppliers within this team. From the very first sketch to ramp-up for serial production, your role ensures that the right suppliers, materials according to specifications and budget, and timelines are in place to bring cutting-edge innovations and improvements to life.

Your main responsibilities include:

  • Leading and coordinating procurement efforts within NPI and CD projects, from concept to serial production.
  • Developing and maintaining project sourcing plans, aligning with Engineering, and Integrated Supply Chain stakeholders.
  • Acting as the primary procurement liaison in multidisciplinary project teams. Translating technical, SCM and Operations needs (e.g. supply risk mitigation, lifecycle management, sustainability) into sourcing strategies, selection and contracting of suppliers.
  • Advising key stakeholders regarding procurement consequences of proposed changes.
  • Engaging suppliers early to ensure feasibility, cost-effectiveness, and timely industrialization.
  • Manage risks at supplier and item level. Including assessment, mitigation planning and execution.
  • Leading benchmark projects in cooperation with your procurement colleagues.
  • Other procurement related projects such as process improvements.
  • Drive initiatives to evaluate and improve our (procurement) way of working in projects.

You thrive in a project-based environment, bringing structure, overview, coordination and decisiveness to the table. You know how to balance innovation, cost, and quality while managing complex internal stakeholders and suppliers. Your ability to align technical, business and procurement goals makes you a trusted partner across disciplines.

You bring the following:

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of experience in procurement, preferably in a high-tech or manufacturing setting.
  • Hands-on experience with project-based work such as NPI, CD and other procurement projects.
  • Knowledge of early supplier involvement, industrialization processes, and cost and lifecycle modeling.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, and technical communication skills.
  • A Teamplayer that performs well under pressure and motivates others to reach the end goal.
  • A structured and proactive project approach, with strong organizational, detail and time management capabilities.
  • Willingness to travel internationally (approx. 10-20%).

Working at Lely means contributing to sustainable progress within one of the most innovative organizations in the Netherlands. You contribute to making the agricultural sector future-proof - and we make sure that you get all the space, resources and support you need to do so.

  • An international working environment with opportunities for own initiative and entrepreneurship.
  • Excellent working conditions, including up to 8 weeks of vacation per year and a good pension scheme.
  • A salary within the scale of € 5.000 - € 7.000 gross per month, in which we like to see opportunities for growth from your starting salary towards the future
  • Good growth opportunities: you are in control of your development and can choose from various training courses through our Lely Academy - from personal development to job-specific training.
  • Our modern Lely Campus offers daily access to extensive sports facilities: an indoor gym, outdoor padel courts, an outdoor basketball and volleyball court, table tennis and table soccer. You can join Hyrox workouts or sign up for personal training - and challenge your colleagues during an active break.
  • Enjoy fresh coffee and tea from our own barista, with milk straight from our farm, as well as a healthy and affordable company restaurant.
  • A healthy work-life balance thanks to our hybrid work policy: you work at least three days a week on Campus, with flexible working hours and plenty of room to spend extra time on site (between 06:00 and 20:00).
  • A free shuttle bus will take you to and from the metro in Maassluis, so your workday starts and ends smoothly.
  • Successes need to be celebrated: from anniversaries to Christmas parties - at Lely we know how to do it!

Recruitment & selection agency, consultancy, and/or secondment agency?
We appreciate the interest, but we are looking for all our candidates directly. We understand that you, as an intermediary, want to present candidates for our great positions and thus contribute to our ambitions, but this is not how we have set up our recruitment. This means that all unsolicited profiles offered on Lely vacancies will be treated as direct applications.

Heidi Saarijärvi p. 044 337 4707 s-posti: heidi.saarijarvi@takuurekry.fi

Takuurekry Oy on henkilöstöalan asiantuntija, jonka toiminnan ytimessä ovat luottamus, laatu ja aito kumppanuus. description:

Young Life requires all​ employees to sign a Statement of Faith. We recommend you read this statement before applying​ for any position.

Because of Young Life’s exclusive Christian purposes of evangelism and discipleship as set forth in its Articles of Incorporation and in these Bylaws, and to reflect what has always been and will continue to be the position of Young Life, specifically the Christian belief that each and every employee and volunteer of the corporation should minister as a servant of God with the primary responsibility of proclaiming the gospel of Jesus Christ and, as such, is an integral part of the Christian mission and ministry of the corporation,

title: Snickare / Installatör av Braskaminer i Stockholm
description:
Gillar du att se ett tydligt, snyggt resultat i slutet av arbetsdagen? Är du händig, orädd för höjder och vill inte stå på samma bygge flera månader i streck? Då har vi ett uppdrag som kanske passar dig.


Vilka vi är

På Värmekoncept är vi experter på kaminer och skorstenar. Det går bra för oss, och nu behöver vi öka kapaciteten i Göteborg. Vi vet att bra jobb kräver bra grejer, därför satsar vi på ordentliga verktyg, bra bilar och hjälpmedel som skonar ryggen. Vi tror på frihet: så länge jobbet blir snyggt gjort och kunden är nöjd, litar vi på att du löser uppgiften bäst själv.


Vad jobbet går ut på

Din vardag handlar om installation, inte bara "montering". Du sätter in kaminer, skorstenar och installerar kassetter i öppna spisar.

  • Utbildning ingår: Du går bredvid en erfaren kollega i början. Du behöver inte vara kaminexpert än, men du ska ha vana att hantera verktyg.
  • Planering: Du ansvarar för dina egna projekt. Du hämtar material på vårt lager och åker sedan ut till kund.


Vi ska vara ärliga: Det här jobbet är fysiskt. Även om vi har bra hjälpmedel så förekommer tunga lyft. Och eftersom skorstenar sitter där de sitter, kommer du tillbringa en hel del tid på tak. Är du höjdrädd är det här fel jobb. Är du däremot bekväm på en takstege och gillar utsikten, är det perfekt.


Vem är du?

Vi tror att du har bakgrund som snickare, montör, murare eller liknande. Det viktiga är att du är tekniskt lagd och lösningsorienterad. Eftersom du jobbar hemma hos privatpersoner (ofta i deras vardagsrum) är det avgörande att du är:

  • Serviceinriktad: Du är vårt ansikte utåt. Att vara trevlig, torka av skorna och hålla snyggt runt sig är lika viktigt som själva installationen.
  • Självgående: Du ser vad som behöver göras och löser det.
  • Svensktalande: Du måste kunna kommunicera obehindrat med kunderna.
  • B-körkort är ett krav.


Vi erbjuder

  • En specialistroll: Du blir expert på ett nischat hantverk.
  • Bra villkor: En riktigt bra fast lön, friskvård och en arbetsmiljö där vi har kul ihop.
  • Variation: Ingen dag är den andra lik, och du slipper harva på samma bygge i månader.


Ansökan

Låter det som ett jobb för dig? Skicka in CV eller bara en kort beskrivning av vad du gjort tidigare. Vi rekryterar löpande, så hör av dig direkt.

title: Backend Engineer (Cloud & AI Integration)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Backend Engineer, Cloud & AI Integration, to build and maintain backend services, APIs, and integrations that support AI product and internal tools.

This role will focus on Python-based backend services, REST APIs, data models, third-party integrations, and cloud-native workflows on AWS. The engineer will work closely with Full Stack Engineers to provide reliable backend services that can support scalable product development.

This is a mid-level backend engineering role suited for someone with strong hands-on experience in backend development, cloud services, APIs, and production systems. AI and Human-in-the-Loop workflows will be taught as part of the role, so prior AI or ML experience is not mandatory.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain backend services and REST APIs using Python.
  • Build and manage integrations with third-party platforms and internal systems.
  • Support AI-powered features and Human-in-the-Loop workflows where AI output is reviewed by a person before the next step.
  • Design reliable data models, backend workflows, and business logic.
  • Build serverless and cloud-native backend applications on AWS.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues across backend services.
  • Collaborate with Full Stack Engineers to deliver end-to-end product features.
  • Own the backend development scope for assigned features and integrations.
  • Contribute to code reviews, testing, documentation, and release activities.
  • Ensure backend services are reliable, scalable, well-tested, and maintainable

Looking For

  • 5+ years of total experience with 3+ years of experience in backend application development and production support.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining Python-based backend services.
  • Strong experience designing and consuming REST APIs.
  • Experience working with AWS and cloud-native application development.
  • Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases in production environments.
  • Experience integrating third-party APIs and external services.
  • Familiarity with Git-based development workflows.
  • Ability to work in a mid-level engineering role with strong execution and collaboration.
  • Comfortable working with Full Stack Engineers, owning the backend side of feature delivery.

Mandatory Skills

A. Technical Skills

  • Python backend development
  • REST API design and development
  • AWS cloud services
  • Cloud-native backend application development
  • Relational and/or NoSQL databases
  • Third-party API integrations
  • Serverless backend workflows
  • Git-based development
  • Production issue troubleshooting
  • Backend service testing and documentation

B.Soft Skills

  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Good communication and collaboration
  • Ability to work with cross-functional engineering teams
  • Ownership of assigned backend deliverables
  • Attention to code quality, reliability, and documentation
  • Ability to troubleshoot issues in a production environment

Good to Have Skills

  • Serverless application development experience
  • Experience with asynchronous processing, messaging, or event-driven architecture
  • Experience working in Agile software development teams
  • Exposure to AI-powered product features
  • Exposure to Human-in-the-Loop workflows
  • Track record of writing clean, well-tested, and well-documented code

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.

title: Senior Vehicle & Equipment Trainer
description:
Our team is highly skilled, passionate about our community, and we care. Let’s grow together.


Who We Are

In Whitby, we are dedicated to our work, our community, and each other. We work hard, we have fun, and we celebrate our successes.

The Town of Whitby is a community in transformation that is located in the heart of Durham Region in the eastern Greater Toronto Area. Whitby is the second-largest municipality in the region and one of the fastest-growing communities in Canada. Located on Lake Ontario and only an hour east of Toronto, the population of Whitby is expected to grow from 140,000 to more than 200,000 by 2031. Whitby’s Official Plan has been updated to establish new directions for Whitby’s planned growth and development; the protection of our natural and built environments; urban design intensification; sustainability; community improvement; and, new employment within this time frame.

The Town of Whitby combines a small town atmosphere with the sophistication and amenities of a larger urban centre. Whitby boasts two beautiful heritage downtowns, one of the finest recreational harbours with an award-winning marina, year round sports and recreation activities, parks, trails, and a robust arts and culture scene, all of which are part of the extraordinary amenities that Whitby residents enjoy every day.

Whitby has an exciting and aspiring future, with a community that is welcoming, growing and transforming. On our team, you can expect to make a difference through your work and have a direct impact on shaping our growing community. Creating an inclusive environment where employees experience job satisfaction and have rewarding careers is important to us. We live our values and foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, respect and engagement where people enjoy coming to work.

The Town of Whitby is a hybrid organization. This means staff are empowered to do their best work from various locations, as appropriate for the position.

We want to be the preferred employer for the most talented people who care about the Town of Whitby, and are excited and proud to serve our vibrant community.

Let’s grow together.

What You Will Get To Do

The successful candidate will have a positive impact on our corporate culture by demonstrating the Town’s CARE core values (Collaborative, Accountable, Respectful, Engaged) through daily interactions with individuals at all levels of the organization, external contacts and elected officials.

By effectively building positive rapport and relationships both internally and externally, the successful candidate will help us achieve our mission that together we deliver services that make a difference in our community.

The Senior Vehicle and Equipment Trainer will maintain the Town of Whitby compliance to all regulatory training requirements along with functional expertise to all Town departments on safe vehicle or equipment use and operation. The position is the primary contact for external training providers, the Town’s Level II CVOR, employee provincial driver’s abstracts, and regulatory guidance.

The position provides individual coaching and assessment of staff that use Town vehicles and equipment.

  • Act as subject matter expert in area of safe vehicle and equipment operation and related training and processes;

  • Research, develop and implement training that meet or exceed applicable legislation and due diligence requirements with respect to vehicle and equipment operation and reviews operator qualifications and training

  • Monitors and acquires fleet training programs and training formats that ensures drivers and supervisors receive training in the areas of safe driving and safe equipment operation

  • Provides recommendations on new hires, collision preventability and training in conjunction with the Safe Driving Program while liasing with HR and other departments to maintain the Program

  • Provides input to vehicle specifications to ensure appropriate operational and safety features are included in the acquisition of new vehicles and equipment

  • Provides suggested avenues of training and compliance to reduce vehicle related collision frequency and severity

  • Conducts vehicle collision investigations to determine preventability as required and reports investigation results to Risk Management to ensure all information is available in the event of serious collision

  • Promotes best practice(s) and vehicle safety awareness through training and safety related communication channels

  • Monitors and reports quarterly on Level II CVOR record for the Town of Whitby

  • Monitors and reports quarterly on Authorized Requester Information Services System for provincial drivers abstracts and CVOR abstract records to ensure ministerial requirements are met including Whitby Fire Services

  • Manages and updates all driver files to ensure ministerial compliance

  • Represents vehicle and Equipment Training in Labour Relations activities related to safe vehicle operation

  • Initiates the development, updating and application of audit/compliance review elements for the Town of Whitby as it relates to the driver/ operator ministerial regulations

  • Perform Defensive Driving Instructor and Support Trainer audits to improve instructor skills/coaching.

Who You Are

You are knowledgeable about and work in compliance with all workplace safety regulations, standards, and practices. You perform work in a safe manner and encourage and support others to do the same. You identify risks and implement ways to mitigate those risks to ensure employees remain safe.

You pay attention to the details. You hold yourself and others accountable for achieving agreed upon commitments, deadlines and milestones. You can explain just about anything to anyone. Your excellent communication and interpersonal skills enable you to skilfully build, establish and maintain positive working relationships and reduce conflict within the workplace. Using your extensive knowledge and experience in the field allows you to navigate through complex problems and recommend solutions.

To you, being at work is a mindset and not a location. You can switch seamlessly across modes of work and cultural norms of working in different environments. You know you best, including the tasks you do better when working virtually versus on-site. You believe that the cornerstone of successful working relationships is trust and understand how this positively impacts productivity and performance. You have a high degree of accountability, readily adapt to disruption, like to learn to skills, and explore new ways to connect and collaborate in the digital world.

What You Bring To Our Team

As the successful applicant, you must possess:

  • Minimum DZ provincial driver’s license (AZ preferred) in good standing to meet provincial Driver Certification Program (DCP) requirements;

  • 5+ years of municipal equipment operation and experience;

  • 5 years directly related industry knowledge of ministerial and regulatory requirements associated to Ministry of Transportation of Ontario (MTO), National Safety Code for Motor Carriers (NSC) and Occupational Health and Safety Act (OH&SA);

  • 5 years of supervisory experience;

  • Knowledge and expertise associated to CVOR requirements;

  • Certification in Adult Instructional techniques;

  • Level I vehicle Collision Investigation (Level II preferred);

  • Commercial Defensive Driving Instructors Certification;

  • Air brake Instructors Certification;

  • Basic knowledge of driver habits and collision trends as they relate to commercial vehicle operation; and,

  • Extensive knowledge of municipal maintenance operations.

  • Intermediate to advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.

  • Prior experience with Workday and Geotab is considered a strong asset.

What We Offer You

  • A hybrid work environment and flexible work arrangements where employees are empowered to do their best work in the way that works for them. This is designated as a designated as a Frontline Hybrid role. Frontline Hybrid recognizes that up to 40% of job functions associated with the role can be done virtually, from a remote office. Further details on these programs will be discussed through the selection process.

Salary Range/Hourly rate:

$113,533.00 - $129,014.00

Hybrid information:

Frontline Hybrid

Hours:

Flex hours, including days, evenings and weekends (up to 24 hours per week)

Closing Date:

August 12, 2026

AI Disclosure: The Town of Whitby confirms that artificial intelligence (AI) will not be used in the screening, assessment, or selection process for this position.

Our commitment to Inclusion, Diversity, Equity, and Antiracism
At the Town of Whitby, we view holistic inclusion as the pathway to achieving healthy relationships, inclusive excellence and fostering a culture where everyone can thrive. We acknowledge our history—the good and the bad, promote social justice and address discrimination and inequities. We strive to create a workplace that encourages you to always bring your authentic self to work.

The Town of Whitby is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer. Applications from women and minority candidates are strongly encouraged. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, pregnancy and pregnancy-related conditions, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The Town of Whitby is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive organization. title: Major Programmes Lead / Senior Programme Director

As a Major Programmes Lead / Senior Programme Director or Programme Management Office Director, you will have experience in playing pivotal roles in £500m+ major capital programmes, across complex construction environments within sectors such as Central Government, Industrial, Life Sciences, Data Centres and Defence.

You provide strategic leadership as a credible and accomplished programme delivery professional with a proven track record of delivering large-scale, high-value investments. You bring deep construction expertise, with the ability to operate seamlessly between strategic programme leadership and project-level detail, influencing key stakeholders and driving critical investment decisions.

Accountable for end-to-end programme delivery, you lead programmes from early-stage definition and mobilisation through execution, transition and benefits realisation. Working across multi-disciplinary teams and complex stakeholder environments, you provide the leadership, governance and commercial acumen required to deliver successful outcomes with clarity, control and confidence for our clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Portfolio & Strategic Thinking: Define and champion the programme vision, ensuring alignment with client business objectives and investment strategies. Lead the successful delivery of major, complex capital programmes across the full lifecycle, from business case development and mobilisation through execution, transition and benefits realisation.
  • Executive Leadership: Provide visible and credible leadership across multidisciplinary teams, creating a high-performance delivery culture. Establish and lead programme management and control frameworks that provide clear governance, accountability, transparency and confidence throughout programme delivery.
  • C-Suite Stakeholder Influencing and Engagement: Implement a structured stakeholder engagement and management process, building strong relationships with senior clients (C-Suite), Boards, Steering Groups, Investors and supplier stakeholders. Build trusted relationships with C-suite executives, Boards, Steering Committees, investors, delivery partners and key stakeholders. Influence strategic decision-making, secure stakeholder alignment and effectively navigate complex governance and organisational environments.
  • Commercial & Financial Stewardship: Maintain overall accountability for programme commercial performance and financial governance. Oversee forecasting, reporting, investment controls and value management, ensuring informed decision-making and delivery of agreed business outcomes.
  • Risk Strategy, Health & Safety Leadership: Identify and mitigate health and safety risks, enforcing safeguards to protect all involved in programme delivery. Lead the development and implementation of programme-wide risk management and assurance strategies. Champion a culture of safety, wellbeing and compliance, ensuring effective controls are in place to protect people, assets and programme objectives.
  • Governance and Delivery Leadership: Design and implement robust governance, reporting and assurance frameworks that support effective programme oversight and delivery. Ensure compliance with organisational, contractual and regulatory requirements while maintaining stakeholder confidence and supporting informed executive decision-making.
  • Commission Management and Business Development: Lead the successful commercial and contractual management of commissions, ensuring delivery excellence, client satisfaction and achievement of performance objectives. Develop trusted client partnerships, identify strategic growth opportunities and actively contribute to business development and market expansion activities.
  • People & Culture: Foster an inclusive, collaborative and high-performing culture across internal and client-facing teams. Build organisational capability through coaching, mentoring and talent development, while leading people management activities that support individual growth, team performance and the One Business culture

This is a Director level role. To excel in this role, you will have:

  • Proven experience delivering high-profile, large-scale, complex transformation/real estate programmes (£250-£500m+) with demonstrable achievement of tangible benefits and outcomes for clients/employers.
  • Ability to prioritise and optimise complex programmes ,responding to internal and external influences over the programme lifecycle.
  • Strong project delivery background with progression into programme leadership within a construction environment

title: Warehouse Operations Associate
description:
Warehouse Operations Associate

Restaurant Technologies is the leading provider of highly innovative and value-enhancing bulk cooking oil management services to the food service industry. The Warehouse Operations Associate is a key member of our depot team, overseeing shipping, receiving, and inventory management, as well as hands-on fleet upkeep—including preventative maintenance, cleaning, loading, and regular calibration. This role is also essential for maintaining food safety and regulatory compliance through rigorous cleaning and maintenance, while actively supporting workplace safety initiatives.

What Makes Restaurant Technologies a Great Place to Work:

  • Compensation:
    • $21 per hour + Shift Differential + Quarterly Bonus
    • Candidates who possess a CDL, Class A or B, with Tanker endorsement will earn an extra $2 per hr.
    • Opportunities to increase base pay with tenure and level-up development programs

  • Available Shift(s):
    • Monday - Friday, 7:00 am - 3:00 pm

  • Benefits:
    • $0 premium Medical for single coverage or employer HSA contribution for family coverage!
    • Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement & more!
    • 401k with matching contribution up to 4.5% of your compensation
    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays.
    • $3,000 employee referral bonus program & $200 new customer referral program.
    • Growth & Opportunity! We have 41 locations nationwide and consistently see year-over-year growth.
    • Award Winning Culture! – Newsweek America's Greatest Workplaces Award + Newsweek America's Greatest Workplaces for Diversity + Newsweek American’s Greatest Workplaces for Mental Wellbeing + Newsweek America's Most Patriotic Companies + Minneapolis St Paul Business Journal – Best Places to Work

Primary Job Accountabilities:

Shipping, Receiving and Inventory Management

  • Oversee the shipping of materials to customers, prepare corporate returns and support the weekly receiving of cooking oil tanker trucks.
  • Oversee the safe receiving of cooking oil tankers. Verifying load specifications against COAs and executing the secure connection and removal of tankers in accordance with environmental and safety containment protocols.
  • Maintain warehouse organization: including accurate receiving and reconciliation of orders and inventory, and partnering with leadership to process corporate repair bins and returns.
  • Inspect oil samples for contaminants and conduct warehouse inspections to ensure there are no hazards or deficiencies.
  • Operate a forklift to safely move, load, unload, and stack materials within the warehouse, ensuring efficiency and adherence to all safety protocols.
  • Load fleet vehicles with cooking oil for daily delivery routes.

Fleet Maintenance

  • Maintain fleet by following weekly (sanitation standard operating procedures) SSOPS, which includes cleaning filters, repair and replacement of hoses, and ensuring truck cleanliness.
  • Conduct regular verification checks on delivery truck flow meters to ensure accuracy and compliance with safety, legal, and quality standards. Perform truck calibrations.
  • Perform repairs and replacements of pumps and hoses on fleet trucks; manage and handle swappable oil tanks, including lifting and installing tanks, as required.
  • If you have a valid CDL, you may be asked to move our DOT regulated trucks within the depot or transport them as needed and conduct routine safety inspections to ensure all units are road-ready and compliant. If you do not have a CDL, you may be asked to move/transport our smaller vans and trucks, as needed.

Warehouse Cleaning and Maintenance

  • Execute daily SSOPs (Standard Sanitary Operating Procedures) to ensure the depot environment maintains sanitary conditions required for food safety standards to prevent contamination of our oil products. Complete related food safety documentation and report any deficiencies.
  • Maintain rigorous depot cleanliness standards through scheduled sanitation of warehouse floors, and common areas, while documenting all corrective actions in regulatory logs.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • Must be 21 years of age.
  • 2+ years of warehouse related job experience.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Current DOT medical card or willingness to obtain one (Restaurant Technologies will assist).
  • This position requires the operation of a DOT-regulated vehicle, and candidates will be subject to passing a DOT-mandated pre-employment drug test. Please be advised, a positive result for any controlled substance will disqualify applicants; including marijuana (THC), even if it is legal under state or local law.
  • Must uphold Restaurant Technologies’ Fleet Safety Policy requirements and maintain a clean driving record
  • Willing to obtain forklift operator certification (training provided).
  • Mechanically inclined with demonstrated ability to work with hand tools to perform basic repairs and maintenance on fleet equipment and warehouse machinery; comfortable troubleshooting, replacing, and installing parts (such as pumps, hoses, and swappable oil tanks) to support daily fleet and depot operations.
  • Able to efficiently operate smartphones and handheld devices to perform a variety of warehouse tasks.
  • Able to carry a minimum of 50 pounds by hand up to several hundred yards by cart
  • Unrestricted ability to bend, stoop, squat, stand, walk, climb, twist, turn and reach out
  • Ability to climb up and down a ladder as high as 20 feet in the air
  • Strong attention to detail, skilled at reviewing documentation for accuracy and identifying actionable items.
  • Proven ability to set priorities, manage multiple goals, and consistently deliver effective results.
  • Excellent collaborator, partnering with internal teams and delivering outstanding customer service.
  • Highly organized with a strong ability to maintain orderly work environments and processes.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma/GED
  • 3+ years of warehouse related job experience preferred.
  • 2+ yrs experience with shipping, receiving and inventory management.
  • 2+ yrs experience executing daily SSOPs (Standard Sanitary Operating Procedures) and completing HACCP documentation.
  • 2+ yrs experience with fleet maintenance, cleaning, calibration and minor repairs.
  • Previous experience driving trucks with CDL Class A or B.

title: Sähköasentajia Kajaaniin
description:
Sähköasentaja Kajaaniin
Etsimme asiakkaallemme Kajaaniin osaavaa ja motivoitunutta sähköasentajaa monipuolisiin sähköalan työtehtäviin. Jos pidät vaihtelevista työpäivistä ja haluat hyödyntää ammattitaitoasi erilaisissa kohteissa, tässä voi olla seuraava askel urallasi. Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan lähiaikoina ja oikealle tekijälle on tarjolla mahdollisuus pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.
Työtehtävät:
Työskentelet vaihtelevissa uudisrakennus-, saneeraus- sekä huolto- ja kunnossapitokohteissa Kajaanin alueella. Päivittäisiin työtehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa sähköasennusten toteuttaminen, kaapeloinnit, sähkökeskusten ja laitteiden asennukset sekä vikojen paikantaminen ja korjaaminen. Lisäksi osallistut järjestelmien käyttöönottoon ja varmistat, että kaikki työt tehdään laadukkaasti, turvallisesti ja voimassa olevia määräyksiä noudattaen. Monipuoliset projektit tarjoavat mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja kartuttaa kokemusta erilaisista työympäristöistä.
Odotamme:
Toivomme sinulta sähköalan koulutusta sekä aiempaa kokemusta sähköasennuksista. Työskentelet sujuvasti itsenäisesti, mutta olet myös luonteva osa työyhteisöä ja yhteistyö eri toimijoiden kanssa sujuu mutkattomasti. Arvostamme huolellista työotetta, vastuullisuutta ja halua tehdä laadukasta työnjälkeä. Voimassa oleva sähköturvallisuuskortti sekä kokemus rakennus-, kiinteistö- tai teollisuussähköasennuksista katsotaan eduksi.
Tarjoamme:
Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä mielenkiintoisissa sähköalan projekteissa vakaassa työympäristössä. Saat käyttöösi asianmukaiset työvälineet, osaavan työyhteisön tuen sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää ammattitaitoasi entisestään. Hyvälle tekijälle on tarjolla pitkäaikainen työ, jossa pääset rakentamaan osaamistasi monipuolisten työtehtävien parissa.
Palkkaus:
Palkka määräytyy sähköistys- ja sähköasennusalan TES:n mukaan. Lopullinen palkka sovitaan osaamisen, kokemuksen ja tehtävän vaativuuden perusteella. Palkkataso sijoittuu noin 15,50-21,35 €/h välille.

title: Executive Director of Facilities Management
description:
Executive Director of Facilities Management

The University of Lynchburg, a private, regional university in the beautiful foothills of the Blue Ridge Mountains in Central Virginia, is seeking applicants for full-time, Executive Director of Facilities Management position in the Operations Department.

This position reports to, is supervised by, and evaluated by the Assistant Vice President of Operations. The evaluation of work performance will be ongoing and will be carried out by the Executive Director of Facilities Management. It will include the specific duties and responsibilities of this position description plus employee attitude and general working behavior.

Job Type: Full-time, Exempt, Benefits Eligible

Job Purpose:

The Executive Director of Facilities Management is a senior, 100% on-site leadership position responsible for overseeing the strategic direction, operational management, and physical development of the University's campus environment. This critical role requires a visionary, hands-on leader who can foster innovation, ensure the safety and functionality of the physical plant, manage multi-million dollar capital projects, and advance the university's mission while providing immediate, localized support to the presidential administration.

The department encompasses Environmental Services & Grounds, Maintenance, Capital Projects, and Warehouse & Logistics (including vehicles, housing operations, and office moves)

Specific Job Duties:

  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement comprehensive strategic plans for campus infrastructure and maintenance that align with the university’s goals and the new presidential administration's priorities.
  • Leadership and Management: Provide executive leadership to the Facilities Management team. Directly supervise and mentor direct reports, and foster an inclusive, equitable work environment for a diverse workforce of tradespeople, staff, and contractors.
  • Regulatory Compliance & Safety: Ensure strict campus compliance with all federal, state, and local regulations, including OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration), EPA (Environmental Protection Agency), ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) accessibility standards, and fire/life safety codes.
  • Policy Development: Formulate and implement policies for preventative maintenance, emergency response, and severe weather protocols to enhance operational effectiveness and ensure compliance with safety regulations.
  • Budget Oversight: Manage complex departmental budgets, including the negotiation and oversight of external vendor contracts (e.g., landscaping, elevator maintenance, and waste management), resource allocation, and financial forecasting.
  • Program Development & Sustainability: Oversee the creation of sustainable campus initiatives—prioritizing energy management, carbon footprint reduction, and waste diversion—alongside major capital renovations (including complex electrical infrastructure upgrades) and space management solutions.
  • Housing Operations & Logistics: Direct comprehensive logistical operations, including the procurement and maintenance of the university vehicle fleet, execution of annual student move-in/move-out processes, and coordination of campus-wide faculty and staff office relocations.
  • Collaboration and Advocacy: Serve as the primary liaison between Facilities Management and other university divisions (such as Residence Life, Campus Safety, and the Office of the President), fostering partnerships to execute seamless campus events and transitions.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Utilize software tools and data analytics to evaluate work order efficiency, track preventative maintenance, and inform capital spending decisions.
  • Community Engagement: Represent the university in local community relations, coordinating with city management and public works regarding zoning, comprehensive city plans, and major campus disruptions.

Starting Salary: $100,000-$120,000

Benefits:

  • Generous paid vacation, personal days, paid sick time and family leave, comprehensive insurance (medical, dental, vision, etc.) and retirement plans, flexible spending account, tuition remission, life and long-term disability insurance, and more. Learn more about employment benefits at the University of Lynchburg.

Schedule:

  • 8:30 am - 5:00 pm (7.5 hours/day with some evenings and weekends to meet needs of the department may be required)

1608 - Senior Data Engineer - GCS

Role Summary and Impact

We are looking for a skilled and motivated Sn Data Engineer to join our global team. You are a hands-on builder who is passionate about creating robust, scalable data solutions that solve real-world problems. You will be a key contributor to the team, responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the data pipelines and infrastructure that are the foundation of our analytics products. In return providing value to our clients.

Working closely with the VP of custom reporting and other engineers in the team, you will execute the technical roadmap, transforming complex business requirements into high-quality, reliable data assets. If you thrive on turning massive datasets into actionable intelligence and enjoy working with cutting-edge cloud technologies, this role is for you.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable and reliable data pipelines and infrastructure, primarily using Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services like BigQuery and Cloud Storage, and Snowflake.
  • Develop, test, and deploy data transformation logic using SQL and DBT (data build tool) to create clean, reliable, and performant data models.
  • Collaborate with analytics, product, and engineering teams to understand data requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
  • Implement and uphold data quality and governance processes to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of our datasets.
  • Contribute to the execution of the data engineering roadmap by delivering on key initiatives and projects.
  • Develop and maintain monitoring for data pipeline performance, identifying and resolving issues to ensure data availability and freshness.
  • Optimize data pipelines and queries for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Support data consumers by exposing data through APIs and supporting integrations with analytics and visualization tools like Power BI.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation for data pipelines, models, and processes to support product adoption and team knowledge sharing.
  • Contribute to a collaborative team environment, participating in code reviews and sharing your expertise with fellow engineers.

Skills and Experience

  • Proven experience as a Data Engineer, with a track record of building and maintaining production-level data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with data manipulation languages for complex data transformation and analysis.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms, ideally Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including services like BigQuery and Cloud Storage.
  • Experience with DBT (data build tool) for building modular, scalable, and testable data models, or equivalent.
  • Strong understanding of data modelling concepts, data warehousing principles, and data integration techniques.
  • Proficiency with a programming language such as Python for scripting and data pipeline development.
  • Digital advertising familiarity: An understanding of campaign data from platforms like Google Ads, Facebook Ads, or DSPs is a strong plus.
  • Analytical mindset and problem-solving skills: You can troubleshoot complex data issues and develop robust, long-term solutions.
  • Excellent collaboration skills: You can communicate effectively and work well in a team-oriented environment with various technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working in an Agile development environment.
  • Experience supporting data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI) is desirable.

Known for its rich heritage and unique brand DNA, Kate Spade New York offers a distinctive point of view and celebrates communities of women around the globe who live their perfectly imperfect lifestyles.

Kate Spade New York is part of the Tapestry portfolio – a global house of brands committed to stretching what’s possible.

Our company name Tapestry, represents the diversity of our brands and the diversity of our people. We know that having a diverse range of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences makes us more innovative and successful and it brings us closer to our consumer. Our goal is to create a culture that is equitable, inclusive and diverse - where all of our employees, customers and stakeholders thrive.

Visit Our People page to learn more about Tapestry's commitment to equity, inclusion, and diversity.

The Stylist will serve as a trusted and knowledgeable advisor who assists customers in selecting products that suit their aesthetic and lifestyle. They will work with the customer to discover and express their own personal style while showing the customer how to incorporate Kate Spade products into their existing wardroom.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Engagement & Styling

  • Greet guests warmly and confidently, demonstrating strong product knowledge.
  • Actively listen and ask insightful follow-up questions to understand customer needs.
  • Provide styling advice, suggest add-ons, and create complete looks.
  • Use creativity to showcase multiple ways to wear products and encourage customers to explore new styles.
  • Guide customers through purchase decisions and ensure a seamless checkout experience.
  • Reinforce and celebrate customer choices, inviting them to return.

Sales & Business Acumen

  • Drive results through strong customer connections and storytelling.
  • Demonstrate deep knowledge of the brand and product attributes across all categories.
  • Maintain operational excellence, including stockroom organization and POS transactions.
  • Give and receive feedback in an honest, constructive manner.

Requirements

Skills & Experience

  • Professional selling skills with exceptional interpersonal and communication abilities.
  • Prior experience in a retail environment.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and work collaboratively in a team setting.
  • Social media awareness and willingness to learn omni/virtual selling techniques.
  • English proficiency (or local language proficiency per market).

Schedule: Ability to work a flexible schedule to meet the needs of the business—including nights, weekends, busy season, and high-traffic retail days (including but not limited to public holidays).

Note: This document serves only as a sample of job duties and responsibilities and does not include an exhaustive list of all performance requirements.

What Kate Spade can offer you:

  • An inclusive, innovative, and fun working environment

  • Internal mobility & career progression

  • 1 paid volunteering day per year and opportunities to volunteer with global projects.

  • Learning & development opportunities with our Ambassador Programme

  • Regular social events

  • Equity Inclusion & Diversity initiatives which include employee resource groups & regional inclusion councils.

  • Attractive employee discount

  • Compelling incentive programme


Our Competencies for All Employees
Courage: Doesn’t hold back anything that needs to be said; provides current, direct, complete, and “actionable” positive and corrective feedback to others; lets people know where they stand; faces up to people problems on any person or situation (not including direct reports) quickly and directly; is not afraid to take negative action when necessary.
Creativity: Comes up with a lot of new and unique ideas; easily makes connections among previously unrelated notions; tends to be seen as original and value-added in brainstorming settings.
Customer Focus: Is dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal and external customers; gets first-hand customer information and uses it for improvements in products and services; acts with customers in mind; establishes and maintains effective relationships with customers and gains their trust and respect.
Dealing with Ambiguity: Can effectively cope with change; can shift gears comfortably; can decide and act without having the total picture; isn’t upset when things are up in the air; doesn’t have to finish things before moving on; can comfortably handle risk and uncertainty.
Drive for Results: Can be counted on to exceed goals successfully; is constantly and consistently one of the top performers; very bottom-line oriented; steadfastly pushes self and others for results.
Interpersonal Savvy: Relates well to all kinds of people, up, down, and sideways, inside and outside the organization; builds appropriate rapport; builds constructive and effective relationships; uses diplomacy and tact; can diffuse even high-tension situations comfortably.
Learning on the Fly: Learns quickly when facing new problems; a relentless and versatile learner; open to change; analyzes both successes and failures for clues to improvement; experiments and will try anything to find solutions; enjoys the challenge of unfamiliar tasks; quickly grasps the essence and the underlying structure of anything.

Our Competencies for All People Managers
Strategic Agility: Sees ahead clearly; can anticipate future consequences and trends accurately; has broad knowledge and perspective; is future oriented; can articulately paint credible pictures and visions of possibilities and likelihoods; can create competitive and breakthrough strategies and plans.
Developing Direct Reports and Others: Provides challenging and stretching tasks and assignments; holds frequent development discussions; is aware of each person's career goals; constructs compelling development plans and executes them; pushes people to accept developmental moves; will take on those who need help and further development; cooperates with the developmental system in the organization; is a people builder.
Building Effective Teams: Blends people into teams when needed; creates strong morale and spirit in their team; shares wins and successes; fosters open dialogue; lets people finish and be responsible for their work; defines success in terms of the whole team; creates a feeling of belonging in the team.

ValviranJulkiterhikki-rekisteröintiä, tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa, tartuntatautilain 55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä kaikilta, jotka täyttävät THL:n riskikriteerit. Tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteen vammaisten ja lasten kanssa työskentelyä varten.

Tiimiesihenkilö Tanja Hartikainen
tanja.hartikainen@mehilainen.fi

Saamme asioita aikaiseksi toimivassa työympäristössä, jossa tukena on osaavia ja välittäviä työkavereita. Kasvamme ja kehitymme yhdessä. title: Senior Windows & Cloud Engineer
description:
Senior Windows & Cloud Engineer

When you join Atlanticus, you become a member of a fast-growing, mission-focused company that is committed to aid in meeting the financial needs of middle-class Americans. With a culture of collaboration and a one-team mindset, we encourage entrepreneurial thinking to empower our customers toward financial well-being.

Atlanticus™ technology enables bank, retail, and healthcare partners to offer more inclusive financial services to everyday Americans through the use of proprietary analytics. We apply the experience gained and infrastructure built from servicing over 20 million customers and over $40 billion in consumer loans over more than 25 years of operating history to support lenders that originate a range of consumer loan products. These products include retail and healthcare, private label credit and general-purpose credit cards marketed through our omnichannel platform, including retail point-of-sale, healthcare point-of-care, direct mail solicitation, digital marketing, and partnerships with third parties. Additionally, through our Auto Finance subsidiary, Atlanticus serves the individual needs of automotive dealers and automotive non-prime financial organizations with multiple financing and service programs.

Office Locations available for this role include

  • Austin, TX – Situated in The Domain, a vibrant tech hub with park-like surroundings, top restaurants, and convenient parking, perfect for post-work socializing.
  • Wilmington, DE – Near the Riverfront, offering rich history, dining, entertainment, and shopping. With direct access to I-95, Amtrak, and SEPTA, employees enjoy flexible living options.
  • Atlanta, GA – Located in the Queen Building (King & Queen Towers, Sandy Springs), with easy access to I-285, GA-400, and a free shuttle to MARTA.

Work Culture

We foster a collaborative, innovative environment where everyone contributes to building something meaningful. You’ll be empowered to lead, grow, and make an impact.

The Role

Atlanticus is seeking a motivated Windows Systems Administrator to join our Infrastructure & Operations team. This role is responsible for supporting and maintaining the organization's Windows server infrastructure, Active Directory, Microsoft 365 environment, endpoint management platform, and enterprise desktop environment.

The ideal candidate has 4–7 years of experience supporting Microsoft technologies and enjoys solving technical challenges while providing outstanding customer service. This position will work closely with the Help Desk, Infrastructure, and Security teams to ensure a reliable, secure, and well-managed IT environment. The role also serves as a Tier 2/Tier 3 escalation point for complex desktop and infrastructure issues.

Key Responsibilities

Windows Server Administration

  • Administer and maintain Windows Server environments, including routine maintenance, performance monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Perform server patching, upgrades, and health checks to ensure system reliability and security.
  • Support server backup, recovery, and disaster recovery activities.
  • Monitor server performance and resolve infrastructure-related issues.

Active Directory Administration

  • Administer Active Directory users, groups, organizational units, and Group Policy.
  • Support identity lifecycle activities, including user provisioning, deprovisioning, and access management.
  • Troubleshoot authentication, Group Policy, DNS, and Active Directory-related issues.
  • Maintain Active Directory security and operational best practices.

Microsoft 365 Administration

  • Support Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Troubleshoot user access, licensing, email, collaboration, and authentication issues.
  • Assist with Microsoft 365 administration and ongoing platform maintenance.

Endpoint Management

  • Manage Windows endpoint devices using Microsoft Intune.
  • Support device enrollment, compliance policies, software deployment, and endpoint configuration.
  • Assist with Windows imaging, provisioning, and lifecycle management of laptops and desktops.
  • Support enterprise endpoint security standards and device compliance.

Patch Management

  • Plan and execute Windows Server and endpoint patching activities.
  • Deploy Windows updates using Microsoft Intune and/or WSUS.
  • Manage third-party application patching using enterprise tools such as ManageEngine Endpoint Central, NinjaOne, Action1, or similar platforms.
  • Monitor patch compliance and remediate failed deployments.

User Support

  • Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 technical support for Windows infrastructure and endpoint-related issues.
  • Escalate and resolve complex incidents from the Help Desk.
  • Support hardware, operating systems, Microsoft applications, printers, VPN, and peripheral devices.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation and knowledge base articles.

Deliver exceptional customer service while building strong relationships with internal business users

title: Mission Staff for Northern Colorado
description:
If you are currently on Young Life staff, please do not apply through this external jobs board. To apply for internal job opportunities, log in to Workday and use the Jobs Hub. Applying externally may delay your application and require you to resubmit internally.

Young Life requires all​ employees to sign a Statement of Faith. We recommend you read this statement before applying​ for any position.

Because of Young Life’s exclusive Christian purposes of evangelism and discipleship as set forth in its Articles of Incorporation and in these Bylaws, and to reflect what has always been and will continue to be the position of Young Life, specifically the Christian belief that each and every employee and volunteer of the corporation should minister as a servant of God with the primary responsibility of proclaiming the gospel of Jesus Christ and, as such, is an integral part of the Christian mission and ministry of the corporation,
Young Life shall only employ individuals or enlist volunteer leaders who: (a) profess a belief in Jesus Christ as their personal Savior and Lord; and (b) subscribe to the statements and policies required of all Young Life staff, including the Young Life Statement of Faith. Therefore, employees and volunteers of Young Life, during working and nonworking hours, shall: (i) be ready, willing and able to fulfill such ministry functions as may be required by the organization; (ii) refrain from conduct and statements that detract from the biblical standards taught and supported by Young Life, and (iii) abide by all policies and practices of Young Life including, without limitation, those related to religious belief or ministry activities.

Mission Staff

Summary:
Mission / AuthorityThrough both training and direct field ministry experience, learn how to lead and participate in effective Young Life ministry.


Ministry Functions:
Spiritual Development — “Following Jesus” includes prayer and spiritual disciplines, fellowship, growth and health and church relationships.
  • Develop a yearly personal growth plan that fosters a vibrant spiritual life including time for solitude, retreat, reflection, prayer and a sincere commitment to understanding God’s Word.

  • Seek and maintain relationships and disciplines, in the context of active participation in a church community.

  • Actively participate in the spiritual life of the Young Life community.

  • Lead teams and individuals in spiritual development.


    • Leadership Development — “Equipping leaders, committee and staff” includes key volunteer care, recruiting, team building and training, supervision and vision casting.
  • Meet with your volunteer leaders and area leadership on a regular basis.

  • Learn to recruit and train new leaders to build a leadership team that reflects the community.

  • Model excellence in contact work, club, Campaigners and camping to other leaders.

  • Assist in training leaders, team leaders and committee how to work effectively in teams and develop a yearly ministry strategy.

    • Resource Development — “Fueling the ministry” includes events, major donor care, public relations (branding) and TDS team.
  • Raise financial support as directed and maintain good donor care practices.

  • Communicate ministry updates and progress to personal donor partners.

  • Observe and learn to network and develop strategic relationships with key adults in the community, including: principals, pastors, parents, potential committee members as assigned by the area director.

  • Assist with camp fundraisers.


    • Direct Ministry — “Proclaiming and modeling” includes contact work, club, Campaigners and camp.
  • Actively engage in all three levels of contact work.

  • Lead a team to plan and conduct a new or existing Young Life club and Campaigners/discipleship ministry with excellence.

  • Lead a team to implement a summer and school-season camping strategy for a ministry.

  • Serve on a summer assignment at a Young Life camp each year.


    • Ministry Support — “Taking care of business” includes accounting, administration, communication (internal), data management and strategic plan.
  • Adhere to all Young Life policies and procedures and maintain professionalism concerning office hours, dress, conduct and time management.

  • Manage finances with stewardship, accountability and transparency using the mission-wide applications.

  • Maintain accurate information on kids, leaders and donors for area records.

  • Provide clear, prompt, appropriate and professional communication to everyone involved in ministry.

  • Set yearly strategic ministry plan and initiatives to reach every kid; review them on a regular basis.

  • Perform other duties as assigned and congruent with gifts, experience and area needs.



    • Training:
    Missionwide Training
  • None is required.

title: Part-Time Recreation Program Leader
description:
Our team is highly skilled, passionate about our community, and we care. Let’s grow together.


Who We Are

In Whitby, we are dedicated to our work, our community, and each other. We work hard, we have fun, and we celebrate our successes.

The Town of Whitby is a community in transformation that is located in the heart of Durham Region in the eastern Greater Toronto Area. Whitby is the second-largest municipality in the region and one of the fastest-growing communities in Canada. Located on Lake Ontario and only an hour east of Toronto, the population of Whitby is expected to grow from 140,000 to more than 200,000 by 2031. Whitby’s Official Plan has been updated to establish new directions for Whitby’s planned growth and development; the protection of our natural and built environments; urban design intensification; sustainability; community improvement; and, new employment within this time frame.

The Town of Whitby combines a small town atmosphere with the sophistication and amenities of a larger urban centre. Whitby boasts two beautiful heritage downtowns, one of the finest recreational harbours with an award-winning marina, year round sports and recreation activities, parks, trails, and a robust arts and culture scene, all of which are part of the extraordinary amenities that Whitby residents enjoy every day.

Whitby has an exciting and aspiring future, with a community that is welcoming, growing and transforming. On our team, you can expect to make a difference through your work and have a direct impact on shaping our growing community. Creating an inclusive environment where employees experience job satisfaction and have rewarding careers is important to us. We live our values and foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, respect and engagement where people enjoy coming to work.

The Town of Whitby is a hybrid organization. This means staff are empowered to do their best work from various locations, as appropriate for the position.

We want to be the preferred employer for the most talented people who care about the Town of Whitby, and are excited and proud to serve our vibrant community.

Let’s grow together.

What You Will Get To Do

The successful candidate will have a positive impact on our corporate culture by demonstrating the Town’s CARE core values (Collaborative, Accountable, Respectful, Engaged) through daily interactions with individuals at all levels of the organization, external contacts and elected officials.

By effectively building positive rapport and relationships both internally and externally, the successful candidate will help us achieve our mission that together we deliver services that make a difference in our community.

Reporting to the Supervisor, Recreation & Community Programs , the Part-Time Recreation Program Leader is responsible for planning, preparing and instructing youth and children programs and special events to ensure participants are provided with enjoyable, safe and quality programs/events, including:

  • instructing and supervising participants at drop-in programs, and recreation programs;

  • developing youth programs by planning seminars, theme nights and special events;

  • promoting child and youth programs and youth memberships;

  • attending staff training sessions;

  • responding to participant interests, goals, needs and questions regarding child and youth issues; and,

  • other duties as may be assigned.

Who You Are

You are committed to creating an inclusive and safe space for all. You will bring a passion for working with children and youth. You are committed to working in a socially inclusive environment, responding with sensitivity to diverse needs. You will have well-developed interpersonal and relationship building skills with the ability to establish rapport, work cooperatively and communicate effectively with staff, children, youth, parents/guardians and community partners.

What You Bring To Our Team

  • a minimum Grade 12 education;

  • Recreation programing, Childhood Development and Youth Leadership Training;

  • a minimum of six (6) months of directly related experience;

  • current certification in Emergency First Aid and CPR ‘C’ with AED;

  • strong research skills to be able to develop the programs and keep up with trends in the field;

  • the ability to coordinate activities and motivate children and youth participants and volunteers;

  • the physical ability to participate in set up and instruct activities;

  • effective demonstrated conflict resolution, reasoning and analytical skills; and,

  • a demonstrated intermediate level working knowledge of technical equipment and computers, including Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook); and

  • a valid police criminal record check to work with the vulnerable sector.

What We Offer You

  • the opportunity to gain independence and develop leadership skills as you find your place in our recreation community

title: Automotive Alignment Technicians
description:
Mavis Tires & Brakes at Discount Prices - Automotive Alignment Technicians


Put your career into high gear with Mavis Tires & Brakes at Discount Prices! We're looking for a full-time Automotive Alignment Technicians to join Team Mavis at one of our state-of-the-art automotive service, repair and tire sales centers in the Wappingers Falls, NY area. With over 2,000 retail locations, Mavis is one of the largest tire sales and automotive repair chains in the United States.

About the Position of Automotive Alignment Technician

Automotive Alignment technicians use the latest equipment to align newly-mounted tires and wheels on customer's vehicles. By measuring and adjusting caster, camber, toe and thrust angles, our Automotive Alignment Technicians reduce customer's tire wear and ensure serviced vehicles travel straight and true. Mavis's Alignment Technicians also complete state-mandated inspections, oil and filter changes and flat repairs, and perform any other required automotive service or vehicle repairs to customer vehicles.

Employee Benefits

At Mavis, we understand that our people drive our success. We provide our team members with competitive weekly pay, including weekly incentive compensation, a good working environment and an excellent combination of additional benefits like health, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer match, paid vacations, paid time off, paid holidays, life insurance, on-the-job training, and opportunities for career growth and advancement.

Qualifications

We recruit team members who share our commitment to providing complete customer satisfaction and delivering the highest quality service. To be eligible for the position of Automotive Alignment Technicians you must (1) be at least 18 years of age; (2) be legally authorized to work in the United States; and (3) possess 1 year of experience and/or training in dismounting, mounting, rotating and balancing tires or any combination of education, training and experience which demonstrates the ability to perform the duties and responsibilities of the position. In addition, it is preferred that Alignment Technicians possess a state inspection license.

As an active position, Automotive Alignment Technicians are required to stand, walk, bend, kneel, stoop, crouch, crawl, climb, pull, reach and perform repeated and repetitive movements consistent with vehicle and tire maintenance and repair. Alignment Technicians must regularly lift and/or move items weighing over 50 pounds.

title: AI-Driven Creative Producer
description:
Where we are right now: we already generate ad videos, gameplay clips, blog articles, and static ads automatically out of all our videos, comics, and games. What we need is more creative input: new trending formats and marketing messages that AI can't just automate its way into.

The skill that matters most here is knowing exactly what AI can and can't do to produce at mass. You use it to turn out ad assets in volume, and you know its frontier: where AI can't yet make a high-quality ad format, you step in and take on the manual steps it takes to get there.

Tasks

  • Generate statics, videos, and playable HTML ads with AI.
  • Work with the User Acquisition Manager to figure out which parts of our product actually convince someone to download the app.
  • Brief and steer UGC creators and partners, from the brief through to material that is genuinely usable.
  • Efficiency counts. We need a high volume of variants every week, so use AI to turn ideas around fast and only go in manually where it actually matters.

Requirements

  • You know the frontier of what AI can and can't produce at volume, and you can step in manually to create the high-quality ad formats it can't.
  • You have produced performance creatives for paid app campaigns and know why a hook works in the first two seconds.
  • You can adjust video and images quickly and precisely in CapCut or a comparable editor.
  • You have hands-on experience with image and video generation

Nice to have
