title: Cybersecurity Policy & Governance Specialist
description:
Cybersecurity Policy & Governance Specialist (Task 5 – Policy & Governance, Federal Cybersecurity Contract)

Location: Hybrid (Washington, D.C. Metro Area)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Clearance: Public Trust (or eligibility to obtain)

We are seeking an experienced Cybersecurity Policy & Governance Specialist to support Task 5 – Policy and Governance on a federal cybersecurity services contract. This role owns the development, review, and approval of cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, and SOPs supporting enterprise cybersecurity operations.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience authoring federal cybersecurity policy and governance documentation, is comfortable independently researching complex regulatory requirements, and is proactive by nature, someone who tracks documents through review, follows up with stakeholders without being asked, and keeps multiple concurrent efforts moving to closure.

Key Responsibilities

* Author, refine, and maintain cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, SOPs, and governance documentation from initial draft through final approval.

* Research and analyze federal cybersecurity laws, regulations, executive orders, NIST publications, and agency guidance to develop well-supported policy recommendations.

* Translate complex technical and regulatory requirements into clear, actionable guidance for technical and non-technical audiences.

* Proactively identify, contact, and follow up with SMEs, ISSOs, system owners, and technical stakeholders to keep documents moving through review.

* Track outstanding reviews and inputs and escalate unresponsive stakeholders or review delays before they impact schedule.

* Build and maintain a Gantt chart or sprint-based schedule to plan, track, and brief on documentation milestones.

* Prepare and deliver weekly status reports and monthly KPI/metrics reporting to program leadership, with on-demand reporting as requested.

* Support Risk Management Framework (RMF), Ongoing Authorization (OA), High Value Asset (HVA), and Continuous Monitoring documentation.

* Support cybersecurity assessments, audits, and compliance activities, including documentation tied to open audit findings.

* Coordinate document reviews, adjudicate stakeholder feedback, and maintain document repositories and version control.

* Support the Policy & Governance Change Control Board (CCB), including preparation of meeting minutes and maintenance of change control logs.

Required Qualifications

* 5+ years of experience supporting federal government cybersecurity programs.

* Demonstrated experience developing cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, SOPs, or governance documentation , and driving them through to final approval, not just drafting.

* Strong knowledge of NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF), NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), FISMA, and OMB guidance.

* Demonstrated track record of proactively managing stakeholders - following up on and escalating reviews rather than waiting for responses.

* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint Online, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).

* Ability to build and maintain a Gantt chart or sprint-based schedule to plan and track documentation milestones.

* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to work directly with government leadership and cross-functional technical teams.

* Eligibility to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.

* Working knowledge of Section 508 accessibility requirements as applied to policy and governance documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience supporting federal civilian cybersecurity programs (HHS, DHS, DOJ, or similar).

* Experience supporting Authorization to Operate (ATO) or Ongoing Authorization (OA) activities.

* Experience supporting High Value Asset (HVA) programs or enterprise policy/governance offices.

* Experience supporting cybersecurity audits or assessments, including closing longstanding findings.

* Familiarity with Microsoft Lists, Power Automate, Power Apps, Planner, or Visio.

* Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, Security+, CAP, or PMP.

Work Schedule & Expectations

* Core hours: standard business hours, Monday through Friday, EST.

* Hybrid schedule; onsite presence required periodically, particularly during onboarding, knowledge transfer, and key program working sessions.

* Remote work permitted with reliable connectivity.

* Writing samples (policies, standards, or SOPs - sanitized as needed) will be requested as part of the interview process.

title: Inventory Coordinator
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

To maintain a high level of inventory accuracy and integrity within the sales facility. Manage inventory on site by overseeing cycle counts, receipts, adjustments, audits, and reconciliation.

SPECIFIC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITES:

  • Monitoring and controlling inventory integrity
  • Process and reconcile weekly cycle counts and update the cycle count log
  • Weekly monitoring and controlling the in-transit inventory
    • Coordinate with shipping to verify incoming shipments are accurate
  • Enter orders from manufacturing to support sales team and maintain min max levels 2-3 times weekly
  • Prepare outbound shipments for redistribution
  • Reconcile discrepancies between physical inventory and inventory records by investigating/identifying root cause
  • Generate and analyze inventory reports, usage and turnover rates
    • Slow moving, excess inventory
    • Areas that can utilize excess inventory
  • Ensure that the warehouse has a product identification and location program
  • Oversee adjustments of all types (scrap, goodwill, warranty, waste, return to vendor, inventory adjustment) and ensure that they are captured in the correct general ledger
  • Oversee the inventory control functions at each assigned facility
  • Responsible for performing inventory audits every year on the hub warehouse and truck warehouses if applicable and report findings to the Supply Chain Manager
  • Oversee open purchase orders and maintaining accurate receipts at each assigned facility weekly
  • Send weekly valuations, open sales orders, and open purchase order reports to staff at each facility
  • Coordinate efforts across sales, accounting and purchasing to enhance inventory accuracy
  • Initiate, recommend, or provide solutions through appropriate channels
  • Work with district managers on upcoming forecasts and demand to keep inventory levels and min max levels maintained
  • Maintain a +/- 2% yearly variance of the total warehouse value
  • Other duties as assigned

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

  • Must have a bachelor’s degree or at least 5 years’ experience working with inventory systems
  • Must be proficient with Microsoft Word, Excel (familiar with using formulas, VLOOKUP, pivot tables), and Outlook
  • Must be able to lift 50lbs as a part of the job function
  • Must be able to pass a forklift certification test and drive a forklift daily if needed

title: Stylist
description:
We consider applications for this position on an ongoing basis.

OVERVIEW

Experience a perfect blend of deliberate purpose and clear-eyed vision. At Ulta Beauty, some of the industry’s most highly-esteemed beauty leaders share themselves, as well as their expertise. Building authentic community. Creating a real sense of belonging—even as they’re plotting a bold, strategic course of exciting innovations destined to revolutionize the industry.

Think robust organizational support. Ever-increasing levels of investment. And a healthy dose of personal empowerment and growth opportunity. All with a company of unwavering strength and stability.

We are the future of beauty services. Be part of the transformation.

GENERAL SUMMARY & SCOPE

The Stylist is responsible for engaging with guests, consulting with them on their hair care needs and recommending products and services. The Stylist delivers quality professional services with an emphasis on the guest’s total look. They support the Experience Manager (EM) and the Assistant Services Manager (ASM) through a focus on performance (service sales, and productivity), people (guest service), and process (operating procedures and compliance standards). This position requires a passion for the beauty industry, exceptional guest service, and the aptitude to learn and communicate product knowledge.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES (*Essential Functions)

The Stylist is a champion of Ulta Beauty’s mission, vision, and values, and should demonstrate them skillfully and consistently by performing the following duties and responsibilities of the position (as well as all other projects/duties as assigned):

Performance

  • Perform hair services including hair design, haircuts, color, texture, hair treatments, styling, updos, perms, blowouts, keratin treatments, extensions, makeup applications, and ear piercing (where applicable).
  • Meet or exceed sales goal of $800 average weekly sales and productivity goals for hair services by delivering exceptional guest service and contribute to meeting or exceeding the store’s goals related to retail and service sales, guest loyalty (including credit), and retail shrink as set by Ulta Beauty.
  • Demonstrate business acumen with understanding of business drivers and identified opportunities for growth.
  • Perform product demonstrations with guests to drive sales and the guest service experience.
  • Support the execution of in-store events, promotions, and marketing-initiatives that deliver an unrivaled guest experience.
  • Take the initiative to stay informed regarding new and existing industry trends, products, and services during work time, and be knowledgeable about the ingredients and benefits of these trends, products, and services to better serve guests.
  • Maintain prompt, regular attendance.

People

  • Develop guest relationships through consultations and appropriate retail and service recommendations.
  • Demonstrate high standards of customer service and salon image standards.
  • Serve all guests, including walk-in guests, in a timely and efficient manner.
  • Develop a partnership with skin therapists and the retail team to provide a total-store and well- rounded guest experience.
  • Establish professional peer and brand partner relationships that foster a shared interest in collaboratively delivering exceptional guest service.
  • Share the benefits of the guest loyalty program, including credit and the Ulta Beauty app, with guests in the salon and on the salesfloor.
  • Attend mandatory trainings and meetings to enable continuous professional development.

Process

  • Be knowledgeable of and ensure compliance with Ulta Beauty policies, procedures, and standards.
  • Follow all safety, sanitation, and infection control procedures before, during, and after services; always ensure compliance with state board guidelines.
  • Follow established service protocols to ensure a consistent and exceptional guest experience.
  • Utilize appropriate booking and clientele systems to book guests for return services and for events.
  • Communicate any supply needs to the EM, ensuring guest readiness at all times.
  • Maintain outstanding store operational standards, including cleanliness of the salon, salesfloor, restrooms, backroom, break area, and any additional assigned area.
  • Adhere to the Ulta Beauty dress code.
  • Protect company assets by following loss prevention best practices and providing exceptional guest service.
  • Execute other operational tasks as directed.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • Cosmetology license

Experience

  • Previous relevant salon experience is preferred.

Skills

  • Proficiency with latest salon techniques for performing haircutting, haircolor, lightening, styling, texture, treatment, extensions, makeup, and ear piercing services (where applicable) and/or an aptitude to develop skills and capabilities in all service categories.
  • Proficiency with use of equipment and chemicals needed to perform technical work
  • Proficiency to demonstrate, recommend and sell pro hair care and makeup products
  • Developed communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships, and build clientele

SPECIAL POSITION REQUIREMENTS

  • Work a flexible schedule to include days, evenings, weekends, and holidays

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Continuous lifting and/or moving up to 10 lbs. during shift
  • Frequent stooping, kneeling, bending, reaching, twisting, and crouching during shift

title: Head Lifeguard
description:
Do you have eagle eyes, a calm-under-pressure mindset, and the ability to make safety look cool? We’re looking for a Head Lifeguard who’s ready to lead the deck, support a team, and help create a safe, welcoming space for every member of our community.

Why This Role Matters
At the YMCA, you’re not just watching the water—you’re helping people feel confident, safe, and connected. As Head Lifeguard, you’ll lead by example and make a real impact every single day.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and support a team of lifeguards with energy and accountability
  • Ensure a safe aquatic environment for all swimmers
  • Jump into action when needed (yes, literally)
  • Help train, coach, and mentor staff
  • Keep the pool deck positive, professional, and fun

You Bring

  • Current lifeguard certification (American Red Cross or equivalent)
  • Strong leadership and communication skills
  • The ability to stay cool—even when things heat up
  • A team-first attitude and commitment to safety

Perks

  • Free YMCA membership
  • Leadership development opportunities
  • A workplace where you can truly make a difference
  • A team that feels like family

POSITION SUMMARY

The Head Guard, working as part of the Aquatics team, will deliver world-class customer service and relationship building skills to create a welcoming environment at the YMCA. The Head Guard will be responsible for assisting the Aquatic Manager/Director with daily operations of the aquatic department along with guarding the pool and assuring a safe and clean aquatic environment for members and guests. The incumbent will also exhibit the core values of caring, honesty, respect and responsibility in all aspects of their work with the YMCA.

OUR PATH

For 150 years, the YMCA of Metro Denver has been more than a place - it is a movement that lifts spirit, mind and body for all. Our direction is clear: Elevate Lives and Rise Together. Grounded by our mission and strengthened by the global YMCA movement we will elevate our people, purpose, partnerships and promise.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Provide on-deck supervision and leadership to ensure a safe and well-managed aquatics environment
  • Enforce all YMCA aquatics policies, procedures, and safety standards
  • Perform lifeguarding duties including scanning, recognizing hazards, and responding to emergencies
  • Lead by example in maintaining vigilance, professionalism, and engagement
  • Assist in training new lifeguards and facilitating in-service trainings
  • Monitor and adjust staff coverage, rotations, and positioning as needed
  • Complete incident reports and communicate effectively with leadership regarding safety concerns
  • Maintain cleanliness and organization of the pool deck and equipment areas
  • Build positive, respectful relationships with members, participants, and staff

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Primarily performed in an indoor and/or outdoor aquatics facility
  • Environment includes warm, humid, and high-noise conditions during peak hours

description:
Etsimme innostunutta ja monitaitoista kokkia liittymään tiimiimme Laitilassa!
Jos nautit monipuolisista työtehtävistä ja viihdyt myös keittiön ulkopuolella asiakaspalvelussa, tämä on tilaisuutesi.

St1 Laitila sijaitsee vilkkaan 8-tien varrelle. Asema on suosittu taukopaikka ja tarjoaa asiakkailleen palvelua ympäri vuorokauden. Lounasaikaan ja viikonloppuisin asiakkaita on mukavasti ruokailemassa.

title: Crisis Services Night Supervisor
company: JEFFERSON BLOUNT ST CLAIR MENTAL HEALTH AUTHORITY
description:
Crisis Services Night Supervisor

JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Crisis Care Center is designed to provide crisis stabilization to individuals experiencing a behavioral health and/or substance use crisis and reduce pressure on local emergency departments. Once the crisis has been resolved and the individual has been stabilized, they will be linked with a community mental health provider for on-going services. This position is a responsible for general supervision of the overnight operation of the Crisis Care Center including training, EMR and basic IT assistance, incident reporting and safety under the direction of the Crisis Care Center Director and Management Team.

This position requires knowledge of program operations, ADMH standards and agency policies and procedures. Organizational skills are essential to ensure the smooth and continuous workflow including documentation responsibilities as well as clinical services throughout the Crisis Care Center. Work requires initiative and independence in the handling of delegated administrative duties. This employee is responsible for the ongoing monitoring of compliance with the ADMH standards and the QA process for consumer chart and documentation. This position assists the management team with planning, operation, performance improvement and accountability of the Crisis Care Center. The individual hired will assist the Crisis Care Center Director and Management Team with clinical and administrative duties and actively participates in a supervisor role to assist with overnight operations and the Crisis Care Center workflow.

Reports To: Crisis Care Center Director

Employees Supervised: Under the direction of the Crisis Care Center Director and Management Team- Staff working the overnight shift

Shift: Overnight hours (11:00 PM - 7:30 AM) with occasional weekend coverage based on operational needs

PRIMARY JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Participate in the planning, coordination, scheduling, and oversight of overnight Crisis Care Center operations
  • Perform clinical and administrative tasks including data collection, tracking and analysis systems to ensure key performance measures are met, creating reports, completing state reports, as needed and required to maintain effective night operations and service delivery at the crisis care center
  • Provide the Crisis Care Center Director and others the necessary data and reports to measure effectiveness and efficiency including submitting agency and Therap Incident reports to ADMH
  • Serve as the primary overnight operational resource by responding to and resolving routine facility, technology, and system-related issues, including EMR, fire alarm, and basic IT concerns.
  • Provide real-time support to staff, coordinate with internal and external resources as needed, and notify the Director or appropriate management personnel of incidents requiring additional oversight or intervention.
  • Responsible for the storage, protection and accountability of client records and information
  • Responsible for maintaining the center’s compliance with standards established by JBS, the Alabama Department of Mental Health, Medicaid agency and any other entities that have oversight responsibility for the Crisis Care Center
  • Review and evaluate staffing levels, acuity, available personnel and adjust overnight assignments as authorized by the Crisis Care Center Director/Management Team that aid in ensuring CCCC workflow is maximized and consistent with effective service delivery
  • Provide overnight on-site supervision during law enforcement and EMS drop-offs, supporting providers and staff in evaluating and accepting referrals in accordance with Crisis Care Center guidelines and admission criteria
  • Strengthen partnerships with law enforcement and EMS agencies during night shift through ongoing communication, education, and collaboration to support access to appropriate behavioral health care
  • Responsible for training Crisis Care Center new hires, ongoing trainings (i.e., CPR/First Aid, Therapeutic Options, Incident Reporting and Crisis Care Center specific trainings).
  • Identify issues/solutions to resolve safety concerns at the Crisis Care Center (i.e., consumers, staff, visitors, vendors etc.) and provide recommendations and reports as needed.
  • Coordinate of ongoing care with emergency departments, hospitals, community health/mental health providers
  • Assist all departmental staff at the crisis care center with completing all crisis care center services when needed including delegating responsibilities to staff as required
  • Assist with front desk when needed by answering the phone, complete point of entry in Avatar to ensure accurate processing of individuals receiving services, review/audit charts, and discharge recipients from Avatar as needed to improve workflow and increase bed capacity
  • Facilitate all required drills (i.e., fire, weather etc.) and inspections per JBS and ADMH guidelines
  • Attend daily shift change meetings with crisis care center staff to review census, acuity, safety concerns, admissions, discharges, and staffing needs to support continuous, high-quality crisis services
  • Provides direct services as needed or required
  • Other duties as assigned

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in human services, or bachelor’s degree in any field accompanied by a minimum of 2 years of experience in serious mental illness, substance use and or crisis services required, 3 years preferred working in the field of mental health supporting service providers
  • Experience with electronic health record entry and maintenance
  • Valid Alabama driver’s license and driving record acceptable to agency automobile insurance carrier for inclusion on agency policy.
  • Certification as a Therapeutic Options Trainer to support activities of the Crisis Care Center preferred

PREFERRED But Not Required

  • Master’s degree in a human services field (Psychology, Counseling, Social Work, Marriage and Family Therapy, Agency Counseling) with five (5) years post graduate experience in mental health preferred
  • Substantial experience working with serious mental illness and substance use populations
  • Supervisory experience and or experience in operational management
  • ALC, LMSW, LCSW, LMFT or LPC

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS and ABILITIES:

  • Demonstrable knowledge of sound mental health practices and procedures
  • Ability to implement and monitor policies, procedures, and program objectives
  • Experience in medical/social service records and computerized data storage and organization
  • Extensive knowledge of both ADMH and Medicaid standards for supported documentation and billing requirements involved with the provision of client services
  • Knowledge of local resources for care and services
  • Demonstrable communication skills - both written and oral
  • Strong interpersonal skills, ability to easily adjust to changing demands and priorities with composure and professionalism
  • Ability to work cooperatively within the Crisis Care Center staff and with other JBS programs and agencies
  • Demonstrable organizational/time management/teaching/supervisory skills
  • Ability to organize, coordinate and manage the activities of the Crisis Care Center program operations

Luke’s Lobster is a Maine-inspired, fast-casual lobster shack known for its award-winning seafood rolls. Our seafood is traceable to its source, sustainably caught and processed by our own team to our own high standards.

Duties & Responsibilities

We offer delicious, high-quality seafood that our guests love. To make that happen you’ll be-

  • Preparing and serving a simple, seafood-centric menu (there’s no cooking but some minor food prep)
  • Engaging in friendly guest interaction
  • Taking orders and recommending products at the register
  • Performing opening and closing duties, including cleaning and setting up for shifts
  • Utilizing your exceptional attention to detail, safety, cleanliness and organization
  • Communicating Luke's mission of serving sustainable, traceable seafood (We’re a certified B-Corp!)
  • What does that mean? Check it out here: https://www.bcorporation.net/community/lukes-lobster

Qualifications

  • Preparing and serving a simple, seafood-centric menu (there’s no cooking but some minor food prep)
  • Engaged guest interaction and frequent table-touches
  • Taking orders, recommending products, and creative merchandising at the register
  • Opening and closing duties including cleaning (sweeping, mopping, light dishes, setting up for AM/PM shift)

  • Communicating Luke's mission of serving sustainable, traceable seafood
  • Opening and closing the shack as a key-holder
  • Overseeing a small team of 2-3 during your shift a
  • Cash handling, tip distribution

The Luke's Lobster Story

Luke’s Lobster was born out of the dream of Maine native and third-generation lobsterman, Luke Holden, to bring the quality lobster rolls of his youth to the big city. He and business partner, Ben Conniff, opened their first lobster shack in NYC’s East Village in October 2009. Now, almost 15 years later, Luke’s Lobster brings traceable, sustainable seafood to guests across the globe. We work directly with fishermen to hand pick the best seafood, bring it straight to our own seafood company in Saco, ME and then ship directly to our shacks, grocery partners, and consumers. From the dock to our guests, we’ve cut out the middleman. This means higher quality, better tasting seafood for you to enjoy and a fairer price for our fishermen. We know our fishermen, we know where and how they fish, and we work together to protect our oceans for tomorrow.

We are proud and passionate about the work environment we have fostered and are excited to see it continue to grow. We value diversity, creativity, transparency and open communication from all levels. Please visit www.lukeslobster.com for more inform

location: Boca Raton Branch - Boca Raton, FL 33432
description:
Entry level position at City Electric Supply in Waterford MI. This position can turn into a career. Many employees have been here for decades.

Job will mainly be delivering electrical materials to jobsites and picking up material from other stores. When not delivering, there will be work in the warehouse putting away stock, and general building maintenance. title: COLLEGE SAFETY AND SEC OFFICER
description:
Washington County Community College is seeking a dedicated and professional Campus Security Officer to join our team. The officer is responsible for maintaining a safe and secure environment for students, faculty, staff, and visitors by patrolling campus buildings and grounds, monitoring security systems, securing facilities, completing daily activity reports and incident reports as needed. Duties also include conducting inspections and monthly audits of campus facilities, promoting crime prevention and safety awareness through training and after-hours escorts, and coordinating with local police and fire authorities when necessary. The officer responds to violations, investigates complaints and disturbances, de-escalates conflicts, and responds to critical incidents. Additional responsibilities include assisting with security at special events, serving as liaison for SafetyWorks and OSHA inspections, and actively participating in the College Safety Committee. The regular schedule is M-F 2:30pm-11:30pm and the position requires flexibility to work varied shifts, including evenings and weekends, as required.

Salary & Benefits

This position is classified within the MSEA bargaining unit at Range 12, with an anticipated hourly rate ranging from $20.53 to $22.25, based on qualifications and relevant experience. Washington County Community College offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package, including employer-paid health and dental insurance, with optional vision and life insurance coverage available for employees, spouses, domestic partners, and eligible dependents. Additional benefits include participation in the Maine Public Employees Retirement System (MainePERS), a Sick Leave Bank, professional development opportunities, childcare expense assistance, and tuition benefits through the Maine Community College System for employees and eligible dependents. Employees also enjoy a generous paid leave package that includes 13 paid holidays, 15 vacation days annually (with additional vacation earned based on years of service), and 12 paid sick days each year.

Työtä tehdään arkisin. Palkkaus sopimuksen, sekä oman osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan.
Jos tunnistit itsesi kuvauksesta, lähetä hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi mahdollisimman pian. Täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.
Lisätiedot:Emilia Pudas-Mattila, emilia.pudas@henkilostotasiantuntijat.fi
"Suomen Henkilöstöasiantuntijat on keskisuomalainen henkilöstöpalvelualan toimija. Palveluihimme kuuluvat rekrytointiratkaisut, henkilöstövuokraus sekä työllistämisen asiantuntijapalvelut.

Olemme reilu ja omista työntekijöistämme huolehtiva henkilöstöpalveluyritys. Työterveyden ja lakisääteisten vakuutusten lisäksi olet meidän kauttamme vakuutettu myös vapaa-ajalla. Maksamme sinulle aina vähintään työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan lomarahoineen ja mahdollisine sairaspäivärahoineen. Työntekijämme ovat vakuutettuja Ifissä ja työterveys hoituu Mehiläisen kautta.

Voit tehdä meillä töitä keikkaluontaisesti, määräaikaisesti tai vakituisesti. Rekrytointitoimeksiantojemme kautta voit työllistyä myös suoraan asiakasyrityksiimme. Meillä et ole vain passiivisesti listoilla, vaan kartoitamme aktiivisesti sinulle sopivia työmahdollisuuksia puolestasi. Haemme jatkuvasti uusia eri alan osaajia, joilla on osaamista ja halua tehdä töitä. Tule meille töihin!"

title: Industrial Engineer
description:
Why should you join our success story?

Based on patented technology developed at MIT, Harvard Medical School and by the Company, Myomo develops and markets the MyoPro® product line of lightweight, non-invasive, powered arm braces (orthoses) to restore function in paralyzed or weakened arms and hands of individuals that have suffered a stroke, spinal cord, or nerve injury. (E.g. brachial plexus injury or other neuro-muscular disabilities.) It is the only device that, sensing a patient’s own neurological signals through non-invasive wearable sensors, can restore the ability to use their arms and hands so that they can live independently, increase their quality of life, reduce cost of care, and return to work. Published clinical research shows a clinically significant instantaneous reduction in upper extremity impairment with the MyoPro. Our technology has been referred by leading-edge rehabilitation facilities including Mayo Clinic, Kennedy Krieger Institute, Cleveland Clinic, Loma Linda Medical Center, Massachusetts General Hospital, numerous VA Hospitals, and more. Myomo is headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts, with sales and clinical professionals across the U.S.

What we’re looking for:

The Industrial Engineer is responsible for improving manufacturing operations through the application of
industrial engineering principles, Lean manufacturing methodologies, and data-driven decision making. This role focuses on optimizing manufacturing processes, labor utilization, material flow, production capacity, and facility layout to improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost. The Industrial Engineer works cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Engineering, and Operations to identify improvement opportunities, implement sustainable solutions, and support operational excellence in a regulated medical device manufacturing environment.

Keys to success include curiosity, initiative, and a drive to unlock better systems and workflows, ultimately supporting optimal performance. Our ideal candidate is deeply positive, process-minded, and highly detailed, viewing this role as a vehicle to continually foster a culture of excellence.
Manufacturing Process Improvement:
  • Analyze manufacturing processes to improve productivity, quality, safety, and efficiency.
  • Conduct time studies, work measurement, and labor utilization analyses to establish standard
    work and optimize staffing levels.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean Manufacturing principles, including Value
    Stream Mapping, 5S, Standard Work, Visual Management, Kanban, and Kaizen events.
  • Identify and eliminate waste while improving workflow, throughput, and manufacturing
    performance.
  • Develop and monitor key manufacturing metrics to drive operational improvements.
Production & Capacity Planning:
  • Evaluate production capacity and develop recommendations to support changing production demands.
  • Perform line balancing and workflow optimization to maximize labor and equipment utilization.
  • Analyze bottlenecks and recommend improvements to increase throughput.
  • Support facility layout planning and material flow improvements.
  • Develop labor standards and assist Operations with production planning.
Manufacturing Support:
  • Partner with Manufacturing Engineering to improve existing manufacturing processes and support new product introductions.
  • Support root cause investigations and implement corrective actions using structured problem-
    solving methodologies.
  • Collaborate with Quality to implement and verify CAPA activities.
  • Identify and lead cost reduction initiatives through process optimization and waste elimination.
  • Evaluate equipment, tooling, fixtures, and automation opportunities to improve operational
    efficiency.
Data Analysis:
  • Collect, analyze, and present manufacturing performance data.
  • Develop dashboards and reports tracking productivity, labor efficiency, OEE, scrap, cycle time, and throughput.
  • Perform statistical analyses to identify trends and quantify improvement opportunities.
  • Present recommendations to leadership using data-driven analyses.
Documentation & Compliance:
  • Develop and maintain manufacturing documentation, including standard work, process maps, work instructions, labor standards, and workflow diagrams.
  • Support process validation activities as required.
  • Ensure compliance with FDA Quality System Regulations (21 CFR Part 820), ISO 13485, and internal quality procedures.
  • Participate in internal and external audits.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
  • Work closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and Operations to achieve production objectives.
  • Train manufacturing personnel on standardized work and Lean methodologies.
  • Participate in cross-functional improvement teams supporting strategic initiatives.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement throughout the organization.
  • Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering or related engineering discipline.
  • 2–5 years of experience in manufacturing, industrial engineering, or operations engineering.
  • Experience with Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Experience conducting time studies, labor analysis, line balancing, and workflow optimization.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and data analysis tools.
  • Experience developing manufacturing KPIs and performance metrics.
  • Familiarity with root cause analysis techniques (5 Whys, Fishbone, A3, 8D).
  • Excellent communication and project management skills.
Preferred:
  • Experience in medical device or other regulated manufacturing environments.
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.
  • Experience with MES systems (Tulip preferred).
  • Familiarity with process validation (IQ/OQ/PQ).
  • Knowledge of statistical process control (SPC).
  • Experience with facility layout planning and material flow analysis.
  • Experience using Power BI, Minitab, SQL, or Python for data analysis.

title: Quarry Operative
description:
About Breedon Group:
Breedon Group plc is a leading vertically integrated construction materials group in Great Britain, Ireland, and the USA. We're dedicated to providing high-quality materials and services for the construction industry, with a commitment to safety, sustainability, and innovation. Joining Breedon means becoming part of a team that values excellence and is committed to making a positive impact.

Position Overview:
We are looking for a reliable and hardworking Quarry Operative to join our team working across the West Coast of Scotland.

In this role, you will be based in a quarry environment, with the majority of your duties focused on operating a loading shovel. You’ll be responsible for the safe and efficient loading, movement, and handling of aggregates and materials to support production targets. You will also carry out general quarry operative duties as required.

The role involves working day and night shifts, often across multiple sites, so flexibility and a strong work ethic are essential. You will be expected to operate heavy plant machinery safely, complete routine checks and basic maintenance, and always follow strict health, safety, and environmental procedures.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys practical outdoor work, operating heavy machinery, and being part of a busy, safety-focused team within the quarrying industry across the West Coast of Scotland.

  • Operate mobile and fixed plant (e.g. dump trucks, loading shovels, crushers, screeners) in a safe and efficient manner
  • Assist in the extraction, crushing, and processing of raw materials
  • Carry out routine checks, cleaning, and basic maintenance on machinery and equipment
  • Load and unload materials safely for transport or further processing
  • Follow daily work schedules and production instructions from supervisors
  • Conduct regular safety checks and report any hazards, defects, or incidents
  • Ensure compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations at all times
  • Keep the quarry site clean, safe, and organised
  • Assist with site inspections and support operational audits as required
  • Work flexibly across different roles and tasks depending on site needs.
Essential
  • Competence in operating plant or machinery (e.g. loading shovel, excavator, dumper truck) – CPCS or MPQC card advantageous
  • Basic mechanical knowledge and ability to perform simple maintenance tasks
  • Understanding of health and safety practices and willingness to follow procedures
  • Good communication and teamwork skills
  • Safety-focused with a responsible attitude
  • Willing to work outdoors in all weather conditions
  • Reliable, punctual, and self-motivated
  • Flexible and able to adapt to different tasks and shift patterns
Desirable
  • Previous experience in quarrying, construction, mining, or similar heavy industry
  • MPQC or NVQ Level 2 in Extractives Operations
  • First Aid or health & safety training (e.g. IOSH Working Safely)
  • A tailored, competitive salary
  • Company Pension Scheme
  • 33 days annual leave, inclusive of bank holidays
  • Share Saver Scheme participation
  • Company Life Assurance Scheme
  • Access to our Employee Assistance Programme for health and wellbeing support
  • Discounts on a wide range of products through our employee benefits platform
  • Broad learning opportunities and career progression pathways.
Diversity Statement:
At Breedon Group, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diversity is valued. We believe in equality of opportunity for all and encourage applications from a diverse range of candidates.

Join Us:
If you're looking for a role that challenges you, offers progression, and contributes to building better futures, we'd love to hear from you. This position is an opportunity to grow your career within a supportive and dynamic environment at Breedon Group.
Application Process:
Ready to make a meaningful difference? Apply now by submitting your CV and cover letter. We look forward to considering your application and potentially welcoming you to our team.

title: Ohjaaja/sosionomi lastensuojeluyksikköön Anjalaan/Elo Familar Oy
description:
Haluatko työskennellä innostavassa työyhteisössä, jossa työtä tehdään suurella sydämellä? Jos vastasit kyllä, saatat olla uusi tiimimme jäsen!

Haemme sosionomia (AMK) ohjaajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen lastensuojeluyksikköömme Familar Saviston koti OyAnjala/Elo.

Familar Saviston Koti tuottaa lastensuojelun sijaishuoltoa mielenterveyden haasteita erilaisilla riippuvuuksilla oireileville 13-17-vuotiaille nuorille. Meillä toiminnan viitekehyksenä ovat voimavara- ja ratkaisukeskeisyys sekä traumasensitiivinen lähestymistapa ja työympäristö. Arkemme rakentuu aikuisjohtoisen arjen ympärille ja toiminnassamme korostuvat omaohjaajatyö, perhetyö ja lasten kanssa yhdessä oleminen ja tekeminen. Haluamme tiimiimme ammattilaista, joka oikeasti haluaa työskennellä nuorten kanssa ja joka kohtaa nuoret empaattisesti ja ymmärtää heidän elämäntarinan tuoman oireilun.

Haemme sosionomi AMK tutkinnon omaavaa ammattilaista ohjaajaksi vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Anjalan/Elon toimintayksikköön.

Vaatimuksemme:
Koulutustaustasi sosionomi AMK korkeakoulututkinto.

Lisäkoulutusta tutkinnon ulkopuolelta sinulla tulee olla vähintään 5 op mielenterveys- ja /tai päihdetyöstä, traumasensitiivisyydestä, perhetyöstä tai nepsy-osaamista tai tämän suorittaminen työsuhteen alettua. Kaikki kokemus lastensuojelutyöstä ja mielenterveys- ja päihdetyöstä katsotaan eduksi.
-hygieniapassi
-Ea

Tarjoamme
kattavat ja monipuoliset täydennyskoulutukset sekä koulutus- ja kehitysmyönteisyyden

ammatillisen kasvun mahdollisuudet kehittyvän ja vakavaraisen työnantajan palveluksessa

toimialan nykyaikaisimmat työvälineet ja mahdollisuuden arvioida työn tuloksia ja vaikuttavuutta

liikuntasetelit, työterveyshuollon ja Mehiläisen digiklinikan palvelut 24/7

yhteistyöverkostomme kautta kattavasti henkilöstöetuja ja -alennuksia erilaisista tuotteista ja palveluista

palkkaus yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:n mukaisesti


Ohjaajana meillä toimit osana moniammatillista työryhmää oman koulutusalasi näkökulmasta luotettavana omaohjaajana ja kasvatusvastuullisena aikuisena yhteistyössä lapsen vanhempien ja muun verkoston kanssa. Mikäli sinulla on osaamista lastensuojelu- tai mielenterveys- ja päihdetyöstä, lisäämme ison plussan nimesi perään. Joukkueessamme viihtyy oma-aloitteinen ja huumorintajuinen tiimipelaaja. Työ on kolmivuorotyötä.

Tehtävään valittavien on esitettävä lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämistä koskevan lain (505/2002) edellyttämä rikosrekisteriote.

Familarin visiona on olla suomalaisen lastensuojelun edelläkävijä. Työllistämme 1500 alan ammattilaista, jotka rakentavat parempaa tulevaisuutta joka päivä edistämällä lasten ja perheiden hyvinvointia yhdessä heidän kanssaan. Teemme uraauurtavaa työtä lastensuojelupalveluiden vaikuttavuuden ja asiakaskokemuksen mittaamisessa sekä tuottamiemme palveluiden laadun jatkuvassa arvioinnissa ja kehityksessä. Tuotamme monipuolisia, lasten ja perheiden erilaisiin ja yksilöllisiin tarpeisiin vastaavia lastensuojelun avo- ja sijaishuollon palveluita ympäri maata.

title: Information Security Officer
description:
Jouw energie in de plus

Als information security officer bij Stedin zorg jij dat onze informatie veilig blijft en de energietransitie nooit stilvalt.

Waarom werken bij Stedin jou energie oplevert:

  • Inhoud die ertoe doet: je vertaalt beleid naar praktijk, standaardiseert IAM processen en maakt Stedin digitaal veiliger.

  • Een salaris tot € 8.500,89 bruto per maand (bij 40 uur) én een persoonlijk budget van 24% om zelf te kiezen: extra salaris of (tot max. 35,5) verlofdagen.

  • Werken bij Cyber Corporate Security in het team Beleid en Processen, standplaats Rotterdam (Blaak): korte lijnen, veel kennisdeling en samenwerken met zo’n 60 security collega’s.

Werk om trots op te zijn

Als information security officer zorg je dat de informatiebeveiliging binnen Stedin op orde is. Je draagt verantwoordelijkheid voor een businessafdeling en meerdere beleidsstukken, waarbij jouw expertise direct impact heeft op onze cybersecurity. In nauwe samenwerking met collega’s van corporate cybersecurity en stakeholders in de business - van technical security experts tot securitycoördinatoren en awareness specialisten - versterk je continu ons informatiebeveiligingsbeleid. Je begeleidt de implementatie, houdt toezicht op naleving en voert risicobeoordelingen uit.


Een dag als information security officer:

  • Met je eerste kop koffie stem je prioriteiten af en bespreek je lopende processen met een MT-lid van jouw businessafdeling.

  • Je haalt feedback op bij collega’s, analyseert processen en stuurt bij waar dat nodig is.

  • Je adviseert in verandertrajecten en doet voorstellen om security- en IAM-processen verder te standaardiseren, bijvoorbeeld om te voldoen aan de CBW. Rond 12 uur schuif je aan bij collega's op de 18e verdieping voor de lunch met een fantastisch uitzicht of maak je een wandeling door het centrum van Rotterdam.

  • Je vertaalt verbeteringen naar concreet beleid en werkt de bijbehorende procesaanpassingen uit.

  • Aan het einde van de dag leg je vast welke verbeteringen worden opgepakt, onder andere binnen ons afwijkingen- en exceptieproces. Daarna klap je je laptop dicht en loop je zo naar station Blaak, op weg naar huis, de sportschool of een gezellige avond in de stad

Hier laad jij van op

Alle financiële arbeidsvoorwaarden op een rij, weet je meteen waar je aan toe bent:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de € 6.07862 en maximaal € 8.500,89 (bij 40 uur) afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring, 24,5 vakantiedagen en pensioenopbouw bij ABP waarbij wij 70% van de premie betalen.

  • Bovenop je salaris ontvang je een persoonlijk budget van 24% (incl. 8% vakantiegeld). Jij kiest: extra salaris of extra verlofdagen. In onze rekentool zie je hoe het werkt.

  • Jaarlijks € 700,- (bruto) om te besteden aan je eigen energie, bijvoorbeeld voor je sportabonnement of je nieuwe sportkleding.

Daar komt dit nog bovenop:

  • Moderne thuiswerkfaciliteiten en een thuiswerkvergoeding van € 2,40 per dag. Bij Stedin werken we 50% thuis en 50% op kantoor.

  • Reizen naar kantoor doe je met de ov vrijregeling (ook privé te gebruiken). Of met de flexibele reisregeling, inclusief extra vergoeding als je met de fiets komt.

  • Jouw ontwikkeling staat centraal: events met collega’s, kennissessies, trainingen en opleidingen. Zo haal jij het beste uit jezelf.

Vol energie vooruit met team Corporate Cybersecurity

In team Corporate Cybersecurity stap je binnen in een hechte club van zo’n 60 specialisten die elke dag werken aan de digitale veiligheid van Stedin. De sfeer is open en gedreven: collega’s zoeken elkaar op, delen actief kennis en pakken complexe security en IAM vraagstukken samen op. Midden in Rotterdam, op loopafstand van station Blaak, werk je in een omgeving waar professionaliteit en samenwerking hand in hand gaan en waar jouw expertise direct impact heeft.

Met deze kwaliteiten groei jij hier verder

Je beweegt moeiteloos tussen strategie en uitvoering. Met jouw helikopterview zie je verbanden, houd je overzicht en verlies je de grote lijnen niet uit het oog. Je schakelt makkelijk met verschillende stakeholders, brengt complexe vraagstukken helder terug tot de kern en vertaalt inzichten naar concreet beleid. title: Trainee Reporter
description:
Newsquest Scotland is seeking an ambitious trainee reporter to join our team based in Dunfermline.

Since 1859, the Dunfermline Press has been setting the news agenda in West Fife. An opportunity has now arisen for a dedicated reporter to join the company’s flagship Fife title and also contribute to the continued success of its sister titles, the Central Fife Times and the Alloa Advertiser.

title: Salesforce Technical Lead
description:
Job Description

As Salesforce Technical Lead within the Agilent IT Team, you will be part of a high-performance global team chartered to deliver secure, scalable, and enterprise-wide Salesforce solutions. In this role, you will partner with Sales, Marketing, Services, and IT organizations to design, develop, configure, integrate, monitor, and support Salesforce capabilities across Sales Cloud, Experience Cloud, Data Cloud, CRM Analytics, Salesforce AI, and related platforms. You will also work closely with enterprise architecture, infrastructure, security, and observability teams to ensure Salesforce solutions are reliable, well-governed, and aligned with Agilent’s business and technology roadmap.

Job Description

The Salesforce.com Senior Developer will be responsible for designing, developing, configuring, securing, monitoring, and supporting enterprise Salesforce solutions that meet business requirements and enable reliable, scalable, and well-governed business processes. Specific responsibilities are:

  • Lead requirement gathering sessions with business stakeholders, architects, product owners, and solution teams to define requirements and present scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Design, develop, configure, test, and deploy Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce, Flows, validation rules, security models, and other Salesforce platform capabilities.
  • Provide deep technical expertise in Salesforce configuration, customization, automation, integration, data model design, and platform services to support enterprise CRM processes.
  • Design and maintain Salesforce security and access control models, including profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing rules, record-level access, field-level security, and access governance.
  • Drive technical design sessions, create technical design documents, and guide solution decisions that balance scalability, performance, security, maintainability, and business value.
  • Establish and support end-to-end Salesforce monitoring, alerting, logging, and incident response practices to improve production stability and operational visibility.
  • Enable enterprise observability for Salesforce using Splunk or similar platforms, including log ingestion, dashboards, alerts, error tracking, and operational insights.
  • Develop and support Salesforce Data Cloud, CRM Analytics, and Salesforce AI capabilities to enable data-driven insights, automation, productivity improvements, and business decision-making.
  • Design and develop integrations between Salesforce and enterprise systems using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, event-based integrations, and standard Salesforce integration patterns.
  • Implement and enhance Salesforce solutions for CRM and PRM business processes integrated with SAP CRM, ECC, SAP CPQ, Marketing Cloud, and other enterprise platforms.
  • Manage Salesforce DevOps and release management practices using GitHub, Gearset, CI/CD pipelines, environment management, testing, deployment governance, and production readiness controls.
  • Stay current with Salesforce platform innovations and partner with product experts to evaluate new capabilities, demonstrate practical use cases, and contribute to Agilent’s Salesforce roadmap.

Qualifications

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of strong hands-on Salesforce experience, including implementation, development, configuration, customization, integration, and production support in enterprise environments.
  • Strong Salesforce development experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce, SOQL/SOSL, Flows, triggers, batch jobs, asynchronous processing, and Salesforce platform services.
  • Strong Salesforce configuration expertise, including objects, fields, page layouts, record types, validation rules, approval processes, automation, reports, dashboards, and business process setup.
  • Deep experience with Salesforce security setup and access control, including profiles, permission sets, permission set groups, roles, sharing rules, organization-wide defaults, field-level security, record access, and access troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating end-to-end monitoring, alerting, logging, and incident management processes for Salesforce production environments.
  • Experience enabling enterprise observability for Salesforce using Splunk or similar tools, including dashboards, alerts, log analysis, error tracking, trend analysis, and production support insights.
  • Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, including data model setup, identity resolution concepts, segmentation, activation, and integration with broader Salesforce and enterprise data platforms.
  • Experience with CRM Analytics, including datasets, dashboards, reporting, insights, and analytics use cases that support business decision-making.
  • Experience applying Salesforce AI capabilities, including Einstein features, automation, predictive insights, and productivity improvements for business users.
  • Understanding and working knowledge of integrating Salesforce with third-party and enterprise systems using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, events, connectors, Data Loader, or other integration patterns.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD, DevOps, and Salesforce deployment strategies, including GitHub-based source control, Gearset, environment management, automated validation, release governance, and production change control.
  • Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer II, Administrator, Platform App Builder, Sales Cloud Consultant, Data Cloud Consultant, CRM Analytics, or Application/System Architect are preferred; equivalent hands-on experience will also be considered.
  • Ability to multi-task, handle high-pressure production situations, troubleshoot complex issues, and make effective decisions with appropriate risk awareness.

Additional Details

This job has a full time weekly schedule.

title: Ljusoperatör med hantverks focus
description:
Ljusoperatör med hantverks focus

Vi på Skånska Stearinljusfabriken i Ängelholm har tillverkat ljus av högsta kvalitet sedan 1951. Med stolta hantverkstraditioner och lång erfarenhet skapar vi produkter som uppskattas av kunder över hela landet. Sedan 2024 är vi en del av Liljeholmens Stearinfabriks AB.

I vår fabrik i Skåne arbetar ett litet och engagerat team på fem personer där alla bidrar för att produktionen ska fungera smidigt. Nu söker vi en Ljusoperatör med hantverks focus.

Om tjänsten

Som ljusstöpare arbetar du praktiskt i vår produktion med tillverkning av stearinljus i äldre maskiner där känsla, noggrannhet och hantverk står i fokus.

Arbetsuppgifterna består bland annat av:

  • Stöpning och hantverksmässig tillverkning av stearinljus enligt traditionella metoder. Arbetet innefattar hela processen från förberedelse av stearinet som innan de pumpas ut i maskinerna till övervakning av själva stöpningen och färdigställande av ljusen.
  • Produktionen sker i äldre maskiner där många arbetsmomenten utförs manuellt och arbetet är fysiskt krävande med flera tunga moment dagligen. Det är därför viktigt att du trivs med praktiskt arbete och har god fysik. Arbetet kräver även noggrannhet, tålamod och förståelse för tillverkningsprocessen för att säkerställa hög kvalitet på varje ljus. I arbetet ingår också att kontrollera att ljusen håller rätt form, yta och kvalitet enligt våra krav.

· Arbetet är praktiskt och stundtals mycket fysiskt krävande. Våra maskiner är äldre och kräver löpande tillsyn och underhåll, vilket gör att det är mycket viktigt att du har ett mekaniskt sinne och tycker om att förstå hur maskiner fungerar. När problem uppstår behöver du kunna felsöka, tänka praktiskt och i många fall själv kunna åtgärda mekaniska fel för att hålla produktionen igång.


· I produktionen är flera maskiner igång samtidigt under hela arbetsdagen, vilket kräver att du kan arbeta metodiskt, behålla överblicken och vara uppmärksam på flera processer samtidigt. Det är viktigt att du snabbt kan upptäcka om något behöver justeras eller åtgärdas för att produktionen ska flyta på utan avbrott.

Vi söker dig som

  • Har ett stort praktiskt och mekaniskt intresse
  • Har god fysik och trivs med fysiskt arbete
  • Är noggrann och kvalitetsmedveten
  • Kan arbeta strukturerat och behålla överblicken i ett högt arbetstempo
  • Har god arbetsmoral och kan arbeta självständigt
  • Har lätt för att samarbeta

Erfarenhet från produktion, verkstad, mekaniskt arbete eller industrimiljö är ett krav. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlighet, ansvarskänsla och viljan att lära sig yrket.

Vi erbjuder

· En central roll i ett engagerat team

· Stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att påverka ditt arbete

· En familjär arbetsmiljö i en fabrik med stolta traditioner

Your delivery approach contributes to informed decision-making, effective portfolio controls and the successful delivery of strategic objectives, establishing and maintaining a culture of operational excellence and high quality client service.

Through your performance you are a trusted advisor and key interface for portfolio delivery teams and senior client stakeholders. Help shape, embed and communicate portfolio direction. Lead and be a key part of driving success and cohesion across delivery activities in line with our behaviours.   • Portfolio Controls & Optimisation: Evaluate the current state of portfolios through gap analysis, creating a roadmap and effectively leading a team to deliver the optimised future state. Establish and embed portfolio management and control frameworks to ensure rigor, compliance, transparency, and continuous improvement.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Influence: Establish and maintain trusted relationships with senior leaders, clients and key stakeholders, building a reputation as a collaborative partner & advisor. Foster effective and strong partnerships and connecting diverse stakeholders behind a common vision and shared outcomes. Vi som bor, lever, verkar och besöker Årjängs kommun brukar säga att det är nära till allt som betyder något.

Nordmarkens skola ligger i södra delen av Årjängs tätort och är kommunens största skola. Det är en F-9-skola med cirka 700 elever och drygt 100 personal. Skolområdet inrymmer tre olika byggnader, var av två är relativt nybyggda. En för åk 1-6, en för åk 7-9 samt en för förskoleklass, fritidshem och förberedelseklass.

Högstadiet är kommunens enda högstadieskola med ca 330 elever i årskurserna 7-9. Skolan byggdes 2015 och varje elev har tillgång till egen dator. 1 plats(er).

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We are in the unique position to experience new and interesting situations that many companies have never seen before. We bake challenges by using agile methodologies, top line tools and of course always working with the best of teams.

This is a chance to be part of a rapidly growing team in a company that is changing the food delivery landscape, and be able to influence, execute and see the impact of your work on millions of users.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Engineering Department teams and help us deliver a seamless and personalized ordering experience for our users. We are a team of energetic, motivated and restless tech enthusiasts that take on the challenge of empowering our customers and internal users. We do that by providing them with the necessary intuitive technologies through creating a wide range of software solutions.

If you're a creative problem solver who is eager to deliver solutions and hungry for a new adventure, then challenge yourself by joining our #techteam and make an impact!

What you'll do:

  • Design and build new backend services and features, from initial implementation to production.

  • Own the full lifecycle of the software you work on, including design, testing, deployment and monitoring.

  • Work on systems that handle high traffic, up to thousand rps, terabyte-scale datasets, and learn how to design for reliability and scale.

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and DevOps to turn requirements into working, shippable software.

  • Contribute to a shared codebase by writing clear, tested code and improving existing solutions where needed.

  • Learn continuously by experimenting with new tools, frameworks, and design and architecture patterns.

  • University and/or Postgraduate Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or equivalent.

  • At least 7 years of working experience in microservices development.

  • Excellent knowledge on any mainstream programming language (such as Go, Java, Python, C++, C# etcr). Any relevant experience on Go, Node, or Python will be considered a plus.

  • Knowledge of relational and non-relational database systems (e.g. MongoDB, Redis, Postgres).

  • Familiarity with SOLID principles and software design patterns.

  • Experience consuming and developing REST APIs.

  • Excellent eye for detail and a self-motivated problem solver.

  • Superior analytical skills and a strong sense of urgency and ownership in your work.

  • Ability to get up to speed with new systems and concepts quickly.

  • Keen to constantly learn and improve your own skills, and not afraid to jump into new things.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills (Greek and English is a must).

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with at least one major cloud services provider (experience with AWS is a plus).

  • Experience working in an Agile team.

  • Involvement with open source projects is a plus.

  • We recognize good work and we want our people to feel appreciated! That’s why we offer an attractive remuneration package for what you bring in! 💰

  • We share a passion for food, so you will certainly appreciate the ticket restaurant card 💳 to spend in restaurants and/or food supplies. We are efooders after all!

  • We take care of you with Private Medical & Life Insurance from day #1 to keep you healthy and safe! 🍎

  • We prioritize your mental health 🧠 and offer round-the-clock access to an online mental health platform. You can schedule unlimited therapy sessions with certified psychologists and coaching sessions with experienced coaches.

  • We want you to grow with us 🚀 ! And to help you keep improving, we provide you access to our online training platform where you can study 📖 topics for your personal and professional growth!

  • Are you a cappuccino lover ☕? Do you desperately want a cookie? Our inhouse cafeteria got you covered!

  • If you want to stay in shape 🏋️ , our in-house gym awaits you fully equipped!

  • We are passionate about exploring, growing & learning and our Global Mobility plan is created to help our people find their purpose around the world! 🌎

  • Saving for the future? We’ve got your back! Our Pension Plan helps you invest in tomorrow while you enjoy today! 💼

  • Free efood pro Subscription: Perks of the job! Enjoy a complimentary efood pro subscription for free deliveries and exclusive discounts on your favorite meals and groceries. 🍔

  • We support your growing family and we offer a childcare allowance for each individual child 🍼

Life @efood:

At efood, no day is the same as the day before!

At efood, we constantly have chances to raise the bar improving, innovating, and challenging ourselves to grow! 🏔️
We take ownership of what we do, embracing challenges, and making things happen! ✔️
We move with pace to deliver value fast, which keeps us ahead, always balancing speed with quality! 🚀
We stay humble ❤️ as we grow and dive deep🔍 in situations, asking questions & exploring beyond the surface to get the best solutions!
We bring good vibes by lifting each other up, focusing on what’s possible, and being the kind of teammate everyone wants on their side! 🙏


We’re a fast-growing, dynamic team where every efooder has the opportunity to shine, grow, and be part of something exciting.

Hungry enough to join us?

At efood, your success is defined by both results and behaviors. We hire for excellence in craft and for the Leadership Principles that shape how we think, decide, and collaborate. What you achieve matters and how you achieve it defines us. Together, they move the business forward and deliver great experiences. Learn more about our Leadership Principles here.

title: Lärare åk 4-6 SV/SO till Bällstabergsskolan (vikariat läsår 2026/2027)
description:
Har du mod att gå före och skapa ett Vallentuna där människor och idéer växer? Vill du vara med och skapa en undervisning där svenska och SO blir spännande, begripligt och meningsfullt? Då ska du söka till oss.

Vallentuna kommun har mod att gå före. Vår ambition är att ligga i framkant när det gäller innovativa lösningar, smarta arbetssätt och en effektiv organisation. Som medarbetare har du en viktig roll i utvecklingsarbetet. Kommunen som arbetsplats präglas av ett samförstånd mellan politik och verksamhet, där det gemensamma intresset och ansvaret för Vallentunas bästa lyser igenom. Bemötande, tillgänglighet och kundens fokus är viktigt i vårt arbete för goda resultat och ökad kvalitet.

Engagemang, samarbete och allas lika värde ska genomsyra vår organisation. Du som söker bör självklart dela våra gemensamma värderingar.

Om verksamheten:

Bällstabergsskolan är en tvåparallellig F–9-skola i södra Vallentuna med närhet till Roslagsbanan. Det är en trygg och välfungerande skola där både elever och personal trivs. Eleverna ges goda förutsättningar att utvecklas både kunskapsmässigt och socialt. Vår verksamhet präglas av engagerade och kompetenta lärare, fritidspersonal och elevhälsa som tillsammans arbetar för att varje elev ska nå sin fulla potential. Skolan har ändamålsenliga lokaler, och varje avdelning har en egen matsal, vilket skapar en lugn och trivsam miljö.

Arbetsuppgifter:

Vi söker en engagerad och legitimerad lärare med behörighet att undervisa i svenska och SO för årskurs 4–6, 80-100 procent. Har du behörighet i ytterligare ämnen ser vi det som meriterande. I tjänsten ingår även mentorskap för en klass på mellanstadiet samt undervisning i mindre grupper.

Som lärare hos oss planerar, genomför och utvecklar du undervisningen utifrån läroplanens mål och elevernas behov. Genom varierade och språk- och kunskapsutvecklande arbetssätt väcker du elevernas nyfikenhet för språk, samhällsfrågor, historia, religion och geografi. Du stimulerar elevernas läsförståelse, skrivutveckling och kommunikativa förmåga samt utvecklar deras kritiska tänkande och förståelse för omvärlden.

Du blir en del av ett engagerat arbetslag för årskurs 4–6 med kompetenta och erfarna kollegor. Vi värdesätter samarbete, kollegialt lärande och ett öppet arbetsklimat där vi tillsammans utvecklar undervisningen och skapar de bästa förutsättningarna för våra elevers lärande.

Du skapar en trygg, inkluderande och strukturerad lärmiljö med höga förväntningar på alla elever. Med ett tydligt pedagogiskt ledarskap bygger du goda relationer, anpassar undervisningen efter elevernas olika behov och inspirerar dem till nyfikenhet, motivation och lust att lära. Tillsammans med kollegor bidrar du aktivt till skolans fortsatta utveckling.

Kvalifikationer:

  • Legitimerad lärare med behörighet i SV/SO för åk 4-6.
  • God digital kompetens.
  • Du har goda kunskaper i svenska i både tal och skrift.
  • Meriterande med behörighet och erfarenhet av andra ämnen för åk 4-6.
  • Meriterande är erfarenhet av inkluderande undervisning och arbete med elever med NPF.

Personliga egenskaper:

  • Du arbetar mot resultat, visar pålitlighet och tar ansvar för planering och uppföljning av ditt arbete.
  • Du stärker relationer genom att du hjälper andra, samarbetar, följer regler och processer och delar information.
  • Du utvecklar, förbättrar, söker lösningar, lärande och kunskap på eget initiativ.
  • Du är länken, ger service, visar lojalitet utåt och inåt och omvärldsbevakar.
  • Gemensamma värderingar syns i ditt bemötande.

Information:

Som arbetsgivare vill vi tillvarata de kvaliteter som en jämn könsfördelning och kulturell mångfald tillför. Vallentuna kommun satsar på kompetensutveckling och ett hållbart arbetsliv. För att ha så goda förutsättningar som möjligt i din medarbetarroll har Vallentuna kommun en medarbetarakademi där du kommer att få utbildning och verktyg.

Anställningen är en visstidsanställning på heltid med start omgående. Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning och provanställning kan komma att tillämpas.

Alla som anställs för arbete med barn och ungdomar ska lämna ett registerutdrag ur polismyndighetens belastningsregister, e-tjänst för ansökan via digitalt utdrag eller blankett hittar du här; https://url11.mailanyone.net/scanner?m=1qR630-0008RL-60&d=4%7Cmail%2F365%2F1690960200%2F1qR630-0008RL-60%7Cin11c%7C57e1b682%7C13778492%7C10514287%7C64CA021A83FDB8A0B13554BFCEB22681&o=%2Fphto%3A%2Fptseelib.s%2Fsnnselsnigateire%3Ftrtgsp_mtiamamcaugn%26drg%3Dt%3D_mtowdpmk3260ts&s=tA9bKjUxw_DG02NtfEM9sc3rm5c

Inför all nyanställning utför Vallentuna kommun bakgrundskontroll.

För att kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsprocessen använder vi verktyget ReachMee. Vi ber dig att skicka in din ansökan genom att klicka på ansökningslänken i annonsen. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar/intresseanmälningar via e-post. Har du några frågor är du välkommen att kontakta oss enligt nedan.

Du är varmt välkommen att skicka din ansökan med ett personligt brev och CV senast 2026-08-14.

title: Deputy Director, Defense & Security Business Development
description:
CS Group Canada offers a unique opportunity to join a dynamic and fast-growing organization operating at the forefront of aerospace, defense, and advanced technologies.

As part of our expansion, we are looking at fulfilling a senior Business Development role to lead the go-to-market strategy, business development, and strategic positioning of our innovative Counter-Unmanned Aerial Systems (C-UAS) solution across Canada.

This role is both strategic and hands-on, ideal for someone who wants to build and expand a new market while engaging with high-level stakeholders in defense, security, and government ecosystems.

Key Responsibilities

Go-to-Market & Product Strategy

  • Define and execute the go-to-market strategy for CS Group - Canada Counter-UAS offering
  • Contribute to product positioning, value proposition, and competitive differentiation
  • Track relevant market data, intelligence, and trends.
  • Capture customer needs and analyze competitive landscape to refine strategy.
  • Support pricing strategy and commercial models (direct sales, partnerships, integrators)

Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem Development

  • Identify, develop, and manage strategic partnerships (OEMs, primes, system integrators, government stakeholders)
  • Build alliances to accelerate market access and product adoption
  • Represent CS Group – Canada in key defense and security ecosystems (Canada, NATO partners)

Customer Engagement & Thought Leadership

  • Establish and maintain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and decision-makers
  • Act as a subject-matter ambassador for CS Group - Canada C-UAS capabilities
  • Represent the company at industry events, trade shows (e.g., CANSEC, DEFSEC), and strategic forums

Sales Execution

  • Lead end-to-end sales & business development activities including prospecting, pipeline generation, client engagement, proposal development, and contract negotiation
  • Identify and secure new business opportunities across defense, homeland security, critical infrastructure, and government agencies
  • Develop and manage a robust sales funnel aligned with revenue targets
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in CRM tools and track sales KPIs.
  • Meet business growth targets set forth by the company.

Internal Collaboration

  • Work closely with engineering, product, and program teams to align customer needs with solution development
  • Support bid/no-bid decisions and contribute to winning proposals and RFP responses
  • Ensure alignment between business strategy and technical roadmap
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 5–10 years of experience in Business Development
  • Proven experience in selling complex systems or solutions in hi-techs industries
  • Demonstrated experience in building and executing go-to-market strategies
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities
  • Experience working with CRM tools and digital sales platforms
  • Fluency in English and French (mandatory)

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in Counter-UAS, radar, sensors, or electronic warfare
  • Business developing/selling experience in security, or defense, or aerospace, or mission-critical technologies.
  • Existing network within defense, public safety, or critical infrastructure sectors
  • Experience working with primes (e.g., Airbus, Thales, RTX, etc.) or government agencies
  • Familiarity with export control and regulatory environments (ITAR, CGP, etc.)

Please note that only selected candidates and Permanent Residents/Canadian Citizens will be contacted.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

CS Group Canada values ​​diversity in the workplace and encourages women, visible minorities, ethnic minorities, aboriginal people, and people with disabilities to apply.

Benefits:

  • Hybrid Work
  • Industry leading medical, dental, and vision Insurance
  • Access to a telemedicine service
  • RRSP program
  • Personal and sick days
  • Recreation room with pool table and foosball table

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
