title: Senior Network Security Engineer
description:
Who we are

At Billennium, we are a global technology company delivering innovative IT services and solutions for enterprises worldwide. With a strong focus on collaboration, continuous learning, and technological excellence, we empower our employees to grow their careers while contributing to impactful projects for leading international organizations.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Network Security Engineer (Edge Defense) to join the Network Security Product area supporting a global enterprise environment. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing perimeter and cloud security solutions, with a strong focus on Next-Generation Firewalls, Zero Trust Network Access, DDoS protection, and security automation. You will help shape the evolution of network security capabilities across hybrid and multi-cloud infrastructures while ensuring resilience against emerging cyber threats.

Your responsibilities

• Lead the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of Palo Alto and/or Fortinet NGFW environments with high-availability architectures.
• Design and implement Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solutions and support the transition from traditional VPNs.
• Engineer and manage network security controls across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments.
• Develop and optimize DDoS mitigation strategies and advanced threat prevention capabilities.
• Drive the full lifecycle of Edge Security solutions, from design and implementation to global rollout and continuous improvement.
• Act as a technical SME for complex network security incidents, troubleshooting and root cause analysis.
• Build monitoring, telemetry, and observability solutions to improve visibility into network security operations.
• Automate security infrastructure and policy management using Infrastructure as Code and orchestration tools.
• Develop APIs and self-service solutions that enable secure consumption of network security services.
• Participate in an on-call rotation supporting critical global security services.

Must have

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Software Engineering, or a related field.
• 5+ years of hands-on experience managing enterprise firewall environments.
• Strong expertise with Palo Alto and/or Fortinet Next-Generation Firewalls.
• Experience with SSL/TLS inspection, IPS/IDS, URL filtering, threat prevention, WildFire, GlobalProtect, and user identification technologies.
• Practical experience implementing network security controls in at least two major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP).
• Strong understanding of hybrid and multi-cloud networking concepts, including VPCs, VNETs, and Transit Gateways.
• Experience with security automation using Ansible, Terraform, Python, or similar tools.
• Knowledge of Zero Trust architectures, SASE frameworks, and modern remote access solutions.
• Strong troubleshooting, packet analysis, and network security investigation skills.
• Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across global teams.

Nice to have

• Experience with DDoS mitigation platforms such as Akamai, Cloudflare, or F5.
• Knowledge of Zscaler, Prisma Access, or other cloud-delivered security platforms.
• Experience in highly regulated industries such as Healthcare, Pharmaceuticals, or Financial Services.
• Familiarity with large-scale environments supporting thousands of diverse device types, including IoT and medical devices.
• Experience with Edge Computing and SASE architecture initiatives.
• Relevant industry certifications (PCNSE, NSE, CCNP Security, CISSP, CCSP, etc.).

What we offer

• Stable employment and long-term cooperation.
• Attractive salary and benefits package.
• Flexible working model (remote/hybrid/on-site depending on the project).
• Access to training platforms, certifications, and professional development opportunities.
• Participation in international and innovative technology projects.
• Friendly work environment focused on knowledge sharing and collaboration.
• Private healthcare and additional employee benefits.
• Opportunity to work with modern technologies and experienced specialists.

Recruitment process

• Initial HR screening.
• Client interview (if applicable).
• Final decision and offer presentation.
• Welcome aboard! 🚀

title: Software Engineer, S-ID
description:
Primary location:

HELSINKI

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join Loyalty’s S-ID squad. You will work as part of a modern software development team building digital services central to customer identity and access management for S Group Loyalty products and services. Your work will follow a hybrid model combining office and remote work depending on team practices and project needs.

About the job

Within the Loyalty domain, the S‑ID squad builds and operates customer identity and access management (CIAM) capabilities that enable secure, scalable and seamless authentication and authorization across user-facing services.

As a Software Engineer in the S‑ID squad, you will work hands-on in a product team developing and operating business-critical systems at the core of the customer experience. Your work directly impacts how millions of customers identify themselves and access S Group’s digital services.

In this role, you will design, build and maintain secure, high-availability services, while actively participating in product discovery, planning and continuous improvement together with product owners, designers and other engineers. You will take ownership of solutions end-to-end: from understanding the underlying business problem to delivering reliable production implementations and ensuring their long-term maintainability and performance.

You will solve challenges related to identity management, security, scalability, integrations and system reliability. The work combines applying established engineering practices with designing new solutions tailored to evolving business and customer needs.

You will collaborate closely with Product Owners, designers, engineers across SOK, and external technology platforms (e.g. cloud providers). The team operates with a strong product mindset and shared ownership culture, emphasizing collaboration, openness, and continuous learning.

We work in a hybrid model, combining remote work with regular on-site collaboration (typically 2–3 days per week).

What we’re looking for?

We are looking for a Software Engineer with solid experience in building and operating modern, cloud-based digital services, and a strong interest in developing secure and scalable customer-facing systems. You work well both independently and as part of a cross-functional team, across the full software development lifecycle, from discovery and design to implementation, deployment and continuous improvement. You have a strong product engineering mindset: you aim to understand the “why” behind requirements and make technical decisions that maximize customer and business value.

Core qualifications:

  • Several years of experience in software development, working with production systems and cloud environments
  • Strong hands-on experience with modern technologies such as React and TypeScript
  • Understanding of system design and architecture, with ability to contribute to technical decision-making to ensure scalability, security and reliability of services
  • Experience working in product teams and across the full development lifecycle (discovery to production)
  • Familiarity with modern development practices: testing (unit/integration/e2e), CI/CD, monitoring and observability
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, and ability to work with designers, product owners and other stakeholders

Additionally, we value:

  • Experience with AWS or other cloud platforms
  • Experience or interest in identity and access management (CIAM) or security-related systems
  • Interest in improving system reliability, performance and observability
  • Experience mentoring or supporting other engineers and contributing to team practices
  • Curiosity towards new technologies, including AI-assisted development tools

What we offer to you


In this role, you will have the opportunity to work on impactful digital services in one of Finland’s largest organizations, contributing directly to customer experience and business success through high-quality software development.

Also:

  • Great work is rewarded, and all our employees are included in a performance-based bonus system.

  • You will have access to Finland’s most extensive employee benefits, which means discounts on groceries, restaurants, hotels, electronics, cosmetics, rainwear, home appliances, or even car washing. You can read more about our benefits here: https://s-ryhma.fi/en/careers/why-work-for-s-group

  • The S Group is Finland’s largest private employer, so opportunities never run out. Our career paths are often long, sometimes winding, but always full of possibilities.

  • We are a safe, stable and Finnish cooperative group. Most of our tax revenue stays in the local area, as does the value generated through procurement and construction. The significant impact of SOK and the entire S Group brings meaningfulness to everyday work.

At S Group, we are committed to fostering a diverse and non-discriminatory working environment where the unique backgrounds, skills, and perspectives of all our employees are respected and valued.

Interested? We’ll be happy to hear from you!


Please send us your CV and an application highlighting your related skills by 23.6.2026 at the latest.

Our interview process is both respectful and comprehensive. You’ll meet our recruiter, hiring manager and some teammates. We’ll discuss technical things as well as softer skills, validating your technical expertise, and performing a suitability assessment. The aim is to ensure we can offer you what you are looking for and to make sure you’re the right person for the job. Despite the outcome, we strive to make the process a positive one.

#SOK #SOKDigitalTalent

title: Platform Engineer (Azure & Databricks)
description:
In Cyclad we work with top international IT companies in order to boost their potential in delivering outstanding, cutting-edge technologies that shape the world of the future. We are looking for an experienced Platform Engineer to join the DevOps team and support the delivery of a Revenue Growth Management pricing platform for the Austrian market, based on an existing UK and Ireland solution.

The role focuses on provisioning, securing, automating, and supporting Azure and Databricks infrastructure using Terraform, Bash, and Azure DevOps. The successful consultant will contribute to both project delivery and ongoing platform operations.

Project information:

  • Type of project: IT Services

  • Office location: Wrocław

  • Work model: 100% remote

  • Budget: 140 - 160 PLN net/ h - b2b

  • Only candidates with citizenship in the European Union and residence in Poland

  • Start date: ASAP

Project scope:

  • Provision and manage Azure data platform infrastructure using Terraform

  • Develop reusable Terraform modules and maintain secure remote state

  • Deploy and configure Azure Databricks workspaces and supporting Azure services

  • Administer Databricks compute, cluster policies, SQL warehouses, permissions, and Unity Catalog resources

  • Configure catalogues, schemas, volumes, storage credentials, and external locations

  • Implement Azure RBAC and Databricks access controls using Microsoft Entra ID groups, managed identities, and service principals

  • Configure secure Azure networking, including virtual networks, private endpoints, private DNS, routing, and firewall controls

  • Develop production-quality Bash scripts for provisioning, deployment, validation, and operational automation

  • Build and maintain multi-stage Azure DevOps YAML pipelines

  • Implement pipeline validation, security scanning, approvals, deployment controls, and rollback processes

  • Support platform onboarding and troubleshoot Azure, Databricks, networking, identity, storage, and CI/CD issues

  • Maintain operational documentation, runbooks, monitoring, governance, and cost-optimisation standards

  • Collaborate with platform, DevOps, data engineering, security, and architecture teams

Competence demands:

  • 5 or more years of experience in Azure, cloud, or platform engineering

  • At least 2 years of hands-on Azure Databricks experience

  • At least 2 years of production Terraform experience

  • Knowledge of: Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure Key Vault, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC and managed identities, Azure networking and private connectivity, Azure Monitor and Log Analytics

  • Practical Azure Databricks administration experience

  • Advanced Terraform skills, including reusable modules, provider management, remote state, imports, drift management, and automated validation

  • Bash proficiency for infrastructure and operational automation

  • Experience integrating Bash with Azure CLI, Databricks CLI, Terraform, and Azure DevOps

  • Knowledge of Bash error handling, input validation, logging, exit codes, secret handling, ShellCheck, and shfmt

  • Strong Azure DevOps experience

  • Ability to independently troubleshoot complex infrastructure, security, networking, deployment, and platform issues

  • Working knowledge of Python for automation, API integration, validation, and platform administration

  • Experience with Azure or Databricks Python SDKs and REST APIs

  • Experience with Databricks Asset Bundles

  • Knowledge of Bicep, Azure Policy, and policy as code

  • Experience with enterprise data platforms, analytics workloads, or pricing solutions

  • Knowledge of platform monitoring, observability, disaster recovery, and cost optimisation

  • Experience with PowerShell and additional automation tooling

  • Very good English skills

We offer:

  • Remote working model

  • Dynamic and innovation-driven engineering environment

  • Full-time job agreement based on b2b

  • Private medical care with dental care (covering 70% of costs)

  • Multisport card (also for an accompanying person)

title: Circle K Sköndal Nynäsvägen söker butikssäljare för nätter 66%
description:
Vart är du på väg?

Nu söker vi butikssäljare – ja, alltså riktiga servicehjältar!

Vi vill bli världsbäst på service. Och därför söker vi nu fler servicehjältar som vill jobba natt. Vad gör en sådan? Jo, du möter våra kunders behov nattetid med kunskap, fingertoppskänsla och ett härligt leende – ofta samtidigt som du kanske fyller på kaffemaskinen eller lägger upp en korv. För vi är en butikskedja som erbjuder allt från god mat och bakverk, till bra drivmedel och fräscha toaletter. Du blir en viktig lagspelare som håller stationen i toppskick när andra kanske sover!

Vi söker nu dig som vill jobba som butikssäljare under nätter hos oss på Circle K Sköndal Nynäsvägen. Tjänsten motsvarar 66% och är en tillsvidare med inledande provanställning på sex månader. I rollen har du ett fast schema där du jobbar nätter varannan vecka och är ledig varannan vecka. Tiderna för schemat varierar mellan 3 till 4 arbetspass den veckan du jobbar och du arbetar mellan 20:00 - 07:00 förutom på söndagar då tiderna är 21:00 - 07:00. På natten är det viktigt att man tar vara på tiden och förbereder för sina kollegor, därför tror vi att du som sökande har ett stort driv och kan arbeta självständigt eftersom ensamarbete förekommer. För att vara aktuell för tjänsten hos oss behöver du ha körkort. Som butikssäljare hos oss har du en månadslön som baseras på din tidigare erfarenhet inom service. Månadslönen vid heltidsarbete varierar mellan 27400-33065 kr/månad. Utöver din månadslön har du även OB-ersättning för arbete under kvällar, nätter, helger och röda dagar. Eftersom vi har en CV-lös och fördomsfri rekrytering behöver du styrka din tidigare erfarenhet genom att uppvisa arbetsgivarintyg under rekryteringsprocessen. För att söka tjänsten fyller du enkelt i dina uppgifter, anger vilka tider du kan arbeta och genomför därefter ett kort servicetest som tar cirka 10 minuter. Är du vår nya butikssäljare som gillar varierande arbetsuppgifter och trivs med att arbeta nattetid? Vi jobbar med löpande urval i rekryteringen så sök tjänsten omgående för att inte missa chansen!

Varmt välkommen in med din ansökan senast 21.08.2026

Om dig:

  • Du är en teamplayer – du sätter laget före jaget.
  • Du är en fixare – du hittar lösningar på allt.
  • Du älskar människor.
  • Du är en allkonstnär: Du gillar att ha koll på allt, och tycker om att göra många saker samtidigt.
  • Du vill lära dig nya saker och utvecklas.
  • Du känner att din samlade erfarenhet gör dig redo att testa på att jobba natt inom service.
  • Du pratar och förstår svenska.
  • Du är över 18 år.

Om oss:

  • Vi är en plantskola för social skills – vi lägger en bra grund för alla framtida yrken. Och du får ett snyggt CV!
  • För dig som redan kommit en bit i yrkeslivet kan vi erbjuda ett utvecklande och mångsidigt jobb.
  • Du får kunskap om hur det är att driva butik.
  • Du lär dig att bli en ledare med förståelse för service.
  • Du får specialistkunskap – vi kan allt från att driva butik och sälja drivmedel, till marknadsföring och ledarskap.
  • Du får en möjlighet till att göra karriär inom företaget – kanske vill du driva din egen butik, eller sikta mot ett jobb på vårt huvudkontor.
  • Du får ett roligt jobb med härliga kollegor.
  • Vi är ett internationellt företag med kollegor runt omkring i hela världen.
  • Våra stationer kan ha biluthyrning, då är körkort B-manuell ett krav.
  • Vi erbjuder dig ett förmånligt friskvårdsbidrag och personalrabatt på alla våra stationer.

Circle K är ett framgångsrikt globalt företag med mer än 17 300 butiker i 27 länder. Totalt har vi cirka 150 000 anställda som arbetar i våra butiker och på kontoren. Vårt nätverk består av butiker som drivs både i bolags- och franchisedrift. Vår kultur och våra värderingar: One Team, Take Ownership, Play to Win och Do the Right Thing är grunden i allt vi gör. Vi vill göra det enkelt för våra kunder längs vägen genom att erbjuda bra produkter och snabb service i världsklass.

För den här tjänsten krävs att du antingen är medborgare i Sverige, ett annat nordiskt land eller ett EU/EES-land, har permanent uppehållstillstånd i Sverige, eller är asylsökande med giltig rätt att arbeta. Under rekryteringsprocessen behöver du kunna visa upp handlingar som styrker ditt medborgarskap eller din arbetsrätt i Sverige.

Vi förbehåller oss rätten att göra bakgrundskontroller på slutkandidater i rekryteringsprocessen.

title: Member Services Representative (32168)
description:
Title: Member Services Representative

Department: Retail Branches

Reports To: Branch Sales Manager III

Job Grade: 8

FLSA: Non-Exempt Last Modified: 3-24-2025

It’s a Job … Only better!

At UKFCU, we’re more than a Credit Union – we’re a community, and we’ve been proudly serving our members since 1937! As a rapidly growing, not-for-profit organization, we’re dedicated to making a real difference in the lives of our members and employees alike. If you’re looking for a workplace where you can grow, make an impact, and have fun while helping others, UKFCU is the place for you!

Why This Role Matters

As a Member Services Representative, you will be the face of UKFCU, providing essential financial services and support to our members. You will process transactions, assist with account inquiries, and educate members about credit union products that align with their financial needs.   • Cross-sell credit union services, including loans, savings plans, and financial tools.
  • Participate in sales development training and activities to enhance service offerings.

Account Management & Compliance:

  • Notarize documents, research accounts, perform account maintenance, open deposit accounts (consumer, business, IRA), originate loan applications, inform members of loan decisions, explain loan documents to members.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations.
  • Maintain confidentiality of member and employee information.

Operational Support & Problem Resolution:

  • Assist in resolving member concerns, escalating issues as necessary.
  • Reconcile cash drawers and maintain accurate cash handling procedures.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, competitor practices, and regulatory changes.

title: Azure Integrations Engineer
description:
At TOMRA, we are transforming how resources are collected, recovered, and reused around the world. To support our continued digital growth, we are looking for an Azure Integrations Engineer to join our Business Systems team and help build the technology backbone that connects our critical business applications and partner platforms.

This is an exciting opportunity to work at the heart of TOMRA's digital ecosystem, designing and developing integrations that enable seamless data flow across ERP, CRM, Customer Care, and external systems. You'll help shape our enterprise integration landscape while working with modern Azure technologies in a collaborative, international environment.

What You'll Be Doing

As an Integrations Engineer, you will play a key role in developing and maintaining TOMRA's Azure Integration Services platform. You'll work closely with business systems experts, architects, infrastructure teams, and external partners to deliver reliable, scalable integrations that support operations across Europe and beyond.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Designing, building, and maintaining integrations using Azure Integration Services, including Logic Apps, ADF, Service Bus, Event Grid, and API Management.
  • Developing API-based, event-driven, and batch integration solutions aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
  • Creating reusable integration components and contributing to a scalable integration catalogue.
  • Supporting testing activities, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring high-quality delivery.
  • Implementing monitoring, logging, and error-handling capabilities to ensure reliability.
  • Working with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices to automate deployments.
  • Collaborating with architects, internal teams, and external vendors to deliver business-critical solutions.
  • Supporting governance, security, and platform standards across the integration landscape.
  • Participating in Agile ceremonies, code reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

What We're Looking For

You enjoy solving complex technical challenges and building solutions that make a real impact. You are comfortable working across systems, stakeholders, and technologies, and you thrive in collaborative environments where innovation and continuous learning are encouraged.

We believe you'll be successful if you have:

  • 4+ years of experience in integration development or cloud-based software development.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Integration Services.
  • Experience with integration platforms such as Boomi, Talend, or similar solutions is an advantage.
  • Strong understanding of API-led, event-driven, and message-based integration patterns.
  • Experience integrating enterprise applications such as ERP, CRM, Contact Center, WMS, TMS, or partner systems.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and version control.
  • Understanding of monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting distributed systems.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent English communication skills.

Why Join TOMRA?

At TOMRA, you'll be part of a company with a clear purpose: enabling a world without waste. We combine technology, innovation, and sustainability to create solutions that help preserve the planet's resources for future generations.

We offer:

  • The opportunity to work with modern cloud and integration technologies.
  • An international and collaborative working environment.
  • Meaningful projects that support TOMRA's digital transformation journey.
  • A culture that values innovation, inclusion, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you're passionate about integration technologies and want to help build the digital foundation of a global technology leader, we'd love to hear from you.

At TOMRA, your work has real impact, and your ideas help shape a better future.
Learn more about life at TOMRA!

What do you get from joining TOMRA?

  • Opportunity for career development
  • A unique chance to be an important part of taking our business growth in Europe to the next level
  • Work in a collaborative and innovative environment.

Ready to grow your career with purpose?

Please apply by sending us your CV, a few words about yourself, and why you are interested in the position and joining TOMRA. Please write this in the field "Message to Hiring Team".

Applications are continually assessed so we encourage you to apply at the earliest.

title: Tech Lead
description:
About the Role

A fast-growing, seed-funded conversational AI startup — backed by Y Combinator and other top-tier investors — is hiring a Tech Lead to scale its engineering team and operations. The company builds voice and text AI agents that automate customer service, lead qualification, appointment scheduling, and operational workflows for businesses in the home improvement and related industries.

This is a high-ownership role that sits at the intersection of hands-on engineering and technical leadership. You'll partner closely with the CTO and senior leadership to drive architecture, team productivity, and delivery — while remaining an active contributor to the codebase (~20–30% of your time). The role is on-site in either New York City, NY or San Francisco, CA.

What You'll Do

  • Manage the engineering team day-to-day, removing blockers and keeping delivery on track.

  • Guide architectural decisions and system design across the product.

  • Own task prioritization and delivery tradeoffs with final say on engineering decisions.

  • Review code and RFCs to maintain quality, consistency, and engineering standards.

  • Establish and enforce engineering best practices, processes, and operational workflows.

  • Serve as a technical liaison and thought partner to executive and cross-functional leadership (CEO, CTO, Sales, Customer Success).

  • Contribute actively to the production codebase alongside your leadership responsibilities.

  • Raise the overall productivity and maturity of the engineering organization.

What We're Looking For

Must-haves (dealbreakers apply):

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with the most recent role as a Staff Engineer or Tech Lead.

  • Proven experience managing an engineering team of 4+ members with day-to-day operational responsibility.

  • Hands-on experience designing software architecture and building production full-stack applications integrated with LLMs.

  • Hands-on experience with conversational AI and/or voice AI technology, including NLP/LLM applications.

  • Production experience deploying and managing cloud-based applications — Microsoft Azure experience strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated ability to own engineering roadmap execution and technical prioritization.

  • Strong cross-functional communication skills, including the ability to advocate technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience in fast-growing startups or scale-ups; comfortable shipping under pressure.

  • US work authorization required — no visa sponsorship available.

Nice-to-have:

  • Prior leadership experience at a conversational AI, voice AI, or AI agent company.

  • Familiarity with the home improvement, real estate, healthcare, insurance, or airline verticals.

  • Experience collaborating with distributed teams across North American and European time zones.

  • Strong business acumen with a clear sense of how technical decisions impact revenue and customer outcomes.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: $220,000 – $250,000 annually

  • Competitive equity package at an early-stage, well-funded company

Location

  • On-site role — candidates must be willing and able to work in-office in New York City, NY or San Francisco, CA.

  • No fully remote option available for this position.

title: Automotive Alignment Technicians
description:
Mavis Tires & Brakes at Discount Prices - Automotive Alignment Technicians


Put your career into high gear with Mavis Tires & Brakes at Discount Prices! We're looking for a full-time Automotive Alignment Technicians to join Team Mavis at one of our state-of-the-art automotive service, repair and tire sales centers in the Walden, NY area. With over 2,000 retail locations, Mavis is one of the largest tire sales and automotive repair chains in the United States.

About the Position of Automotive Alignment Technician

Automotive Alignment technicians use the latest equipment to align newly-mounted tires and wheels on customer's vehicles. By measuring and adjusting caster, camber, toe and thrust angles, our Automotive Alignment Technicians reduce customer's tire wear and ensure serviced vehicles travel straight and true. Mavis's Alignment Technicians also complete state-mandated inspections, oil and filter changes and flat repairs, and perform any other required automotive service or vehicle repairs to customer vehicles.

Employee Benefits

At Mavis, we understand that our people drive our success. We provide our team members with competitive weekly pay, including weekly incentive compensation, a good working environment and an excellent combination of additional benefits like health, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer match, paid vacations, paid time off, paid holidays, life insurance, on-the-job training, and opportunities for career growth and advancement.

Qualifications

We recruit team members who share our commitment to providing complete customer satisfaction and delivering the highest quality service. To be eligible for the position of Automotive Alignment Technicians you must (1) be at least 18 years of age; (2) be legally authorized to work in the United States; and (3) possess 1 year of experience and/or training in dismounting, mounting, rotating and balancing tires or any combination of education, training and experience which demonstrates the ability to perform the duties and responsibilities of the position. In addition, it is preferred that Alignment Technicians possess a state inspection license.

As an active position, Automotive Alignment Technicians are required to stand, walk, bend, kneel, stoop, crouch, crawl, climb, pull, reach and perform repeated and repetitive movements consistent with vehicle and tire maintenance and repair. Alignment Technicians must regularly lift and/or move items weighing over 50 pounds.

Waythrough was formed in 2024 following the merger of Humankind and Richmond Fellowship. Together, we’ve created one of the largest mental health and social support charities in England.

Every year, we support around 125,000 people through nearly 200 services – and it’s all made possible by our 3,500 brilliant staff and volunteers.

Make a real difference in your community

Are you passionate about helping others live safer, healthier, more independent lives? Join our team at Waythrough and support people facing challenges around mental health, substance use, housing or domestic abuse. This is more than just a job – it’s a chance to build meaningful relationships and create lasting change.

title: Analyst, Non-US Advanced Analytics & Decision Intelligence
description:
Working with Us
Challenging. Meaningful. Life-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. You’ll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities uncommon in scale and scope, alongside high-achieving teams. Take your career farther than you thought possible.

Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. Read more: .

Analytics Delivery & AI Enablement

  • Support the development and delivery of analytical solutions under the guidance of senior analysts and team leads.
  • Apply foundational analytics, decision science, and AI/ML techniques to support Ex-US Commercial initiatives across brand strategy, omnichannel engagement, and resource allocation.
  • Translate well-defined business questions into analytical tasks, execute analyses, and summarize findings.
  • Ensure accuracy, quality, and adherence to analytical best practices in all deliverables.

Stakeholder Support & Business Understanding

  • Collaborate with Ex-US Commercial stakeholders, Global Analytics, OCx, Marketing, and BIT to understand business context and analytical requirements.
  • Support preparation of analytical outputs, presentations, and dashboards for stakeholder discussions.
  • Clearly communicate results, assumptions, and limitations with guidance from senior team members.
  • Incorporate stakeholder feedback to refine analyses and outputs.

Omnichannel & Commercial Analytics

  • Execute analytics supporting personal and non-personal promotion channels, including field force, email, web, paid media, social, and third-party platforms.
  • Support development and tracking of performance metrics related to reach, engagement, and effectiveness.
  • Assist in test-and-learn initiatives, A/B tests, and basic quasi-experimental analyses.
  • Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities in data and escalate insights to senior team members.

Team Collaboration & Learning

  • Work collaboratively within project teams, contributing to shared goals and timelines.
  • Learn and adopt standard analytical frameworks, tools, and coding best practices used by the team.
  • Participate in knowledge-sharing sessions and training programs.
  • Demonstrate curiosity and initiative in developing analytical and business skills.

Technical Execution & Data Handling

  • Build and maintain datasets, basic models, dashboards, and recurring reports.
  • Perform data validation, quality checks, and documentation of analytical processes.
  • Work with data engineering and BIT teams to understand data structures and resolve data issues.
  • Follow established governance, compliance, and documentation standards.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail and data quality.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain analyses in simple terms.
  • Ability to manage assigned tasks effectively and meet deadlines.
  • Willingness to learn new tools, techniques, and business concepts.
  • Collaborative and proactive team player with a positive attitude.
  • Basic problem-solving skills and ability to apply structured thinking.

Experience & Qualifications

  • BA/BS required; degrees in life sciences, computer science, mathematics, statistics, data science, or engineering preferred.
  • 1–3 years of professional experience in analytics, data analysis, decision science, or related roles.
  • Experience working with structured datasets and performing quantitative analyses.
  • Exposure to commercial analytics, marketing analytics, or healthcare/pharmaceutical analytics is a plus.
  • Interest in applying data, analytics, and AI to solve real-world business problems.

Technical Skills (Preferred)

  • Hands-on experience with Python and/or R for data analysis and basic modelling.
  • Familiarity with statistical concepts and introductory machine learning techniques.
  • Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., R Shiny, Dash, Tableau, Power BI, or similar).
  • Exposure to collaborative analytics environments (e.g., Databricks, Git, SharePoint).
  • Basic understanding of omnichannel, digital marketing, or commercial data sources.

If you come across a role that intrigues you but doesn’t perfectly line up with your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. You could be one step away from work that will transform your life and career.

Uniquely Interesting Work, Life-changing Careers
With a single vision as inspiring as “Transforming patients’ lives through science™ ”, every BMS employee plays an integral role in work that goes far beyond ordinary. Each of us is empowered to apply our individual talents and unique perspectives in a supportive culture, promoting global participation in clinical trials, while our shared values of passion, innovation, urgency, accountability, inclusion and integrity bring out the highest potential of each of our colleagues.

On-site Protocol

BMS has an occupancy structure that determines where an employee is required to conduct their work. This structure includes site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design jobs. The occupancy type that you are assigned is determined by the nature and responsibilities of your role:

Site-essential roles require 100% of shifts onsite at your assigned facility. Site-by-design roles may be eligible for a hybrid work model with at least 50% onsite at your assigned facility. For these roles, onsite presence is considered an essential job function and is critical to collaboration, innovation, productivity, and a positive Company culture. For field-based and remote-by-design roles the ability to physically travel to visit customers, patients or business partners and to attend meetings on behalf of BMS as directed is an essential job function.

Supporting People with Disabilities

Applicants can request a reasonable workplace accommodation/adjustment prior to accepting a job offer. If you require reasonable accommodations/adjustments in completing this application, or in any part of the recruitment process, direct your inquiries to adastaffingsupport@bms.com. Visit eeo-accessibility to access our complete Equal Employment Opportunity statement.

Candidate Rights

BMS will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, pursuant to applicable laws in your area.

If you live in or expect to work from Los Angeles County if hired for this position, please visit this page for important additional information:

Data Protection

We will never request payments, financial information, or social security numbers during our application or recruitment process. Learn more about protecting yourself at .

Any data processed in connection with role applications will be treated in accordance with applicable data privacy policies and regulations.

title: Product Manager - 12 month FTC
description:
What is Flagstone?

Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work.

Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage.


A feel for our culture:

To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth.

That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it.

We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three.

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.

About the squad
The Mobile App squad sits within our Engagement Tribe, whose mission is to deepen how clients engage with Flagstone and grow the balances they hold with us. The native mobile app is an important growth area for us, and we're looking for a product manager to lead the squad through an intensive period of building.


Does this sound like you?

This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You'll lead the squad, setting the product direction for the mobile app, leading discovery, owning the roadmap, and being the product leader the squad rallies around. You'll report to the Group Product Manager and work closely with both the Group Product Manager and the Tribe Lead on wider tribe strategy, but the direction of the mobile app is yours to shape and deliver.


What you’ll do:

  • Shape the mobile app strategy and roadmap, using customer and market insight, and align it to our tribe and company goals.

  • Lead product discovery: validate problems with data and research, scope solutions, and connect what you build to measurable outcomes.

  • Own delivery end to end for the squad, shipping small and often so we learn quickly and improvements land reliably through the app stores.

  • Provide product leadership to the squad: set the standard for how you work, run retrospectives and experiments, and keep raising the bar on quality.

  • Own the squad's outcomes and metrics, focused on engagement and deposits, and show how the squad's work contributes to wider company goals.

  • Shape stakeholder expectations and secure buy-in across design, engineering, compliance and growth, bringing people with you rather than relying on your title.

  • Analyse in-app journeys from a data perspective to find where they fall short and prove the impact of what you launch.

  • Work with Compliance, content designers, data analysts and go-to-market experts so that what you ship is compliant, well made, evidence-led and ready for clients.


What you’ll bring:

Essential

  • At least 3-5 years in product management, including experience leading a squad or owning a product area end to end.

  • Hands-on experience shipping native mobile app features on iOS and/or Android, including app store release cycles.

  • A strong track record in product discovery and strategy: turning customer and market insight into a roadmap, and validating problems before building.

  • Experience owning engagement or growth outcomes such as activation, retention, deposits or acquisition.

  • A strong grounding in data, comfortable digging into funnel and journey data to find problems and prove impact.

  • Confident stakeholder management, able to align senior stakeholders and navigate competing priorities without leaning on positional authority.

  • Backlog management, prioritisation, and writing epics, features and user stories.

  • Comfortable working in a regulated financial services environment.

Desirable

  • A FinTech or financial services background.

  • Experience with mobile engagement mechanics like push notifications, in-app messaging and CRM-triggered comms.

  • Experience using AI tools to speed up the product development lifecycle.

How we reward you:

At Flagstone, the benefits extend beyond false gifts like “fruit and snacks”. Instead, we invest in your health, wealth, and professional development. Here’s a selection of our benefits:

  • Hybrid working - Spend at least 1 day a week with your team in our collaborative London office

  • Competitive bonus scheme - designed to reward and recognise high performance

  • Flexible benefits budget - a pot to fund meaningful benefits for you, whether it's hormone or fertility testing, cancer screening, neuro-diversity coaching or something that matters for you.

  • A range of salary sacrifice options to help you make tax efficient savings on electric cars, nursery schemes, home and tech goods.

  • Around the World scheme - 3 months work from anywhere scheme

  • Mental wellbeing support – Access therapy and mental health sessions through Spill

  • Learning and development – £1,000 personal development budget to help you grow in your role.

  • Private health care - Enjoy all the benefits AXA has to offer, including reduced gym memberships and medical history disregarded

  • Medical cash plan - To help you with the costs of dental and optical expenses

  • Life insurance and Income Protection- four times your annual salary for peace of mind

  • Matched pension contributions up to 5%

  • 25 days holiday - plus bank holidays, well-being days and volunteering days

  • Enhanced Parental Leave – enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption pay.

All are welcome.

At Flagstone, we’re assembling a diverse team that defies our industry’s norms. Think this role could suit you? We encourage you to apply, no matter your background.

title: Senior Material Engineer
description:
Job Description

The Senior Material Engineer will be responsible for developing and implementing strategies related to selection, processing a wide range of products and raw materials. Independently studies structures and chemical properties of various materials required by R&D to enhance existing products. Identifies and solves problems related to performance or selection of materials, including failure analysis.

  • Ensures specific parts used in manufactured products and systems are reliable and effective. Work is involved during the production, research, development, compliance, and design stages of manufacturing.
  • Acts as a technical resource for Electronics/Electro-Mechanical components related selection/issues relevant to Company products.
  • Trains and develops other engineers in use of engineering practices and is a recognized technical expert inside and outside of the greater Agilent community.
  • Represents Agilent to scientific and technical communities.
  • Utilize project management methods to complete assignments, plan, direct or coordinate activities of functional area as part of a corporate cross-functional project.
  • Work with Design team - turning research ideas into technical plans using computer aided design(CAD) and computer modelling programs.

Key Responsibilities:

The Senior Material Engineer responsibilities includes to create/ modify the part specifications that define Agilent requirements and permit procurement from multiple suppliers following FFF compatibility and /or input from materials engineering.

  • Evaluates part requests to eliminate duplication or similarity with existing parts.
  • Inform user about the changing trends in technology as identified through parts request information or supplier input.
  • Notifies part requesters when non-recommended parts or suppliers are being requested and suggests alternate recommended parts or suppliers.
  • Discusses requestor's needs versus the benefits of using recommended suppliers and preferred parts in product design by reviewing the criteria by which recommended suppliers and preferred parts are selected.
  • Identifies critical variations in parts specifications between multiple suppliers, which would limit interchangeability.
  • Requests are either rejected or further investigation is initiated.
  • Assessing the manufacturability of new and existing products to achieve a cost effective and reliable product in electro-mechanical assembly environment based on component knowledge.
  • Component selection & assigning preference code for use in NPI's.
  • Support component quality and thus support Operations Quality organizations with regard to component quality development, maintenance, as well as failure analysis and resolution activities.
  • Utilize project management methods to complete assignments, plan, direct or coordinate activities of functional area as part of a corporate cross-functional project.
  • Involved in departments -wide efforts to improve material specifications consistency, timeliness, quality, and usability across assigned subset of categories. May participate in part standardization efforts with materials engineering. May involve obtaining samples from suppliers.
  • PCN / Disco Notices issues by manufacturer for Parts impacted and update parts as instructed by manufacturer. Review notices by Manufacturers for Impacted parts. Consult and take approval from user for changes to impacted parts. Update parts and inform users and Material Engineering community for related change.
  • Data integrity issues: Review database for any missing, inaccurate, or unusable data or part specifications Inform user about the issue. Fix the issue and take preventive actions to avoid the same in future.

title: Associate – Programme Management
description:
As an Associate in Programme Management and Programme Management Office delivery, you will have experience delivering key roles in £200m+ major capital programmes, across complex construction environments within sectors such as Central Government, Industrial, Life Sciences, Data Centres and Defence.

You play a critical role in driving excellence in commission performance, client delivery, business performance and team leadership. Supporting the Programme Director/Team Leader, you deliver across major programmes and provide team leadership, ensuring clarity of direction, performance of programme functions, robust governance, compliance, outcomes delivery, and trusted client partnership.

You deliver to the programme strategy and establish and maintain successful stakeholder relations with client leaders and your teams. You are a credible and accomplished programme delivery professional with a proven track record of delivering complex programmes. You bring significant construction programme expertise, with the ability to operate efficiently and effectively between programme and project-level detail, maintaining strong key stakeholder relationships and driving progress and successful programme outcomes.

You drive programmes from early-stage definition and mobilisation through execution, transition and benefits realisation. Working in multi-disciplinary teams and complex stakeholder environments, you provide the delivery expertise, governance and commercial acumen required to deliver successful outcomes with clarity, control and confidence, leading by example for our clients.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Programme Delivery & Leadership: Take ownership of delivering to the programme vision and direction. Drive success and cohesion across delivery activities. Effectively empower, motivate, and guide colleagues and lead by example to establish high-performing team cultures.

Deliver or manage critical programme functions/services within the wider controls framework, and a focus on outcomes and the realisation of benefits back to the business case and organisational strategy.

Develop trusted client partnerships, identify growth opportunities and actively contribute to business development and market expansion activities.

  • Risk Strategy, Health & Safety: Work with the team to identify and mitigate health and safety risks, enforcing safeguards to protect all involved in programme delivery. Proactively contribute to and/or lead the development and implementation of programme-wide risk management and assurance strategies. Support and help drive a culture of safety, wellbeing and compliance, and ensuring effective controls are in place to protect people, assets and programme objectives.

Build capability, lead by example, mentor teams, drive inclusion across the team and successfully carry out people management responsibilities where required to drive internal team performance and growth and our One Business culture.

This is an Associate level role. To excel in this role, you will have:

  • Proven experience in programme management, including in large-scale and/or high-profile real estate transformation programmes (£100-£300m+) with demonstrable achievement of benefits and outcomes for clients/employers.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and programme management tools, reporting systems and digital platforms, with a proactive approach to data, innovation and digital tools and strategy, including the use of AI.

title: Quality Assurance Specialist
description:
POSITION SUMMARY: Prioritize daily sample testing and perform a variety of microbiological tests on raw materials and finished batches. Identifies, isolates and studies micro-organisms, bacteria, and their byproducts. Investigate OOS/OOT results and implement any corrective action as determined by QC Management. Aid in training new Associates.

FUNCTIONS OF THE JOB:

1. Behavior: Exhibit team player qualities of cooperation and coordination; professional interaction in all business contacts.

2. Attendance/Punctuality: Presence at work on time when scheduled is a mandatory function

3. Safety: Compliance with all company safety rules, procedures, and guidelines is mandatory.

4. Perform and document testing in accordance with cGMP. Testing includes, but is not limited to, finished product analysis and preparatory testing of newly developed products, raw material analysis, and organism identification.

5. Maintains inventory levels of reagents, media, and stock cultures.

6. Troubleshooting, maintenance, and calibration of laboratory equipment are expected.

7. Organize workload of laboratory and provide management with feedback of overall laboratory performance.

8. Work on special projects as assigned or requested.

9. Modify SOPs as necessary and ensure that procedures are in place for all tasks within the laboratory.

10. Perform general housekeeping duties.

11. Coordinate information flow within the laboratory and to internal customers.

12. Access, input, and retrieve information from the QC computer systems.

13. Disposition of raw materials, process samples and finished products for use or sale.

14. Be thoroughly versed in GMP regulations and ensure that all laboratory documentation meets standards for completeness and accuracy.

15. Demonstrate a complete understanding of safe procedures for processing, analyzing, and storage of hazardous and/or flammable products and raw materials in accordance with local, state, and federal guidelines.

16. Document deviations in performance not anticipated or indicated in test procedures.

17. Be or become thoroughly familiar with QC and manufacturing process and workflow, QC retain program and documentation procedures.

18. Work with minimal supervision, re-prioritizing work schedules quickly.

19. Be proficient in performing traditional plating techniques and routine Celsius analysis.

20. Become familiar and assist with OOS/OOT and Customer complaint investigations.

21. Become familiar and assist with Method Development Protocols and conduct requisite testing.

22. Become familiar and assist with SOP creation, review, and revision activities.

23. Become familiar and assist with supplies/services ordering process.

24. Become familiar and assist with instrument maintenance and troubleshooting.

25. Must be able to perform any routine task in the laboratory in an efficient manner.

26. Participate in meetings as required.

27. Complete training assignments as required.

28. All other duties as assigned.

Physical Activities: Walking, talking, hearing, climbing, balancing, reaching, grasping, standing, and stooping.

Physical Demands: Occasionally lift boxes of product 5-40 lb. Frequently lift samples 1-5 lb.

Visual Acuity: Clarity of vision at 20 inches or less, with the ability to distinguish colors and adjust eye to bring objects into sharper focus.

Environmental/Atmospheric Conditions: Worker exposed to extreme heat and cold with temperatures sufficiently high or low to cause marked bodily discomfort. Exposed to sufficient noise to cause worker to shout to be heard above the ambient noise level. Worker exposed to hazards such as proximity to moving mechanical parts. Works in laboratory, production line and warehouse environments.

Maintains complete and timely documentation in approved systems and collaborates with cross functional partners to support on time contract execution. Reporting Relationship • Reports to Associate Director/Director Site Contracting Operations Qualifications Specific Knowledge, Skills, Abilities • Working knowledge of clinical study protocols, contract templates, investigator grants, and site budget negotiation processes; ability to negotiate within SOP defined guardrails and thresholds. • High attention to detail with strong organization and time management; able to manage multiple negotiations against agreed timelines. • Effective negotiation and communication skills in multinational, multilingual settings; comfortable using approved translation resources/tools where applicable. • Proficiency with contract management systems and e signature platforms; strong MS Office skills. title: Devops Engineer
description:
O Grupie Astek

Założona w 1988 roku we Francji Grupa Astek jest światowym partnerem w obszarze doradztwa inżynieryjnego oraz IT. Dzięki swojej wiedzy specjalistycznej w wielu sektorach przemysłowych i technologicznych, Astek wspiera międzynarodowych Klientów w rozwijaniu i wdrażaniu produktów oraz usług, jednocześnie uczestnicząc w ich transformacji cyfrowej.

Grupa Astek od momentu powstania opiera swój rozwój na kulturze przedsiębiorczości i innowacyjności oraz na budowaniu umiejętności swoich ponad 10 000 pracowników, którzy codziennie uczestniczą w zróżnicowanych projektach technologicznych i inżynieryjnych.

Zapraszamy na po więcej szczegółów.

Dla naszego klienta poszukujemy DevOps Engineer

Poszukujemy doświadczonego DevOps Engineera, który będzie odpowiedzialny za rozwój i utrzymanie nowoczesnej infrastruktury, automatyzację procesów wdrożeniowych oraz zapewnienie stabilności środowisk aplikacyjnych. Jeśli dobrze odnajdujesz się w środowisku Kubernetes, automatyzacji oraz rozwiązaniach chmurowych i chcesz mieć realny wpływ na rozwój platformy developerskiej – zapraszamy do aplikowania.

Twoje codzienne obowiązki obejmują:

· Przygotowywanie, zgłaszanie oraz uzyskiwanie akceptacji zmian wdrożeniowych.

· Wdrażanie zmian na środowiska testowe oraz produkcyjne.

· Wsparcie procesu wdrożeń poprzez stabilizację, optymalizację i strojenie środowisk.

· Koordynacja procesu wdrażania zmian pomiędzy zespołami.

· Wdrażanie poprawek i aktualizacji dostarczanych przez zewnętrznych dostawców.

· Budowa i rozwój wewnętrznej platformy developerskiej (Platform Engineering).

· Rozwój i utrzymanie infrastruktury aplikacyjnej opartej o Kubernetes (RKE2, GKE, AKS) oraz usługi chmurowe.

· Projektowanie i rozwój rozwiązań w środowiskach chmury publicznej i prywatnej.

· Projektowanie, rozwój i automatyzacja procesów CI/CD zgodnie z podejściem Everything as Code.

· Tworzenie skryptów automatyzujących zadania administracyjne.

· Monitorowanie infrastruktury oraz aplikacji i zapewnianie wysokiej dostępności środowisk.

Czego od Ciebie oczekujemy:

· Minimum 5 lat doświadczenia na stanowisku DevOps Engineer lub Platform Engineer.

· Praktyczne doświadczenie z platformą Kubernetes (instalacja, konfiguracja, administracja) na poziomie odpowiadającym certyfikatom CKA lub CKAD.

· Doświadczenie w zarządzaniu infrastrukturą jako kod (Infrastructure as Code) z wykorzystaniem Terraform i Ansible.

· Bardzo dobrą znajomość technologii konteneryzacji (Docker, Containerd).

· Doświadczenie w projektowaniu i utrzymaniu rozwiązań w co najmniej jednej chmurze publicznej (Microsoft Azure lub Google Cloud Platform).

· Doświadczenie w budowie i utrzymaniu procesów CI/CD z wykorzystaniem narzędzi takich jak GitHub Actions, Zuul CI, ArgoCD, Helm, Kustomize oraz JFrog Artifactory.

· Bardzo dobrą znajomość systemu kontroli wersji Git.

· Umiejętność administracji systemami Linux.

· Doświadczenie w budowie lub utrzymaniu systemów monitoringu opartych o Prometheus, Grafana, ELK lub podobne rozwiązania.

· Znajomość przynajmniej jednego języka skryptowego: Python lub Bash.

Mile widziane

Dodatkowym atutem będzie znajomość takich technologii jak:

  • NGINX,

  • Istio,

  • Kyverno,

  • HashiCorp Vault,

  • Hazelcast.

Co zyskujesz?

· Długoterminowa współpraca

· Możliwość wyboru preferowanego rodzaju współpracy (regularna umowa o pracę ze wszystkimi korzyściami lub elastyczny kontrakt B2B)

· Szkolenia techniczne, certyfikaty i podnoszenie kwalifikacji

· Mentoring Competence Center - będziesz członkiem społeczności CC od pierwszego dnia pracy. Będziesz miał szansę rozwijać swoje umiejętności, uczestniczyć w różnych konferencjach oraz dzielić się wiedzą i doświadczeniem z ludźmi, którzy na co dzień mierzą się z tymi samymi wyzwaniami

· Jasna ścieżka kariery

· Pakiet benefitów pracowniczych

· Przyjazną atmosferę pracy, imprezy integracyjne i spotkania team-buildingowe

Challenging. Meaningful. Life-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. title: Parts & Warehouse Analyst
description:
Parts & Warehouse Analyst

Blake Thermal Sales & Service Inc. is a full-service thermal solutions company that supplies engineered products, services, and complete systems. Blake Thermal has a 98-year history of providing an array of products and services supporting steam, hot water for process and domestic heat for commercial, industrial, medical, educational and manufacturing facilities. Headquartered in East Windsor, CT, Blake Thermal maintains multiple locations across New York and New England including Portland, ME.

This position is responsible for direct parts support and parts business growth for a multifunctional business unit providing steam and hydronic thermal solutions in the Northeast. The Parts & Warehouse Analyst is responsible for supporting internal and external customers to ensure availability of parts. This position plays a key role in maintaining the company's reputation as a leading provider of thermal energy solutions. This position reports to the Engineering Group Leader and is located in Portland, Maine.

Ideal Candidates will be in alignment with Blake Thermal's Core Values:

  • Customer Focused
  • Opportunity is Earned
  • Solutions Provider
  • Trustworthy
  • Driven to Succeed
  • Confident but Humble

Key Responsibilities:

  • Generate parts proposals for internal and external customers. This will include taking incoming inquiries for parts by phone or email.
  • Responsible for local inventory management to ensure inventory is aligned with market needs.
  • Ensure shipments from company inventory are processed and submitted for billing.
  • Provide strategic input to the sales team that will ensure advancement in Blake Thermal's position in the marketplace.
  • Frequent communication with service coordinator, service manager and local sales team.
  • Provide direct parts support to internal and external customers.
  • Remain up to date on all safety and compliance rules, regulations and policies related to this position.
  • Take items from receiving dock and transfer them to Blake Thermal staging area and/or inventory.
  • Pack and process outgoing raw materials and finished goods as well as receiving inbound product and processing returns.
  • Maintain and keep warehouse organized.
  • Other duties assigned by management.

Requirements:

  • Experience in commercial or industrial parts support operations preferred.
  • Ability to read and decipher material lists for the purposes of identifying parts.
  • Inventory management and logistics experience preferred.
  • Ability to produce detailed and concise quotations pertaining to customer requirements.
  • Ability to think strategically and to appropriately prioritize based on business needs.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and remain effective in a dynamic organization.
  • Experience with shipping and receiving preferred.
  • Strong communication skills for both internal and external customers.
  • Ability to productively interact with a cross-functional team.
  • Self-starter who possesses a positive attitude.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Computer proficiency.
  • Lifting up to 75lbs.
  • Forklift certified or ability to become certified.
  • Potential local travel. Valid drivers' license required.

This opportunity offers a competitive salary commensurate with experience, 401k, generous health benefits, company paid life/ AD&D, company paid training with future advancement opportunities.

title: 3rd shift Truck Unloader (Truck dumper) 4AM-2PM
description:
Truck Unloader (Truck Dumper)

Darling Ingredients is looking to hire a Truck Unloader for our plant in Collinsville, OK. Are you ready to get started in an entry-level manufacturing job with a stable worldwide company? This Truck Unloader position earns a competitive entry-level wage of $21.03/hour. We also offer comprehensive full-time benefits, including full medical, dental, vision, a 401(k) plan, vacation time, and more. If this sounds like the right yard jockey opportunity for you, consider applying today!

ABOUT DARLING INGREDIENTS

We began as a family business in 1882 and have continued to grow into the world's leading innovative developer and producer of sustainable organic ingredients for a growing population. Headquartered in Irving, TX with regional offices in Cold Spring, KY and Des Moines, IA as well as production facilities across the U.S., we have over 10,000 employees across the globe. We repurpose and reuse rather than discarding what others might consider waste. We capture valuable ingredients and nutrients to help maximize what nature has to offer, providing components for a wide range of products that include pet food, fertilizer, and biofuel. Giving nature a second life is our second nature.

Our greatest assets are our employees. Our inclusive global workforce and their wide variety of skills, abilities, experiences, and perspectives have been critical in helping us consistently deliver best-in-class results around the world. In order to attract and retain employees who share our values of integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship, we offer competitive pay, excellent benefits, stability, and opportunities for career growth.


A DAY IN THE LIFE OF AN ENTRY-LEVEL DAY OR NIGHT TRUCK UNLOADER

As a Truck Unloader, you are the cornerstone of our production process. You ensure that our raw floor has enough raw material to run the manufacturing plant. Based on what is available and what is needed, you communicate effectively with the Raw Loader Operator to coordinate which loads should be dumped next. You keep a running log of the trailers dumped as well as what is available in the yard. Much of your time is spent jockeying trailers and tipping them with a truck tipper. You work in a safe and timely manner.

You ensure a steady flow of raw material in order to maintain a consistent mix of materials. To make sure that the trailer is set up in accordance with customer requirements, you clean the Yard truck and dock area after dumping. You position each trailer in the holding lot to ensure readiness for the next routes. As a get-it-done person who likes to be active, you take pride in a job well done!


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS FOR AN ENTRY-LEVEL DAY OR NIGHT TRUCK UNLOADER

  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Ability and willingness to work safely outside in the weather.
  • Manufacturing, industrial, or agricultural experience is preferred.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS include:

  • Ability to accurately fill out paperwork for loads dumped.
  • Ability to handle, move and lift up to 50 lbs.
  • Basic math skills.

Manufacturing, industrial, or agricultural experience and Yard tractor experience are helpful, but multiple factors will be taken into consideration. Do you have good communication skills, both written and verbal? Are you attentive to safety? Do you have a strong work ethic? Are you self-motivated? If so, you might just be perfect for this entry-level job as a yard jockey!

DAY OR NIGHT WORK SCHEDULE

The full-time yard jockey job works either 10-hour nights on Mon-Sat. This production plant operates 24/7 and the flexibility to work days, nights, or weekends as needed is required.

READY TO JOIN OUR PRODUCTION TEAM?

We understand your time is valuable, and that is why we have a very quick and easy application process. If you feel that you would be right for this yard jockey job in a manufacturing environment, please fill out our initial 3-minute, mobile-friendly application. We look forward to meeting you!

Darling Ingredients is an equal opportunity employer and gives consideration to qualified applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, pregnancy, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, physical or mental disability, military service, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state and local law. title: Senior Analyst I - Trial Analytics, Insights & Planning (TAIP)
description:
Working with Us
Challenging. Meaningful. Life-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. You’ll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities uncommon in scale and scope, alongside high-achieving teams. Take your career farther than you thought possible.

Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. Read more: .

Position Title

Senior Analyst – Trial Analytics, Insights & Planning (TAIP) Sr. Mgr level (EG 120)

Location: Hyderabad

---

Position Summary

The Senior Analyst role in Bristol Myers Squibb’s Trial Analytics, Insights, and Planning (TAIP) unit is an excellent opportunity for professionals with approximately 3–6 years of experience in consulting, life sciences analytics, or clinical trial operations to step into an internal consulting environment that directly accelerates drug development.

Senior Analysts join one of two tracks based on their background and preference:

· The Analytical track focuses on forecasting, data modelling, dashboards, and site performance analytics.

· The Scientific track focuses on protocol logic, patient population sizing, eligibility criteria, and feasibility planning.

Regardless of track, you will gain exposure to both domains and are expected to develop strong, well-rounded expertise in scientific and analytical areas over time.

As a Senior Analyst, you will be embedded in a specific clinical trial team and work under the guidance of more senior team members to deliver core analytics workstreams that support smarter, faster trial execution. This includes taking ownership of trial forecasting models, feasibility analyses, and protocol analytics — always with the goal of helping bring therapies to patients more effectively.

You are not expected to be a therapeutic area or protocol expert on day one, but you will be expected to build domain knowledge over time, apply structured thinking to complex trial problems, and deliver high-quality, consistent outputs. You’ll also be part of a global, cross-functional team, working closely with peers across time zones to deliver with speed and precision.

---

Key Responsibilities

· Own key trial-level analytics workstreams (e.g., enrollment forecasting, feasibility analysis, protocol input)

· Translate structured study requirements into analytical deliverables in collaboration with more senior TAIP colleagues

· Work within a specific clinical trial context, gaining exposure to operational strategy, protocol logic, and real-world trial planning challenges

· Build therapeutic area knowledge over time, contributing to more targeted and scientifically grounded analyses

· Ensure accuracy, consistency, and clarity in data models, dashboards, and insights shared with the study team

· Collaborate across geographies, coordinating with other analysts and team members globally

· Contribute to cost-related analyses, such as country mix optimization and study design trade-offs

· Support study optimization by analyzing site and patient burden, competitor activity, and external data sources

· Coordinate with field-based colleagues to integrate local insights into feasibility and planning analytics

· Utilize trial analytics platforms and tools to generate, structure, and communicate data-driven insights

· Support analytics that may inform clinical supply forecasting or site-level supply considerations

· Applies critical thinking to analyze complex data, challenge assumptions, and generate strategic, evidence-based recommendations

---

Qualifications & Experience

· Education: Preferred advanced degree (e.g., MSc, MPH, PharmD, PhD, MBA) in a relevant field

· Experience:

o 3–6+ years of experience in consulting, healthcare analytics, life sciences strategy, or clinical trial planning and delivery is required

o Proven ability to manage and deliver complex analytical projects in fast-paced environments

· Skills:

o Excellent communication and structured problem-solving skills

o Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills required

o Interest in developing deeper expertise in therapeutic areas and clinical trial analytics

---

Why Join This Team?

· Grow in a Learning Environment: Build your scientific, analytical, and strategic expertise over time

· Be Part of an Internal Consulting Model: Operate in a pod-based team inspired by top-tier strategy firms

· Progress Through a Clear Career Path: Advance through a structured path modeled on strategic consulting, with transparent expectations, ~2–3 years per role, and rapid progression based on ownership and impact

· Pathway to Strategic Leadership at BMS: Career development is actively encouraged and expected, with opportunities to move into broader strategy and leadership roles within BMS in a short timeframe

· Accelerate Therapies to Patients: Help drive clinical decisions that bring treatments to patients faster

If you come across a role that intrigues you but doesn’t perfectly line up with your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. You could be one step away from work that will transform your life and career.

Uniquely Interesting Work, Life-changing Careers
With a single vision as inspiring as “Transforming patients’ lives through science™ ”, every BMS employee plays an integral role in work that goes far beyond ordinary. Each of us is empowered to apply our individual talents and unique perspectives in a supportive culture, promoting global participation in clinical trials, while our shared values of passion, innovation, urgency, accountability, inclusion and integrity bring out the highest potential of each of our colleagues.

On-site Protocol

BMS has an occupancy structure that determines where an employee is required to conduct their work. This structure includes site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design jobs. The occupancy type that you are assigned is determined by the nature and responsibilities of your role:

Site-essential roles require 100% of shifts onsite at your assigned facility. Site-by-design roles may be eligible for a hybrid work model with at least 50% onsite at your assigned facility. For these roles, onsite presence is considered an essential job function and is critical to collaboration, innovation, productivity, and a positive Company culture. For field-based and remote-by-design roles the ability to physically travel to visit customers, patients or business partners and to attend meetings on behalf of BMS as directed is an essential job function.

Supporting People with Disabilities

BMS is dedicated to ensuring that people with disabilities can excel through a transparent recruitment process, reasonable workplace accommodations/adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Applicants can request a reasonable workplace accommodation/adjustment prior to accepting a job offer. If you require reasonable accommodations/adjustments in completing this application, or in any part of the recruitment process, direct your inquiries to adastaffingsupport@bms.com. Visit eeo-accessibility to access our complete Equal Employment Opportunity statement.

Candidate Rights

BMS will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, pursuant to applicable laws in your area.

If you live in or expect to work from Los Angeles County if hired for this position, please visit this page for important additional information:

Data Protection

We will never request payments, financial information, or social security numbers during our application or recruitment process. Learn more about protecting yourself at .

Any data processed in connection with role applications will be treated in accordance with applicable data privacy policies and regulations.

If you believe that the job posting is missing information required by local law or incorrect in any way, please contact BMS at TAEnablement@bms.com. Please provide the Job Title and Requisition number so we can review. Communications related to your application should not be sent to this email and you will not receive a response. Inquiries related to the status of your application should be directed to Chat with Ripley.
